name: The One Ring, The Great Ring
subtitle: The Great Ring
text: While wearing The One Ring, each time bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead. Maneuver: Wear The One Ring until the regroup phase. Skirmish: Add a burden to make the Ring-bearer strength +3.

name: Gollum, Threatening Guide
subtitle: Threatening Guide
lore: 'But if we was master, then we could help ourselfs, yes....'
text: Gollum is strength +1 for each threat you can spot. Each time Gollum wins a skirmish, you may add a threat.

name: Sméagol, Pitiable Guide
subtitle: Pitiable Guide
lore: ...now that I see him, I do pity him.
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, you may shuffle up to 2 [gollum] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck. Skirmish: Exert a Ring-bound companion to make Sméagol strength +2.

name: Aragorn, Well-traveled Guide
subtitle: Well-traveled Guide
lore: The skill of the Elves can reforge the sword of Kings, but only you have the power to wield it.
text: Fellowship. Ranger. While the Ring-bearer is the only other companion you can spot, Aragorn is an archer, defender +1, and can take no more than 1 wound each skirmish.

name: Boromir, Destined Guide
subtitle: Destined Guide
lore: In a dream, I saw the eastern sky grow dark.
text: Fellowship. Ranger. While you can spot two unbound Hobbits, Boromir's twilight cost is -1. Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, you may exert an unbound Hobbit to discard each minion he is skirmishing from play.

name: Not Bound to His Fate
lore: Your time will come. You will face the same evil....
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [gondor] Man. At the end of each turn, if bearer is not Aragorn, return this condition to hand.

name: Strength in My Blood
lore: I would have followed you my Brother... my Captain... my King!
text: Bearer must be a fellowship companion. While bearer is a [gondor] companion, he or she is damage +1.

name: Gríma, Servant of Another Master
subtitle: Servant of Another Master
text: When you play Gríma, you may remove (4) to exert an unbound companion. That companion cannot use special abilities until the regroup phase. Assignment: Exert Gríma to assign him to an unbound companion. That companion may exert to prevent this.

name: Urgency
lore: If the mountain defeats you, will you risk a more dangerous road?
text: Weather. Each time the fellowship moves, add (2) for each Ent you can spot. Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a non-[wraith] minion strength +1.

name: The Balrog, Demon of Might
subtitle: Demon of Might
lore: The flames roared up to greet it, and wreathed about it....
text: Damage +2. Fierce. While at an underground site, skip the archery phase, the maneuver phase, and The Balrog cannot be assigned to skirmish companions of strength 6 or less.

name: Reaching Tentacle
lore: Frodo felt something seize him by the ankle....
text: Tentacle. This minion cannot bear possessions. Discard this minion from play if not at a marsh. This minion is strength +1 for each tentacle you can spot.

name: Gimli, Opinionated Guide
subtitle: Opinionated Guide
lore: If anyone was to ask for my opinion, which I note they're not, I'd say we were taking the long way round.
text: Fellowship. Damage +1. Each time you play a [dwarven] possession, you may draw a card.

name: Strong Tentacle
lore: One came wriggling over the threshold....
text: Tentacle. This minion cannot bear possessions. Discard this minion from play if not at a marsh. This minion is strength +1 for each tentacle you can spot.

name: Watcher in the Water, Many-tentacled Creature
subtitle: Many-tentacled Creature
lore: ...as if a host of snakes were swimming up....
text: Discard all other minions (except tentacles). Watcher in the Water cannot bear possessions. The fellowship's current site gains marsh. Shadow: Play a tentacle from your discard pile.

name: Pit Troll
lore: Black blood. Flat feet. Scaly skin.
text: Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) To play, spot an [orc] Orc. When you play this minion, add 2 threats. The Free Peoples player may exert the Ring-bearer to prevent this.

name: Troll of the Deep, Cave Troll
subtitle: Cave Troll
lore: Stones to move. Bridges to be rebuilt.
text: To play, spot an [orc] Orc. Skirmish: Remove a threat to make an [orc] minion strength +2.

name: Brought Down from Inside
lore: Bring it down! Bring it down! Bring it down!
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. At the start of each skirmish you may transfer this condition to a [rohan] Man. At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, return this condition to hand.

name: Éomer, Éored Captain
subtitle: Éored Captain
lore: Now is the hour, Riders of Rohan, oaths you have taken! Now, fulfill them all! To Lord and Land!
text: Valiant. Éomer is strength +2 for each wound on each minion he is skirmishing.

name: Éowyn, Lady of the Mark
subtitle: Lady of the Mark
lore: It's tradition for the women of the court to farewell the men.
text: Valiant. Fellowship: Play a [rohan] companion with a twilight cost of 3 or more; his or her twilight cost is -1.

name: Sauron's Might
lore: One by one, the free lands of Middle-earth fell to the power of the Ring.
text: Remove a Free Peoples culture token to add a threat. When you play this event, you may remove (1) to place this on the bottom of your draw deck instead of in your discard pile.

name: Frodo, Little Master
subtitle: Little Master
lore: We're friends of Gandalf the Grey.
text: Ring-bearer. Ring-bound. Fellowship. While you cannot spot 4 threats, Shadow cards cannot discard cards from your hand or from the top of your draw deck.

name: Merry, Resolute Friend
subtitle: Resolute Friend
lore: 'You can trust us to stick to you through thick and thin – to the bitter end.'
text: Fellowship. Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, take 2 [shire] cards from your discard pile and remove them from the game to make a companion strength +2.

name: Still Twitching
text: Bearer must be a [dwarven] companion. Bearer gains hunter 2. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [dwarven] companion. At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, discard this condition from play.

name: Pippin, Steadfast Friend
subtitle: Steadfast Friend
lore: 'You must go – and therefore we must, too. Merry and I are coming with you.'
text: Fellowship. Pippin is strength +1 for each tale you can spot.

name: Rabbit Stew
text: Bearer must be a [shire] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to a fellowship companion. Each time this condition is transferred to a companion, heal that companion.

name: Sam, Loyal Friend
subtitle: Loyal Friend
text: Ring-bound. Fellowship. While Sam bears The One Ring, he is resistance -4. While you can spot 3 [shire] companions, Sam is strength +2. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer.

name: Lurtz, Resilient Captain
subtitle: Resilient Captain
lore: The Uruk-hai leader walked into view on the misty hilltop beneath the dark trees. Hungry for blood.
text: Archer. Damage +1. Response: If Lurtz is about to take a wound or be exerted, remove (2) (or exert another Uruk-hai) to prevent that wound or exertion.

name: In Twilight
lore: The Nazgûl's true forms were revealed to him, shining like ghostly Kings.
text: Bearer must be a [wraith] minion. When you play this, you may draw a card. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [wraith] minion.

name: Úlairë Attëa, Dark Predator
subtitle: Dark Predator
lore: Those that knew the most power as kings were placed in particular ways for the will of Sauron.
text: Fierce. While you can spot 5 twilight tokens in the twilight pool and another [wraith] card, Úlairë Attëa is strength +3.

name: Úlairë Enquëa, Dark Threat
subtitle: Dark Threat
lore: The Nine Riders were embodiments of Sauron's will, searching all of Middle-earth for his prize.
text: Fierce. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions and discard a Nazgûl from hand to wound an unbound companion.

name: Úlairë Lemenya, Dark Enemy
subtitle: Dark Enemy
lore: 'Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'
text: Fierce. Úlairë Lemenya is strength +1 for each [wraith] possession in your discard pile.

name: Úlairë Nertëa, Dark Horseman
subtitle: Dark Horseman
lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.
text: Fierce. When you play Úlairë Nertëa, name a race. The Free Peoples player cannot assign Úlairë Nertëa to skirmish a companion of the named race.

name: Úlairë Toldëa, Dark Shadow
subtitle: Dark Shadow
lore: Open, in the name of Mordor!' said a voice thin and menacing.
text: Fierce. Úlairë Toldëa cannot be assigned to skirmish the same companion in a fierce skirmish that he has already been assigned to this turn.

name: That's Two!
lore: Legolas, two already!
text: Spot Gimli and exert a fellowship companion to have each Shadow player discard one of his or her Shadow cards from play.

name: The Witch-king, Dark Lord
subtitle: Dark Lord
lore: 'A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'
text: Fierce. Skirmish: Discard a Nazgûl from hand to make The Witch-king strength +1 (or strength +2 if you can spot that discarded Nazgûl).

name: Army Long Trained
text: Bearer must be an [elven] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another [elven] companion. At the start of the archery phase, you must exert bearer or return this condition to hand.

name: Arwen, Royal Maiden
subtitle: Royal Maiden
lore: I would rather share one lifetime with you than face all the ages of this world alone.
text: Ranger. While you can spot 2 [elven] followers, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -2. Maneuver: Add 3 threats to reconcile your hand.

name: Legolas, Skeptical Guide
subtitle: Skeptical Guide
lore: Have you heard nothing Lord Elrond has said? The Ring must be destroyed!
text: Fellowship. Archer. Archery: Add two threats to wound a minion; Legolas does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Gandalf, Wise Guide
subtitle: Wise Guide
lore: The Ring yearns above all else to return to the hand of its master. They are one, the Ring and the Dark Lord. Frodo, he must never find it.
text: Fellowship. Response: If an event is played, exert Gandalf twice to cancel that event.

name: Stern Words
text: To play, spot a [gandalf] Wizard. Bearer must be a companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this condition to another companion. At the end of each turn, return this condition to hand.

name: Dunlending Rampager
lore: To kill and destroy was the mission of the wild hillmen.
text: When you play this minion, the Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards from hand to discard him.

name: Balglin, Elven Warrior
subtitle: Elven Warrior
lore: He is a strong fighter. He asks for no quarter and gives none.
text: To play, spot an Elf. While skirmishing a wounded minion, Balglin takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.

name: Grishnákh, Orc Captain
subtitle: Orc Captain
lore: 'They might agree with me, with Grishnákh....'
text: Tracker. The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -3. Shadow: Exert Grishnákh twice and spot another [sauron] Orc to draw 3 cards. The Free Peoples player may add 2 burdens to prevent this.

name: I'd Make You Squeak
lore: 'If I had my way, you'd wish you were dead now.'
text: To play, exert 2 [sauron] Orcs. Plays to your support area. The Shadow number of each site is +1 for each wound on a Hobbit (limit +3).

name: Morannon
lore: The black gate of Mordor were called the Morannon.
text: Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of the first [sauron] Orc played at site 4[T] is -3. Shadow: Spot 2 [sauron] Orcs and discard 4 cards from hand to draw 3 cards. Discard this condition.

name: Orc Captain
lore: ...far away from hidden holds and outposts in the hills came answering calls....
text: When you play this minion, you may spot a [sauron] condition to draw a card for each site you control (limit 3).

name: Orc Cutthroat
lore: A few Orc casualties were of no concern to him.
text: Tracker. The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -3. Skirmish: Discard another [sauron] Orc and exert Orc Cutthroat to wound a companion he is skirmishing.

name: Orc Fighter
lore: The Orcs of Mordor extended the will of Sauron to control the weak Men of the East.
text: Regroup: Spot a [sauron] condition and exert this minion to take control of a site.

name: Orc Infantry
lore: Barad-dûr sent Orcs to all corners of Middle-earth.
text: Regroup: Spot a [sauron] condition and discard this minion to take control of a site.

name: Orc Patrol
lore: Sauron's Orcs ranged far and wide, searching for Baggins and the Ring.
text: Tracker. The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -3. Maneuver: Exert Orc Patrol twice and spot another [sauron] Orc to discard a condition.

name: Orc Pursuer
lore: '...why not kill them now? They're a cursed nuisance, and we're in a hurry.'
text: Tracker. The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1. When you play this minion, you may exert him and remove (2) to draw a card.

name: Orc Runner
lore: 'There's no time to kill them properly.... No time for play on this trip.'
text: Tracker. The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1. When you play this minion, you may exert him and discard 2 cards from hand to draw a card.

name: Break the Charge
lore: A storm of white arrows answered the attacking hand of Isengard.
text: Archery: Exert 3 Elf companions to make the fellowship archery total +2.

name: Teeth of Mordor
lore: None could pass the Teeth of Mordor and not feel their bite....
text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Spot a [sauron] Orc and remove (3) to stack that minion here. Shadow: Play a [sauron] Orc stacked here as if played from hand.

name: Frodo, Master of the Precious
subtitle: Master of the Precious
lore: 'We promises, yes I promise!... Good master, good Sméagol, gollum, gollum!'
text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Fellowship: Add a burden to play Sméagol from your discard pile.

name: No Help for It
lore: '...he'll come back, you'll see. The promise will hold yet a while. And he won't leave his Precious, anyway.'
text: Regroup: Spot Sam and discard Sméagol or Gollum to remove 3 burdens.

name: No Use That Way
lore: 'Don't take the Precious to Him!... Keep it, nice master, and be kind to Sméagol.'
text: Skirmish: Add 3 burdens to wound a minion skirmishing a companion who has the Frodo signet twice.

name: Rare Good Ballast
lore: 'What a hobbit needs with coney... is some herbs and roots, especially taters – not to mention bread.'
text: Plays on Sam. Response: If a regroup special ability is used, discard Sméagol or Gollum to cancel that action.

name: Sam, Nice Sensible Hobbit
subtitle: Nice Sensible Hobbit
lore: 'Trust Sméagol now? Very, very good.'
text: Ring-bound. While you can spot Frodo and Sméagol, Sam may not be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: Sting, Baggins Heirloom
subtitle: Baggins Heirloom
lore: 'This is Sting. You have seen it before once upon a time.'
text: Bearer must be Frodo. Skirmish: Exert Frodo to make Sméagol strength +2 or Gollum strength -2.

name: You Must Help Us
lore: 'You will have to come with us, that's all, while we keep an eye on you.'
text: Fellowship: Play Sméagol from your discard pile to heal each Ring-bound Hobbit twice.

name: Hornburg Wall
text: Regroup: Spot your minion and remove (9) to make the fellowship move again this turn (if the move limit allows).

name: Nan Curunír
text: Plains. Response: If your mounted minion is about to take a wound, remove (2) to prevent that wound.

name: Legolas' Sword
lore: Legolas wielded a longsword to strike from horseback.
text: Bearer must be Legolas. Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot a wounded minion to heal Legolas.

name: Caverns of Isengard
text: Underground. The Free Peoples player wins the game only if the Ring-bearer survives until Shadow players reconcile.

name: Legolas, Archer of Mirkwood
subtitle: Archer of Mirkwood
lore: '...even more would I give for a hundred good archers of Mirkwood. We shall need them.'
text: Archer. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a Dwarf companion or another Elf companion.

name: Éowyn, Daughter of Éomund
subtitle: Daughter of Éomund
lore: 'Let the heralds announce to the folk that Lady Éowyn will lead them!'
text: Valiant. Maneuver: Play a [rohan] possession on Éowyn to heal her.

name: Taurnil, Sharp-eyed Bowman
subtitle: Sharp-eyed Bowman
lore: Taurnil's careful aim can disarm his enemies at long range.
text: To play, spot an Elf. While Taurnil bears a ranged weapon, the twilight cost of each Shadow possession is +2, and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: That Is No Orc Horn
lore: Anxious defenders cheered the welcome sound of Elvish trumpets.
text: Regroup: Spot 3 Elf companions to heal a companion and liberate a site.

name: Birchseed, Tall Statesman
subtitle: Tall Statesman
lore: Slender and royal, he presided over many Entmoots.
text: Unhasty. Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit or discard 2 cards from hand to allow Birchseed to skirmish. Fellowship: Exert Birchseed to heal an unbound Hobbit.

name: Down From the Hills
lore: Down leaped Shadowfax, like a deer....
text: Spell. Maneuver: Exert Gandalf 3 times to make an unbound companion with the Gandalf signet strength +5, defender +1, damage +2, and unable to take wounds until the regroup phase.

name: Forest Guardian
lore: 'We keep off strangers and the foolhardy; and we train and we teach, we walk and we weed.'
text: Unhasty. Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit or discard 2 cards from hand to allow this companion to skirmish.

name: Fury of the White Rider
lore: The White Rider was upon them, and the terror of his coming filled the enemy with madness.
text: Spell. Maneuver: Spot 3 twilight tokens and exert Gandalf to wound a minion twice.

name: Lindenroot, Elder Shepherd
subtitle: Elder Shepherd
lore: A most well-founded and considerate Ent.
text: Unhasty. Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit or discard 2 cards from hand to allow Lindenroot to skirmish. Skirmish: Exert Lindenroot to wound an [isengard] minion he is skirmishing.

name: Dunlending Renegade
lore: The strength of the hillmen was driven by passion and anger.
text: When you play this minion, the Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards from hand to discard him.

name: Turn of the Tide
lore: 'Indeed my friends, none of you have any weapon that could hurt me.'
text: Spell. Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to discard up to 2 Shadow possessions. Any Shadow player may discard a minion to prevent this.

name: Be Back Soon
lore: 'Now I wonder where he's got to?'
text: Maneuver: Discard Sméagol to discard a minion. An opponent may exert a minion twice to prevent this.

name: Evil-smelling Fens
lore: 'No birds here. There are snakeses, wormses, things in the pools. Lots of things, lots of nasty things.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each site on the adventure path is a marsh. Shadow: Exert Gollum twice and discard this condition to play a minion from your discard pile.

name: Follow Sméagol
lore: 'Follow Sméagol very carefully, and you may go a long way, quite a long way, before He catches you, yes perhaps.'
text: Plays on Sméagol. Regroup: Exert Sméagol or Gollum to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

name: Gollum, Nasty Treacherous Creature
subtitle: Nasty Treacherous Creature
lore: '...we won't let you go, either. You're full of wickedness and mischief, Gollum.'
text: Regroup: Discard Gollum to exert a companion or ally.

name: Gollum, Stinker
subtitle: Stinker
lore: 'Still he's a Baggins, my precious, yes, a Baggins. A Baggins stole it. He found it and he said nothing. We hates Bagginses.'
text: Gollum is strength +1 for each burden. Each time Gollum wins a skirmish, you may add a burden.

name: Look at Him
lore: 'That's what it is. It's that Gollum! Snakes and adders! And to think I thought that we'd puzzle him with our bit of a climb!'
text: Shadow: Spot Sméagol or Gollum to add (1) for each burden.

name: Poor Wretch
lore: 'Throttle us in our sleep, that's his plan.'
text: Plays on Sméagol. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make Sméagol damage +1.

name: Sméagol, Old Noser
subtitle: Old Noser
lore: 'Could you find anything fit for a hungry hobbit?'
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Regroup: Exert Sméagol (or Gollum) twice to reveal the top 4 cards of your draw deck. Wound a minion for each Shadow card revealed. Place those 4 cards beneath your draw deck in any order.

name: Sméagol, Slinker
subtitle: Slinker
lore: '...that it is my fate to receive help from you, where I least looked for it, and your fate to help me whom you long pursued with evil purpose.'
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Skirmish: Add a burden to make Sméagol strength +2 and take no wounds.

name: Leaping Blaze
lore: ...they saw torches, countless points of fiery light upon the black fields behind, scattered like red flowers, or winding up from the lowlands....
text: Shadow: Spot 3 [dunland] minions to shuffle your hand into your draw deck and draw 8 cards. The Free Peoples player may discard 3 cards from hand to prevent this.

name: We Must Have It
lore: 'No, sweet one. See, my precious: if we has it, then we can escape, even from Him, eh?'
text: Shadow: Play Gollum from your draw deck or discard pile. Skirmish: Discard a card at random from hand to make Gollum strength +3.

name: Alcarin, Warrior of Lamedon
subtitle: Warrior of Lamedon
lore: Named for a mighty king, Alcarin is determined to prove himself in battle.
text: Knight. The twilight cost of each other knight in your starting fellowship is -1. Assignment: Assign Alcarin to a minion bearing a [gondor] fortification to heal Alcarin.

name: Citadel of the Stars
lore: The city of Osgiliath was the first capital of Gondor.
text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

name: City Wall
lore: The war-weary defenses of Osgiliath still protected the Men of Gondor.
text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

name: Fall Back
lore: Osgiliath's defenses protected the Gondorian troops.
text: Skirmish: Discard all Shadow cards borne by a minion bearing a [gondor] fortification.

name: Gondorian Knight
lore: Soldiers of Gondor share a long heritage of defending their borders against Sauron's attackers.
text: Knight.

name: Knight of Gondor
lore: The brave men of Gondor's army were well-armed and armored.
text: Knight. Fellowship: Discard a [gondor] condition to heal this companion.

name: Men of Númenor
lore: '...I do not love the bright sword for its sharpness, nor the arrow for its swiftness, nor the warrior for his glory....'
text: Skirmish: Wound a minion bearing a [gondor] fortification.

name: Rally Point
lore: A strategic fallback helps Gondorian knights to plan their counterattack.
text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a knight to transfer a [gondor] fortification borne by a minion to your support area.

name: Stone Tower
lore: The battlements of Osgiliath provided some defense against Sauron's attackers.
text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert 2 [gondor] Men to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

name: Wild Men of the Hills
lore: The swarm of Dunlendings destroyed everything in its path.
text: The twilight cost of this minion is -2 during the skirmish phase. When you play this minion, the Free Peoples player may discard 4 cards from hand to discard it.

name: Take Cover
lore: Gondor forces at Osgiliath were too few to fight the advancing armies in the field.
text: Fellowship: Exert a knight to play a [gondor] fortification from your discard pile.

name: These Are My People
lore: '...I will die as one of them.'
text: Fellowship: Exert Aragorn twice to play any number of possessions from your discard pile onto companions with the Aragorn signet.

name: Turgon, Man of Belfalas
subtitle: Man of Belfalas
lore: He hopes to someday become one of the knights of Dol Amroth.
text: Knight. To play, spot a knight. Maneuver: Exert Turgon to wound a minion bearing a [gondor] fortification.

name: War Must Be
lore: '...we defend ourselves against a destroyer who would devour all....'
text: Skirmish: Make a [gondor] Man strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a minion bearing a [gondor] fortification).

name: Battering Ram
lore: The trees... smote the timbers with a rending boom.
text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [isengard] token on this card. Skirmish: Spot 5 companions and an [isengard] token here to make an Uruk-hai damage +1. Discard this condition.

name: Berserk Rager
lore: Their mission at Helm's Deep was to clear the walls.
text: Damage +1. Berserk Rager is strength +1 for each wound on a character in its skirmish. Skirmish: Remove 3 [isengard] tokens from a machine and exert Berserk Rager twice to wound every ally twice.

name: Berserk Savage
lore: Skull-like helmets are distinctive to the Berserkers.
text: Damage +1. Berserk Savage is strength +1 for each wound on a character in its skirmish. Skirmish: Remove 4 [isengard] tokens from a machine and exert Berserk Savage twice to make it strength +8.

name: Berserk Slayer
lore: Berserkers are the first wave of Uruks sent to battle.
text: Damage +1. Berserk Slayer is strength +2 for each wound on a character in its skirmish. Skirmish: Remove 5 [isengard] tokens from a machine and exert Berserk Slayer twice to wound every companion.

name: Black Shapes Crawling
lore: Some were squat and broad, some were tall and grim, with high helms and sable shields.
text: Maneuver: Spot X Uruk-hai. The Free Peoples player may assign X wounds to your minions. Play X [isengard] weapons from your discard pile.

name: Devilry of Orthanc
lore: 'They have a blasting fire, and... they took the Wall.'
text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [isengard] token on this card. Maneuver: Spot 8 [isengard] tokens here to exert every character. Discard this condition.

name: Baruk Khazâd
lore: ...a small dark figure that none had observed sprang out of the shadows and gave a hoarse shout....
text: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to wound a minion. You may take the next maneuver action.

name: Foul Horde
text: Warg-rider. While Foul Horde is not exhausted, it is fierce. While Foul Horde has at least 3 vitality, it is ambush (1). While Foul Horde has at least 4 vitality, it is damage +1.

name: Gríma, Chief Counselor
subtitle: Chief Counselor
lore: 'I care for you and yours as best I may.... Let others deal with these irksome guests.'
text: Maneuver: Spot 4 Free Peoples cultures and exert Gríma to return an unbound companion, and all cards on him or her, to their owners' hands.

name: Isengard Flanker
lore: Sharku used his warg-riders to scout and defend.
text: Warg-rider. While this minion is not exhausted, he is fierce.

name: Isengard Rider
lore: 'He has taken Orcs into his service, and Wolf-riders, and evil Men....'
text: Warg-rider. While this minion is not exhausted, he is fierce.

name: Isengard Scimitar
lore: Orcs from Isengard favor a short, curved sword when mounted.
text: Bearer must be an [isengard] Orc. When you play this weapon, you may add (1) for each site you control.

name: Isengard Scout Troop
lore: '...where the warg howls, there also the orc prowls.'
text: Warg-rider. While this minion is not exhausted, it is fierce. Each time an [isengard] Orc wins a skirmish, you may exert this minion to control a site.

name: Saruman, Master of Foul Folk
subtitle: Master of Foul Folk
text: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. Each time the fellowship moves, you may heal each [isengard] Orc twice. Shadow: Exert Saruman to play an [isengard] possession from your discard pile.

name: Scaling Ladder
lore: Hundreds of long ladders were lifted up. Many were cast down in ruin, but many more replaced them....
text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [isengard] token on this card. Skirmish: Spot an [isengard] token here to heal an Uruk-hai. Discard this condition.

name: Sharku, Warg-captain
subtitle: Warg-captain
lore: Only Sharku commanded enough respect to control Saruman's warg-riders.
text: Warg-rider. While Sharku is not exhausted, he is fierce. Each time you play an [isengard] mount, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion (except a Hobbit).

name: Sharku's Warg
lore: The warg-captain picked the fastest and strongest mount.
text: Bearer must be a warg-rider. If bearer is Sharku, he is damage +1. Response: If a skirmish special ability is used in a skirmish involving bearer, exert bearer to cancel that action.

name: Defending the Keep
lore: 'I have fought many wars, master Dwarf. I know how to defend my own Keep.'
text: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to draw a card or play a [dwarven] condition from your discard pile.

name: Siege Engine
lore: Ropes... were hurled over the parapet....
text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Play an Uruk-hai to place an [isengard] token on a machine. Response: If one or more machines are about to be discarded by an opponent, discard this condition to prevent that.

name: Uruk Engineer
lore: Trained Uruk-hai operated Saruman's siege engines at Helm's Deep.
text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may place an [isengard] token on a machine.

name: Uruk Sapper
lore: The destruction of the Hornburg fortifications was the task of Saruman's engineer troops.
text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may place an [isengard] token on a machine.

name: Uruk-hai Berserker
lore: Goatskins full of blood poured upon berserkers before battle instill their bloodlust.
text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each wound on a character in its skirmish.

name: War-warg
lore: Bigger and stronger wargs were ridden into battle.
text: Bearer must be a warg-rider. Response: If a skirmish special ability is used in a skirmish involving bearer, exert bearer to cancel that action.

name: Warg
lore: 'Tell him there is no hope ahead. He should return to Edoras before the wolves of Isengard come there.'
text: Bearer must be a warg-rider. Response: If a skirmish special ability is used in a skirmish involving bearer, exert bearer to cancel that action.

name: Warg-master
lore: '...yet I feared that wolf-riders and plunderers might ride nonetheless to Meduseld, while it was undefended.'
text: Warg-rider. When you play this minion, you may play an [isengard] mount from your discard pile. While this minion is not exhausted, he is fierce.

name: Warg-rider
lore: Swiftly a scout rode back and reported that wolf-riders were abroad in the valley....
text: Warg-rider. While this minion is not exhausted, he is fierce.

name: Wolf-voices
lore: '...these howls freeze my blood.'
text: Skirmish: Make an [isengard] Orc strength +2 (and heal it if mounted).

name: Wolves of Isengard
lore: Saruman's warg-riders traveled the plains faster than even the Riders of Rohan.
text: Plays on a plains site you control. Regroup: Exert an [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

name: Gimli, Skilled Defender
subtitle: Skilled Defender
lore: Despite Théoden's preparations, Gimli found it necessary to warn him of the advancing Uruk army.
text: Damage +1. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion assigned to skirmish an unbound companion.

name: Army of Haradrim
lore: The desert lords of Harad support their huge forces with mammoth war beasts.
text: Southron. Skirmish: Remove (3) to play a [raider] mount from your discard pile.

name: Company of Haradrim
lore: The quick movements of Southron soldiers cut off all paths of retreat.
text: Southron. Regroup: Remove (9) and spot another Southron to make the move limit -1 for this turn (to a minimum of 1).

name: Desert Stalker
lore: They strike only when their prey is haggard and tired.
text: Southron. Ambush (2). Maneuver: Exert this minion and spot 4 Free Peoples cultures to exert every companion.

name: Mûmak
lore: Sam saw a vast shape crash out of the trees and come careening down the slope.
text: Bearer must be a Southron. Bearer is fierce. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may add (2).

name: Southron Marcher
lore: Hardy desert warriors needed little rest.
text: Southron. Ambush (2). While you can spot a Southron, this minion's twilight cost is -2.

name: Southron Runner
lore: Swift scouts track enemy movements to set up surprise attacks.
text: Southron. Ambush (2). While you can spot a Southron, this minion's twilight cost is -2.

name: Southron Traveler
lore: Men of Harad were used to long journeys.
text: Southron. Ambush (2). Response: If a Southron is about to take a wound, remove (3) to prevent that wound.

name: Strength in Numbers
lore: Lacking arms and armor, the Haradrim use swift movements to outnumber their opponents.
text: To play, spot a Southron. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Discard this condition to add (1) for each Man with ambush you spot.

name: War Mûmak
lore: 'Big as a house, much bigger than a house, it looked to him, a grey-clad moving hill.'
text: Bearer must be a Southron. Bearer is fierce. Each time bearer overwhelms a character, you may add (5).

name: Armory
lore: 'Choose from these ere we go, and may they serve you well!'
text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Spot 2 [rohan] Men to remove 2 tokens from a machine or to take a [rohan] possession into hand from your discard pile. Discard this condition.

name: Horn of Helm
lore: ...sudden and terrible, from the tower above, the sound of the great horn of Helm rang out.
text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf companion to make each minion at a battleground lose all damage bonuses until the regroup phase.

name: Arrow-slits
lore: Here and there were clefts in the stone through which men could shoot.
text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Spot 2 [rohan] Men to discard a possession or a machine. Discard this condition.

name: Ecglaf, Courageous Farmer
subtitle: Courageous Farmer
lore: Like many of the Rohirrim, Ecglaf no longer had a home awaiting his return.
text: Villager. Fellowship: Exert Ecglaf and spot 2 valiant Men to play a [rohan] possession from your discard pile.

name: Gamling, Warrior of Rohan
subtitle: Warrior of Rohan
lore: He was one of Théoden's most trusted lieutenants.
text: Valiant. To play, spot a [rohan] Man. Skirmish: Play a [rohan] possession on Gamling to make him strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Household Guard
lore: The king and the men of his household were in the Hornburg....
text: Valiant.

name: I Am Here
lore: 'The last host of the Eorlingas has ridden forth. It will not return without battle.'
text: Fellowship: Exert Théoden twice to heal every other companion with the Théoden signet twice.

name: Let Us Be Swift
lore: 'Let us drive through such foes as are already between us and the fastness.'
text: Regroup: Spot 3 valiant Men to discard up to 2 conditions and liberate a site.

name: No Rest for the Weary
lore: 'We must draw all our forces now behind the walls.'
text: Maneuver: Spot 3 valiant Men to make one of those Men defender +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Parapet
lore: Upon the spur of rock from the cliff stood high walls of ancient stone.
text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. Archery: Spot 2 [rohan] Men to remove 2 tokens from a machine or to make the minion archery total -3. Discard this condition.

name: Rohirrim Bow
lore: 'The Rohirrim have good bowmen after their fashion, but there are too few here, too few.'
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. Archery: Exert bearer and discard this possession to wound a minion.

name: Rohirrim Helm
lore: The armory of Helm's Deep provided raiment of war for her defenders.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. Skirmish: Discard this possession to cancel a skirmish involving bearer. A minion in this skirmish may exert to prevent this.

name: More to My Liking
lore: 'This country has tough bones.'
text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Stack the top card from your draw deck here (limit once per phase). Maneuver: Spot a Dwarf and discard a card stacked on a [dwarven] condition to take a Free Peoples card stacked here into hand.

name: Rohirrim Scout
lore: ...scouts rode out far ahead, passing like shadows in the folds of the land.
text: Valiant. Regroup: Exert this companion and spot a [rohan] possession to return that possession to hand.

name: Rohirrim Shield
lore: The Rohirrim carried round wooden shields, usable on foot and on horseback.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. The minion archery total is -1. Regroup: Discard this possession to heal bearer.

name: Sigewulf, Brave Volunteer
subtitle: Brave Volunteer
lore: The courage of Sigewulf and other Rohirrim like him will not be forgotten.
text: Villager. Regroup: Exert Sigewulf and spot 5 valiant Men to discard a minion.

name: Théoden, King of the Golden Hall
subtitle: King of the Golden Hall
lore: 'You thought I remained in Meduseld bent like an old tree under winter snow.... But a west wind has shaken the boughs.'
text: Valiant. Maneuver: Play a [rohan] possession on Théoden to heal a [rohan] ally.

name: Thundering Host
lore: ...with a rush like the sudden onset of a great wind the last host of Rohan rode thundering into the West.
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a mounted [rohan] Man strength +3 (and heal that Man if at a plains).

name: Dead Marshes
text: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 4[T], Ring-bound companions skirmishing [sauron] Orcs are strength -1. Maneuver: Spot 2 [sauron] Orcs to play up to 2 [sauron] conditions from your discard pile. Discard this condition.

name: Eye of Barad-Dûr
lore: The Lidless Eye looked out from Sauron's fortress.
text: Skirmish: Make a companion or ally skirmishing a [sauron] Orc strength -1 for each Ring-bound companion. Response: If a Free Peoples player reveals this card from your hand, discard this card to add 2 burdens.

name: Gate Soldier
lore: ...a host of orcs lurked, ready at a signal to issue forth like black ants going to war.
text: When you play a [sauron] condition, you may exert this minion and remove (2) to draw a card.

name: Gate Trooper
lore: Another dreadful day of fear and toil had come to Mordor; and the night-guards were summoned....
text: When you play this minion, you may exert him and spot 5 burdens to draw a card.

name: Gate Veteran
lore: ...the day-guards, evil-eyed and fell, were marching to their posts.
text: When you play this minion, you may exert him and spot 6 companions to draw a card.

name: Argument Ready to Hand
lore: 'And you, Master Dwarf, pray take your hand from your axe-haft, till I am up! You will not need such arguments.'
text: Spot a Dwarf to choose a Shadow player who must spot a race. Discard from play all minions of all other races.

name: No Pauses, No Spills
lore: And no regurgitation!
text: Toil 2. (For each [dwarven] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot 2 Dwarves to draw up to 4 cards.

name: Rallying Orc
lore: Orcs can spring from the shadows in surprising numbers.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time you play another [orc] lurker at a battleground or underground site, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.

name: Retribution
lore: With his mighty army, the Dark Lord exacted a high price for resisting his will.
text: Each time an [orc] minion bearing a weapon wins a skirmish, add a burden. Shadow: Discard this condition to play an [orc] weapon from your discard pile.

name: Scavenging Goblins
lore: 'The Orcs have often plundered Moria; there is nothing left in the upper halls.'
text: When you play this minion, you may play an [orc] weapon from your discard pile on your [orc] Orc.

name: Storming the Ramparts
lore: The defenses of Minas Tirith were daunting, but the siegecraft of the Orcs was equal to the challenge.
text: Toil 2. (For each [orc] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot an [orc] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions from play.

name: Taunt
lore: 'Go on. Call for help. Squeal! No one's gonna save you now.'
text: Reveal the top 5 cards of your draw deck (or, if the fellowship is at a battleground site, the top 7 cards) to make an [orc] minion strength +1 for each [orc] card revealed.

name: Troll's Keyward, Keeper of the Beast
subtitle: Keeper of the Beast
lore: Tending the Cave Troll is a task neither envied or respected within the tribes of Moria.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Shadow: Exert Troll's Keyward and reveal your hand to add (1) for each [orc] Troll revealed.

name: Vile Goblin
lore: The Orcs infesting Khazad-dûm despoiled and defiled the ancient Dwarven mansion.
text: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a Dwarf, this minion is fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Aldred, Éored Soldier
subtitle: Éored Soldier
lore: 'We counted all the slain and despoiled them....'
text: At the start of each skirmish involving Aldred, you may discard a possession borne by a minion he is skirmishing.

name: Cast Out
text: Toil 2. (For each [rohan] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Maneuver: Spot a [rohan] Man and discard this condition to exert a minion. Maneuver: Spot a mounted [rohan] Man and discard this condition to return an exhausted minion to its owner's hand.

name: Challenging the Orc-host
lore: '...we overtook the Orcs at nightfall two days ago, near to the borders of the Entwood. There we surrounded them, and gave battle....'
text: Make a [rohan] companion strength +2 (or +1 for each minion you can spot if that companion has resistance 5 or more).

name: Nobody Tosses a Dwarf
lore: 'My folk have never had dealings with any of the servants of the Enemy.'
text: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, make an opponent discard 3 cards from the top of his or her draw deck.

name: Cleaving a Path
lore: Captains and champions fell or fled before them.
text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [rohan] companion strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is at a plains site; he or she has resistance 4 or more; he or she is bearing armor; he or she is skirmishing a wounded minion.

name: Coif
lore: ...the Hornburg still held fast, like an island in a sea.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. Each time a Shadow card adds any number of twilight tokens, you may exert bearer to prevent that. Each time the fellowship moves from a forest site, exert a companion.

name: Éomer, Éored Leader
subtitle: Éored Leader
lore: ...the front of the first éored roared like a breaker foaming to the shore....
text: While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1. Maneuver: If you can spot more minions than companions, exert Éomer to play a [rohan] companion from your draw deck.

name: Éored Warrior
lore: '...suspecting what I most fear, a league between Orthanc and the Dark Tower, I led forth my éored, men of my own household....'
text: While this companion is at a battleground or plains site, he is strength +3.

name: For the Mark
lore: South strode Éomer and men fled before his face, and they were caught between the hammer and the anvil.
text: Spot a [rohan] Man to discard a possession from play. You may exert a [rohan] Man who has resistance 3 or more to play this event during the maneuver phase.

name: Golden Glimmer
lore: 'Dark is the hour, yet maybe we shall return to the Golden Hall.'
text: Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot a [rohan] companion and add 2 burdens to prevent that.

name: Haethen, Veteran Fighter
subtitle: Veteran Fighter
lore: His years as a Rider of Rohan were long behind him, but the threat to Helm's Deep demanded this old warrior again take up arms.
text: Haethen cannot take wounds during fierce skirmishes. Skirmish: Exert Haethen to make him strength +1.

name: Léofric, Defender of the Mark
subtitle: Defender of the Mark
lore: 'There is trouble now on all our borders, and we are threatened....'
text: Skirmish: If Léofric is in a skirmish, exert him to play a [rohan] skirmish event from your draw deck.

name: The Mouth of Sauron, Lieutenant of Barad-dûr
subtitle: Lieutenant of Barad-dûr
lore: 'Is there anyone in this rout with authority to treat with me?' he asked. 'Or indeed with wit to understand me?'
text: Assignment: Assign The Mouth of Sauron to the companion who has the highest strength. (If two or more are tied for highest, choose one.)

name: Bilbo, Melancholy Hobbit
subtitle: Melancholy Hobbit
lore: 'I want to see the wild country again before I die, and the Mountains....'
text: Ring-bound. At the start of each skirmish involving Bilbo, you may exert him to take a [shire] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.

name: Proud and Able
lore: 'Dwarves' tongues run on when speaking of their handiwork, they say.'
text: Each Dwarf is damage +1 for each possession he bears. Fellowship: Discard this condition to play a [dwarven] possession from your discard pile.

name: Diversion
lore: Each member of the fellowship was willing to make any sacrifice to safeguard the Quest.
text: Discard a Hobbit not assigned to a skirmish from play to discard a minion from play. If the fellowship is at a battleground site, you may add 2 burdens to play this event during a skirmish involving a Hobbit.

name: Flotsam and Jetsam
lore: 'Welcome, my lords, to Isengard!' he said. 'We are the doorwardens.'
text: If a companion (except a Hobbit) wins a skirmish, heal a Hobbit.

name: Home and Hearth
lore: He drew a deep breath. 'Well, I'm back,' he said.
text: Each time you play a Hobbit, you may remove a burden. Then, if the fellowship is at dwelling site, heal the Ring-bearer.

name: Hope is Kindled
lore: 'Soft as butter they can be, and yet sometimes as tough as old tree-roots.'
text: Make a Hobbit strength +2. If that Hobbit wins this skirmish, you may remove a burden.

name: Long Live the Halflings
lore: 'My friends, you bow to no one.'
text: To play, spot a Hobbit. Skirmish: If your Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to make each companion who has resistance 7 or more strength +2 until the regroup phase.

name: Measure of Comfort
lore: Though fate had it that the fellowship would not accompany Frodo to his final goal, some reassurance came in knowing he did not have to make the journey alone.
text: While you can spot a Hobbit, each unbound companion is resistance +1.

name: No Worse for Wear
lore: 'That was good.'\" \"'Let's get another one!'
text: Prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. Then, if the fellowship is at a dwelling site, you may discard 2 cards from hand to return this event to your hand.

name: Pippin, Hobbit of Some Intelligence
subtitle: Hobbit of Some Intelligence
lore: 'Anyway, you need people of intelligence on this sort of mission... quest... thing.'
text: When you play Pippin, remove a burden or heal a companion.

name: A Promise
lore: 'But I'm glad, Sam. I cannot tell you how glad. Come along! It is plain that we were meant to go together.'
text: While you can spot Frodo and Sam and neither is exhausted, each is strength +1.

name: Rosie Cotton, Barmaid
subtitle: Barmaid
lore: 'It seems she didn't like my going abroad at all....'
text: Sam cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns Rosie Cotton to a skirmish, add 2 burdens.

name: Sharp Defense
lore: Gimli hewed the legs from under another that had sprung up on Balin's Tomb.
text: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +2 for each possession he bears if he has resistance 4 or more).

name: Simple Living
lore: They do not and did not understand or like machines more complicated than a forge-bellows, a water-mill, or a hand-loom....
text: Response: If you play a [shire] event, discard this condition to heal each Hobbit.

name: Stand Together
lore: 'For a breathless time they sat there, silent and alert....'
text: Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, he or she gains muster until the end of the turn. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)

name: Sudden Fury
lore: It raised a whip a second time, but the blow never fell.
text: Each time a [shire] companion loses a skirmish, add a [shire] token here. Skirmish: Remove a [shire] token from here to make a [shire] companion strength +1.

name: Tolman Cotton, Farmer of Bywater
subtitle: Farmer of Bywater
lore: The land was rich and kindly, and though it had been long deserted when they entered it, it had before been well tilled....
text: Response: If a burden is about to be added by a Shadow card, spot another Hobbit and exert Tolman Cotton to prevent that.

name: Advancing Uruk
lore: 'Already they are scaling the bank at many points, thick as marching ants.'
text: Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) When you cannot spot another [uruk-hai] minion, discard this minion.

name: Barbaric Uruk
lore: Their lust for Man-flesh allowed Saruman to bend the Uruk-hai to his will.
text: Damage +1. Assignment: Make the Free Peoples player assign this minion to an unwounded companion.

name: Berserker Torch
lore: '...the Orcs have brought a devilry from Orthanc....'
text: Toil 1. (For each [uruk-hai] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.) Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai. Bearer is strength +2 for each wound on each character in its skirmish.

name: Breeding Pit Conscript
lore: A select few of Saruman's Uruk-hai were charged with harvesting his war-machine.
text: Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) When you play this minion, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.

name: Broken Heirloom
lore: '...he blew the horn. But no help came. Only more orcs.'
text: Toil 2. (For each [uruk-hai] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot an [uruk-hai] minion to discard a possession borne by a companion who has resistance 4 or less.

name: Broken in Defeat
lore: 'The world of Men will fall and all will come to darkness, and my city to ruin.'
text: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +2. Then you may spot 6 companions to return this event to your hand.

name: Stalwart Support
lore: '...I am glad to have you standing nigh....'
text: Each Dwarf gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) Each time the fellowship moves from a plains site, discard a card from your hand.

name: Crushing Uruk
lore: Uruks strike with crippling force.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Response: If a companion loses a skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] minion, exert this minion to discard a possession borne by that companion.

name: Dark Alliance
lore: The power of Isengard is at your command, Sauron, Lord of the Earth.
text: Response: If an ally or companion uses a special ability, discard this condition and exert an [uruk-hai] lurker to prevent that.

name: Merciless Uruk
lore: They reached the summit of the rock; they drove towards the gates.
text: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to place this minion on the bottom of your draw deck.

name: Quelling Force
lore: They gained the gates. The trees, swung by strong arms, smote the timbers with a rending boom.
text: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +1 for each other [uruk-hai] minion you can spot.

name: Saruman, Agent of the Dark Lord
subtitle: Agent of the Dark Lord
lore: 'There will be no dawn for Men.'
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Exert Saruman to make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +2. Each time a companion is killed, you may heal Saruman.

name: Shingle in a Storm
lore: Against the Deeping Wall the hosts of Isengard roared like a sea.
text: While you can spot 6 companions, each [uruk-hai] minion is damage +1. Assignment: Discard this condition to assign an [uruk-hai] minion to a companion who has resistance 2 or less.

name: Strange Device
lore: ...a small white hand in the centre of a black field.
text: Spot an [uruk-hai] minion to draw 3 cards. Then discard 2 cards from hand or discard an [uruk-hai] minion from hand.

name: Suppressing Uruk
lore: Few fighters are skilled enough to outstrip the natural instincts of the Uruk-hai.
text: Damage +1. While there is a companion in the dead pile, each unbound companion is resistance -4.

name: Tempest of War
text: While you can spot an [uruk-hai] minion, each unbound companion is resistance -1 for each condition he or she bears. Skirmish: Spot an [uruk-hai] minion and a companion who has resistance 2 or less to discard from play all conditions in all players' support areas.

name: Uruk Common
lore: Casualties of war were neither honored nor remembered by the White Hand.
text: Damage +1. Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at a battleground site, remove (2) or discard this minion.

name: Thrarin, Smith of Erebor
subtitle: Smith of Erebor
lore: Like many other representatives who have come to Rivendell, Thrarin the smith brings troubling news from the East.
text: For each artifact and possession Thrarin bears, he is damage +1.

name: Uruk Decimator
lore: The barricade was scattered as if by a thunderbolt.
text: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is strength +2. While this minion is bearing a possession, it is damage +1.

name: Uruk Desecrator
lore: Madness is seldom considered a liability, but a requisite in the ranks of the Uruk-hai.
text: Damage +1. Each unbound companion is resistance -2 for each wound he or she has.

name: Uruk Dominator
lore: The Great Orc race revels in its ability to overwhelm an enemy.
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make it strength +1 for each [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai you spot (or +2 for each if you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less).

name: Uruk Pikeman
lore: The dark tide flowed up to the walls from cliff to cliff.
text: Damage +1. While this minion is skirmishing an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3 (or +5 if that companion has resistance 4 or less).

name: Uruk Slaughterer
lore: Captives of the Uruk-hai are treated with brutality and malice, but only if they survive their capture.
text: Damage +1. Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] minion, you may discard any number of cards from hand to draw the same number of cards.

name: Uruk Zealot
lore: The Uruk-hai do not question the authority of the White Hand. They know its cause is righteous.
text: Damage +1. To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion. Each companion who has resistance 0 is strength -3. Each time Uruk Zealot wins a skirmish, you may draw 3 cards.

name: Uruk-hai Guard
lore: 'Wolves and orcs were housed in Isengard, for Saruman was mustering a great force....'
text: Damage +1. Assignment: Exert this minion and spot a companion to prevent the Free Peoples player from assigning that companion to this minion.

name: Uruk-hai Troop
lore: Attacking in swarming hordes, the Uruk-hai close with the enemy rapidly to make weapons useless.
text: Damage +1. Each character skirmishing this minion loses all strength bonuses from weapons.

name: Vicious Uruk
lore: ...the sweet grass of Rohan had been bruised and blackened as they passed.
text: Damage +1. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may draw a card for each wound on a character it is skirmishing.

name: Weapon of Opportunity
lore: The fighting Uruk-hai will use any resource available to carry out the will of Saruman.
text: Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] minion. When you play this possession on a minion that has a twilight cost of 4 or more, draw a card.

name: Attunement
lore: With deep focus and heightened senses, Elven archers are able to make seemingly impossible shots.
text: Spot an Elf to reveal cards from the top of your draw deck until you reveal a Shadow card. Make an Elf strength +2 for each card revealed. Place the revealed cards in any order on the bottom of your draw deck.

name: Worthy of Mordor
lore: Tasked by Sauron, Saruman moved swiftly to build the army demanded of him.
text: At the start of the regroup phase, you may remove (1) to make an [uruk-hai] minion gain muster until the end of the regroup phase. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)

name: Black Rider
lore: 'The Nine are abroad again. They have crossed the River secretly and are moving westward. They have taken the guise of riders in black.'
text: Fierce. This minion is strength +1 for each companion you can spot.

name: Dark Approach
lore: Frodo hesitated for a second: curiosity or some other feeling was struggling with his desire to hide.
text: Play a Nazgûl. His twilight cost is -1 for each forest site you can spot (limit -4).

name: Dark Temptation
lore: He felt that he had only to slip it on, and then he would be safe.
text: Each time you play a Nazgûl, you may heal the Ring-bearer twice to add a burden.

name: Echo of Hooves
lore: ...the black horses leaped down the hill in pursuit, and from the Riders came a terrible cry....
text: Toil 2. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot your Nazgûl at a battleground or forest site to play a mount on him from your draw deck.

name: In the Ringwraith's Wake
lore: 'He is fading.... We must get him to my father.'
text: If a Nazgûl wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.

name: Lingering Shadow
lore: 'I am wounded... wounded; it will never really heal.'
text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl. Each time a wound is removed from bearer, add a burden.

name: Minas Morgul Answers
lore: There was a flare of livid lightnings: forks of blue flame springing up from the tower and from the encircling hills into the sullen clouds.
text: Toil 2. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a Nazgûl to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.

name: Nazgûl Blade
lore: Fear and terror may be the greatest weapons the Nazgûl wield, but their steel is just as perilous.
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. While bearer is at a battleground or forest site, he is strength +1.

name: Sauron's Gaze
lore: 'Then suddenly he seemed to see me, and he laughed at me. It was cruel. It was like being stabbed with knives.'
text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl. The Free Peoples player cannot use bearer's special abilities.

name: Elrond, Witness to History
subtitle: Witness to History
lore: 'I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'
text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: If Elrond is skirmishing a minion, exert him to place an [elven] card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

name: Sense of Obligation
text: To play, spot a [wraith] minion. Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer. At the end of each assignment phase, if bearer is not assigned to a skirmish and a companion who does not bear a [wraith] condition is, add a burden.

name: Shadowy Mount
lore: '...why do these black horses endure such riders?'
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. While bearer is at a battleground or forest site, he is fierce. Assignment: Make the Free Peoples player assign bearer to an unbound companion bearing a [wraith] condition.

name: Steed of Mordor
lore: ... the Black Riders rode like a gale....
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. Bearer gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may draw 2 cards.

name: Úlairë Attëa, Black Predator
subtitle: Black Predator
lore: Frodo thought that he heard a faint hiss as of venomous breath and felt a thin piercing chill.
text: Fierce. Skirmish: Remove (2) and discard a [wraith] card from hand to make Úlairë Attëa strength +3.

name: Úlairë Cantëa, Black Assassin
subtitle: Black Assassin
lore: 'Flee them! Speak no words to them! They are deadly.'
text: Fierce. Assignment: Assign Úlairë Cantëa to a companion who has resistance 0. Skirmish: Spot 6 companions and another [wraith] card to kill a companion Úlairë Cantëa is skirmishing.

name: Úlairë Enquëa, Black Threat
subtitle: Black Threat
lore: '...the Shire is no longer any protection to you.'
text: Fierce. Toil 1. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.) Response: If you are playing a [wraith] event that has toil X, exert Úlairë Enquëa to reduce that event's twilight cost by X.

name: Úlairë Lemenya, Black Enemy
subtitle: Black Enemy
lore: Out of the gate in the trees that they had just left rode a Black Rider.
text: When you play Úlairë Lemenya, you may play a [wraith] mount from your discard pile.

name: Úlairë Nelya, Black Hunter
subtitle: Black Hunter
lore: '...peril is now both before you and behind you, and upon either side.'
text: Fierce. Each time Úlairë Nelya wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.

name: Úlairë Nertëa, Black Horseman
subtitle: Black Horseman
lore: 'Watch every shadow! ...Black horsemen have passed through Bree.'
text: The twilight cost of each mount is -1. While Úlairë Nertëa is mounted, each Nazgûl is strength +1 and has muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)

name: Úlairë Otsëa, Black Specter
subtitle: Black Specter
lore: 'We can feel their presence – it troubled our hearts, as soon as we came here, and before we saw them; they feel ours more keenly.'
text: Shadow: Exert Úlairë Otsëa and discard a [wraith] condition from hand to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.

name: Hadafang
lore: This blade is called Hadafang, a noble defense against the enemy throng for a noble lady.
text: Bearer must be Arwen or Elrond. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert him or her to discard a condition from play.

name: Úlairë Toldëa, Black Shadow
subtitle: Black Shadow
lore: So black were they that they seemed like black holes in the deep shade behind them.
text: Fierce. When you play Úlairë Toldëa, you may exert him to take a [wraith] event from your discard pile into hand.

name: Unending Life
lore: 'The power of their master is in them, and they stand or fall by him.'
text: While you can spot 6 companions, each Nazgûl is strength +3. Skirmish: Discard this condition to heal a Nazgûl.

name: Unimpeded
lore: 'Who goes there?'
text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Nazgûl strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he is at a battleground or forest site; he is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less; he is bearing a possession; he is in a fierce skirmish.

name: The Witch-king, Black Lord
subtitle: Black Lord
lore: He sprang forward and bore down on Frodo.
text: Fierce. The Witch-king is twilight cost -1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer. Each time a companion is played, you may reveal this card from hand to exert the Ring-bearer.

name: The Witch-king's Beast, Fell Creature
subtitle: Fell Creature
lore: The great shadow descended like a falling cloud.
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. If bearer is The Witch-king, after all skirmishes and fierce skirmishes have been resolved, you may exert him twice to make him participate in one additional assignment and skirmish phase.

name: The Angle
text: Forest. Shadow: Play a Nazgûl (or spot 6 companions and discard 2 cards from hand) to draw a card.

name: The Bridge of Khazad-dûm
text: Battleground. Underground. The Balrog is twilight cost -3.

name: Emyn Muil
text: Mountain. Maneuver: Remove (2) and exert your minion that is not fierce to make that minion fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Hill of Sight
text: Battleground. Forest. While you can spot 3 minions (or 6 companions), each unbound companion is resistance -2.

name: Hobbiton Market
text: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves from this site, wound each minion that is not a lurker.

name: Long-knives of Legolas
lore: Sharp, bone-handled knives defend the Elves of Mirkwood at close quarters.
text: Bearer must be Legolas. Each Orc or Uruk-hai skirmishing Legolas is strength -2.

name: Northern Pelennor
text: Battleground. Plains. Shadow: Make your lurker minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.

name: Shores of Nen Hithoel
text: River. Shadow: Spot 5 [orc] Orcs to prevent the fellowship from moving again this turn.

name: Slopes of Orodruin
text: Mountain. Shadow: Remove (2) and discard 2 Free Peoples cards from hand to draw a card.

name: Starkhorn
text: Mountain. Each time your Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.

name: Wold Battlefield
text: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your Man (except an enduring Man) to make him or her damage +1.

name: Belt of Erebor
lore: 'We make good armour and keen swords....'
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each minion skirmishing bearer loses all damage bonuses. Skirmish: Discard this possession to transfer one of bearer's possessions to another eligible bearer.

name: Orophin, Brother of Haldir
subtitle: Brother of Haldir
lore: ...wolves were howling on the wood's borders: but on the land of Lórien no shadow lay.
text: While Orophin is at a forest site and you can spot another Elf, Orophin is an archer.

name: Refuge
lore: 'Now you shall rest, and we will not speak of your further road for a while.'
text: To play, spot an Elf. Fellowship: Discard a companion from hand to heal a companion.

name: Rúmil, Brother of Haldir
subtitle: Brother of Haldir
lore: ...the Elves feared and distrusted the world outside....
text: Maneuver: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, Rúmil is an archer until the regroup phase.

name: Seclusion
lore: 'We allow no strangers to spy out the secrets of the Naith. Few indeed are permitted even to set foot there.'
text: Toil 2. (For each [elven] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot an Elf companion to discard a condition from play.

name: Taking the High Ground
text: Toil 1. (For each [elven] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.) Archery: Discard an [elven] character from hand to make the fellowship archery total +1. Each time the fellowship moves from an underground site, return your Elf to your hand.

name: Betrayal of Isengard
lore: 'There is only one Lord of the Ring.'
text: Each time an opponent draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the Shadow phase, you may remove (1). Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound Saruman twice.

name: Discoveries
lore: 'I have come back from dark journeys and long search....'
text: Spell. Toil 3. (For each [gandalf] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -3.) Spot a [gandalf] Wizard and X other companions to examine the top X cards of your draw deck. Replace those cards in any order.

name: Gandalf, The White Rider
subtitle: The White Rider
lore: 'Look to my coming at first light on the fifth day.'
text: Skirmish: If Gandalf is not assigned to a skirmish, exert him and another unbound companion skirmishing a minion to make Gandalf strength +3 and have him replace that companion in that skirmish.

name: Gandalf's Hat
lore: He wore a tall pointed blue hat....
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each time the fellowship moves from a battleground site, add a burden. Regroup: Add 2 burdens to remove all twilight tokens from the twilight pool.

name: Introspection
lore: '...I do not know the word – yet. But we shall soon see.'
text: Spell. Choose one: Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to choose an opponent who must discard one of his or her conditions from play; or spot a [gandalf] Wizard at a battleground site to discard a condition from play.

name: A Clamour of Many Voices
lore: ...crying strange news in the dawn.
text: Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish in which you played a [dwarven] event, you may draw a card.

name: Járnsmid, Barding Emissary
subtitle: Barding Emissary
lore: Sauron's Easterling allies were another trial for the Bardings, still keenly aware of the great efforts to rebuild Dale.
text: At the start of each skirmish involving Járnsmid, you may remove a burden (or 2 burdens if you can spot another [gandalf] companion).

name: Mysterious Wizard
lore: '...there are older and fouler things than Orcs in the deep places of the world.'
text: Spell. Make Gandalf strength +2 (or +4 if you cannot spot 5 burdens).

name: Salve
lore: ...the whole hall became suddenly dark as night.
text: Spell. To play, spot a [gandalf] Wizard. Bearer must be a companion. Limit 1 per bearer. Response: If bearer is about to take a wound that would kill him or her, discard this condition to prevent that wound.

name: The Terror of His Coming
lore: The Orcs reeled and screamed and cast aside both sword and spear.
text: Make a [gandalf] companion strength +2. Then, if that companion is at a battleground or dwelling site, you may take a [gandalf] condition from your discard pile into hand.

name: Traveled Leader
lore: '...the question is: who will follow me, if I lead you there?'
text: Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to replace a site in the fellowship's current region with a site from your adventure deck.

name: Watch and Wait
lore: 'I could not take it from him without doing greater harm; and I had no right to do so anyway.'
text: To play, spot a [gandalf] companion. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per bearer. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.

name: With Doom We Come
lore: 'We come, we come with roll of drum....'
text: While Gandalf is at an underground site, he gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) While the fellowship is at a battleground site, each [gandalf] character gains muster.

name: Come Away
lore: 'All ways are watched, yes,' said Gollum. 'Of course they are. But hobbits must try some way. This may be least watched.'
text: While you can spot Sméagol, the Shadow number of each site is -1. Each time the fellowship moves, wound a companion or discard this condition.

name: From Deep in Shadow
lore: ...she moved with a horrible speed, now running on her creaking legs, now making a sudden bound.
text: Spot X [gollum] cards to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. You may play a revealed minion. Its twilight cost is -2.

name: Not Alone
lore: Gollum stalked the Ring-bearer over many leagues, awaiting the right opportunity to strike.
text: Each time the fellowship moves to a mountain or underground site, you may discard a [gollum] event from hand to take a minion from your discard pile into hand.

name: Durability
lore: Gimli unexpectedly faced another test of Dwarven endurance.
text: Make a Dwarf strength +2. Then, if that Dwarf is at a battleground or mountain site, draw a card.

name: There's Another Way
lore: Frodo felt a strange certainty that in this matter Gollum was for once not so far from the truth....
text: To play, spot Sméagol. Sméagol is strength +1. Regroup: Discard this condition to replace the fellowship's current site with a site from your adventure deck.

name: Treacherous Little Toad
lore: 'The Precious will be ours once the Hobbitses are dead!'
text: To play, spot a [gollum] card. Bearer must be a wounded companion. While you can spot a [gollum] character or a [gollum] card in your support area, bearer cannot heal.

name: Blade of Gondor, Sword of Boromir
subtitle: Sword of Boromir
lore: Its strength pales next to that of the man wielding it.
text: Bearer must be Boromir. He is damage +1. Skirmish: If Boromir is not assigned to a skirmish, discard a [gondor] card borne by him to have him replace an unbound Hobbit skirmishing a minion.

name: Boromir, Defender of Minas Tirith
subtitle: Defender of Minas Tirith
lore: ...seated a little apart was a tall man with a fair and noble face... proud and stern of glance.
text: Ranger. Fellowship: Add (2) to heal Boromir.

name: Concealment
lore: '...your refuge is so hidden that perhaps he does not know that Men are concealed here.'
text: Make a [gondor] Man strength +1. If he or she is skirmishing a roaming minion, your opponents cannot use special abilities.

name: Confronting the Eye
lore: 'To know that I lived and walked the earth was a blow to his heart, I deem; for he knew it not till now.'
text: Fellowship: Spot a [gondor] Man and add (2) to make each unbound companion strength +1 until the regroup phase (limit +1).

name: Elendil's Valor
lore: 'In panoply of ancient kings, / in chainéd rings he armoured him; / his shining shield was scored with runes / to ward all wounds and harm from him....'
text: Make a [gondor] companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Faramir, Dúnadan of Gondor
subtitle: Dúnadan of Gondor
lore: 'We do not want the escapes of Mirkwood in Ithilien.'
text: Ranger. Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make him strength +1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.

name: Faramir's Sword
lore: 'There will be hard handstrokes nigh at hand ere the day is full.'
text: Bearer must be Faramir. He is damage +1. Each minion skirmishing Faramir at a battleground or forest site is roaming.

name: Gondorian Steed
lore: A skilled cavalry augments Minas Tirith's mighty defenses.
text: Bearer must be a knight. Bearer is damage +1. Each time the fellowship moves from a mountain site, add (2).

name: Dwarven Bracers
lore: Dwarven-smiths forge bracers for fit and agility.
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, discard this possession to prevent that wound.

name: Guardian
lore: Boromir wouldn't fail the other Hobbits as he had Frodo.
text: Toil 2. (For each [gondor] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Skirmish: If a [gondor] companion is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to have him or her replace an unbound companion skirmishing a minion.

name: Invigorated
lore: He sprang down the steps and away, leaping down the path.
text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to heal a [gondor] Man (or to heal 2 [gondor] Men if you can spot a roaming minion).

name: Tireless
lore: So long as foes were standing, so too would Aragorn.
text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [gondor] Man strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is at a battleground site; he or she has resistance 4 or more; he or she is bearing a hand weapon; he or she is skirmishing a roaming minion.

name: Valorous Leader
lore: Before he ever sat the throne, Aragorn had proven himself a great leader to the people of Gondor.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. Limit 1 per bearer. Skirmish: Discard this condition to discard a possession borne by a minion skirmishing bearer.

name: Saruman, Of Many Colours
subtitle: Of Many Colours
lore: '\"White!\" he sneered. \"It serves as a beginning.\"'
text: Damage +1. Fierce. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) When you play Saruman, name a culture. Each companion of the named culture is strength -1.

name: Brutal Easterling
lore: 'Out of some savage land in the wide East they come, we deem.'
text: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish an exhausted companion, it is fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Castamir of Umbar, Corsair Vandal
subtitle: Corsair Vandal
lore: '...they have allied them with the Enemy, and now make a heavy stroke in his cause.'
text: Fierce. Toil 1. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.) Each wounded [men] minion is strength +2.

name: Corrupted Spy
text: This minion is strength +1 for each other character you can spot. While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, this minion is damage +1. While you can spot a companion who has resistance 0, this minion is fierce.

name: Countless Companies
lore: 'Not tall, but broad and grim... wielding great axes.'
text: Response: If a [men] possession is discarded from play, stack it here. Shadow: Remove (1) to play a possession stacked here as if from hand.

name: Covetous Easterling
lore: Long have the Men of Rhûn thirsted for the wealth of Gondor, and many times have they sought to claim it.
text: While this minion is skirmishing a Man, it is damage +2.

name: Dwarven Skill
lore: Gimli's axe-work on the Amon Hen hewed a mighty path through the Uruk-hai.
text: Toil 2. (For each [dwarven] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Dwarf strength +3 (or +4 if he has resistance 4 or more).

name: Crazed Hillman
lore: Already given to fierce passions, a warrior of Dunland quickly frenzies in the heat of battle.
text: Fierce. While this minion is in a fierce skirmish, it is strength +7 (or +10 if it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less).

name: Crooked Townsman
lore: '...the Riders can use men and other creatures as spies, as we found at Bree.'
text: This minion is strength +1 for each other character you can spot.

name: Dunlending Zealot
lore: ...unfriendly to the Dúnedain, hating the Rohirrim.
text: While this minion is exhausted, each unbound companion is resistance -1 (or -2 if the fellowship is at a battleground site).

name: Easterling Banner-bearer
lore: 'They hold the northward road; and many have passed on into Anórien. The Rohirrim cannot come.'
text: This minion is strength +1 for each wound on each companion he is skirmishing (or +2 for each if that companion has resistance 2 or less).

name: Enraged Southron
lore: As with wild animals, fleeing prey seems only to incite the warriors of Harad.
text: Ambush (3). The move limit for this turn is +1.

name: Frenzied Dunlending
lore: While Dunlendings lack the skills of the trained soldiers they attack, they carry in them a well-honed hatred.
text: While this minion is bearing a possession, it is fierce.

name: Gathering Strength
lore: 'Always more people coming to Mordor. One day all the peoples will be inside.'
text: Toil 2. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Make a [men] minion strength +6.

name: Goaded to War
lore: ...the mûmakil were bellowing....
text: To play, spot a [men] minion. Each time the fellowship moves to a battleground or plains site, add (1).

name: Gríma, Betrayer of Rohan
subtitle: Betrayer of Rohan
lore: In his eyes was the hunted look of a beast seeking some gap in the ring of his enemies.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving a [men] minion, you may exert Gríma to exert a companion.

name: Harrying Hillman
lore: Though Dunlendings are by no means cowardly, their prowess in battle seems to manifest more as victory grows more assured.
