text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving a [men] minion, add (2).

name: Dwarven Warrior
lore: Though Dáin rules Erebor as King Under the Mountain, many of his kindred continue to dwell in the Iron Hills.
text: When you play this companion during the fellowship phase, choose a Shadow player who must discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.

name: Hemmed In
text: While you can spot 6 companions, each companion skirmishing a [men] minion loses all strength bonuses from possessions. Maneuver: Spot your [men] minion and discard this condition to transfer a Free Peoples possession borne by a companion to another eligible bearer.

name: Last Days
lore: 'Not long now shall stand the high hall which Brego son of Eorl built. Fire shall devour the high seat.'
text: Each time a [men] minion is killed or discarded from play (except during the regroup phase), you may play a [men] minion. Its twilight cost is -2, and it is fierce and strength +2 until the regroup phase.

name: Messenger's Mount
lore: ...it was huge and hideous, and its face was a frightful mask....
text: Bearer must be The Mouth of Sauron. He is fierce. Response: If a [men] minion is about to take a wound, remove (3) to prevent that.

name: The Mouth of Sauron, Messenger of Mordor
subtitle: Messenger of Mordor
lore: ...he learned great sorcery, and knew much of the mind of Sauron; and he was more cruel than any orc.
text: Maneuver: Exert The Mouth of Sauron to play a [men] condition or [men] possession from your draw deck.

name: Mûmak Rider
lore: Only the best marksmen can keep their aim true as they are carried along by the great beasts of the Haradrim.
text: Archer. When you play this minion to a battleground or plains site, you may spot another [men] minion to discard a possession from play.

name: Poisonous Words
lore: 'So fair. So cold. Like a morning of pale spring still clinging to winter's chill.'
text: Toil 2. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Add (1) for each [men] card you can spot.

name: Trail of Terror
lore: 'Now the Wild Men are moving through the Westfold, burning as they go.'
text: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot 3 [men] minions and remove (1) to make each unbound companion resistance -1 until the regroup phase.

name: War Trident
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. While bearer is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 5 or less, bearer is strength +2. While bearer is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 3 or less, bearer is strength +2.

name: Wrathful Hillman
lore: 'For behold! the storm comes, and now all friends should gather together, lest each singly be destroyed.'
text: Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at a plains site, remove (2) or discard this minion.

name: The Balrog, The Terror of Khazad-dûm
subtitle: The Terror of Khazad-dûm
lore: The fire in it seemed to die, but the darkness grew.
text: Damage +1. While The Balrog is at an underground site, it is fierce and cannot take wounds or be exerted.

name: His Father's Charge
lore: A sharpened axe does well to protect Dwarven honor.
text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Dwarf strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he is at a mountain or underground site; he has resistance 3 or more; he is bearing a possession; he is skirmishing a fierce minion.

name: Whip of Many Thongs, Weapon of Flame and Shadow
subtitle: Weapon of Flame and Shadow
lore: ...it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed....
text: Bearer must be The Balrog. It is fierce. When you play this artifact, the Free Peoples player reveals his or her hand and discards all Free Peoples cards from hand that have a twilight cost of 1 or less.

name: Abiding Evil
lore: 'The Dark Tower was broken, but its foundations were not removed; for they were made with the power of the Ring, and while it remains they will endure.'
text: Spot X burdens to make a character skirmishing an [orc] Orc strength -X.

name: Barrage
lore: Fires now raged unchecked in the first circle of the City....
text: Toil 2. (For each [orc] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Make each of your [orc] minions strength +2 until the regroup phase.

name: The Beckoning Shadow
lore: Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.
text: To play, exert an [orc] minion. If you can spot 5 burdens, and the Free Peoples player has no cards in his or her draw deck, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.

name: Bloodstained Field
lore: Orcs will eagerly spill any blood, but Elven is the sweetest of all.
text: Spot an [orc] lurker to wound an Elf.

name: Cave Troll of Moria, Savage Menace
subtitle: Savage Menace
lore: 'There is no hope of escape that way.'
text: Damage +1. Fierce. Toil 2. (For each [orc] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Each time an [orc] lurker wins a skirmish, you may make the Free Peoples player discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.

name: Cave Troll's Hammer, Unwieldy Cudgel
subtitle: Unwieldy Cudgel
lore: Its weight is greater than any foe it has felled.
text: Bearer must be an [orc] Troll. When you play this possession, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion for each lurker you spot.

name: Goblin Aggressor
lore: 'The road may lead to Moria, but how can we hope that it will lead through Moria....'
text: While this minion is bearing a possession, each [orc] minion is strength +1.

name: Great Cost
text: At the start of each skirmish involving an [orc] minion, you may spot 6 companions to exert a companion in that skirmish. Shadow: Discard this condition and spot an [orc] minion to make the Free Peoples player place a card from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck.

name: Mordor Aggressor
lore: 'The enemy,' men murmured. 'The dike is down. Here they come pouring through the breaches!'
text: While this minion is bearing a possession, each [orc] minion is strength +2.

name: Loud and Strong
lore: 'Alas! My axe is notched: the forty-second had an iron collar on his neck.'
text: Skirmish: Discard a [dwarven] card from hand and spot a minion skirmishing a Dwarf to make that minion fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Morgul Tormentor
lore: Some Orcs go beyond savagery, taking pleasure in the suffering of their enemies.
text: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to skirmish an unwounded companion, he or she must add a burden or discard a card from hand.

name: Orc Artisan
lore: Much Orc weaponry is scavenged from fallen foes, but they still have ample need for smiths to outfit their troops.
text: Each time you play an [orc] possession on an [orc] Orc, you may add (1) (or (2) if that Orc is at a battleground or underground site).

name: Orc Dreg
lore: ...their Captain cared not greatly what they did or how many might be slain....
text: Each time this minion is assigned to a skirmish, if it is not at an underground site, remove (2) or discard this minion.

name: Orc Footman
lore: On they came, reckless of their loss as they approached....
text: When this minion is discarded from play, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to shuffle this minion into your draw deck.

name: Orc Sapper
lore: ...their purpose was only to test the strength of the defence and to keep the men of Gondor busy in many places.
text: When you play this minion, you may spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less to prevent that companion from being assigned to this minion until the regroup phase.

name: Orc Skulker
lore: 'I have never heard before of Orcs upon Amon Hen. Yet who knows what may happen in these evil days....'
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each skirmish event you play is twilight cost -1.

name: Orc Spear
lore: The flared backs of Orkish spearheads are crafted to inflict more damage as they are pulled out of a victim.
text: Bearer must be an [orc] minion. When you play this possession on a minion that has a twilight cost of 4 or more, add (2).

name: Orc Strategist
lore: It takes a strong will indeed to command an unruly band of Orcs.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Maneuver: Make an [orc] lurker minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.

name: Orc Tormentor
lore: ...orc-speech sounded at all times full of hate and anger....
text: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to skirmish an unwounded companion, he or she must add a burden or discard a card from hand.

name: Pitiless Orc
lore: Curses they heeded not, nor understood the tongues of western men....
text: When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each companion over 4.

name: Arod, Rohirrim Steed
subtitle: Rohirrim Steed
lore: A smaller and lighter horse, but restive and fiery....
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. When you play Arod, you may reinforce a [dwarven] token. Response: If bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, remove 2 [dwarven] tokens to prevent that.

name: Asfaloth, Swift Blossom
subtitle: Swift Blossom
lore: '...my horse will not let any rider fall....'
text: Bearer must be an Elf. When you play Asfaloth, you may reinforce an [elven] token. Skirmish: Remove 2 [elven] tokens to heal bearer (or heal bearer and heal another Elf if bearer is in a fierce skirmish).

name: Vicious Dunlending
lore: A swath of terror cut across the fields of Rohan.
text: Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another [men] minion damage +1.

name: Voice of the Desert, Southron Troop
subtitle: Southron Troop
text: To play, spot a [men] minion. While the fellowship is in region 1, each [men] minion cannot take wounds. While the fellowship is in region 2, each [men] minion is an archer. While the fellowship is in region 3, each [men] minion is fierce.

name: Worn Battleaxe
lore: Arms of the Hillmen of Dunland are crude but effective.
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. While you can spot a culture token, bearer is strength +1 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.

name: Always Threatening
text: When you play this, you may add an [orc] token here for each [orc] condition you can spot. Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a lurker minion strength +2.

name: Chamber Patrol
text: To play, spot an [orc] minion. While the fellowship is in region 1, [orc] Orcs cannot take wounds. While the fellowship is in region 2, the current site gains underground. While the fellowship is in region 3, each [orc] Orc is strength +2.

name: Defiled
lore: ...transmogrified to trophies by the advancing hordes.
text: You may remove from the game 4 [orc] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Make your [orc] lurker minion strength +2.

name: Enemy Upon Enemy
lore: On they came, reckless of their loss as they approached.
text: Regroup: Spot an [orc] lurker minion to stack that minion here. Shadow: Remove a burden to play a lurker minion stacked here as if from hand. That minion is twilight cost -3.

name: Expendable Servants
lore: Sauron's minions were loyal to his rule. Their loyalty was repaid in blood: the enemy's or their own.
text: If you can spot more [orc] conditions than [orc] minions, you may discard your [orc] condition from play to play an [orc] minion from your discard pile.

name: Forced March
lore: Orcs do not rest.
text: To play, spot 2 [orc] minions. Regroup: Make the Free Peoples player spot another [orc] condition, discard it from play, and remove (3) to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn (if the move limit allows). Discard this condition.

name: Howling Orc
lore: Losses served only to enrage the besiegers.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time an [orc] minion is killed in a skirmish, you may make this minion strength +2 until the regroup phase.

name: Celeborn, The Wise
subtitle: The Wise
lore: 'I did not know that your plight was so evil.'
text: While the fellowship is at a forest site, each Elf who has resistance 7 or more gains muster. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may take an [elven] event into hand from your discard pile.

name: Isengard Informant
lore: Some remained in Isengard to propel the war machine.
text: Regroup: Exert this minion to play an [orc] Troll from your discard pile.

name: Massing Strength
lore: ...the Dark Power, moving its armies like pieces on the board, was gathering them together.
text: Discard any number of your [orc] minions from play to make an [orc] minion strength +3 for each one discarded.

name: Orc Crusher
lore: 'Hit me now, Sam. Hit me!'
text: To play, spot an [orc] Orc. This minion is twilight cost -1 for each burden. Each time a Ring-bound companion loses a skirmish involving an [orc] minion, you may reveal this card from hand to add a burden.

name: Orc Line-breaker
lore: Fell captains moved Sauron's forces from the Gorgoroth plains.
text: At the end of each skirmish involving this minion, if you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, this minion is fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Orc Plains Runner
lore: Saruman unleashed the remaining minions to ravage the countryside of Rohan.
text: Regroup: Discard this minion from play (or exert this minion if the fellowship's next site is an underground site) and spot another [orc] minion to return that minion to your hand.

name: Orc Raid Commander
lore: Once inside the walls of the City, the besiegers were ordered to kill on sight.
text: To play, spot an [orc] card in your support area. When you play this, spot a Free Peoples condition to discard from play each other card that has the same card title as that condition.

name: Orc Reaper
lore: As they overrun the lands of the Free Peoples, the forces of the Shadow destroy all available resources.
text: While you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, each minion that has the title Orc Reaper is strength +2.

name: Ordnance Grunt
lore: Only Trolls had the strength to man the siege catapults.
text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [orc] minion. Shadow: Discard an [orc] condition from play to play this minion from your discard pile.

name: Picket Denizen
lore: Frontline minions drew the fire of parapet archers.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Response: If another [orc] minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that.

name: Underdeeps Denizen
lore: There was a crash on the door, followed by crash after crash.... How many there were the Company could not count.
text: While this minion is at an underground site, it cannot take wounds.

name: City of the Trees
lore: Many stairs they climbed to meet the Galadhrim.
text: At the end of your turn, discard this from play if the fellowship did not move more than once this turn. At the start of each skirmish involving an Elf and a wounded minion, you may draw a card.

name: Unforgiving Depths
text: While you can spot 3 underground sites, each [orc] Orc gains muster. Shadow: Discard this condition from play and spot an [orc] minion to replace the fellowship's current site with an underground site from your adventure deck.

name: Whatever Means
lore: The besiegers believed not that the flames would burn the city walls, but the souls of those behind them.
text: Make an [orc] Orc strength +2 (or +6 if you remove 2 burdens).

name: Bitter Tidings
lore: Théodred my son is slain.'
text: If Théoden is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Éomer or Théodred to prevent that. If Théodred is about to take a wound in a skirmish, you may discard from play Éomer or Éowyn to prevent that.

name: Éomer, Heir to Meduseld
subtitle: Heir to Meduseld
lore: 'I have no child. Théodred my son is slain. I name Éomer my sister-son to be my heir.'
text: While Éomer bears a mount, he is damage +1. While no other companion is assigned to a skirmish, Éomer is strength +1 for each other [rohan] companion you can spot.

name: Éowyn, Restless Warrior
subtitle: Restless Warrior
lore: 'Let her be as lord to the Eorlingas, while we are gone.'
text: Each possession you play on Éowyn during the fellowship phase is twilight cost -1. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reinforce a [rohan] token (or reinforce 2 [rohan] tokens if you can spot Éomer or Théoden).

name: Ferthu Théoden Hal
lore: 'Receive now this cup and drink in happy hour.'
text: To play, spot 2 [rohan] Men. Unless you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, discard a possession from play.

name: Firefoot, Mearas of The Mark
subtitle: Mearas of The Mark
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. When you play Firefoot, you may reinforce a [rohan] token. At the start of the maneuver phase, if bearer is Éomer, you may remove 2 [rohan] tokens to make him defender +1 and strength +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Freely Across Our Land
lore: Unchecked, unchallenged, killing at will!
text: When you play this, add a [rohan] token here. Regroup: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to play a [rohan] possession from your discard pile on your [rohan] companion.

name: Háma, Captain of the King's Guard
subtitle: Captain of the King's Guard
lore: 'Do not hope too much! These are dark days.'
text: Háma is strength +1 for each Shadow possession you can spot. Each time Háma wins a skirmish, you may discard a possession from play.

name: Hamstrung
lore: Spears and arrows from Rohan brought down the mighty Mûmakil.
text: Make a [rohan] companion strength +2 (or +5 if the fellowship has moved twice this turn).

name: Crashing Cavalry
lore: At that moment there came a roaring and a rushing: a noise of loud waters rolling many stones.
text: Assignment: Discard this from play and assign a minion to an [elven] companion. Those characters cannot use skirmish special abilities until the start of the regroup phase.

name: Hurried Barrows
lore: The fallen sleep with honor.
text: You may remove from the game 4 other [rohan] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Make your mounted [rohan] companion strength +3.

name: King's Board
lore: Also wakened in Edoras was hospitality.
text: Skirmish: Exert Éomer to make Éowyn or Théoden strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Éowyn to make Éomer or Théoden strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Théoden to make Éomer or Éowyn strength +2.

name: Merchant of Westfold
lore: Villagers from the surrounding farmlands fled to Helm's Deep seeking safety.
text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may add (1) and remove a Free Peoples culture token to reinforce a [rohan] token.

name: Riddermark Tactician
text: When you play this, you may reinforce a [rohan] token. Each time a Shadow player replaces the fellowship's current site, you may spot another [rohan] Man to make, until the regroup phase, the fellowship archery total +2 and the minion archery total -2.

name: Ride With Me
lore: Maybe we shall cleave a road, or make such an end as will be worth a song – if any be left to sing of us hereafter.'
text: Make your [rohan] companion strength +2 (or exert Théoden to make that companion strength +5 and damage +1 instead).

name: Rider's Bow
lore: Riders of the Mark carried short bows easily fired from horseback.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. If bearer is mounted, he or she is strength +1. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may choose a Shadow player who must wound one of his or her minions.

name: Snowmane, Noble Mearas
subtitle: Noble Mearas
lore: 'Where now the horse and the rider?'
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. When you play Snowmane, you may reinforce a [rohan] token. Skirmish: If bearer is Théoden, you may remove 2 [rohan] tokens to exhaust a minion he is skirmishing.

name: Théoden, The Renowned
subtitle: The Renowned
lore: 'Let horse be bridled, horn be sounded!'
text: While you can spot Éowyn, Théoden is defender +1. While you can spot Éomer, Théoden is damage +1. While you can spot Théodred, the move limit is +1.

name: Théodred, Second Marshal of the Mark
subtitle: Second Marshal of the Mark
lore: The son of Théoden defended Rohan at the Fords of Isen.
text: While you can spot a [rohan] Man who has resistance of 7 or more, Théodred is twilight cost -1. At the start of each skirmish involving Théodred, you may exert each minion he is skirmishing.

name: Wind-swept Homestead
text: To play, spot 2 [rohan] companions. When you play this, add a [rohan] token here for each plains site and each battleground site on the adventure path. At the start of each regroup phase, add a [rohan] token here for each of your companions that has muster.

name: Final Shot
lore: Redoubling their efforts, the Company at last felled the Cave Troll.
text: Make an [elven] companion strength +2 (or +5 if the fellowship has moved more than once this turn).

name: Sauron, Dark Lord of Mordor
subtitle: Dark Lord of Mordor
lore: '...the Shadow grows once more....'
text: Damage +1. Fierce. When you play Sauron, you may exert any number of minions. For each minion you exert, Sauron is twilight cost -X, where X is the current region number.

name: Sceptre of the Dark Lord
text: Bearer must be Sauron. He is damage +1. Each time Sauron wins a skirmish and the companion he is skirmishing is not killed, you may assign X wounds to other companions, where X is the current region number.

name: Bilbo, Aged Ring-bearer
subtitle: Aged Ring-bearer
lore: '...I am quite ready to go on another journey....'
text: Ring-bound. While Bilbo is not assigned to a skirmish, each Ring-bound Hobbit is strength +1. At the start of each skirmish involving Bilbo, you may remove a burden for each other Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.

name: Bill the Pony, Dearly-loved
subtitle: Dearly-loved
lore: Sam would not go to bed until he had visited Bill....
text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. When you play Bill the Pony, you may reinforce a [shire] token. Regroup: Spot 2 minions and remove 2 [shire] tokens to make a Shadow player discard a minion from play.

name: Daddy Twofoot, Next-door Neighbor
subtitle: Next-door Neighbor
lore: 'That's a dark bad place, if half the tales be true.'
text: Aid – Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may take a [shire] event into hand from your discard pile.

name: Don't Let Go
lore: 'Don't you give up on me Mr. Frodo!'
text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a Hobbit strength +1 for each of the following that is true: he or she is participating in a fierce skirmish; he or she has resistance 7 or more; he or she is at a dwelling site; you can spot an unwounded Hobbit.

name: Everything but My Bones
lore: ...I'll carry Mr. Frodo up myself....'
text: You may remove from the game 4 other [shire] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Make your Hobbit at a dwelling or forest site strength +3.

name: Faith in Friendship
lore: I'm going to take care of you.
text: When you play this, add a [shire] token here. At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard this from play or remove a token from here to heal a [shire] companion.

name: Fates Entwined
lore: 'Yes, I am coming... The Ring-bearers should go together.'
text: Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, you may heal another Hobbit once (or heal another Hobbit twice if the Hobbit that won the skirmish was Frodo or Bilbo).

name: Frodo, Frenzied Fighter
subtitle: Frenzied Fighter
text: Ring-bound. While you can spot more minions than companions, Frodo cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled. Skirmish: If Frodo is not assigned to a skirmish, exert Frodo to have him replace a Ring-bound companion skirmishing a minion.

name: Galadriel, Sorceress of the Hidden Land
subtitle: Sorceress of the Hidden Land
lore: 'Do not let your hearts be troubled....'
text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may reveal a card from the top of your draw deck for each forest on the adventure path to heal an Elf for each [elven] card revealed.

name: Frodo Gamgee, Son of Samwise
subtitle: Son of Samwise
lore: '...Rose and me had settled to call him Frodo, with your leave....'
text: Aid – Add 2 burdens. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add 2 burdens to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a Ring-bound Hobbit. Bearer is strength +1 for each Ring-bound Hobbit you can spot.

name: The Gaffer, Master Gardener
subtitle: Master Gardener
lore: ...the Gaffer was recognized as the leading authority....
text: Aid – Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.) When you transfer The Gaffer to a [shire] companion, heal bearer (or heal bearer twice if he or she is at a dwelling site).

name: Humble Homestead
text: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. When you play this, add a [shire] token here for each forest site and each dwelling site on the adventure path. Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 3 tokens from here to cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit.

name: Mithril-coat, Dwarf-mail
subtitle: Dwarf-mail
lore: '...cold as ice, and harder than steel.'
text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. Each minion skirmishing bearer loses all damage bonuses. Skirmish: Exert bearer to make each minion he is skirmishing lose fierce and unable to gain fierce until the regroup phase.

name: New Chapter
lore: And so it was settled. Sam Gamgee married Rosie Cotton in the spring of 1420....
text: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Each time you play a follower, you may heal a companion (or heal Sam twice).

name: Phial of Galadriel, The Light of Eärendil
subtitle: The Light of Eärendil
text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. While bearer is in region 1, bearer gains muster. While bearer is in region 2, each of your [shire] companions gains muster. While bearer is in region 3, each character gains muster.

name: Sam, Bearer of Great Need
subtitle: Bearer of Great Need
lore: '...the last of all the Company. The errand must not fail.'
text: Ring-bound. Sam is resistance +1 for each Hobbit you can spot. Regroup: Exert Sam and transfer a follower he is bearing to your support area to discard a minion from play.

name: Westfarthing Businessman
lore: 'There's a tidy bit of money tucked away up there, I hear tell....'
text: This companion is strength +1 for each [shire] card that has a culture token on it.

name: Assault Commander
lore: Fear is a potent weapon in the hands of an Uruk-hai.
text: Damage +1. Shadow: Exert this minion and spot a Free Peoples condition to make an unbound companion resistance -1 for each card that has the same card title as that condition.

name: Assault Denizen
lore: Theories and tactics of warfare were tested upon the battlefields of Middle-earth.
text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each Free Peoples culture token you can spot.

name: Inside a Song
lore: 'I thought that Elves were all for moon and stars; but this is more elvish than anything I ever heard tell of.'
text: Exert an Elf to take an [elven] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile and you may reinforce an [elven] token.

name: Cavern Denizen
lore: Saruman uses the enemy's strength to his own advantage.
text: Damage +1. While you can spot a Free Peoples culture token, this minion cannot take wounds except during skirmishes.

name: Endless Assault
text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +1 for each of the following that is true: it is at a battleground site; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less; it is bearing a possession; you can spot an [uruk-hai] minion not assigned to a skirmish.

name: Enemy Without Number
lore: Valour could not prevent the breach of the Deeping Wall.
text: To play, spot 2 [uruk-hai] minions. Shadow: Discard 2 cards from hand to add (1). Regroup: Spot an [uruk-hai] minion and discard this condition from play to add (3).

name: Entranced Uruk
lore: An Uruk is disarmed only when it hurls its weapon.
text: Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Possessions borne by this minion cannot be discarded by Free Peoples cards.

name: Fearless Approach
text: To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion. When you play this, if you spot a battleground site on the adventure path, reinforce 3 [uruk-hai] tokens. Each time the Free Peoples player plays the fellowship's next site, you may discard a condition from play.

name: Isengard Infiltrator
lore: The Uruk-hai trained to engage the enemy in its own territory.
text: Damage +1. While the fellowship is at a forest site, the fellowship archery total is -1. Each [elven] companion skirmishing this minion is strength -2.

name: New Enemy
lore: ...goblin-soldiers of greater stature.
text: You may remove from the game 4 [uruk-hai] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Make your [uruk-hai] minion skirmishing a companion with resistance 4 or less strength +2.

name: Signs of War
lore: Horsemen were galloping on the grass of Rohan; wolves poured from Isengard.
text: While you can spot 3 [uruk-hai] lurker minions, at the start of each skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] lurker minion, each companion skirmishing that minion must exert.

name: Uruk Aggressor
lore: The defenses of the Hornburg were exploited, exposing their weakest points.
text: Damage +1. When you play this, you may spot a companion who has resistance 0 to make this minion twilight cost -2.

name: Uruk Blitz
text: To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion. While the fellowship is in region 1, each Uruk-hai is damage +1. While the fellowship is in region 2, each companion is strength -1. While the fellowship is in region 3, each unbound companion is resistance -2.

name: Kindreds Estranged
lore: 'Men multiply and the Firstborn decrease....'
text: You may remove from the game 4 other [elven] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Make a minion skirmishing your Elf at a forest or river site strength -3.

name: Uruk Distractor
lore: Wounds do not always remove the Uruk-hai from their assault.
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert it to discard a possession borne by a companion skirmishing another [uruk-hai] minion.

name: Uruk Invader
lore: To sense weakness is to assume victory.
text: Damage +1. This minion is twilight cost -1 for each companion who has resistance 2 or less.

name: Uruk Outrider
lore: The lesser the enemy, the greater the rage.
text: This minion is damage +1 for each character in the dead pile.

name: Uruk Reserve
text: Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time your [uruk-hai] minion is about to be killed in a skirmish, you may place that minion on the bottom of your draw deck instead.

name: Uruk Rogue
lore: Some minions prefer to fight alone.
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: If no other minions are assigned to a skirmish, exert this minion twice to make it fierce and strength +4 until the regroup phase.

name: Uruk Tactician
lore: Select warriors had been tasked with advancing the assault beyond the Deeping Wall.
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a companion skirmishing an [uruk-hai] lurker minion strength -2.

name: War Machine
lore: ...on the front of their iron helms was set an S-rune, wrought of some white metal.
text: Exert your [uruk-hai] lurker minion to play an [uruk-hai] hand weapon from your discard pile on your [uruk-hai] minion.

name: Weapons of Control
text: When you play this, add an [uruk-hai] token here for each wounded companion. Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a companion skirmishing an [uruk-hai] minion strength -1.

name: Dark Fell About Him
lore: Men cast from the saddle lay grovelling on the ground.
text: To play, exert your Nazgûl twice and spot an exhausted companion. Heal that companion to add a burden. If the fellowship is not in region 1, you may repeat this for each other wound on that companion.

name: From Hideous Eyrie
lore: Down, down it came, and then, folding its fingered webs, it gave a croaking cry....
text: You may remove from the game 4 [wraith] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Make your Nazgûl in a fierce skirmish strength +2.

name: Legolas, Of the Grey Company
subtitle: Of the Grey Company
lore: 'My heart bids me go on... but we must hold together. I will follow your counsel.'
text: Archer. At the start of each archery phase, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, wound a minion.

name: Shadow in the East
lore: '...it is called Minas Morgul, the Tower of Sorcery.'
text: Toil 1. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.) To play, spot a [wraith] card in your support area. Spot a companion to draw a card for each wound on that companion (and draw an additional card if you can spot a Nazgûl).

name: They Came From Mordor
lore: 'That is the worst news that has come to Bree....'
text: When you play this, you may add a [wraith] token here for each [wraith] card in your support area. Shadow: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to play a [wraith] mount from your draw deck on your [wraith] minion.

name: Úlairë Enquëa, Sixth of the Nine Riders
subtitle: Sixth of the Nine Riders
lore: 'It is many a year since the Nine walked abroad.'
text: Fierce. When you play Úlairë Enquëa, if you can spot 2 other Nazgûl, you may exert 2 unbound companions (or exert each companion if you can spot 6 companions).

name: Úlairë Lemenya, Servant of the Shadow
subtitle: Servant of the Shadow
lore: 'As the Shadow grows once more, they too may walk again.'
text: Fierce. Shadow: Exert Úlairë Lemenya and discard a Nazgûl from your hand to discard a condition from play.

name: Úlairë Nertëa, Servant of the Shadow
subtitle: Servant of the Shadow
lore: From inside the hood came a noise as of someone sniffling to catch an elusive scent....
text: Fierce. While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, Úlairë Nertëa is twilight cost -2.

name: Abandoned Mine Shaft
text: Underground. If this site is not in region 1 when the fellowship moves from here during the regroup phase, add a burden.

name: Caves of Aglarond
text: Underground. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may remove 2 burdens.

name: City of Kings
text: Battleground. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may draw a card.

name: Courtyard Parapet
text: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves to this site, the first Shadow player may discard 2 cards from hand to add a burden.

name: Crossroads of the Fallen Kings
text: Forest. When the fellowship moves to this site during the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may heal a companion of each culture.

name: Let Fly
lore: 'Yet I make my tale twenty at the least. But that is only a few leaves in a forest.'
text: Spot 3 Elves, spot a Shadow race, and choose a Shadow player to wound each of that player's minions which is not of that race.

name: Doors of Durin
text: Marsh. Each companion of each race that has the most companions is strength -1.

name: Fords of Isen
text: River. Each character is strength +1 for each card borne by that character.

name: The Great Gates
text: Battleground. While a player can spot more companions than minions, each minion is strength +1.

name: Isenwash
text: Battleground. Plains. At the start of the regroup phase, each Shadow player may exert a minion to exert a companion.

name: Redhorn Pass
text: Mountain. Culture tokens cannot be added, removed, or reinforced.

name: Awkward Moment
lore: It's a long way.
text: Make a Dwarf strength +3 (or +4 and damage +1 if you can spot a [dwarven] token).

name: Lórien Protector
lore: There was a sound of soft laughter over their heads, and then another clear voice spoke in an elven-tongue.
text: While another companion is assigned to a skirmish, during each skirmish, prevent all wounds to this companion after the first wound.

name: Many Miles
lore: 'I can see a darkness. There are shapes moving in it, great shapes far away upon the bank of the river; but what they are I cannot tell.'
text: Spot 2 Elf archers to make the fellowship archery total +1 (or +2 if a Shadow player has replaced the fellowship's current site this turn).

name: Secluded Homestead
text: To play, spot 2 Elves. When you play this, add an [elven] token here for each forest site and each river site on the adventure path. Regroup: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to reconcile your hand.

name: Shrouded Elf
lore: Cloaked by Elven garments and by darkness, warriors led by Haldir reinforced Helm's Deep.
text: Response: If you play an event during a skirmish involving this companion, exert this companion to place that event on top of your draw deck.

name: Spring Forth Nimbly
lore: ...the Elf had no boots, but wore only light shoes, as he always did....
text: Make an Elf strength +1 for each card that has an [elven] token on it.

name: Standing Tall
lore: Yrch,' said Legolas, falling into his own tongue.
text: Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1 for each of the following that is true: it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or more; it is wounded; you can spot an Elf archer; the fellowship is at a forest site.

name: Take Up the Bow
lore: Stringing the bow and fitting an arrow....
text: Toil 2. (For each [elven] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Archery: Discard this from play and spot 3 Elf archers to discard a minion from play. Each of those archers loses archer and cannot gain archer.

name: Wells of Deep Memory
text: At the end of your turn, discard this from play if the fellowship did not move more than once this turn. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card for each of the following you can spot: Arwen, Celeborn, or Galadriel.

name: Alatar, Final Envoy
subtitle: Final Envoy
lore: Third of the Istari to be named, he was clad in sea-blue.
text: Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may reinforce a [gandalf] token. While you can spot a [gandalf] companion, each minion skirmishing bearer is strength -1.

name: Dasron, Merchant From Dorwinion
subtitle: Merchant From Dorwinion
lore: ...its inhabitants, traditional trading partners of Esgaroth and Dale, now look to their northern allies for protection against the wild Easterlings....
text: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may remove 2 Free Peoples culture tokens to take a [gandalf] event into hand from your discard pile.

name: Deep Hatred
lore: ...the War of the Dwarves and the Orcs....
text: Each time the fellowship moves, add (2). Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf who is not assigned to a skirmish to wound 2 Orcs (or to wound 1 Orc twice). Discard this from play if the fellowship is ahead on the adventure path.

name: Fear and Great Wonder
lore: The Hosts of Isengard roared, swaying this way and that, turning from fear to fear.
text: When you play this, add a [gandalf] token here. Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to spot a [gandalf] companion. That companion gains muster until end of turn.

name: The Flame of Anor
lore: The power of the flame is like that of the Sun – beautiful yet blinding.
text: Spell. Spot 3 [gandalf] companions to make a minion skirmishing a companion strength -3.

name: For a While Less Dark
lore: The Nazgûl gave a long wailing cry and swerved away; and with that the four others waivered....
text: Spell. Make a [gandalf] companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion bears a follower).

name: Gandalf, Bearer of Obligation
subtitle: Bearer of Obligation
lore: 'But all worthy things that are in peril as the world now stands, those are my care.'
text: While Gandalf is the Ring-bearer, each time the fellowship moves, add 3 burdens unless you spot 2 other companions and discard 2 [gandalf] cards from hand.

name: Look to My Coming
lore: '...at dawn on the fifth day.'
text: You may remove from the game 4 other [gandalf] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Spot Gandalf to make your [gandalf] companion strength +3.

name: No Colour Now
lore: 'He raised his hand, and spoke slowly in a clear cold voice. 'Saruman, your staff is broken.'
text: Discard your [gandalf] condition from play to discard a condition from play and draw a card.

name: The Palantír of Orthanc, Recovered Seeing Stone
subtitle: Recovered Seeing Stone
lore: ...a heavy shining thing came hurtling down from above.
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. To play this, if you can spot The Palantír of Orthanc, discard it. At the start of the fellowship phase, you may add a burden to reveal a Shadow player's hand. He or she must choose a revealed minion and discard it from hand.

name: Pallando, Far-travelling One
subtitle: Far-travelling One
lore: Brought as a companion by Alatar, he traveled the South and East to aid the Free Peoples.
text: Aid – (2). Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a [gandalf] companion, exert bearer twice. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard a condition from play.

name: Radagast, Tender of Beasts
subtitle: Tender of Beasts
lore: 'It would have been useless in any case to try and win over the honest Radagast to treachery.'
text: Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) While you can spot 2 [gandalf] companions, minions skirmishing bearer do not gain strength bonuses from possessions.

name: Return to Us
lore: 'Yes, that was the name. I was Gandalf.'
text: Discard 2 Shadow cards from hand to take a [gandalf] event into hand from your discard pile.

name: Dwarf-lords
lore: ...Seven for the Dwarf-lords in their halls of stone....
text: You may remove from the game 4 other [dwarven] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Make your Dwarf bearing a hand weapon strength +3.

name: Shadowfax, Roaring Wind
subtitle: Roaring Wind
lore: Then Shadowfax gathered himself together and sprang away, and the night flowed over him....
text: Bearer must be a Wizard. When you play Shadowfax, you may reinforce a [gandalf] token. Skirmish: Remove 2 [gandalf] tokens to wound a minion skirmishing bearer.

name: Strange Meeting
lore: 'Gandalf obviously expected to find Treebeard here; and Treebeard might almost have been loitering about near the gates on purpose to meet him.'
text: Each companion bearing a follower gains muster (and is strength +1 if that companion is a [gandalf] companion).

name: Traveler's Homestead
lore: Of the Wizards, it was Gandalf that chose no home.
text: To play, spot a Wizard. When you play this, add X [gandalf] tokens here, where X is the current region number. Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to discard a Shadow condition from play.

name: Vapour and Steam
lore: 'There was none to see, or perhaps in after ages songs would still be sung of the Battle of the Peak.'
text: Skirmish: Exert your [gandalf] companion and add a burden to make that companion damage +1.

name: Chasm's Edge
lore: ...Gollum, dancing like a mad thing, held aloft the ring... It shown now as if verily it was wrought of living fire.
text: Gollum is strength +1 for each Ring-bound companion you can spot.

name: Cunningly Hidden
lore: 'No one ever found out what had become of Déagol....'
text: You may remove from the game 4 [gollum] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Spot Gollum to make a minion strength +2.

name: Déagol, Fateful Finder
subtitle: Fateful Finder
lore: '...there in his hand lay a beautiful golden ring.'
text: To play, spot Sméagol. Aid – Add a burden. Skirmish: If bearer is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this from play to play an artifact or possession from your draw deck on bearer.

name: Duality
lore: Gollum had two loyalties: The Ring and The Ring.
text: Spot Sméagol to choose a Shadow player who must discard a Shadow card from hand or remove (2).

name: Fishing Boat
text: Bearer must be Sméagol. When you play Fishing Boat, you may reinforce a [gollum] token. Each time Sméagol is about to be overwhelmed in a skirmish, you may remove 2 [gollum] tokens to make him strength +2 until the end of that skirmish.

name: Gladden Homestead
text: To play, spot Sméagol. When you play this, add a [gollum] token here for each [gollum] card you can spot. Maneuver: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to spot a Shadow condition and place that condition on top of its owner's draw deck.

name: Gimli, Lord of the Glittering Caves
subtitle: Lord of the Glittering Caves
lore: 'He and his people did great works in Gondor and Rohan.'
text: Damage +1. Gimli is strength +1 for each minion assigned to a skirmish. Assignment: Exert Gimli and spot a lurker minion to make that minion lose lurker until the regroup phase.

name: Gollum, Her Sneak
subtitle: Her Sneak
lore: Of that deadly gleam and of the dark eyeholes Frodo and Sam were always conscious.
text: While a card titled Déagol is removed from the game, Gollum is strength +2 and fierce. Shadow: Remove a card titled Déagol in your discard pile from the game to play this minion from your discard pile.

name: It's My Birthday
lore: 'Give us that, Déagol, my love....'
text: Make Gollum strength +2 (or +4 if you can spot Sméagol or Déagol).

name: Little Snuffler
text: If the fellowship is in region 1, spot Gollum to wound a companion. If the fellowship is in region 2, spot Gollum to exert a companion. If the fellowship is in region 3, play a [gollum] minion from your discard pile.

name: Naked Waste
lore: 'Nothing can hide from them. Curse the White Face!'
text: You may remove from the game 4 other [gollum] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Spot Sméagol to make a Ring-bound companion strength +3.

name: Out of All Knowledge
lore: And he thought suddenly: \"It would be cool and shady under those mountains. The Sun could not watch me there.\"'
text: Spot Sméagol or exert Gollum to make Sméagol strength +2 and you may reinforce a [gollum] token.

name: Sméagol, Simple Stoor
subtitle: Simple Stoor
lore: '...his head and his eyes were downward.'
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. For each card titled Déagol in your discard pile, Sméagol is strength +2 and resistance -1. Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, you may take a [gollum] card from your draw deck and place it in your discard pile.

name: Softly Up Behind
lore: 'The Ring went into the shadows with him, and even the maker... could learn nothing of it.'
text: Spot Sméagol and discard 2 [gollum] cards from hand to return a minion with strength 6 or less to its owner's hand. While this is in your discard pile, Sméagol gains muster.

name: Trap Is Sprung
lore: 'Crumbs on his jacket. He took it. He took it!'
text: To play, discard Gollum from play. Heal the Ring-bearer to add a burden. If the fellowship is not in region 1, you may repeat this for each other wound on the Ring-bearer.

name: Wild Light of Madness
lore: ...for at that moment many things happened.
text: Spot Gollum to make the Free Peoples player choose to either add a burden or exert a companion.

name: Aragorn, Isildur's Heir
subtitle: Isildur's Heir
lore: Thus came Aragorn, son of Arathorn, Elessar....
text: Aragorn is strength +1 for each [gondor] card that has a culture token on it. At the start of each assignment phase, you may exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion that has resistance 7 or more defender +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Honoring His Kinfolk
lore: ...but Gimli had to be dragged away by Legolas....
text: If a Dwarf wins a fierce skirmish, play a [dwarven] possession from your discard pile and you may reinforce a [dwarven] token.

name: Away on the Wind
lore: '...then I will have naught: neither life diminished, nor love halved, nor honour abated.'
text: Response: If Faramir is about to take a wound, discard this condition from play and place Boromir or Denethor in the dead pile from play to prevent that and heal Faramir twice.

name: Banners Blowing
lore: And so... with less than six thousands... the Captains of the West came at last to challenge the Black Gate....
text: You may remove from the game 4 other [gondor] cards in your discard pile to play this event from your discard pile. Then remove this event from the game. Make your [gondor] Man strength +3.

name: Boromir, Doomed Heir
subtitle: Doomed Heir
lore: 'I shall go to Minas Tirith, alone if need be, for it is my duty.'
text: Boromir is resistance -1 for each lurker minion you can spot. Skirmish: Exert Boromir to make him strength +1 for each possession he bears.

name: Brego, Loyal Steed
subtitle: Loyal Steed
lore: 'Turn this fellow free. He has seen enough of war.'
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. When you play Brego, you may reinforce a [gondor] token. Maneuver: Exert bearer and remove 2 [gondor] tokens to wound a minion.

name: Denethor, Last Ruling Steward
subtitle: Last Ruling Steward
lore: ...he took up the staff of his Stewardship that lay at his feet and broke it on his knee.
text: Denethor is resistance +1 for each [gondor] possession in your discard pile. Maneuver: Spot a [gondor] possession borne by a companion and remove that possession from the game to exert a minion twice.

name: Elendil, High-king of Gondor
subtitle: High-king of Gondor
lore: '...and Elendil of Westernesse who overthrew Sauron....'
text: Knight. To play, spot 2 [gondor] knights or exert 2 [gondor] Men. Each of your [gondor] companions is resistance +1. Maneuver: Remove a [gondor] token to make an unbound companion resistance +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Faramir, Prince of Ithilien
subtitle: Prince of Ithilien
lore: 'Do you wish then... that our places had been exchanged?'
text: While you can spot Boromir, Faramir is twilight cost -1. While you can spot Denethor, Faramir is twilight cost -1. While Faramir bears a [gondor] possession, he is defender +1.

name: Guard of the White Tree
lore: This was the livery of the heirs of Elendil, and none wore it now in all Gondor, save the Guards of the Citadel....
text: Knight. Skirmish: Discard a [gondor] condition from your support area to make this companion strength +2.

name: Guarded City
lore: ...so strong and old that it seemed to have been not builded but carven by giants out of the bones of the earth.
text: Spot a [gondor] companion to reinforce a [gondor] token for each possession borne by that companion.

name: Heirs of Gondor
lore: 'And Eldarion our son is a man full-ripe for kingship.'
text: When you play this, add a [gondor] token here. Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a [gondor] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2.

name: Sorrow Shared
lore: Gimli was saddened by Éowyn's despair.
text: Remove a [dwarven] token to heal a Dwarf.

name: Hope Renewed
lore: '...Frodo saw the old king's head: it was lying rolled away by the roadside... 'Look! The king has got a crown again!'
text: Discard a [gondor] possession from play to discard a possession from play and you may reinforce a [gondor] token.

name: Isildur, Heir of Elendil
subtitle: Heir of Elendil
lore: '...Elendil's son cut the Ring from Sauron's hand....'
text: Knight. Isildur is resistance +1 for each card in your hand. At the end of any phase, if Isildur has resistance 0, place him in your dead pile. Each time you reconcile, you may draw a card.

name: Kings' Legacy
text: Each time Elendil wins a skirmish, make a [gondor] or [elven] companion strength +2 until the start of the regroup phase. Each time Isildur wins a skirmish, heal a Man. Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, make a [gondor] Man damage +1 until the start of the regroup phase.

name: Kingsfoil
lore: 'Life to the dying / In the king's hand lying!'
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Fellowship: Discard this possession from play to heal a companion and, if that companion is a [shire] companion, you may discard a condition he or she bears.

name: Rally the Company
lore: Aragorn was able to keep the way open for escape from the Chamber of Mazarbul.
text: Make a [gondor] companion strength +2 (or +4 if that companion has resistance 6 or more).

name: Stewards' Legacy
text: Each time Denethor exerts, he gains muster until the end of the regroup phase. Each time Boromir exerts, you may exert a minion. Each time Faramir exerts, you may spot a minion to prevent it from using special abilities until the regroup phase.

name: Storied Homestead
lore: ...a silent company of tall images graven in cold stone.
text: When you play this, add a [gondor] token here for each [gondor] companion who has resistance 7 or more. Response: If a minion's special ability is used, discard this condition or remove 2 [gondor] tokens from here to cancel its effect.

name: Tradesman From Lebennin
lore: Fearful of the spreading Shadow, many from southern Gondor sought refuge behind the walls of Minas Tirith.
text: At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (2) to reinforce a [gondor] token.

name: Alatar Deceived
lore: '...the world of Men, which We must rule.'
text: Each time a Wizard wins a skirmish, this condition becomes a fierce, damage +1 Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 11 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.

name: Pallando Deceived
lore: 'We may join with that Power.'
text: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert a Wizard to make this condition a fierce Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 10 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.

name: Subterranean Homestead
text: To play, exert 2 Dwarves. When you play this, add a [dwarven] token here for each mountain site and each underground site on the adventure path. Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make a Shadow player discard the top card of his or her draw deck.

name: Radagast Deceived
lore: 'Radagast the Simple! Radagast the Fool!'
text: Each time a Wizard heals, this condition becomes a fierce Wizard minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 12 strength and 1 vitality, and cannot take wounds or bear other cards. This card is still a condition.

name: Staff of Saruman, Fallen Istar's Stave
subtitle: Fallen Istar's Stave
lore: He raised his staff and it engulfed Gandalf in flames.
text: Bearer must be a Wizard. Regroup: If Saruman is the only minion you can spot, discard this artifact from play to return him to your hand.

name: Bring Down the Wall
lore: 'Helm's Deep has one weakness. Its outer wall is solid rock but for a small culvert at its base, which is little more than a drain.'
text: Spot a companion to make a [men] minion strength +1 for each wound on that companion.

name: Caravan From the South
text: To play, spot a [men] minion. When you play this, if you spot a plains site on the adventure path, reinforce 3 [men] tokens. Each time the Free Peoples player plays the fellowship's next site, you may discard a possession from play.

name: Corsair Champion
lore: Rumor of his approach strikes terror.
text: Each time a Free Peoples possession is played, you may spot a [men] card and reveal this minion from hand to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion. While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.

name: Cruel Dunlending
lore: Burning with a rage stoked by Saruman, the Wild Hillmen made the Rohirrim villagers suffer.
text: Skirmish: If this minion is not assigned to a skirmish, you may exert him to make another [men] minion fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Desert Wind
lore: Silent Haradrim assassins strike as if from nowhere.
text: To play, spot a [men] minion. While you can spot 5 or more culture tokens, the minion archery total is +2.

name: Driven From the Plains
lore: The Hillmen sent the villagers before them like lambs to the slaughter.
text: Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make a [men] minion damage +1 for each of the following that is true: it is at a plains site; it is bearing a possession; it is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less.

name: Dunlending Patriarch
lore: The wisdom of Dunland is passed from elder to youth.
text: When you play this, you may spot another [men] minion to make this minion twilight cost -1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer. While each companion is wounded, this minion is fierce.

name: Dunlending Trapper
lore: His traps catch men as well as beasts.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) To play, spot a [men] minion. Assignment: Discard a [men] card from your hand to assign this minion to an unbound companion.

name: Arwen, Reflection of Lúthien
subtitle: Reflection of Lúthien
lore: 'Arwen vanimelda, namarië!'
text: While the fellowship is at a forest site, each of your other [elven] companions is resistance +1. Skirmish: Exert Arwen to make a minion she is skirmishing strength -1 for each other companion assigned to a skirmish.

name: Easterling Runner
lore: The key to coordinating the columns of the Easterling army is their use of swift couriers.
text: Shadow: Exert this minion, spot another [men] minion, and remove a culture token to reinforce a [men] token.

name: Fires Brightly Burning
lore: The torches of hate carried by the Dunlendings were kindled by the voice of Saruman.
text: You may remove from the game 4 [men] cards in your discard pile instead of paying the twilight cost for this card. Make your [men] minion strength +2.

name: Gríma, Footman of Saruman
subtitle: Footman of Saruman
lore: 'He was crafty: dulling men's wariness, or working on their fears, as served the occasion.'
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time a Free Peoples character is killed, you may spot another [men] minion to exert each companion.

name: Harmless
lore: The Dunlendings prey on weak village folk.
text: Response: If a companion loses a skirmish involving a [men] minion, transfer this condition from your support area to that companion. Limit 1 per companion. Minions cannot take wounds during skirmishes involving bearer.

name: Howdah
lore: Wooden towers perched on the backs of the Mûmakil.
text: When you play this, add a [men] token here for each [men] archer you spot. At the start of the archery phase, you may discard this condition from play or remove 2 tokens from here to make the minion archery total +1.

name: Lying in Wait
text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to your [men] minion. Limit 1 per bearer. Bearer is strength +1 for each other [men] minion you can spot. Each time a [men] minion wins a skirmish, make bearer strength +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Merciless Dunlending
lore: Victims of the Dunlendings receive no quarter.
text: While you can spot another [men] minion, this minion is strength +2 for each companion assigned to a skirmish.

name: Pirate Cutthroat
lore: Prisoners are never taken by the Corsairs of Umbar.
text: To play, spot a [men] card in your support area. Shadow: Exert this minion and spot a Free Peoples condition to reinforce a [men] token for each card you spot that has the same card title as that condition.

name: Southron Murderer
lore: In Harad, death is often swift, but seldom painless.
text: Archer. While you can spot 4 or more culture tokens, this minion cannot take wounds except during skirmishes.

name: Stragglers
lore: When finished ransacking a homestead, Dunlendings slaughtered fleeing villagers.
text: When you play this, add a [men] token here. Skirmish: Discard this from play or remove a token from here to make a [men] minion strength +2 for each [men] minion not assigned to a skirmish.

name: Bound By Rage
text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot 2 [dunland] Men to place 2 [dunland] tokens here. Response: If a [dunland] Man is about to take a wound, discard this condition or remove a [dunland] token from here to prevent that wound.

name: Suspended Palaces
text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot a Dwarf to place 2 [dwarven] tokens here. Fellowship: Discard this condition or remove a [dwarven] token from here to stack the top card of your draw deck on a [dwarven] condition that has a card stacked on it.

name: Dead Ones
lore: 'The Dead can't really be there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'
text: Twilight. Damage +1. To play this minion, remove a burden or spot a twilight minion.

name: Gate Picket
lore: Now the watch-towers, which had fallen into decay, were repaired, and filled with arms, and garrisoned with ceaseless vigilance.
text: Maneuver: Exert this minion twice to make the Free Peoples player name 3 cultures. Wound each companion and ally not of a named culture.

name: Gate Sentry
lore: In it there was a single gate of iron, and upon its battlement sentinels paced unceasingly.
text: Maneuver: Exert this minion twice and spot another [sauron] minion to discard a condition.

name: Gate Troll
lore: This was Cirith Gorgor, the Haunted Pass, the entrance to the land of the Enemy.
text: Fierce. While you can spot a Troll, Gate Troll's twilight cost is -4. For each other [sauron] minion you can spot, this minion is strength +1.

name: Orc Insurgent
lore: 'You've spoken more than enough, Uglúk,' sneered the evil voice. 'I wonder how they would like it in Lugbúrz.'
text: Shadow: Exert this minion to draw X cards and add (X), where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you spot over 2.

name: Peril
lore: 'A winged Nazgûl awaits us northward on the east-bank.'
text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a [sauron] Orc to play a Nazgûl or [sauron] minion. Its twilight cost is -4 and it comes into play exhausted.

name: Troll of Udûn
lore: '...Trolls are only counterfeits, made by the Enemy in the Great Darkness, in mockery of Ents....'
text: Fierce. While you can spot a Troll, this minion's twilight cost is -4. Skirmish: Discard a [sauron] card from hand to make this minion strength +1.

name: Troll's Chain
lore: Trolls they were, but filled with the evil will of their master.
text: Bearer must be a [sauron] Troll. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.

name: Wisp of Pale Sheen
lore: 'They do not see what lies ahead / When Sun has failed and Moon is dead.'
text: Twilight. Regroup: Spot another [sauron] or twilight minion and discard this minion to add a burden.

name: Held
text: Bearer must be Frodo. Each time Frodo is about to be killed by a wound, add a burden instead. When the fellowship moves to site 9, Frodo is corrupted. Regroup: If you can spot no minions, discard this condition.

name: Toss Me
lore: 'Don't tell the Elf.'
text: While this card is stacked on a [dwarven] condition, Gimli is strength +1. Fellowship: Place this card or another [dwarven] card from hand on top of or beneath your draw deck.

name: It Burns Us
lore: 'No more than you deserve.'
text: Regroup: Spot Sam and Sméagol (or Gollum) to choose an opponent who must reveal his or her hand. Wound a minion X times, where X is the number of different cultures revealed.

name: Kept Safe
text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, place 2 [shire] tokens here. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to take a wound, discard this condition or remove a [shire] token from here to prevent that wound.

name: Long Slow Wrath
lore: 'The coming of the hobbits and the tidings that they brought have spilled it: it will soon be running like a flood....'
text: Skirmish: Exert an unbound Hobbit to make him strength +1 and damage +1 for each [gandalf] companion you can spot.

name: Merry, Impatient Hobbit
subtitle: Impatient Hobbit
lore: 'Don't talk to it Merry. Don't encourage it.'
text: Regroup: Discard Merry to heal a [gandalf] companion.

name: Pippin, Hastiest of All
subtitle: Hastiest of All
lore: 'By root and twig, but this is a strange business: up sprout a little folk that are not in the old lists....'
text: Regroup: Discard Pippin to choose a Shadow player who must wound one of his or her minions.

name: Rocks of Emyn Muil
text: Fellowship: Play a companion with the Frodo signet to remove a burden.

name: Westfold
text: Fellowship: Exert Aragorn twice to play a companion with the Aragorn signet from your draw deck.

name: Meduseld
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert 3 companions with the Gandalf signet to play an unbound companion from your dead pile.

name: Hornburg Hall
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Spot 3 companions with the Théoden signet and discard your hand to draw 4 cards.

name: Valley of Saruman
text: When the fellowship moves to this site, discard all allies.

name: Agility
lore: Elves rely upon more than strength in combat.
text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot an Elf to place 2 [elven] tokens here. Skirmish: Discard this condition or remove an [elven] token from here to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1.

name: Saruman's Laboratory
text: Response: If your minion is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

name: Faramir, Ithilien Ranger
subtitle: Ithilien Ranger
lore: 'Not while Faramir is Captain... his life is charmed, or fate spares him for some other end.'
text: Ring-bound. Ranger. If Faramir is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. Fellowship: Play a ranger to heal a Ring-bound companion.

name: The Witch-king, Deathless Lord
subtitle: Deathless Lord
lore: 'Dead? No, you cannot kill them.'
text: Fierce. Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving a Nazgûl, wound an ally twice or exert a companion.

name: Arwen, Evenstar of Her People
subtitle: Evenstar of Her People
lore: 'If you trust nothing else, trust this... trust us.'
text: Skirmish: Exert an Elf to make a minion skirmishing Arwen strength -1.

name: Banner of Elbereth
lore: 'First name the four, the free peoples: / Eldest of all, the elf-children...'
text: Bearer must be an Elf companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may draw a card. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this possession to liberate a site.

name: Elrond, Keeper of Vilya
subtitle: Keeper of Vilya
lore: 'You have forseen it. War is coming... many will die.'
text: At the start of each turn, heal Elrond. Fellowship: Exert Elrond to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, you may take it into hand and heal an Elf companion.

name: Forearmed
lore: 'Give them a volley.'
text: Skirmish: Reveal the top card of your draw deck to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the revealed card.

name: Forewarned
lore: 'Whether by the sword or the slow decay of time, Aragorn will die.'
text: To play, spot 2 Elves. Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Add (1) to look at the top card of your draw deck. You may discard this condition to discard that card.

name: Galadriel, Keeper of Nenya
subtitle: Keeper of Nenya
lore: 'In Dwimordene, in Lórien / More fair than thoughts of Mortal Men.'
text: At the start of each turn, heal Galadriel. Skirmish: Exert Galadriel to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is a Shadow card, make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -3.

name: Gift of Foresight
lore: 'Here you will dwell, bound to your grief, under the fading trees.'
text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may discard it, return it to the top of your draw deck, or take it into hand.

name: Dunlending Elder
lore: Hatred of the Rohirrim is passed from generation to generation.
text: While you control 2 sites, this minion is strength +5, fierce and damage +1.

name: Must Be a Dream
lore: 'May the Grace of the Valar protect you.'
text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. Heal up to 2 companions whose culture matches the revealed card. You may discard the revealed card.

name: Naith Longbow
lore: 'Show them no mercy, for you shall receive none.'
text: Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: Exert bearer to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, exert a minion.

name: Naith Troop
lore: Now only the bow and the sword can forestall the coming of the Shadow.
text: To play, spot 3 Elf companions. Skirmish: Exert Naith Troop to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, make a minion skirmishing Naith Troop strength -2.

name: Naith Warband
lore: 'But do not think that only by singing amid the trees... is Lothlórien maintained and defended....'
text: To play, spot 3 Elf companions. While Naith Warband bears a ranged weapon, it takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase and does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Boomed and Trumpeted
lore: 'For bole and bough are burning now, the furnace roars – we go to war!'
text: Skirmish: Make an Ent strength +X and damage +X, where X is the number of unbound Hobbits you can spot.

name: Crack Into Rubble
lore: 'To Isengard! Though Isengard be ringed and barred with doors of stone; / Though Isengard be strong and hard, as cold as stone and bare as bone....'
text: Regroup: Exert 2 Ents to liberate a site and discard a Shadow condition.

name: Enraged
lore: 'An angry Ent is terrifying.'
text: Bearer must be an Ent. Limit 1 per bearer. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

name: Ent Avenger
lore: As they drew near the flash and flicker of their eyes could be seen.
text: While you can spot 3 Ents, this companion is strength +2.

name: Ent Horde
lore: 'With doom we come, with doom we come!'
text: To play, spot 2 Ent companions. Ent Horde's twilight cost is -2 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot. While you can spot more minions than companions, Ent Horde is defender +1.

name: Ent Moot
lore: But when the Ents all gathered round Treebeard,... then the Hobbits saw that they were all of the same kindred, and all had the same eyes....
text: To play, exert an unbound Hobbit. Bearer must be an Ent. Limit 1 per bearer.

name: Dunlending Footmen
lore: Driven by Saruman's ranting, waves of Dunlendings descended upon the holdings of Rohan.
text: The twilight cost of this minion during a skirmish phase is -2.

name: Gandalf, Mithrandir
subtitle: Mithrandir
lore: 'The Dark Lord has Nine. But we have One, mightier than they: the White Rider. He has passed through the fire and the abyss, and they shall fear him.'
text: Damage +1. Each time the fellowship moves, wound Gandalf.

name: Glamdring, Lightning Brand
subtitle: Lightning Brand
lore: 'Thunder they heard, and lightning... smote upon Celebdil, and leaped back broken into tongues of fire.'
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. He is damage +1. Each time you play a spell during a skirmish, you may make Gandalf damage +1 until the end of that skirmish.

name: Host of Fangorn
lore: 'Of course, it is likely enough, my friends... that we are going to our doom, the last march of the Ents.'
text: To play, spot 2 Ent companions. Host of Fangorn's twilight cost is -2 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot.

name: Quickbeam, Bregalad
subtitle: Bregalad
lore: 'But if we stayed home and did nothing, doom would find us anyway, sooner or later.'
text: Quickbeam's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot.

name: Roused
lore: To Isengard!' the Ents cried in many voices.
text: Skirmish: Exert an Ent to make him strength +1 for each Ent you spot (limit +4).

name: Skinbark, Fladrif
subtitle: Fladrif
lore: 'He was wounded by Orcs, and many of his folk and tree-herds have been murdered and destroyed.'
text: Skinbark's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent or unbound Hobbit you can spot. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to take a wound, exert Skinbark to prevent that wound.

name: Threw Down My Enemy
lore: '...he fell from the high place and broke the mountain-side where he smote it in his ruin.'
text: Spell. Skirmish: Make a minion skirmishing Gandalf strength -1 for each wound on each character in the skirmish.

name: Treebeard, Guardian of the Forest
subtitle: Guardian of the Forest
lore: 'The little that I know of his long slow story would make a tale for which we have no time now.'
text: Unhasty. Assignment: Exert an unbound Hobbit to allow Treebeard to skirmish. Skirmish: Exert Treebeard to make an Ent damage +1.

name: Don't Follow the Lights
lore: 'Careful, careful now or Hobbits go down to join the dead ones and light little candles.'
text: Response: If Sméagol wins a skirmish, add a burden to discard a minion.

name: Don't Look at Them
lore: 'You should not look in when the candles are lit.'
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Spot Sméagol and discard 3 cards from hand to wound a minion Sméagol is skirmishing once (or twice if that minion is a [wraith] minion).

name: Dunlending Headman
lore: The diminished Rohirrim offered little resistance to the advancing Dunland horde.
text: When you play this minion, you may spot 2 other [dunland] Men to take control of a site. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards from hand to prevent this.

name: Gollum, Old Villain
subtitle: Old Villain
lore: 'Must take it. The Wraiths are searching. Must take it.'
text: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to make Gollum strength +1 (or +2 if skirmishing a Ring-bound companion).

name: Master Broke His Promise
lore: 'Kill them! Kill them! Kill them both! And then we take the Precious! We be the Master!'
text: Regroup: Exert Gollum 3 times to wound each companion. The move limit for this turn is -1.

name: Nasty, Foul Hobbitses
lore: 'We ought to wring their filthy little necks!'
text: Response: If Gollum wins a skirmish, add a burden.

name: Not Listening
lore: 'They'll wake too quick and kill us... Not now. Not Yet.'
text: Response: If Sméagol wins a skirmish, heal him and remove 2 burdens.

name: Safe Paths
lore: 'Soft and quick as shadows we must be!'
text: Regroup: Exert Sméagol 3 times and discard him to wound each minion. The move limit for this turn is +1. If the fellowship moves, each Shadow player may take up to 3 Shadow cards into hand from his or her discard pile.

name: Sméagol, Poor Creature
subtitle: Poor Creature
lore: 'And we're so lonely... We'll be nice to them, very nice, if they'll be nice to us, won't we, yes, yess.'
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to make Sméagol strength +1.

name: They Stole It
lore: 'Where iss it, where iss it: my precious....'
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Spot Gollum and discard 3 cards from hand to wound a companion Gollum is skirmishing once (or twice if that companion is a [shire] companion).

name: You're a Liar and a Thief
lore: 'No, sweet one. See, my precious: if we has it, then we can escape, even from Him, eh?'
text: Response: If Gollum wins a skirmish, wound a companion (except the Ring- bearer).

name: Anborn, Skilled Huntsman
subtitle: Skilled Huntsman
lore: 'Perhaps under the shadow of the Unnamed some of the beasts of Mirkwood are wandering hither to our woods.'
text: Ring-bound. Ranger. Each time Anborn wins a skirmish, you may make a minion's site number +3 until the regroup phase.

name: Ancient Roads
lore: '...they go ever more heedlessly, we learn, thinking that the power of their new master is great enough....'
text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot 3 rangers, the site number of each minion skirmishing a ranger is +2.

name: Dunlending Reserve
lore: The relentless campaign of the hillmen drove citizens of the Westfold to the shelter of their capital.
text: The twilight cost of this minion during a skirmish phase is -2.

name: Aragorn, Defender of Free Peoples
subtitle: Defender of Free Peoples
lore: '...this is the hour when we draw swords together.'
text: Skirmish: Remove an [elven] token to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength -3. Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token to heal a Dwarf. Regroup: If Aragorn is mounted, remove a [rohan] token to wound a minion twice.

name: Banner of Westernesse
lore: 'What brought they from the foundered land / Over the flowing sea?... / and one white tree.'
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may heal another [gondor] companion. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this possession to liberate a site.

name: Garrison of Osgiliath
lore: 'So ever do we watch the shores nigh Osgiliath....'
text: Fortification. Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot a [gondor] Man to place 2 [gondor] tokens here. Skirmish: Discard this condition or remove a [gondor] token from here to make a [gondor] Man strength +1.

name: Mortal Men
lore: 'I fear neither death nor pain.'
text: Skirmish: Make a [gondor] Man strength +2 (and exert a minion if you spot a [rohan] token).

name: Perilous Ventures
lore: 'But still we will not sit idle and let Him do all as He would....'
text: Regroup: Exert 2 rangers to discard a minion (or 2 [wraith] minions).

name: Ring of Barahir
lore: 'This is a thing of worth beyond your reckoning. For its ancientry alone. It has no power, save the esteem in which those hold it who love my house.'
text: Bearer must be Aragorn. At the start of each of your turns, you may spot a culture token to heal a companion of that culture.

name: Trust
lore: 'You cannot falter now.'
text: Skirmish: Make a [gondor] Man strength +2 (and heal a companion if you spot an [elven] token).

name: Agents of Orthanc
lore: 'How long is it since Saruman bought you?'
text: This minion is strength +2 and damage +1 for each Free Peoples culture that you can spot over 2.

name: Assault Ladder
lore: 'It is a great host....'
text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [isengard] token on this card. Skirmish: Spot 3 [isengard] tokens here to make an Uruk-hai strength +3. Discard this condition.

name: Banner of Isengard
lore: ...blazoned upon every helm and shield the ghastly hand of Isengard was seen.
text: Bearer must be an [isengard] minion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion for each site you control.

name: Hill Clan
lore: 'We will take their king.'
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [dunland] Man from hand. That Man is fierce and damage +2 until the regroup phase.

name: Berserk Butcher
text: Damage +1. Berserk Butcher is strength +1 for each wound on each character in its skirmish. Maneuver: Remove an [isengard] token from a machine and exert Berserk Butcher twice to prevent all wounds to Uruk-hai until the assignment phase.

name: Desertion
lore: 'Who knows what you've spoken to the darkness in the bitter watches of the night?'
text: To play, spot an [isengard] Man. Plays on a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Assignment: Assign an [isengard] minion with less strength than bearer to skirmish bearer. Discard this condition.

name: Fires and Foul Fumes
