lore: 'One of them... got caught in a spray of some liquid fire and burned like a torch: a horrible sight.'
text: Regroup: Discard 4 [isengard] Orcs to wound a companion 4 times (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Gnawing, Biting, Hacking, Burning
lore: 'Destroyers and usurpers.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a regroup action discards an [isengard] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card. Shadow: Discard 2 cards stacked here and remove (1) to play an [isengard] Orc from your discard pile.

name: Iron Fist of the Orc
lore: 'The old world will burn in the fires of industry.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a regroup action discards an [isengard] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card. Regroup: Discard 3 cards stacked here and remove (1) to discard a Free Peoples possession.

name: Isengard Artisan
lore: Minions of Orthanc shared their master's fascination with machines.
text: Regroup: Discard an [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

name: Isengard Builder
lore: 'They were all singing with harsh voices, and laughing, making a hideous din.'
text: Regroup: If stacked on an [isengard] card, discard this card to add (2).

name: Isengard Journeyman
lore: Drudgery and toil at Isengard left Saruman's minions hungry for sport.
text: Regroup: Discard an [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

name: Isengard Mechanics
text: Regroup: Discard an [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion (or 2 companions if you spot 6 companions). Regroup: If this minion is stacked on an [isengard] card, spot an [isengard] Orc and discard this minion to add (3).

name: Isengard Plodder
lore: Saruman dispatched his trusted Orcs to aid in the sack of Rohan.
text: Regroup: Discard an [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

name: Ready to Fall
lore: 'Why do you lay these troubles on an already troubled mind?'
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Spot 2 sites you control and remove (2) to play a [dunland] Man from your discard pile.

name: Isengard Tender
lore: Unfortunate Orcs assisted in Saruman's foul wizardry.
text: Regroup: If stacked on an [isengard] card, discard this card and remove (2) to exhaust a companion.

name: Isengard Tinker
lore: 'I wonder if his fame was... due to his cleverness in settling at Isengard.'
text: Regroup: Discard an [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

name: Rohirrim Traitor
lore: 'Once it was a man, and did you service in its fashion.'
text: While you can spot a companion bearing an [isengard] condition, this minion is strength +2.

name: Scaffolding
lore: Towers marked the inner ring, implements of industry.
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a regroup action discards an [isengard] Orc, you may stack that Orc on this card. Response: If an [isengard] Orc is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards stacked here to prevent that wound.

name: Sharku, Vile Marauder
subtitle: Vile Marauder
lore: 'Send out your warg-riders.'
text: Warg-rider. While Sharku is not exhausted, he is fierce. Regroup: Exert Sharku to add (1).

name: Twisted Tales
lore: 'Too long have you sat in the shadows....'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving an [isengard] Man, you may spot a possession to stack that possession here.

name: The Balrog, Terror of Flame and Shadow
subtitle: Terror of Flame and Shadow
lore: '...he burst into new flame.'
text: Damage +2. The twilight cost of The Balrog is -3 if you can spot a [moria] minion. The Balrog cannot be assigned to skirmish companions or allies of strength less than 6.

name: Durin's Tower
lore: '...carved in the living rock of Zirakzigil, the pinnacle of the Silvertine.'
text: Plays to your support area. At sites 2[T] and 3[T], The Balrog's twilight cost is -3. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a unique [moria] minion strength +3.

name: Easterling Army
text: Easterling. Fierce. Skirmish: Spot 2 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +1. Skirmish: Spot 4 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +2. Skirmish: Spot 6 burdens and exert this minion to make an Easterling strength +3.

name: Easterling Polearm
lore: '...and the tips of their spears....'
text: Bearer must be an Easterling. While you can spot 2 burdens, bearer cannot take wounds. While you can spot 5 burdens, bearer is damage +1.

name: Too Long Have These Peasants Stood
lore: The rabble of Dunland pillaged their way across the Mark.
text: Response: If a [dunland] Man wins a skirmish, discard all conditions.

name: Southron Archer Legion
lore: 'But I've heard tales of the big folk down away in the Sunlands.'
text: Southron. Archer. Archery: Remove (3) to add 1 to the minion archery total for each companion over 4 (limit +4).

name: Southron Invaders
lore: 'So when you said \"Men out of the South, all in red and gold,\" I said \"were there any oliphaunts?\" For if there was, I was going to take a look....'
text: Southron. Ambush (1). When you play this minion, you may spot another Southron to play a minion with ambush from your discard pile.

name: Trample
lore: '...I stomp round and round, / Never lie on the ground, / Not even to die. / Oliphaunt am I....'
text: Maneuver: Spot a mounted [raider] Man to discard a companion (except the Ring-bearer). The Free Peoples player may add (4) to prevent this.

name: Fell Beast
lore: 'And these winged creatures that they ride on now, they can probably see more than any other creature. They are like great carrion birds.'
text: To play, discard 2 cards from hand. Bearer must be a Nazgûl. Bearer is fierce.

name: Spied From Above
lore: It leaped into all of their minds that the Black Wings had spied them and had sent armed soldiers to seize them....
text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a Nazgûl twice to play a [wraith] or [sauron] minion. That minion's twilight cost is -8 and it comes into play exhausted.

name: Sword of Dol Guldur
lore: The weapons of the Nine are wrought with sorcery.
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. While bearer is Úlairë Toldëa, each time he wins a skirmish the Free Peoples player must discard a Free Peoples possession or a Free Peoples condition.

name: Úlairë Lemenya, Winged Hunter
subtitle: Winged Hunter
lore: ...the helpless horror that had come with the cry in the wind and the shadow on the moon....
text: Regroup: Exert Úlairë Lemenya and discard 3 cards from hand to return a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to owner's hand.

name: Úlairë Nertëa, Winged Hunter
subtitle: Winged Hunter
lore: A vast winged shape passed over the moon like a black cloud... The stars fainted before it....
text: When you play Úlairë Nertëa, spot another Nazgûl to make the Free Peoples player exert a Ring-bound companion for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.

name: Úlairë Toldëa, Winged Sentry
subtitle: Winged Sentry
lore: 'They are calling for it. Calling for the precious.'
text: Fierce. Each time Úlairë Toldëa wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or add a burden.

name: Winged and Ominous
lore: It scudded across the moon... outrunning the wind in its fell speed.
text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a Nazgûl to place a [wraith] token on this card. Shadow: Remove 3 [wraith] tokens from here to add (2).

name: Lend Us Your Aid
lore: 'He hewed a two-handed stroke and laid the last Orc before his feet. 'Now my count passes Master Legolas again.'
text: Maneuver: Exert Gimli twice to make him and each Elf companion strength +3 until the regroup phase.

name: Banner of the Mark
lore: 'Fell deeds awake. Now for wrath. Now for ruin, and the red dawn.'
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] companion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a minion. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this possession to liberate a site.

name: Blood Has Been Spilled
lore: They were hemming the Orcs in, preventing them from scattering, and driving them....
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard a mount borne by a [rohan] Man to prevent that Man from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

name: Éomer, Rohirrim Captain
subtitle: Rohirrim Captain
lore: 'Gúthwinë for the Mark!'
text: Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1. Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to make a [rohan] Man strength +2 for each wound on each minion in his or her skirmish.

name: Ever the Hope of Men
lore: 'Would that day was here and we might ride down upon them like a storm out of the mountains!'
text: Regroup: Exert 2 mounted [rohan] Men to discard up to 2 wounded minions.

name: Háma, Doorward of Théoden
subtitle: Doorward of Théoden
lore: 'Yet in doubt a man of worth will trust to his own wisdom. I believe you are friends and folk worthy of honour, who have no evil purpose.'
text: To play, spot a [rohan] Man. Skirmish: Exert Háma to discard a possession borne by a minion he is skirmishing.

name: Hrethel, Rider of Rohan
subtitle: Rider of Rohan
lore: ...gaining on the Orcs, gaining on them like a tide over the flats on folk straying in a quicksand.
text: To play, spot a [rohan] Man. Skirmish: Heal a minion skirmishing Hrethel to make Hrethel strength +3 (limit +3).

name: News From the Mark
lore: 'We are friends of Rohan, and of Théoden, your king.'
text: Fellowship: Spot 3 mounted [rohan] Men to make the move limit for this turn +2. Each Shadow player may draw 6 cards.

name: We Left None Alive
text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, you may spot a [rohan] Man to place 2 [rohan] tokens here. Skirmish: Discard this condition or remove a [rohan] token from here to make a [rohan] Man skirmishing an exhausted minion strength +2.

name: Banner of the Eye
lore: Stony-faced they were, with dark window-holes staring north and east and west, and each window was full of sleepless eyes.
text: Bearer must be a [sauron] Orc. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may add (1) for each site you control.

name: Corpse Lights
lore: 'I tried once; but you cannot reach them. Only shapes to see, perhaps, not to touch.'
text: Twilight. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a [sauron] or twilight minion strength +1 for each twilight minion you can spot.

name: Dáin Ironfoot, King Under the Mountain
subtitle: King Under the Mountain
lore: 'The time of my thought is my own to spend.'
text: Each of your other Dwarves and [gandalf] Men is twilight cost -1. At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a [dwarven] or [gandalf] condition from play to discard a minion from play.

name: Furious Hillman
lore: No village pitchfork could provide defense against the rages of the Wild Men.
text: Response: If the Free Peoples player plays an event, spot another [men] Man and discard this minion from play to cancel that event.

name: Swarming Hillman
lore: Roving in mindless mobs, the Dunlendings destroyed many Rohirrim homesteads.
text: At the start of the regroup phase, if you can spot more Man characters than any other race, make the move limit -1 this turn.

name: Half-troll of Far Harad
lore: ...bred for battle in the southern reaches of Haradwaith....
text: At the start of each assignment phase, if you can spot more companions than minions, you may remove (2) to play an [orc] Orc from your discard pile.

name: Horror of Harad
lore: The troll-men sprinted on to the Pelennor to bathe their blades in the blood of the enemy.
text: Ambush (1). Damage +1. Fierce. Lurker. Muster. Toil 2.

name: Uruk-hai Healer
lore: Restoratives were in short supply within the ranks of the White Hand.
text: Damage +1. At the start of each assignment phase, you may heal an Uruk-hai for each companion you can spot.

name: Uruk-hai Scout
lore: ...swart, slant-eyed, with thick legs and large hands.
text: Damage +1. When you play this, choose one of the following keywords: battleground, mountain, plains, or underground. The fellowship's current site gains that keyword until the end of the turn.

name: Elladan, Son of Elrond
subtitle: Son of Elrond
lore: The Lady Celebrían bore Elrond two sons, the identical twins Elladan and Elrohir; elder brothers of Arwen, and grandchildren of Galadriel.
text: Elrohir is twilight cost -2. Each time you play an [elven] event during a skirmish involving Elladan or Elrohir, that event is twilight cost -2.

name: Elrohir, Son of Elrond
subtitle: Son of Elrond
lore: 'From the North we came with this purpose, and from Elrond our father we brought this very counsel. We will not turn back.'
text: Elladan is twilight cost -2. Each time you play an [elven] event during a skirmish involving Elrohir or Elladan, each minion in that skirmish is strength -2.

name: Gildor Inglorion, Of the House of Finrod
subtitle: Of the House of Finrod
lore: 'Elves seldom give unguarded advice, for advice is a dangerous gift, even from the wise to the wise, and all courses may run ill.'
text: At the start of each archery phase, if you can spot more minions than companions, each of your companions is an archer.

name: Brand, King of Dale
subtitle: King of Dale
lore: ...he had the aid of the Dwarves of Erebor.
text: Each of your Dwarves and other [gandalf] Men is strength +1. While you can spot more minions than companions, the fellowship archery total is +X, where X is the number of minions minus the number of companions.

name: Grimbeorn, Beorning Chieftain
subtitle: Beorning Chieftain
lore: He was perhaps a shape-shifter like his father.
text: At the start of each turn, heal Grimbeorn. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert Grimbeorn twice and discard a minion from hand to make Grimbeorn strength +X until the regroup phase, where X is that minion's strength.

name: Duilin, Ranger From Blackroot Vale
subtitle: Ranger From Blackroot Vale
lore: To Minas Tirith Duinhir brought both of his sons, Derufin and Duilin, to defend the Free Peoples of Middle-earth.
text: Ranger. While the fellowship is at a forest or river site, Duilin is strength +3.

name: Duinhir, Tall Man of Blackroot Vale
subtitle: Tall Man of Blackroot Vale
lore: The garrison at Osgiliath fought valiantly.
text: While you can spot a mount, Duinhir is damage +1. Each time Duinhir wins a skirmish, if you can spot more minions than companions, you may exert him to discard a minion that has strength 7 or less.

name: Halbarad, Ranger of the North
subtitle: Ranger of the North
lore: He was tall, a dark standing shadow.
text: Ranger. While the Ring-bearer has resistance 9 or more, Halbarad's twilight cost is -1. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may discard a [gondor] card from hand to heal a [gondor] companion.

name: Bill Ferny Sr., Servant of Azog
subtitle: Servant of Azog

name: The Last Lights of Durin's Day
Driven into the Hills
lore: 'Not in half a thousand years have they forgotten their grievance that the lords of Gondor gave the Mark to Eorl the Young and made alliance with him.'
text: To play, spot a [Dunland] minion. For each companion you can spot over 4, the Free Peoples player must have an additional card in hand to have initiative.

name: Naith Armaments
lore: The great bow of Lórien sang...
text: Bearer must be a valiant Elf. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert bearer to heal another valiant Elf.

name: To Honour That Allegiance
lore: 'It is told that Elendil stood there watching for the coming of Gil-galad out of the West, in the days of the Last Alliance.'
text: Exert a valiant companion (or spot 2 valiant Elves) to take a valiant [elven] companion or [elven] possession into hand from your draw deck.

name: Your Friends Are With You
lore: 'With hope or without hope we will follow the trail of our enemies....We will make such a chase as shall be accounted a marvel among the Three Kindreds of Elves. Dwarves, and Men.'
text: Each time your Man, Elf, or Dwarf wins a skirmish, make your Man, Elf, or Dwarf of another race strength +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Gandalf, Lathspell
subtitle: Lathspell
lore: 'No counsel have I to give to those that despair. Yet counsel I could give, and words I could speak to you.'
text: Each mounted companion gains valiant. Response: If a minion's special ability is used, spot 3 valiant companions and exert Gandalf twice to prevent that and exert that minion.

name: Remember Your Old Strength
lore: 'If this is bewitchment,' said Théoden, 'it seems to me more wholesome than your whisperings.'
text: Exert Gandalf to make Theoden and each valiant companion strength +1 until the regroup phase (or strength +2 if every unbound companion is valiant).

name: Watching and Waiting
text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards. Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (9) to draw 8 cards. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

name: Aragorn, Last Hope of Men
subtitle: Last Hope of Men
text: Valiant. At the start of each turn you may spot another valiant companion to draw a card. Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make a skirmishing valiant companion strength +2.

name: I Will Die as One of Them
lore: 'Andúril! Andúril goes to war. The Blade that was Broken shines again!'
text: Exert Aragorn three times to make each valiant companion strength +2 until the regroup phase.  If Aragorn dies during this turn, make each valiant companion strength +1 for the rest of the turn.

name: Back on the Menu
lore: Five dead Orcs lay there. They had been hewn with many cruel strokes, and two had been beheaded.
text: Skirmish: Discard a [Sauron] tracker to make an [Isengard] tracker strength +2. Skirmish: Exert an [isengard] tracker to make a [sauron] tracker fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Berserk Deathseeker
lore: The foremost fell with Legolas' last arrow in his throat. but the rest sprang over him.
text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each wound on each character in its skirmish. When this minion is killed, add 3 [isengard] tokens to an [isengard] machine.

name: Dunlending Raider
lore: 'They bring fire...and are burning as they come, rick, cot, and tree.'
text: While you have initiative, this minion's twilight cost is -2.

name: Berserk Fanatic
lore: Then the Orcs screamed, waving spear and sword, and shooting a cloud of arrows.
text: Damage +1.  This minion is strength +1 for each wound on each character in its skirmish. When this minion dies in a skirmish, you may remove 2 [isengard] tokens from a machine to wound a character it was skirmishing.

name: Breaching Shot
lore: 'They have crept in the culvert again, while we talked, and they have lit the fire of Orthanc beneath our feet.'
text: Remove X tokens from machines to assign an Uruk-hai costing X or less to an ally or unbound companion.

name: Fell from Wisdom into Folly
text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards. Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (5) to take up to 4 Shadow items into hand from your draw deck. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

name: Fires of Industry
lore: 'For bole and bough are burning now, the furnace roars...'
text: When you play this condition, spot 2 [Isengard] Orcs or a Wizard to add 2 [isengard] tokens here. At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard this condition (or remove an [isengard] token here), to heal an [Isengard] Orc.

name: Hound of Isengard
lore: 'He has taken Orcs into his service, and Wolf-riders, and evil Men...'
text: Bearer must be a warg-rider . When you play this possession, you may take an [isengard] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.

name: Isengard Foreman
lore: 'He has taken up with foul folk, with the Orcs.'
text: When you play this minion, you may play an [isengard] orc from your discard pile; it is strength +1 until the regroup phase. Regroup: Discard this minion to add two threats.

name: Isengard Grunt
lore: ...Saruman was mustering a great force on his own account, in rivalry of Sauron and not in his service yet.
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to prevent an [isengard] Orc from being overwhelmed unless its strength is tripled.

name: Legion of Isengard
lore: ...blazoned upon every helm and shield the ghastly hand of Isengard was seen...
text: Damage +1. While you control a battleground, this minion is damage +1. While at a battleground, skirmish special abilities cannot be used during skirmishes involving this minion.

name: Machinery of War
text: When you play this condition, spot a Wizard to add 2 [isengard] tokens here. Each time an [isengard] Orc loses a skirmish, add an [isengard] token here. Skirmish: Discard this condition (or remove 2 [isengard] tokens here) to cancel a skirmish involving an [isengard] Orc.

name: Saruman, Mind of Metal and Wheels
subtitle: Mind of Metal and Wheels
lore: 'I think that I now understand what he is up to. He is plotting to become a Power.'
text: Saruman may not be assigned to a skirmish. Companions skirmishing [Isengard] Orcs lose all damage bonuses. Response: If an [isengard] Orc is about to take a wound, exert Saruman to prevent that wound.

name: Dunlending Reaver
lore: Now they could hear, borne over the dark, the sound of harsh singing...
text: While you have initiative, this minion is strength +3 and damage +1.

name: Strength of the Pack
lore: At a gap in the circle a great dark wolf-shape could be seen halted, gazing at them. A shuddering howl broke from him, as if he were a captain summoning his pack to the assault.
text: Mounted [Isengard] Orcs are strength +1. While you can spot 2 mounted [isengard] Orcs, your [isengard] mounts are twilight cost -1.

name: Trail of Savagery
lore: 'They are burning or despoiling all that is left in the vale.'
text: Each site you control gains battleground. Skirmish: Remove 2 [isengard] tokens to cancel a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai.

name: Uneasy Alliance
lore: ...a quarrel seemed on the point of breaking out again between the Northerners and the Isengarders.
text: Search. While you can spot an [Isengard] tracker and a [Sauron] tracker, trackers are strength +1. Shadow: Discard a [sauron] tracker from hand to play an [isengard] tracker from your discard pile. Discard this condition.

name: Uruk Grumbler
lore: 'We came out of Isengard, and led you here, and we shall lead you back by the way we choose.'
text: Tracker. Fierce. Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a companion, you may spot a [sauron] tracker and discard this minion to wound that companion.

name: Uruk Occupier
lore: 'Our scouts have gained no news of him, and the enemy fills all the valley behind us.'
text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each battleground you control. Shadow: If you control 3 battlegrounds, discard a card from hand to play this minion from your discard pile.

name: Uruk Shield Wall
lore: They held their great shields above them like a roof...
text:
Machine. Each time an Uruk-hai costing X is about to take a wound (except during a skirmish), prevent that and exert it. X is the number of [isengard] tokens you can spot here.
Maneuver: Exert an Uruk-hai to add an [isengard] token here.

name: Wolf Pit
lore: Horsemen were galloping on the grass of Rohan; wolves poured from Isengard.
text: When you play this possession, you may stack two [isengard] mounts here from your draw deck or discard pile. Shadow: Exert an [Isengard] minion to play an [Isengard] mount stacked here as if from hand.

name: Ancient Evil
lore: '...I found myself suddenly faced by something that I have not met before.'
text: Each time a [moria] minion wins a skirmish, you may stack it here. Shadow: Play a unique minion stacked here, it is twilight cost -1 for each other card stacked here. Discard this condition.

name: The Balrog, Lieutenant of Morgoth
subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgoth
text: Fierce. Damage +1. Each time a minion takes a wound, you may remove (1) to add a threat. Each time the Free Peoples player uses a skirmish special ability during a skirmish involving the Balrog, you may wound a companion it is skirmishing.

name: From Deepest Dungeon
lore: 'Far, far below the deepest delving of the Dwarves, the world is gnawed by nameless things.'
text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may reveal The Balrog from your hand to add a threat. Shadow: Remove X threats.  Play The Balrog from your discard pile; its twilight cost is -X.

name: Horsemen Took Your Lands
lore: They will not give way now for dusk or dawn...
text: Play a non-unique [Dunland] minion from your discard pile. If you have initiative, you may play a [dunland] possession on that minion from your discard pile.

name: Through Fire and Water
lore: 'His fire was quenched, but now he was a thing of slime, stronger than a strangling snake.'
text: Each time a unique [moria] minion wins a skirmish, you may remove a threat to exert a companion.

name: To Highest Peak
lore: 'There was none to see, or perhaps in after ages songs would still be sung of the Battle of the Peak.'
text: Discard X [Moria] minions to add X threats. The Free Peoples player may exert X companions to prevent this.

name: Valiant but Foolish
text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards. Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (6) to take up to 4 Shadow conditions into hand from your draw deck. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

name: All Hope of Secrecy Lost
text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards.\Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (4) to take up to 4 Shadow events into hand from your draw deck. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

name: Threats on All Sides
text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards. Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (9) to add up to 6 threats. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

name: Do Not Trust to Hope
lore: 'I fret in this prison,' said Théoden. 'If I could have set a spear in rest, riding before my men upon the field, maybe I could have felt again the joy of battle, and so ended. But I serve little purpose here.'
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] companion. Bearer is valiant. At the start of the regroup phase, wound bearer or discard this condition.

name: An End Worthy of Remembrance
lore: Captains and champions fell or fled before them. Neither orc nor man withstood them.
text: Spot X [rohan] conditions and remove 2 tokens from each to make 3 valiant companions strength +X until the regroup phase.

name: Erkenbrand, Kinsman of the House of Eorl
subtitle: Kinsman of the House of Eorl
lore: 'He was a mighty man. In him lived again the valour of Helm the Hammerhand.'
text: When you play Erkenbrand, remove up to 3 non-unique [rohan] companions in the dead pile from the game. Each exhausted companion gains valiant.

name: Stronghold of My Fathers
lore: 'Is it not said that no foe has ever taken the Hornburg, if men defended it?'
text: Fortification. To play, spot 3 [rohan] companions (or 2 valiant companions). Response: If a [rohan] companion is about to take a wound, discard this or 2 other [rohan] possessions to prevent that wound.

name: Gúthwinë, Eomer's Blade
subtitle: Eomer's Blade
lore: The swords flashed from the sheath as one.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] companion. If bearer is Eomer, he is damage +1 and each time he wins a skirmish, you may reinforce a [rohan] token.

name: Ritual Oath of Enmity
text:
While you can spot 18 twilight tokens in region 1, this card can be played from your draw deck.
Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) and remove (7) to add a [dunland] token here.
Shadow: Spot a [dunland] token here to take control of 2 sites. Discard this artifact.

name: Let This Be the Hour
lore: At his right hand was Aragorn, Elendil's heir, behind him rode the lords of the House of Eorl the Young.
text: Exert a valiant companion to make that companion defender +1. That companion is strength +1 for each minion skirmishing them until the regroup phase.

name: Now for Wrath
text: Each time a [rohan] item or [rohan] ally is killed or discarded from play or from hand (except during the fellowship phase), add a [rohan] token here. Each time a minion is exerted by a Free Peoples card, you may remove 2 [rohan] tokens here and exert a valiant companion to wound that minion.

name: Now for Ruin
text: Each time a minion is killed, spot 2 valiant companions to add a [rohan] token here. Each time there are 3 [rohan] tokens here, remove all tokens here to play a [rohan] condition or event from your discard pile. The Shadow player may then play a minion from their discard pile.

name: And the Red Dawn
lore: 'The end will not be long,' said the king. 'But I will not end here, taken like an old badger in a trap.'
text: Maneuver: Spot 3 valiant companions to discard your hand. For each Shadow card discarded, exert a minion. For each Free Peoples card discarded, heal a valiant or [rohan] companion. You may not make any more Maneuver actions.

name: Royal Guard
lore: 'It is not as I would have it,' said Théoden; 'for this is little like my fair house in Edoras. And your friend is gone, who should also be here.'
text: To play, spot Theoden (or 3 [rohan] Men). Skirmish: Exert this ally to add his strength to a skirmishing Hobbit and make that Hobbit gain valiant until the regroup phase (limit once per phase).

name: Theoden, Last of His House
subtitle: Last of His House
lore: His beard was laid like snow upon his knees; but his eyes still burned with a bright light, glinting as he gazed...
text: Valiant. Theoden is strength +1 for each other valiant companion assigned to a skirmish.

name: To the King!
lore: 'Helm for Théoden King!'
text: Spot an unassigned valiant companion to have them replace an unbound companion in a skirmish (and make them damage +1 if that unbound companion is Theoden).

name: Attention of the Eye
text: Shadow: Spot your minion and remove (3) to draw 2 cards. Shadow: Spot 18 twilight tokens (or 25 if in region 3) to play up to 2 minions from your draw deck costing (5) or more. If in region 1, this action can be performed from your draw deck.

name: Down to Join the Dead Ones
lore: 'They lie in all the pools, pale faces, deep deep under the dark water.'
text: To play, spot a Wraith. Regroup: Discard two twilight minions to add a burden. The Free Peoples player may wound the Ring-bearer to prevent this.

name: Grishnakh, Servant of Lugburz
subtitle: Servant of Lugburz
lore: 'My dear little fellows, please believe me when I say that it was not out of kindness: that's not even one of Uglúk's faults.'
text: Tracker. The site number of each [sauron] orc is -3.  Skirmish: Exert Grishnakh to make a skirmishing [sauron] Orc with a site number of 1 or less damage +1.

name: Arwen, Lady of Rivendell
subtitle: Lady of Rivendell
lore: 'Dark is the Shadow, and yet my heart rejoices; for you, Estel, shall be among the great whose valour will destroy it.'
text: Aragorn is strength +1. While Arwen is exhausted, Aragorn is defender +1. Each time Aragorn is about to take a wound, you may wound Arwen to prevent that wound.

name: Lugburz Spotter
lore: 'You're as bad as the other rabble: the maggots and the apes of Lugbúrz.'
text: Tracker.  If this minion's site number is 1 or less, it is strength +5.

name: Marsh Wight
lore: 'The Dead can't be really there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'
text: Twilight. To play, spot a twilight minion. This minion is twilight cost -1 for each burden you can spot. While you can spot 4 burdens, this minion is damage +1.

name: No One's Going to Save You Now
lore: 'You'll wish there was more that you could tell to satisfy the Questioner, indeed you will: quite soon.'
text: Search. Make a [Sauron] tracker strength +1 for each search card you can spot (limit +5).

name: Orc of Lugburz
lore: 'Is Saruman the master or the Great Eye?' said the evil voice. 'We should go back at once to Lugbúrz.'
text: Tracker.  Each [sauron] orc with a site number of 1 or less cannot take wounds except during the skirmish phase.

name: Orc Searcher
lore: 'We'll find a use for your legs before long. You'll wish you had got none before we get home.'
text: Tracker. The site number of each [Sauron] orc is -1. Skirmish: Discard this minion to cancel a skirmish involving an [isengard] tracker.

name: Shapes to See, Not to Touch
lore: 'You cannot reach them, you cannot touch them.'
text: To play, spot a Wraith. While you can spot 3 twilight minions, twilight minions may not take wounds except during skirmishes. When the ringbearer takes off the One Ring, discard this condition.

name: Trapped in its Gaze
lore: Very soon it would nail him down, know just exactly where he was.
text: Exert a Wraith to make a twilight minion strength +2. If that minion wins its skirmish you may exert it to add a burden.

name: Eastemnet Hills
text: Mountain. When the fellowship moves from here during the regroup phase, each player may discard 2 cards to draw 2 cards.

name: Theodred's Tomb
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a valiant character to draw a card.

name: Westfold Plains
text: Plains. Each mount is twilight cost -1.

name: Deadly Contest
lore: 'Good!' said Legolas. 'But my count is now two dozen. It has been knife-work up here.'
text: Spot an [elven] companion to reinforce a [dwarven] token or spot a [dwarven] companion to reinforce an [elven] token. If you can spot both Legolas and Gimli you may reinforce both an [elven] and [dwarven] token an additional time.

name: Breached Wall
text: Battleground. The count of sites each Shadow player controls  is +1.

name: Helm's Tower
text: Battleground. While you can spot 6 companions, each character is damage +1.

name: Desolation of Saruman
text: When the fellowship moves to this site, each player may discard a card from their opponent's support area.

name: Isengard Clefts
text: Shadow: Exert a minion to play a Shadow possession from your discard pile.

name: Path of the Fellowship
lore: 'It's a dangerous business, Frodo, going out your door. You step onto the Road, and if you don't keep your feet, there's no knowing where you might be swept off to.'
text: Before the game begins, place this Map in your support area. Your adventure deck must only contain cards from the Fellowship site path.

name: Road to the Towers
lore: 'Faithless is he that says farewell when the road darkens.'
text: Before the game begins, place this Map in your support area. Your adventure deck must only contain cards from the Towers site path.

name: Journey of the King
lore: 'Tall ships and tall kings / Three times three, What brought they from the foundered land / Over the flowing sea? Seven stars and seven stones / And one white tree.'
text: Before the game begins, place this Map in your support area. Your adventure deck must only contain cards from the King site path.

name: Gandalf's Staff, Old Man's Crutch
subtitle: Old Man's Crutch
lore: 'The staff in the hand of a wizard may be more than a prop for age.'
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Discard any weapon he bears. Response: If Gandalf is exerted by a Free Peoples card, heal him (limit once per turn).

name: Haldir, Naith Commander
subtitle: Naith Commander
text: Valiant.  While Haldir bears a ranged weapon, each valiant Elf is strength +1 and does not add to the fellowship archery total. Each time an [elven] possession is about to be discarded by a card effect, you may exert Haldir to prevent that.

name: Leithio i Phillin!
lore: 'I must go and seek some arrows,' said Legolas. 'Would that this night would end, and I could have better light for shooting.'
text: Spot 2 valiant elves to wound a minion (or wound a minion twice if each of those elves bears a ranged weapon).

name: Beneath the Mountains
lore: 'There forged was blade, and bound was hilt; / The delver mined, the mason built.'
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to play a [dwarven] weapon from your discard pile.

name: Hand Axe
lore: Their captain rallied two other orcs to attack. In answer, Gimli's side axe brought him down.
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Archery: Discard this weapon to make the fellowship archery total +1.

name: Fearing the Worst
lore: 'Even if we are allowed to leave Bree unhindered, we can hardly hope now to leave it unnoticed.'
text: Stealth. To play, exert 2 Hobbits. Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each search card and each tracker is +2.

name: Filibert Bolger, Wily Rascal
subtitle: Wily Rascal
lore: Filibert knows paths and tracks that few have trodden. He is not adventurous by nature, but his escapades often require rapid departures.
text: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit companion twice to cancel a fierce skirmish involving that Hobbit.

name: Frodo, Reluctant Adventurer
subtitle: Reluctant Adventurer
lore: 'I am not made for perilous quests. I wish I had never seen the Ring! Why did it come to me? Why was I chosen?'
text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). The cost of each artifact, possession, and [shire] tale played on Frodo is -1.

name: Hobbit Sword-play
lore: Boromir sensed that a blade in a Halfling's hand would surprise a larger foe.
text: Maneuver: Exert a Hobbit bearing a weapon to wound a minion. That minion's owner may remove (3) to prevent this.

name: Merry, Horticulturalist
subtitle: Horticulturalist
lore: 'Ow... I think I've broken something.'
text: Fellowship: Exert Merry to play Farmer Maggot from your draw deck.

name: Mithril-coat
lore: '...its worth was greater than the value of the whole Shire and everything in it.'
text: Bearer must be Frodo. The minion archery total is -1. Each minion skirmishing Frodo does not gain strength bonuses from weapons and loses all damage bonuses.

name: Nice Imitation
lore: 'Very life-like!... But what will happen when they have penetrated the disguise?'
text: Stealth. Plays to your support area. Response: If a Hobbit is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.

name: Not Feared in Sunlight
lore: '...our shapes cast shadows in their minds, which only the noon sun destroys....'
text: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Plays to your support area. Each Nazgûl is strength -4. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.

name: O Elbereth! Gilthoniel!
lore: With a last effort Frodo... slipped the Ring from his finger and closed his right hand tight upon it.
text: Tale. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer. Skirmish: Discard this condition to take off The One Ring or to cancel a skirmish involving the Ring-bearer and a Nazgûl.

name: Orc-bane
lore: Glamdring shone with a pale light, and Sting glinted at the edges.
text: Maneuver: Spot Sting or Glamdring and exert its bearer X times to wound X Orcs or X Uruk-hai.

name: Make Light of Burdens
lore: A Dwarf does not readily notice the weight on his back, or in his heart.
text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf companion and discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to discard either a Shadow condition from a Dwarf or a weather condition.

name: Pippin, Mr. Took
subtitle: Mr. Took
lore: Pippin was evidently much enjoying the attention he was getting, and had become quire forgetful of their danger.
text: Fellowship: Play Gandalf or Aragorn; his twilight cost is -2.

name: Practically Everyone Was Invited
lore: Thank you, I shall certainly come.
text: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo to play a Hobbit from your draw deck.

name: A Promise
lore: 'But I'm glad, Sam. I cannot tell you how glad. Come along! It is plain that we were meant to go together.'
text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot Frodo and Sam and neither is exhausted, each is strength +1.

name: Red Book of Westmarch
lore: 'Don't adventures ever have an end? I suppose not. Someone else always has to carry on the story.'
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a tale, you may spot Bilbo to draw a card.

name: Sam, Proper Poet
subtitle: Proper Poet
lore: 'First he was a conspirator, now he's a jester. He'll end up by becoming a wizard – or a warrior!'
text: Maneuver: Exert Sam twice to make him defender +1 until the regroup phase. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: Hobbiton Party Field
text: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play Bilbo from your draw deck.

name: Hobbiton Woods
text: Forest. Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play your site 2 (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

name: Town Center
text: Fellowship: Play a [shire] ally to draw a card.

name: Great Chasm
text: Underground. The twilight cost of the first [moria] archer played each Shadow phase is -2.

name: Hollin
text: Plains. Uruk-hai are not roaming.

name: Realm of Dwarrowdelf
lore: 'There must have been a mighty crowd of dwarves here... and every one of them busier than badgers....'
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to make a Dwarf strength +1 (limit +3) and, if underground, damage +1 (limit +3).

name: Valley of the Silverlode
text: River. Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves to Valley of the Silverlode, each Hobbit companion may heal.

name: Gimli, Dwarf of the Mountain-race
subtitle: Dwarf of the Mountain-race
lore: 'In the ruins of the Dwarves, a dwarf's head will be less easy to bewilder than Elves or Men or Hobbits.'
text: Damage +1. Each underground site's Shadow number is -2.

name: Gandalf, The Grey Pilgrim
subtitle: The Grey Pilgrim
lore: 'When evening in the Shire was grey / his footsteps on the Hill were heard; / before the dawn he went away / on journey long without a word.'
text: At the start of each of your turns, you may draw a card.

name: Tidings of Erebor
lore: '...we have so far been fortunate, though we do not escape the shadow of these times.'
text: Regroup: Spot a Dwarf to draw 3 cards. Any Shadow player may remove (3) to prevent this.

name: Till Durin Wakes Again
lore: Gimli was silent. Having sung his song, he would say no more.
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Each time a Dwarf companion moves from an underground site, you may heal that Dwarf.

name: What Are We Waiting For?
lore: 'It is not despair, for despair is only for those who see the end beyond all doubt.'
text: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf to make an opponent draw 2 cards. That player then chooses to either discard 2 Shadow cards from hand or skip his or her next Shadow phase.

name: A Blended Race
lore: '...he has been doing something to them.... For these Isengarders are more like wicked Men.'
text: To play, spot an Elf. Plays to your support area. Each Uruk-hai is strength -2 and loses all damage bonuses. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.

name: Dismay Our Enemies
lore: Reeling from the bite of an arrow, the Cave Troll became enraged trying to strike the nimble Elf.
text: Response: If an Elf archer wins a skirmish, make an opponent choose a minion to discard. That opponent may remove (3) to prevent this.

name: Hosts of the Last Alliance
lore: '...many great princes and captains were assembled.'
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. While you can spot an Elf companion, the minion archery total is -1. Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.

name: Release the Angry Flood
lore: The three Riders that were still in the midst of the Ford were overwhelmed.... Their piercing cries were drowned in the roaring of the river as it carried them 'away.
text: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to wound each Nazgûl once (or twice if at a river).

name: Disquiet of Our People
lore: 'Ah, alas!... When will the day come of our revenge?'
text: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to make that Dwarf defender +1 (or defender +2 if you spot an Orc) until the regroup phase.

name: Secret Sentinels
lore: 'Yet so little faith and trust do we find now in the world beyond Lothlórien... that we dare not by our own trust endanger our land.'
text: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally to discard a condition (or 2 conditions if you spot an Orc).

name: Erland, Advisor to Brand
subtitle: Advisor to Brand
lore: 'They are good folk the Bardings. The grandson of Bard the Bowman rules them, Brand son of Bain son of Bard.'
text: To play, spot Gandalf. Shadow players may not look at or reveal cards in your hand.

name: Gandalf's Staff
lore: As the wizard passed on ahead up the great steps, he held his staff aloft, and from its tip there came a faint radiance.
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. The twilight cost of each [gandalf] spell is -1. Skirmish: Exert Gandalf twice to cancel a skirmish involving him.

name: Gandalf's Wisdom
lore: Now as the companions sat or walked together they spoke of Gandalf, and all that each had known and seen of him came clear before their minds.
text: Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each possession or artifact played on Gandalf or a character who has the Gandalf signet is -1.

name: Hugin, Emissary from Laketown
subtitle: Emissary from Laketown
lore: Several wise Bardings were sent to Elrond to tell of the Dark Lord's new offer.
text: To play, spot Gandalf. Fellowship: Exert Hugin to reveal a Free Peoples card from your discard pile and place it beneath your draw deck.

name: Járnsmid, Merchant from Dale
subtitle: Merchant from Dale
lore: The Men of Dale freely traded with the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain for fine metalwork.
text: To play, spot Gandalf. Each time you play a shield, armor, helm, or hand weapon, its twilight cost is -1.

name: Speak "Friend" and Enter
lore: Picking up his staff he stood before the rock and said in a clear voice: Mellon!
text: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot Gandalf to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary). Draw a card if you play an underground site.

name: Staff Asunder
lore: At that moment Gandalf lifted his staff, and crying aloud he smote the bridge before him.
text: Spell. Skirmish: Discard a staff Gandalf is bearing and then exert him twice to discard a minion he is skirmishing.

name: Wielder of the Flame
lore: The Balrog made no answer. The fire in it seemed to die, but the darkness grew.
text: Spell. Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to make a companion defender +1 until the regroup phase. Any Shadow player may remove (3) to prevent this.

name: Wizard Staff
lore: 'We must have power – power to order things as we will for that Good which only the Wise can see.'
text: Bearer must be a Wizard. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a minion strength -3.

name: Dwarven Bracers
lore: Dwarven-smiths forge bracers for fit and agility.
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, discard this possession to prevent that wound.

name: You Cannot Pass!
lore: The Balrog fell back and its sword flew up in molten fragments. The wizard swayed on the bridge, stepped back a pace, and then again stood still.
text: Spell. Maneuver: Spot Gandalf bearing a staff to prevent a minion from being fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Blood of Númenor
lore: 'I do not know what strength is in my blood, but I swear to you – I will not let the White City fall....'
text: To play, exert a [gondor] companion. Plays to your support area. Each [sauron] Orc comes into play exhausted. Skip the archery phase. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.

name: Flaming Brand
lore: ...a glimpse of Strider leaping out of the darkness with a flaming brand of wood in either hand.
text: Bearer must be a Man. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Bearer is strength +2 and damage +1 while skirmishing a Nazgûl.

name: Flee in Terror
lore: Aragorn smote to the ground the captain that stood in his path, and the rest fled in terror of his wrath.
text: Response: If a [gondor] companion wins a skirmish, discard an exhausted Orc. That minion's owner may remove (3) to prevent this.

name: Gondor Will See It Done
lore: 'Boromir!... Go after those two young hobbits, and guard them at the least, even if you cannot find Frodo.'
text: Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, exert a [gondor] companion to prevent that wound.

name: Natural Cover
lore: The tree, the bough, the leaf. To a ranger, these are all defenses against the enemy.
text: To play, spot a ranger. Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at a forest, the minion archery total is -2.

name: No Mere Ranger
lore: 'If by my life or death, I can protect you, I will....'
text: Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make another companion strength +2 (or +3 if that companion has the Aragorn signet).

name: Sentinels of Númenor
lore: ...they still preserved through the suns and rains of forgotten years the mighty likenesses in which they had been hewn.
text: Skirmish: Make a [gondor] companion strength +2 (or +4 if in a fierce skirmish).

name: Shield of Boromir
lore: Boromir bore the heirlooms of the Steward's house with pride.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. The minion archery total is -1. If bearer is Boromir, each minion skirmishing him does not gain strength bonuses from weapons.

name: Beyond the Height of Men
lore: 'Whom do you serve?'
text: Maneuver: Exert an Uruk-hai to discard an armor possession, helm possession, or shield possession (or all such Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 6 companions).

name: Endurance of Dwarves
lore: 'Dwarves too can go swiftly, and they do not tire sooner than Orcs.'
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +1.

name: Demands of the Sackville-Bagginses
lore: In the middle of the commotion, the Sackville- Bagginses arrived.
text: To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time a [shire] ally exerts, add (1).

name: Evil Afoot
lore: 'It is not the Eastern Shore I am worried about. A shadow and a threat has been growing in my mind. Something draws near, I can feel it.'
text: Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai and spot X burdens to shuffle X minions from your discard pile into your draw deck.

name: Goblin Man
lore: 'He looks more than half like a goblin.'
text: Discard this minion if underground. Shadow: Exert this minion to look at the Free Peoples player's hand.

name: Lurtz's Sword
lore: The Uruk giant laid down his bow and drew a broad-bladed weapon.
text: Bearer must be Lurtz. He is damage +1. Each time Lurtz wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.

name: No Business of Ours
lore: 'Goblins? Cobblers! Far-off tales and children's stories, that's all that is!'
text: To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Plays to your support area. The Free Peoples player may not look at or reveal cards in any Shadow player's hand.

name: Too Much Attention
lore: 'A little more caution from you – that is not a trinket you carry.'
text: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot an [isengard] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard the top 5 cards of his or her draw deck.

name: Uruk Captain
lore: The captains marched the Uruk-hai to the great river without halting.
text: Damage +1. Shadow: Remove (1) and exert Uruk Captain to play an Uruk-hai from your discard pile.

name: Uruk Scout
lore: Forward Uruk troops caught the fellowship unaware.
text: Tracker. Damage +1. The roaming penalty for each [isengard] minion you play is -1. Response: If an event is played that spots or exerts a ranger, exert this minion to cancel that event.

name: Wizard Storm
lore: There was a black look in the sky, and the sun was wan. The wind had gone now round to the north-east.
text: Spell. Weather. To play, exert an [isengard] minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site. When the fellowship moves from this site, every companion must exert. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

name: Archer Commander
lore: Their commander led the Goblin bowmen to the highest rise across the gap.
text: Archer. Each other [moria] archer is strength +2.

name: Flurry of Blows
lore: With a second axe, a warrior of Erebor can parry on either flank and counter quickly.
text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 and damage +1 if bearing 2 hand weapons).

name: The Balrog's Sword
lore: In its right hand was a blade like a stabbing tongue of fire....
text: Bearer must be The Balrog. It is damage +1. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon.

name: The Balrog, Durin's Bane
subtitle: Durin's Bane
lore: 'Indeed I saw upon the bridge that which haunts our darkest dreams....'
text: Damage +1. Fierce. While you can spot The Balrog, discard all other minions. Skip the archery phase. Discard The Balrog if not underground.

name: The Balrog, Flame of Udûn
subtitle: Flame of Udûn
lore: ...suddenly it drew itself up to a great height, and its wings were spread from wall to wall....
text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [moria] Orc. Discard The Balrog if not underground. Shadow: Exert The Balrog and remove (2) to play a [moria] Orc from your discard pile.

name: Cave Troll's Chain
lore: 'They have a Cave Troll!'
text: Bearer must be Cave Troll of Moria. The Free Peoples player may choose for the archery phase to be skipped. Each time Cave Troll of Moria takes a wound during the archery phase, you may wound an archer companion.

name: Dark Fire
lore: ...he seemed small, and altogether alone: grey and bent, like a wizened tree before the onset of a storm.
text: To play, spot The Balrog. Plays on Gandalf. Each time the fellowship moves, Gandalf must exert.

name: Dark Places
lore: 'There is some new devilry here... devised for our welcome, no doubt.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each unique [moria] minion is strength +1. Shadow: Spot an opponent's site to replace it with your marsh or underground site of the same number.

name: Fill With Fear
lore: He drew, but his hand fell, and the arrow slipped to the ground. He gave a cry of dismay and fear.
text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot The Balrog, skip the archery phase. Maneuver: Exert The Balrog to discard a ranged weapon.

name: Final Cry
lore: ...it swung its whip, and the thongs lashed and curled about the wizard's knees, dragging him to the brink.
text: Response: If a skirmish that involved The Balrog bearing Whip of Many Thongs is about to end, wound a companion in that skirmish twice.

name: Foul Tentacle
lore: Its fingered end had hold of Frodo's foot, and was dragging him into the water.
text: Tentacle. When you play this minion, you may play a tentacle from your draw deck. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.

name: Foul Things
lore: 'Something has crept, or has been driven out of dark waters under the mountains.'
text: Shadow: Play a [moria] minion from your discard pile.

name: Frór, Gimli's Kinsman
subtitle: Gimli's Kinsman
lore: It appeared that amid the splendour of their works of hand the hearts of the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain were troubled.
text: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Uruk-hai, Frór is strength +3.

name: Goblin Bowman
lore: The crude arrows of the Goblins served notice of the dangers of Moria.
text: Archer.

name: Goblin Flankers
lore: 'There are Orcs, very many of them.... And some are large and evil....'
text: When you play this minion, you may add (3) if the fellowship has moved more than once this turn.

name: Goblin Pursuer
lore: Had the fellowship remained in Dimrill Dale, pursuers from Moria would have overwhelmed them.
text: If the fellowship has moved more than once this turn, this minion is strength +3.

name: Goblin Reinforcements
lore: 'We don't have a moment! Come nightfall these hills will swarm with Orcs!'
text: When you play this minion, you may heal a [moria] minion.

name: Goblin Scrabbler
lore: Orcs were as keen as hounds on a scent, it was said, but they could also climb.
text: When you play this minion, you may discard an [elven] condition. The roaming penalty for each [moria] Orc you play is -1.

name: Goblin Spearman
lore: ...with the speed of a striking snake, he charged into the Company and thrust with his spear....
text: While bearing a Goblin Spear, this minion is damage +2.

name: Huge Tentacle
lore: Out from the water a long sinuous tentacle had crawled; it was pale-green and luminous and wet.
text: Tentacle. Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may play Watcher in the Water from your draw deck. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.

name: Moria Archer Troop
lore: Most of the Goblin arrows flew harmlessly into the chasm, but there were so many!
text: Archer. While you can spot another [moria] archer, add 1 to the minion archery total.

name: Must Do Without Hope
lore: His enemy halted again, facing him, and the shadow about it reached out like two vast wings.
text: Maneuver: Exert The Balrog to add a burden.

name: Old Differences
lore: 'I'll be dead before I see the Ring in the hands of an Elf!'
text: Skirmish: Make an Elf or Dwarf skirmishing a [moria] Orc strength -1 (or -3 if you spot an Elf and a Dwarf).

name: Glóin, Friend to Thorin
subtitle: Friend to Thorin
lore: 'But what then would happen, if the Ruling Ring were destroyed, as you counsel?'
text: For each [dwarven] tale you can spot, Glóin is strength +1 (limit +4).

name: Power and Terror
lore: The ranks of the orcs had opened, and they crowded away, as if they themselves were afraid.
text: Shadow: Reveal any number of [moria] Orcs from your hand to play The Balrog. Its twilight cost is -2 for each Orc revealed.

name: Throw Yourself in Next Time
lore: 'This is a serious journey, not a hobbit walking- party.... Now be quiet!'
text: To play, spot a [moria] Orc. Plays on a Hobbit companion. Bearer may be exerted only by Shadow cards.

name: Troubled Mountains
lore: 'The Dimrill Dale is full of vapour and clouds of smoke.... There are noises in the deeps of the earth.'
text: Shadow: Exert a [moria] minion and spot X burdens to add (X) (limit (5)).

name: Watcher in the Water, Keeper of Westgate
subtitle: Keeper of Westgate
lore: The dark water boiled... there was a hideous stench.
text: Damage +1. While you can spot Watcher in the Water, discard all other minions (except tentacles). Each tentacle is strength +2 and damage +1. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh.

name: Whip of Many Thongs
lore: It raised the whip, and the thongs whined and cracked.
text: Bearer must be The Balrog. Skirmish: Exert The Balrog to discard a helm, shield, or armor borne by a character The Balrog is skirmishing.

name: Bill Ferny, Swarthy Sneering Fellow
subtitle: Swarthy Sneering Fellow
lore: '...as for Ferny, he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'
text: Nazgûl are not roaming. The Free Peoples player may not assign a character to skirmish Bill Ferny. Discard Bill Ferny if underground.

name: Helpless
lore: He heard Frodo's voice, but it seemed to come from a great distance, or from under the earth, crying out strange words.
text: To play, spot Frodo and a Nazgûl. Plays on Sam. Sam's game text does not apply.

name: His Terrible Servants
lore: '...in the dark they perceive many signs and forms that are hidden from us: then they are most to be feared.'
text: Plays to your support area. Response: If a twilight Nazgûl is about to take a wound, remove (1) to prevent that wound.

name: It Wants to be Found
lore: ...perhaps it had tried to reveal itself in response to some wish or command that was felt in the room.
text: Maneuver: Spot a twilight Nazgûl to add a burden.

name: Resistance Becomes Unbearable
lore: Not with the hope of escape, or of doing anything, either good or bad: he simply felt that he must take the Ring and put it on his finger.
text: Maneuver: Exert a twilight Nazgûl to exert the Ring-bearer. If the Ring-bearer is then exhausted, he puts on The One Ring until the regroup phase.

name: Golden Light on the Land
lore: 'The Orcs will not, maybe, come out till after dusk, but we must be far away before nightfall.'
text: To play, spot a Dwarf. Plays to your support area. At a site which is not underground, each [moria] Orc's twilight cost is +2. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.

name: Stricken Dumb
lore: He felt his tongue cleave to his mouth and his heart labouring. His sword broke and fell out of his shaking hand.
text: Maneuver: Exert The Witch-king to discard a tale or weapon.

name: They Will Find the Ring
lore: ...to the dismay of Frodo and his friends out from the trees and rocks away on the left four other Riders came flying.
text: Maneuver: Exert 2 Nazgûl and spot X burdens to exert X companions.

name: Úlairë Attëa, The Easterling
subtitle: The Easterling
lore: 'They had words with Harry at Westgate on Monday.... He was white and shaking when they left him.'
text: Twilight. When you play Úlairë Attëa, you may wound an ally.

name: Úlairë Enquëa, Ringwraith in Twilight
subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight
lore: In their white faces burned keen and merciless eyes....
text: Twilight. Each time Úlairë Enquëa wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer once (or twice if you can spot 5 burdens).

name: Úlairë Nelya, Ringwraith in Twilight
subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight
lore: Over the lip of the little dell, on the side away from the hill, they felt, rather then saw, a shadow rise, one shadow or more than one.
text: Twilight. While you can spot 2 burdens or 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer, Úlairë Nelya is fierce and damage +1.

name: The Witch-king, Lord of the Nazgûl
subtitle: Lord of the Nazgûl
lore: 'A great king and sorcerer was he of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'
text: Twilight. Return to Its Master may not be played. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer twice.

name: Wraith-world
lore: 'He is passing into the shadow world, he will soon become a wraith like them.'
text: Skirmish: Spot a twilight Nazgûl and the Ring-bearer wearing The One Ring to add 3 burdens.

name: The Eye of Sauron
lore: '...he has indeed arisen again and left his hold in Mirkwood and returned to his ancient fastness in the Dark Tower of Mordor.'
text: Shadow: Exert a [sauron] Orc and spot X burdens to draw X cards (limit 5).

name: Memory of Many Things
lore: 'But my memory reaches back even to the Elder Days.... I have seen three ages in the West of the world, and many defeats, and many fruitless victories.'
text: Maneuver: Exert a [sauron] Orc to discard an ally (or 2 [elven] allies).

name: Orc Scout
lore: 'Orc!... Not very near, and yet too near, it seems.'
text: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [sauron] minion you play is -1. Response: If an event is played that spots or exerts a ranger, exert or discard this minion to cancel that event.

name: Great Works Begun There
lore: 'Moria! Moria!... Long have its vast mansions lain empty since the children of Durin fled.'
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a Dwarf, you may discard the top 2 cards from your draw deck to take a [dwarven] event into hand from your discard pile.

name: Orc Taskmaster
lore: An Orc acts when the taskmaster promises reward or the whip.
text: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (1).

name: Southern Spies
lore: 'They will know all the news now, for they have visited Bill Ferny; and probably that Southerner was a spy as well.'
text: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot a [sauron] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard his or her hand.

name: Spies of Mordor
lore: 'Mordor Orcs patrol the Eastern Shore. We must wait for the cover of darkness.'
text: Search. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw a card (or 2 cards if you can spot a [sauron] tracker).

name: Tower Assassin
lore: A Ring of Power would not stop the blade of an assassin lying in wait.
text: Maneuver: Exert Tower Assassin to wound an ally.

name: Verily I Come
lore: There was an eye in the Dark Tower that did not sleep. He knew that it had become aware of his gaze.
text: To play, exert a [sauron] Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer. Each time the Free Peoples player draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the fellowship phase, add a burden.

name: Vile Blade
lore: The blood of enemies slain that day blackened the edge of the commanders blade.
text: Bearer must be a [sauron] Orc. Bearer is strength +2 while skirmishing a Man or Elf.

name: Bilbo, Well-spoken Gentlehobbit
subtitle: Well-spoken Gentlehobbit
lore: ...as Mr. Baggins was generous with his money, most people were willing to forgive him his oddities and his good fortune.
text: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo and discard a tale to discard a Shadow condition from an opponent's support area.

name: Consorting With Wizards
lore: 'He wasn't always this peculiar! When I were a lad, old Bilbo was a most respectable Hobbit.'
text: Tale. Bearer must be Bilbo. Bilbo may not take wounds (except during the archery phase). Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Bilbo or discard this condition to remove (1).

name: Dear Friends
lore: He pressed him for news of himself and of the wide world... and they stayed up far into the night.
text: Fellowship: Exert a companion to place a Free Peoples card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck (or 2 Free Peoples cards if that companion has the Frodo signet).

name: Deft in Their Movements
lore: They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk who they do not wish to meet come blundering by.
text: Stealth. Regroup: Spot 2 Hobbits to make each site's Shadow number -2 until the end of the turn.

name: Great Day, Great Hour
lore: 'Oft hope is born, when all is forlorn.'
text: If an opponent plays a minion, exert a Dwarf who is damage +X to exert that minion X times.

name: Fleet-footed
lore: Not all Elven weapons are carried in sheath or quiver.
text: Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -2. Spot a site in a support area to place this event on top of your draw deck.

name: Speak No More to Me
lore: 'Go slow! Bring no fire to this place while Faramir lives! Do nothing until Gandalf comes!'
text: Exert a [sauron] minion to return a Free Peoples condition to its owner's hand (or 2 if both are [shire] conditions).

name: Troll of Cirith Gorgor
lore: ...these fell creatures would bite the throats of those that they threw down.
text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [sauron] minion. This minion is strength +1 for each possession you can spot.

name: Uruk Axe
lore: A sharp edge for the sharp-natured.
text: Bearer must be a [sauron] minion. If bearer is an Uruk-hai, it is strength +2.

name: Window of the Eye
lore: ...as from some great window immeasurably high there stabbed northward a flame of red, the flicker of a piercing Eye....
text: To play, spot a [sauron] minion. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may remove a threat to wound an unbound companion.

name: Birthday Present
lore: '...he caught Déagol by the throat and strangled him, because the gold looked so bright and beautiful.'
text: Fellowship: Add a burden to choose 2 [shire] events with different card titles from your discard pile. Choose an opponent and make him or her choose 1 of those cards for you to take into hand.

name: Brave and Loyal
lore: 'Now come, you filth!' he cried. 'You've hurt my master, you brute, and you'll pay for it.'
text: If a Hobbit companion is not assigned to a skirmish, exert that Hobbit to have him or her replace a companion (except the Ring-bearer) in a skirmish.

name: Chance Observation
lore: '...he thought he saw something shining in the river-bed; and holding his breath he grabbed at it.'
text: If there are 4 or more [shire] cards in your discard pile, make a Hobbit strength +1 for each Hobbit you can spot.

name: Great Heart
lore: And there stood Meriadoc the hobbit in the midst of the slain, blinking like an owl in the daylight, for tears blinded him....
text: Play this condition only during a skirmish. Bearer must be a Hobbit. When this condition is played, wound a minion skirmishing bearer.

name: A Light in his Mind
lore: Far off, as in a little picture drawn by elven-fingers, he saw the Lady Galadriel standing on the grass in Lórien, and gifts were in her hands.
text: Each time you lose initiative, you may spot 2 [shire] companions to remove a burden.

name: Make Haste
lore: There's something still alive in that place, something with eyes, or a seeing mind, if you take me; and the longer we stay in one spot, the sooner it will get 'on to us.'
text: Stealth. Spot a [shire] companion and return him or her to your hand to make a Shadow player choose to remove (2) or discard a minion.

name: Galadriel, Lady Redeemed
subtitle: Lady Redeemed
lore: 'I pass the test,' she said. 'I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.'
text: When Galadriel is in your starting fellowship, her twilight cost is -3. Fellowship or Regroup: Discard an [elven] event from hand to discard a Shadow condition or Shadow possession.

name: A Marvel
lore: Howling with pain and fear but desperate the orc charged head-down at him.
text: Exert a Hobbit to make another Hobbit strength +3.

name: Narrow Escape
lore: 'If those two had seen us, they would have dropped all their quarrel until we were dead.'
text: Spot 2 Hobbit companions to make a Shadow player discard a minion (or spot 4 Hobbit companions to make that player discard 2 minions).

name: Nine-fingered Frodo and the Ring of Doom
lore: 'What a tale we have been in, Mr. Frodo, haven't we?'
text: Tale. Exert a [shire] character to remove a burden or 2 threats.

name: Orc Armor
lore: 'Well, there you are, Mr. Frodo. A perfect little orc, if I may make so bold....'
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Each Orc and each Uruk-hai skirmishing bearer is strength -1.

name: Shadowplay
lore: ...it saw a great silent shape, cloaked in a grey shadow, looming against the wavering light behind....
text: To play, spot 2 [shire] companions. Each time a minion is played, you may exert a Hobbit companion to exert that minion (limit once per turn).

name: Slunk Out of Sight
lore: ...harsh and loud they heard orc-voices.
text: Stealth. If there are 6 or more [shire] cards in your discard pile, cancel a skirmish involving your Hobbit and a minion who is not fierce. Each minion in that skirmish is fierce until the regroup phase.

name: The Tale of the Great Ring
lore: 'I have quite finished, Sam,' said Frodo. 'The last pages are for you.'
text: Tale. Skirmish: Prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless a Shadow event is (or was) played during this skirmish. Discard this condition.

name: Base of Mindolluin
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: If you cannot spot 2 threats, add a threat to play a fortification from your draw deck.

name: Pelennor Prairie
text: Plains. Shadow: Exert a minion and remove a burden to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions.

name: Steward's Tomb
text: Wounds cannot be prevented or healed. Burdens cannot be removed.

name: Glimpse of Fate
lore: 'The uttermost choice is before you: to repent and go to the Havens... or else to abide the Doom of Men.'
text: To play, spot 2 Elves. Each time you lose initiative, make a minion strength -4 until the regroup phase.

name: Watchers of Cirith Ungol
text: Skirmish: Spot your [wraith] Orc and remove 2 threats to make that [wraith] Orc strength +3.

name: Frodo, Resolute Hobbit
subtitle: Resolute Hobbit
lore: '...if it's the only way, we must take it.'
text: Ring-bearer (resistance 12).

name: Sam, Great Elf Warrior
subtitle: Great Elf Warrior
lore: '...I'd say there's a large warrior on the loose, Elf most likely, with an elf-sword anyway....'
text: Ring-bound. Sam is strength +1 for each [shire] companion you can spot. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: Phial of Galadriel, Star-glass
subtitle: Star-glass
lore: ...the hand that held it sparkled with white fire.
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Skirmish: Until the regroup phase, remove the game text (except card type and race) from a minion skirmishing bearer and make it unable to gain game text. Discard this artifact.

name: Borne Far Away
lore: ...the wanderers were lifted up and borne far away out of the darkness and the fire.
text: Spot your Wizard to exchange a companion in hand with a companion in your dead pile or discard pile.

name: Brooding on Tomorrow
lore: '...tomorrow will be certain to bring worse than today, for many days to come.'
text: Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may spot a [gandalf] companion to choose an opponent who must discard one of his or her conditions.

name: Gathering Wind
lore: ...the rush of their wide wings as they passed over was like a gale.
text: Exert your Wizard to choose a number. Make each minion with that twilight cost strength -2 until the regroup phase.

name: Out of the High Airs
lore: ...the Nazgûl turned and fled, and vanished into Mordor's shadows....
text: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert your Wizard to discard each minion.

name: Treebeard, Keeper of the Watchwood
subtitle: Keeper of the Watchwood
lore: 'Leave it to the Ents!... Trees are coming back to live here, old trees, wild trees.'
text: To play, spot 3 [gandalf] companions. Regroup: Exert Treebeard twice to play a [gandalf] condition from your discard pile and make an opponent discard one of his or her conditions.

name: A Dark Shape Sprang
lore: Something struck Sam violently in the back....
text: If an opponent plays a possession on a companion, play Gollum at twilight cost -2 from your discard pile or hand to suspend the current phase. Begin a skirmish phase involving Gollum and that companion. When it ends, resume the suspended phase.

name: Memories of Darkness
lore: 'Had I known what was before me, I think that not for any friendship would I have taken the Paths of the Dead.'
text: To play, spot a Dwarf. Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may play a [dwarven] condition from hand or from your discard pile.

name: Final Strike
lore: The fires below awoke in anger....
text: Any site 9 is a mountain. Shadow: If the fellowship is at any site 9, play Gollum from your discard pile. Response: If the Free Peoples player uses a maneuver or archery special ability, exert Gollum to cancel its effect.

name: Gollum, Mad Thing
subtitle: Mad Thing
lore: ...swiftly but warily, creeping on behind, a slinking shadow among the stones.
text: To assign Gollum to a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must make Gollum strength +3 until the regroup phase or add a burden.

name: Reclaim the Precious
lore: ...white fangs gleamed, and then snapped as they bit.
text: Assignment: Assign Gollum to a companion bearing an artifact. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to prevent this and assign Gollum. Regroup: Exert Gollum twice to discard a possession. Discard this condition.

name: Shelob, Her Ladyship
subtitle: Her Ladyship
lore: ...she served none but herself, drinking the blood of Elves and Men....
text: Enduring. Fierce. When you play Shelob, if you can spot Gollum, you may spot a companion. That companion cannot be assigned to a skirmish until the end of the turn.

name: Unabated in Malice
lore: ...she lusted for sweeter meat. And Gollum had brought it to her.
text: While you have initiative, each [gollum] minion is damage +1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [gollum] minion strength +1 for each culture you can spot.

name: Aragorn, Elessar Telcontar
subtitle: Elessar Telcontar
lore: 'Now come the days of the King, and may they be blessed while the thrones of the Valar endure!'
text: When you play Aragorn, you may heal another companion. At the start of each fellowship phase, you may exert a companion of one culture to heal a companion of another culture.

name: Cursed of Erech
lore: ...a black dread fell on them....
text: Enduring. To play, add a threat. When you play Cursed of Erech, exert him twice. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert another [gondor] Wraith to make Cursed of Erech defender +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Dead Man of Dunharrow
lore: ...the Shadow Host pressed behind and fear went on before them....
text: Enduring. To play, add a threat. When you play this companion, exert him twice.

name: Denethor, Lord of Minas Tirith
subtitle: Lord of Minas Tirith
lore: There Denethor sat in a grey gloom, like an old patient spider....
text: To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men. Fellowship: If at a sanctuary, exert Denethor to take a [gondor] card into hand from your draw deck, then reshuffle. Choose an opponent who may draw 2 cards.

name: Drawing His Eye
lore: 'We cannot achieve victory by arms, but by arms we can give the Ring-bearer his only chance, frail though it be.'
text: For each [gondor] companion you spot, reveal 1 card at random from a Shadow player's hand. Choose a revealed Shadow card to be discarded, then its owner draws a card.

name: More Yet to Come
lore: '...whatever is still to do, I hope to have a part in it, for the honour of the folk of the Lonely Mountain.'
text: If a Dwarf kills a minion in a skirmish and that minion did not take all wounds caused by that Dwarf's damage bonus, assign those remaining wounds to minions not assigned to a skirmish.

name: End of the Game
lore: ...he drew Andúril and held it up glittering in the sun. 'You shall not be sheathed again until the last battle is fought,' he said.
text: Make an exhausted [gondor] companion strength +2. If that companion wins this skirmish, heal that companion or make him or her damage +1.

name: Every Little is a Gain
lore: And so the companies came and were hailed and cheered and passed through the Gate, men of the Outlands marching to defend the City of Gondor in a dark hour....
text: Spot a [gondor] Man to discard a stacked Shadow card or to wound a minion bearing a fortification.

name: Fifth Level
lore: A strong citadel it was indeed....
text: Fortification. Bearer is strength -1 for each fortification you can spot. Maneuver: Exert 2 [gondor] Men or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition to a minion.

name: Hardy Garrison
lore: All before the walls on either side of the Gate the ground was choked with wreck and with bodies of the slain....
text: To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men. Each time you lose initiative, you may wound a minion.

name: Last Throw
lore: 'We must push Sauron... We must march out to meet him at once.'
text: If no opponent controls a site, spot 2 [gondor] Men to make the move limit +1 for this turn.

name: Suffered Much Loss
lore: 'For we are already at war, as you may have seen....'
text: Each site on the adventure path is a battleground. While you have initiative, each Uruk-hai is strength +1.

name: Cast Unto the Winds
lore: 'With horns in my mouth / I walk in the South....'
text: Regroup: Spot a Southron, remove a threat, and remove (3) to wound an unbound companion.

name: Corsair Boatswain
lore: Promise of plunder and of the whip keep in line a lustful Corsair crew.
text: Corsair. To play, spot a [raider] Man. Shadow: Exert this minion to play a [raider] support area possession from your draw deck.

name: Corsair Brute
lore: ...the region of South Gondor became a debatable land between the Corsairs and the Kings.
text: Corsair. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove a [raider] token to wound a companion he is skirmishing.

name: Corsair Ruffian
lore: An incarnation of savagery was Ghynóh the Cruel.
text: Corsair. When you play this minion, you may spot another corsair and discard the top card of the Free Peoples player's draw deck to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

name: Aegnor, Elven Escort
subtitle: Elven Escort
lore: Affectionately referred to as 'Figwit' by his contemporaries in Rivendell.
