text: Skirmish: Exert Aegnor to make a minion skirmishing an unbound [elven] companion strength -1 for each archer you spot.

name: Easterling Berserker
lore: ...from nearby there marched up an army of Easterlings that had waited for the signal....
text: Easterling. To play, spot an Easterling. While this minion is unwounded, he is damage +2. Skirmish: Wound 2 other [raider] Men to heal this minion.

name: Easterling Pillager
lore: ...for the sack of the City and the rape of Gondor....
text: Easterling. Fierce. When you play this minion, you may spot another Easterling to add a burden for each companion over 5.

name: Far Harad Mercenaries
lore: ...men like half-trolls, with white eyes and red tongues.
text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may spot 6 companions and another [raider] Man to discard an unbound companion this minion is skirmishing.

name: Field of the Fallen
text: To play, spot a [raider] Man. While there is a character in the dead pile, each companion of the same culture as that character is strength -1. Skirmish: Exert your Southron to make him strength +1.

name: High Vantage
lore: Southrons rain arrows down upon their enemies from their defended perch atop their great beasts of war.
text: Until the end of the assignment phase, each time a Southron is about to take a wound, prevent that.

name: Mûmak Chieftain
lore: The commander of a mûmak never imagines he is in complete control of the beast.
text: Southron. When you play this minion, you may play a mount on him from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.

name: Quelled
lore: Against the great mounts of the Southron army, Rohirrim steeds could not easily prevail.
text: Exert a [raider] Man to discard a Free Peoples condition. If you spot a [rohan] Man, discard an additional Free Peoples condition.

name: Rallying Call
lore: Horns were blown and trumpets were braying....
text: To play, spot a [raider] Man. Threats cannot be removed by Free Peoples cards. Shadow: Remove (1) and play a Southron to add a threat.

name: Seasoned Leader
lore: Only by many conquests and hardships does one rise to prominence in the army of the Haradrim.
text: Bearer must be a Southron. Bearer is enduring. Skirmish: Remove a threat to play a [raider] condition from your discard pile.

name: Southron Fanatic
lore: Stirred by the Dark Lord, the fullness of Southron cruelty was leveled at the people of Gondor.
text: Southron. Each time a Man is assigned to skirmish this minion, wound that Man.

name: Arwen, Echo of Lúthien
subtitle: Echo of Lúthien
lore: '...mine is the choice of Lúthien, and as she so have I chosen, both the sweet and the bitter.'
text: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to discard the bottom card of your draw deck. If the bottom card was an [elven] card, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -3.

name: Southron Savage
lore: The merciless deserts of Haradwaith breed equally merciless fighters.
text: Southron. While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.

name: Stampeded
lore: ...the Mûmak of Harad was indeed a beast of vast bulk, and the like of him does not walk now in Middle-earth....
text: If a Free Peoples possession is played, spot a [raider] card to discard that possession. If that possession was a [gondor] or [rohan] possession, wound an unbound Man.

name: Under Foot
lore: 'I make the earth shake, / As I tramp through the grass; / Trees crack as I pass.'
text: Shadow: If you have initiative, spot a [raider] Man and discard this condition to reconcile your hand. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [raider] Man strength +2.

name: Black Marshal
lore: ...at their head was one greater than all the rest: a Rider, all black....
text: Shadow: Exert a Nazgûl and play a [wraith] minion to add (1) (or (2) if you have initiative).

name: Cirith Ungol Scavenger
lore: A noise of tramping feet and harsh shouts: Orcs were coming up to the Cleft from the far side....
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert it to discard a possession borne by a character this minion is skirmishing.

name: Cirith Ungol Soldier
lore: ...not even the black shadows, lying deep where the red glow could not reach, would shield him long from the night-eyed orcs.
text: Shadow: Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Cirith Ungol Warrior
lore: ...deafening, roaring in his ears, the crash of the feet and the rending clamour of the Orcs before him.
text: Shadow: Spot a possession to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Cirith Ungol Watchman
lore: Sam looked up towards the orc-tower, and suddenly from its narrow windows lights stared out like small red eyes.
text: Each companion skirmishing this minion loses all damage and strength bonuses from possessions.

name: Dark Swooping Shadows
lore: '...how can he win to the Gate, if these foul hell-hawks have other weapons than fear?'
text: Heal an enduring [wraith] minion to add a burden or 2 threats.

name: Gorbag, Covetous Captain
subtitle: Covetous Captain
lore: 'I tell you, it's no game serving down in the city.'
text: For each wound on the Ring-bearer, each [wraith] Orc is strength +1.

name: Arwen, Queen of Elves and Men
subtitle: Queen of Elves and Men
lore: 'Often is it seen,' said Aragorn, 'that in dangerous days men hide their chief treasure.'
text: Each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -2 for each wounded minion you can spot.

name: Gorbag's Sword
lore: 'You touch it and I'll stick this blade in your gut.'
text: Bearer must be a [wraith] Orc. When you play this possession, you may discard a possession. Its owner may place it on top of his or her draw deck instead. If bearer is Gorbag, he is fierce.

name: Houses of Lamentation
lore: '...thy shrivelled mind be left naked to the Lidless Eye.'
text: Make a [wraith] minion strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a companion of the same culture as a card in the dead pile).

name: Morgul Banner-bearer
lore: So great an army had never issued from that vale since the days of Isildur's might....
text: While the total number of other minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, this minion is strength +3 and an archer.

name: Morgul Vanguard
lore: '...soon the host of Morgul will enter in at many points.'
text: Assignment: Assign this minion to an unbound companion bearing a hand weapon.

name: Stooping to the Kill
lore: And with a piercing cry out of the dim sky fell the winged shadows....
text: While you have initiative, each of your [wraith] minions is damage +1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [wraith] minion strength +2.

name: Swarming Like Beetles
lore: '...in secret they have long been building floats and barges in great number in East Osgiliath.'
text: Maneuver: Spot a [wraith] Orc and remove a threat to wound an unwounded companion.

name: Ten Times Outnumbered
lore: The passage of Anduin was won by the Enemy.
text: Make a [wraith] Orc strength +2 for each wound on the Ring-bearer.

name: Úlairë Cantëa, Thrall of The One
subtitle: Thrall of The One
lore: ...the shadows of death fell dark upon the earth.
text: Enduring. Fierce. Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Cantëa during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Cantëa to discard a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing.

name: Úlairë Enquëa, Thrall of The One
subtitle: Thrall of The One
lore: Ever they circled above the City, like vultures that expect their fill of doomed men's flesh.
text: Enduring. Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Enquëa during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: If Úlairë Enqueä is skirmishing, heal him to add a burden.

name: Úlairë Lemenya, Thrall of The One
subtitle: Thrall of The One
lore: It was no brigand or orc-chieftain that ordered the assault upon the Lord of Mordor's greatest foe.
text: Enduring. Fierce. Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Lemenya during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Lemenya to wound up to 3 other [wraith] minions.

name: Celeborn, Lord of the Galadhrim
subtitle: Lord of the Galadhrim
lore: ...with him went the last living memory of the Elder Days in Middle-earth.
text: At the start of each skirmish involving Celeborn, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, you may discard it to wound each minion in that skirmish.

name: Úlairë Nelya, Thrall of The One
subtitle: Thrall of The One
lore: Perching now on the wall beside the ruined gate the Nazgûl sent out its deadly cries. All the cliffs echoed.
text: Enduring. Fierce. Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Nelya during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Nelya to add (1) for each burden.

name: Úlairë Toldëa, Thrall of The One
subtitle: Thrall of The One
lore: ...like shadows of untimely night, he saw in the middle airs below him five birdlike forms....
text: Enduring. Shadow cards cannot exert Úlairë Toldëa during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: Heal Úlairë Toldëa to make him damage +1.

name: Éowyn, Lady of Ithilien
subtitle: Lady of Ithilien
lore: 'Yet now that I have leave to depart, I would remain. For this House has become to me of all dwellings the most blessed.'
text: Skirmish: Exert Éowyn to choose an opponent. That opponent must wound a minion for each wound on each minion skirmishing Éowyn.

name: Fell Deeds Awake
lore: ...he seized a great horn from Guthláf his banner-bearer, and he blew such a blast upon it that it burst asunder.
text: To play, spot a [rohan] Man. Each time you lose initiative, you may liberate a site.

name: Unyielding
lore: ...they gathered and rallied and fought until the day wore away.
text: If your [rohan] Man wins a skirmish, discard a [rohan] possession to wound a minion or to liberate a site.

name: Advance Captain
lore: The foe who gave him his scar soon after gave him the adornment for his helm.
text: Each roaming [sauron] minion is damage +1.

name: Advance Marauder
lore: The sun gleamed red....
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a roaming [sauron] minion strength +3.

name: Advance Regular
lore: In vain men shook their fists at the pitiless foes that swarmed before the Gate.
text: Each roaming [sauron] minion is fierce.

name: Advance Scout
lore: The lines of fire became flowing torrents, file upon file of Orcs bearing flames....
text: Shadow: Exert or discard this minion to make each [sauron] minion you spot roaming until the regroup phase.

name: Barren Land
lore: There the last living things gave up their struggle....
text: To play, spot a [sauron] minion. Each time the fellowship moves to any site 8 or 9, exert each Ring-bound companion. Shadow: Discard this condition to play a [sauron] minion. Its twilight cost is -2.

name: Círdan, The Shipwright
subtitle: The Shipwright
lore: ...he was grey and old, save that his eyes were keen as stars....
text: To play, spot 2 Elves. Skirmish: Exert Círdan to make a minion he is skirmishing strength -1 for each [elven] event in your discard pile.

name: Beaten Back
lore: The Rammas was broken, and all the Pelennor abandoned to the Enemy.
text: Make a [sauron] minion strength +2 for each site you control. If you have initiative, that minion is fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Cirith Ungol Guard
lore: ...this stronghold had been built not to keep enemies out of Mordor, but to keep them in.
text: Damage +1.

name: Cirith Ungol Patroller
lore: 'A message came: Nazgûl uneasy. Spies feared on stairs. Double vigilance. Patrol to head of Stairs.'
text: Damage +1. While you can spot 3 possessions, this minion is fierce.

name: Cirith Ungol Sentinel
lore: 'Any trespasser found by the guard is to be held at the tower.'
text: Damage +1. If you can spot another [sauron] Uruk-hai, this minion is twilight cost -1 for each possession you can spot.

name: Cirith Ungol Sentry
lore: ...treachery had yielded up the Tower to the Lord of the Ringwraiths, and now for long years it had been held by evil things.
text: Damage +1.

name: Flames Within
lore: Soon there was great peril of fire behind the wall....
text: While you have initiative, each of your [sauron] minions is strength +2. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [sauron] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is roaming).

name: Gorgoroth Keeper
lore: ...new foes came swirling behind....
text: Besieger. While you control a site, this minion's twilight cost is -2. Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control.

name: Gorgoroth Swarm
lore: File after file passed....
text: Besieger. When you play this minion, you may spot 6 companions and another besieger to play a besieger from your discard pile and control a site.

name: Gothmog, Lieutenant of Morgul
subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lore: 'Move into the City. Kill all in your path.'
text: Besieger. When you play Gothmog, the Free Peoples player must wound a companion for each site you control. While you control a site, Gothmog is fierce.

name: Gothmog's Warg
lore: 'Form ranks, you maggots! Form ranks!'
text: Bearer must be a [sauron] Orc. For each site you control, bearer is strength +1 (or +2 if bearer is Gothmog).

name: Elrond, Venerable Lord
subtitle: Venerable Lord
lore: 'To me then even our victory can bring only sorrow and parting – but to you hope of joy for a while.'
text: To play, spot an Elf. At the start of each skirmish involving Elrond, you may reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, you may heal another Elf.

name: Mordor Brute
lore: There came a long rolling of great drums like thunder in the mountains....
text: Each [sauron] Orc bearing a possession cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).

name: Mordor Fiend
lore: The onslaught of Mordor broke like a wave on the beleaguered hills....
text: Shadow: If you cannot spot another minion and there are 3 or fewer twilight tokens, add (3) (or (5) if this minion is roaming).

name: Mordor Pillager
text: Besieger. Fierce. Shadow: Exert this minion and spot another [sauron] minion to control a site. If you cannot spot 3 Free Peoples cultures, the Free Peoples player may exert a companion to prevent this.

name: Mordor Wretch
lore: ...a braying of horns... shook the very stones and stunned men's ears.
text: Shadow: Spot 4 Free Peoples cultures and exert another [sauron] minion twice to add (3) and draw a card.

name: Orc Ravager
lore: The Captains of the West were foundering in a gathering sea.
text: To play, spot a [sauron] minion. Shadow: Remove 2 threats to discard a condition.

name: Orc Slaughterer
lore: All about the hills the hosts of Mordor raged.
text: Enduring. For each wound on this minion, it is strength +2.

name: Rank and File
lore: ...even fear by night had scarcely over-counted them.
text: Each time a roaming [sauron] minion takes a wound, you may add a [sauron] token here. Regroup: Exert an Uruk-hai or discard a [sauron] minion to add a [sauron] token here. Skirmish: Remove 2 [sauron] tokens from here to make a [sauron] minion strength +2.

name: The Ring is Mine!
lore: '...I do not choose now to do what I came to do. I will not do this deed.'
text: If a burden is added, spot a [sauron] minion to add an additional burden.

name: Ruinous Hall
lore: ...they began to throw missiles marvelously high, so that they passed right above the battlement and fell thudding within the first circle of the City....
text: If the Free Peoples player plays a possession, discard a [sauron] minion from hand to prevent him or her from playing any more cards until the end of this phase.

name: Shagrat, Captain of Cirith Ungol
subtitle: Captain of Cirith Ungol
lore: 'If you think I'm so damaged that it's safe to flout me, you're mistaken.'
text: Damage +1. Each time Shagrat loses a skirmish, you may exert a character.

name: Balglin, Elven Warrior
subtitle: Elven Warrior
lore: He is a strong fighter. He asks for no quarter and gives none.
text: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While skirmishing a wounded minion, Balglin takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.

name: Legolas, Archer of Mirkwood
subtitle: Archer of Mirkwood
lore: '...even more would I give for a hundred good archers of Mirkwood. We shall need them.'
text: Archer. Valiant. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a Dwarf companion or another Elf companion.

name: Taurnil, Sharp-eyed Bowman
subtitle: Sharp-eyed Bowman
lore: Taurnil's careful aim can disarm his enemies at long range.
text: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While Taurnil bears a ranged weapon, the twilight cost of each Shadow possession is +2, and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Foul Horde
text: Warg-rider. While Foul Horde is not exhausted, it is fierce. While Foul Horde has at least 3 vitality, it is ambush (1). While Foul Horde has at least 4 vitality, it is damage +1.

name: Grima, Chief Counselor
subtitle: Chief Counselor
lore: 'I care for you and yours as best I may.... Let others deal with these irksome guests.'
text: Maneuver: Exert Grima to hinder a condition borne by an unbound companion (or hinder that companion and all Free Peoples cards they bear if you can spot 4 Free Peoples cultures).

name: Scaling Ladder
lore: Hundreds of long ladders were lifted up. Many were cast down in ruin, but many more replaced them....
text: Machine.\Shadow: Exert an Uruk-hai to place an [isengard] token on this card (limit 2).\Skirmish: Discard this condition to heal an Uruk-hai for each [isengard] token on this card.

name: Gimli, Skilled Defender
subtitle: Skilled Defender
lore: Despite Théoden's preparations, Gimli found it necessary to warn him of the advancing Uruk army.
text: Damage +1. Valiant. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion assigned to skirmish an unbound companion.

name: Let Us Be Swift
lore: 'Let us drive through such foes as are already between us and the fastness.'
text: Regroup: Spot 3 valiant companions to discard up to 2 conditions and liberate a site.

name: No Rest for the Weary
lore: 'We must draw all our forces now behind the walls.'
text: Maneuver: Spot 3 valiant companions to make one of those companions defender +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Sigewulf, Brave Volunteer
subtitle: Brave Volunteer
lore: The courage of Sigewulf and other Rohirrim like him will not be forgotten.
text: Villager. Regroup: Exert Sigewulf and spot 5 valiant companions to discard a minion.

name: Forearmed
lore: 'Give them a volley.'
text: Reveal the top card of your draw deck to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength –X, where X is the twilight cost of the revealed card.  If that minion is now 4 strength or less, discard the revealed card.

name: Naith Troop
lore: Now only the bow and the sword can forestall the coming of the Shadow.
text: Valiant. To play, spot 3 Elf companions. Skirmish: Exert Naith Troop to discard the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, make a minion skirmishing Naith Troop strength –2.

name: Naith Warband
lore: 'But do not think that only by singing amid the trees... is Lothlórien maintained and defended....'
text: Valiant. To play, spot 3 Elf companions. While Naith Warband bears a ranged weapon, it takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase and does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Too Long Have These Peasants Stood
lore: The rabble of Dunland pillaged their way across the Mark.
text: If a [dunland] Man wins a skirmish, hinder all conditions.

name: Coat of Mail
lore: Soldiers of the White Tower have long appreciated the craftsmanship of the Gondorian metalsmiths.
text: Bearer must be a Man or [gondor] companion.  Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

name: Great Shield
lore: The Kingdom of Gondor has smiths much practiced in creating strong tools of war.
text: Bearer must be a Man or [gondor] companion.  The minion archery total is -1.

name: No Stranger to the Shadows
lore: 'Ah, but you had not got me with you then,' laughed Strider. 'My cuts, short or long, don't go wrong.'
text: Stealth. Bearer must be a ranger. Each site's Shadow number is -1.

name: Farin, Dwarven Emissary
subtitle: Dwarven Emissary
lore: Among the envoys sent to represent the Dwarves of Erebor at the Council of Elrond was Farin, a young but wise Dwarf, and a fierce foe in battle.
text: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Orc, Farin is strength +2.

name: Strength of Kings
lore: 'Believe not that in the land of Gondor the blood of Númenor is spent, nor all its pride and dignity forgotten.'
text: If a skirmish event is played during a skirmish involving a [gondor] companion, cancel that event.

name: Gimli, Dwarf of Erebor
subtitle: Dwarf of Erebor
lore: Gimli now walked ahead by the wizard's side, so eager was he to come to Moria.
text: Damage +1 Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, add (2) and place a card from hand beneath your draw deck to draw a card.

name: Hunt Them Down!
lore: 'Do not stop until they are found!'
text: Maneuver: Make an Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Saruman's Power
lore: The Uruks of Saruman are bred to be the instruments of his will, destroying his enemies with foul cruelty.
text: Spell. Exert an [isengard] minion to discard a Free Peoples condition and then hinder all conditions.

name: Saruman's Snows
text: Spell. Weather. To play, exert an [isengard] minion. Plays on a site. No player may play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving an [isengard] minion at this site. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

name: Savagery To Match Their Numbers
lore: Uruk-hai match their enemies' strength with their own feral rage.
text: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2.\If you can spot 5 companions, also make it fierce and strength +2 more until the regroup phase).

name: Traitor's Voice
lore: 'In all the long wars with the Dark Tower treason has ever been our greatest foe.'
text: Search. To play, spot an [isengard] minion.\Regroup: Spot 4 [isengard] minions, an exhausted Ring-bearer, or 5 burdens to make the move limit for this turn -1 (limit once per phase).

name: Gimli's Helm
lore: A helm fashioned under the Lonely Mountain protects the head of Gimli the Dwarf.
text: Bearer must be Gimli. He takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. Skirmish: Discard Gimli's Helm to make Gimli unable to take wounds.

name: Uruk Rager
lore: A bloodthirsty bellow from a huge Uruk can win a skirmish before it begins.
text: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or discard the top 3 cards of their draw deck.

name: Uruk Shaman
lore: Uruk shamans know the arts of healing as well as those of battle.
text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Remove (2) to heal an [Isengard] minion.

name: Uruk Soldier
lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai band together as an extremely effective fighting unit.
text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, exert a companion. The Free Peoples player may discard the top 2 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.

name: Uruk-hai Armory
text: While you can spot an Uruk-hai, the fellowship archery total is -1. Shadow: Discard this condition to play an [Isengard] possession from your discard pile. Response: If your [Isengard] minion is about to take a wound, remove (1) and discard this condition to prevent that wound.

name: Uruk-hai Raiding Party
lore: 'Imagine, Gandalf, an army – born from the earth of Isengard.'
text: Damage +1. While you can spot 2 Uruk-hai, each Uruk-hai is strength +1. While you can spot 4 Uruk-hai, this minion is fierce.

name: Greatest Kingdom of My People
lore: 'With golden roof and silver floor / And runes of power upon the door.'
text: Tale. To play, exert a Dwarf. \The first time your opponent plays an Orc each turn, you may take a [dwarven] card into hand from your discard pile. The Shadow player may discard the bottom 2 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.

name: Uruk-hai Sword
lore: Their malevolent strength worsens the wounds from the gruesome weapons of the Uruks.
text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or discard the top 2 cards of their draw deck.

name: Denizens Enraged
lore: ...there came a great noise: a rolling Boom that seemed to come from depths far below, and to tremble in the stone at their feet.
text: Choose one: make a [moria] minion strength +2, or make a [moria] Orc strength +1 for each other [moria] minion you can spot (limit +5).

name: Grimir, Dwarven Elder
subtitle: Dwarven Elder
lore: Old and grey after many years spent in exile before the Lonely Mountain was reclaimed, Grimir can still wield his axe with strength.
text: Skirmish: Spot a [dwarven] companion and exert Grimir twice to play a [dwarven] skirmish event from your discard pile, then remove it from the game.

name: Goblin Archer
lore: An arrow whistled over Frodo's head.
text: Archer. The fellowship archery total is -1 for each [moria] archer you can spot. Assignment: Exert this minion to prevent [moria] archers from being assigned to skirmishes.

name: Goblin Patrol Troop
lore: As they ran they heard the beat and echo of many hurrying feet behind. A shrill yell went up: they had been seen. There was a ring and clash of steel.
text: Shadow: Exert this minion or a unique [moria] Orc to draw a card.

name: Relics of Moria
lore: By both the doors they could now see that many bones were lying, and among them were broken swords and axe-heads, and cloven shields and helms.
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (2) to play a [moria] possession from your discard pile.

name: Through the Misty Mountains
lore: 'One must tread the path that need chooses.'
text: Search. To play, exert a [moria] minion. Each time the fellowship moves to any site 4, 5, or 6 and contains a Dwarf or Elf, draw a card. The Free Peoples player may discard 1 card at random from hand to prevent this.

name: The Pale Blade
lore: In his wretched grip, the Captain raised a Pale Sword.
text: Bearer must be The Witch-king. He is damage +1. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a Free Peoples condition.

name: Nobody Tosses a Dwarf
lore: 'My folk have never had dealings with any of the servants of the Enemy.'
text: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, discard a Shadow card.  Its owner may discard 3 cards from the bottom of their draw deck to prevent this.

name: Úlairë Nertëa, Messenger of Dol Guldur
subtitle: Messenger of Dol Guldur
lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.
text: When you play Úlairë Nertëa, for each companion over 4, you may play a unique [Wraith] minion from your discard pile.

name: Band of the Eye
lore: Far more Orcs has Sauron bred in the pits under Barad-dûr than Saruman could ever imagine.
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may remove (2) to add 2 burdens.  The Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards at random from hand to prevent this.

name: Desperate Measures
lore: 'Go back, Sam. You can't swim. I'm going to Mordor alone.'
text: Spot a [sauron] Orc and remove a burden to take a [sauron] card into hand from your discard pile.  The Free Peoples player may discard the top 5 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.

name: Forces of Mordor
lore: '....the Dark Lord is not without allies. The Easterlings and Haradrim now pay tribute to Mordor.'
text: Shadow: Exert a [sauron] minion to add (1) for each [sauron] Orc you can spot (limit (3)).

name: Still Draws Breath
lore: When thirteen had fallen the rest fled shrieking, leaving the defenders unharmed....
text: Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may discard a card from hand to heal that Dwarf.

name: The Irresistible Shadow
lore: Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.
text: To play, exert a [sauron] Orc. The Ring-bearer is strength +1 per burden you can spot.\If you cannot spot a companion besides the Ring-bearer, the Ring-bearer is resistance -2 per burden you can spot.

name: Mordor Enraged
lore: The armies of Elendil and Gil-galad inflamed Sauron's anger and hatred.
text: To play, exert a [sauron] minion. Plays on an archer companion. Each time the Free Peoples player uses an archery special ability, bearer must exert.

name: The Number Must Be Few
lore: 'The number must be few, since your hope is in speed and secrecy.'
text: Search. While you can spot 7 companions, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1). When you can no longer spot 7 companions or this card leaves play, this penalty is immediately lost.

name: Orc Butchery
lore: For sport, Orcs hew cruelly at the bodies of those they slay.
text: If a companion is killed by a [sauron] Orc, for each card in the dead pile the Free Peoples player must choose to add a burden or discard 4 cards from the top of their draw deck.

name: Orc Inquisitor
lore: Cruel questioners of Mordor tore the secret from poor Gollum, that Sauron's most prized possession once again was found.
text: When you play this minion, you may draw a card.  The Free Peoples player may discard 1 card at random from hand to prevent this.

name: Tower Lieutenant
lore: Sauron shows favour to those in his dungeons with the ambition to squeeze the information he needs from those caught spying out his borders.
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer). The Free Peoples player may discard 2 cards at random from hand to prevent this.

name: The Weight of a Legacy
lore: 'It is because of Men, the Ring survives.... I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'
text: To play, exert a [Sauron] Orc. Plays on a [Gondor] companion. Limit 1 per bearer.  While you can spot 2 tales, bearer is strength -2.

name: Ancient Enmity
lore: Hard and bitter is the Elven hatred of Orcs, for they have lost many kinsmen to Orc savagery.
text: Make an Elf strength +1. \If a minion loses this skirmish to that Elf, you may heal an Elf; that minion's owner may discard a card from hand to prevent this.

name: Merry, From O'er the Brandywine
subtitle: From O'er the Brandywine
lore: 'I don't know why he's so upset, it's only a few carrots... my point is, he's overreacting.'
text: While Merry bears a weapon, he is strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Merry to make him strength +1 for each hand weapon you can spot (limit +3).

name: Sam, Faithful Companion
subtitle: Faithful Companion
lore: Mr. Frodo's not going anywhere without me!'
text: Fellowship: Exert Sam to take a [shire] item into hand from your draw deck (limit once per turn). Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: Sam, Son of Hamfast
subtitle: Son of Hamfast
lore: 'Oh, I've never held a girl's hand before. I... I think I might just have myself another ale.'
text: Fellowship: Exert Sam and another companion to remove a burden. Then, exert Sam again unless you can spot 2 [shire] allies (or Rosie Cotton). Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: Sting
lore: 'This is Sting.... Take it, if you like.'
text: Bearer must be Frodo. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Frodo to reveal 4 cards at random from an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed (limit (2)).

name: A Talent for Not Being Seen
lore: With their small size, Hobbits use any hole to hide in, and their trail is difficult to detect.
text: Stealth. Bearer must be Merry or Pippin. Limit 1 per character. Each site's Shadow number is -1.

name: Ettenmoors
text: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your character (except an enduring character), to make it strength +2.

name: Midgewater Moors
text: Plains. Each time a minion is played, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion or discard a card from hand.

name: Curse Their Foul Feet!
lore: 'They crossed the Nimrodel – curse their foul feet in its clean water!'
text: Exert an Elf to reveal 4 cards at random from an opponent's hand.  Make the fellowship archery total +X until the regroup phase, where X is the number of Orcs revealed.  That player may discard X cards from hand to prevent this.

name: Slopes of Amon Hen
text: While you can spot more companions than minions, [isengard] minions are twilight cost -1 for each [isengard] minion you can spot.

name: Elrond, Lord of Rivendell
subtitle: Lord of Rivendell
lore: He was the Lord of Rivendell and mighty among both Elves and Men.
text: To play, spot Gandalf or an Elf. At the start of each of your turns, heal up to 3 allies whose home is site 3. Fellowship: Exert Elrond twice (or once if you can spot 2 other [Elven] allies) to draw a card.

name: Far-seeing Eyes
lore: Keen Elven eyes see farther and more clearly than those of Men or Dwarves.
text: Each time you play an Elf, draw a card.  Any Shadow player may discard a card from hand to prevent this.

name: Foul Creation
lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai mirrored the singular focus of their master, viewing with contempt and disgust all they encountered.
text: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. You may draw 2 cards if an [isengard] minion was revealed.

name: Galadriel, Lady of Light
subtitle: Lady of Light
lore: Very tall they were, and the Lady no less tall than the Lord; and they were grave and beautiful... and the hair of the Lady was of deep gold....
text: At the start of each of your turns, heal up to 3 allies whose home is site 6. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play an Elf; that Elf's twilight cost is -1.

name: Haldir, Elf of the Golden Wood
subtitle: Elf of the Golden Wood
lore: 'But there are some of us who still go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies.... I am one. Haldir is my name.'
text: To play, spot an Elf. While Haldir is at a forest or river (or any site 6, 7, or 8), he is strength +2 and an archer.

name: Cleaving Blow
lore: The shoddy workmanship of Orc-smiths cannot withstand the fury of Durin's folk.
text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 and damage +1 and discard a Shadow item borne by a minion that Dwarf is skirmishing.

name: Legolas, Greenleaf
subtitle: Greenleaf
lore: And I too will go with him,' said Legolas. 'It would be faithless now to say farewell.'
text:
Archer.
Archery: Exert Legolas to wound a minion. Exert him again unless he bears a ranged weapon or you can spot more minions than companions.

name: Lorien Elf
lore: '...we dwell now in the heart of the forest, and do not willingly have dealings with any other folk.'
text: To play, spot an Elf.

name: The Mirror of Galadriel
lore: 'What you will see I cannot tell....'
text: Plays to your support area. Each Elf ally whose home is site 6 is strength +1. Maneuver: Exert Galadriel to reveal 3 cards at random from an opponent's hand. Place one on top of that player's draw deck.

name: Shoulder to Shoulder
lore: 'May it be a sign that though the world is now dark better days are at hand, and that friendship shall be renewed between our peoples.'
text: Fellowship: Add (1) and exert a Dwarf to heal an Elf, or add (1) and exert an Elf to heal a Dwarf.

name: Stand Against Darkness
lore: 'What power still remains lies with us, here in Imladris, or with Círdan at the Havens, or in Lórien. But have they the strength, have we here the strength to withstand the Enemy...?'
text: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to wound a [sauron] minion twice or discard a [sauron] condition or possession.

name: The White Arrows of Lorien
lore: 'What you will see I cannot tell....'
text: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to exert a minion. An opponent may discard a card from hand to prevent this.

name: Dwarf Guard
lore: Dwarves from Dain's people are stout companions, trustworthy and loyal.
text: To play, spot a Dwarf.

name: Barliman Butterbur, Prancing Pony Proprietor
subtitle: Prancing Pony Proprietor
lore: 'You don't know much even about them, if you think old Barliman is stupid,' said Gandalf. 'He is wise enough on his own ground.'
text: Fellowship: Exert Barliman Butterbur to take a spell into hand from your discard pile.

name: Ottar, Man of Laketown
subtitle: Man of Laketown
lore: The Men of Laketown come from the North, where they trade with the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain.
text: To play, spot Gandalf. Fellowship: Exert Ottar and discard a card from hand to draw a card.

name: Sleep, Caradhras
lore: 'Losto Caradhras, sedho, hodo, nuitho i ruith.'
text: Spell. Exert Gandalf to discard a Shadow condition and then hinder all condition.

name: A Wizard Is Never Late
lore: 'A wizard is never late, Frodo Baggins, nor is he early. He arrives precisely when he means to.'
text: Play a Wizard or [gandalf] ally from your draw deck.

name: Dwarven Axe
lore: 'Buckler and corslet, axe and sword / And shining spears were laid in hoard.'
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf.  Each time a minion loses a skirmish to bearer, you may make a minion strength -1 until the regroup phase.  The Shadow player may discard 2 cards from the bottom of their draw deck to prevent this.

name: Armor
lore: Then Elendil the Tall and his mighty sons, Isildur and Anárion, became great lords; and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....
text: Bearer must be a Man or [gondor] companion.  Bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.

name: Boromir's Cloak
lore: He was cloaked and booted as if for a journey on horseback; and indeed though his garments were rich, and his cloak was lined with fur, they were stained with 'long travel.
text: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir to discard a weather condition.\Response: If a skirmish event or special ability is used during a skirmish involving Boromir, discard this to prevent that.

name: Filibert Bolger, Wily Rascal
subtitle: Wily Rascal
lore: Filibert knows paths and tracks that few have trodden. He is not adventurous by nature, but his escapades often require rapid departures.
text: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit companion twice (except the Ring-bearer) to cancel a fierce skirmish involving that Hobbit.

name: Merry, Horticulturalist
subtitle: Horticulturalist
lore: 'Ow... I think I've broken something.'
text: Fellowship: Exert Merry to take a Hobbit ally into hand from your draw deck (limit once per turn).

name: Not Feared in Sunlight
lore: '...our shapes cast shadows in their minds, which only the noon sun destroys....'
text: To play, spot 2 Hobbits.\Fellowship: Discard this condition to make each Nazgûl strength -4 until the regroup phase.

name: O Elbereth! Gilthoniel!
lore: With a last effort Frodo... slipped the Ring from his finger and closed his right hand tight upon it.
text: Tale. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make the Ring-bearer strength +4 if skirmishing a Nazgul or to take off The One Ring.

name: Make Light of Burdens
lore: A Dwarf does not readily notice the weight on his back, or in his heart.
text: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf and hinder an item borne by that Dwarf to hinder a Shadow condition (if that condition is a weather or borne by a Dwarf, discard it instead).

name: Pippin, Mr. Took
subtitle: Mr. Took
lore: Pippin was evidently much enjoying the attention he was getting, and had become quire forgetful of their danger.
text: Each time you play a companion, you may play an item on them from your discard pile (at twilight cost -2 if that companion is Gandalf or Aragorn).

name: Realm of Dwarrowdelf
lore: 'There must have been a mighty crowd of dwarves here... and every one of them busier than badgers....'
text: Skirmish: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to make a Dwarf strength +1 (limit +3) and, if underground, damage +1 (limit +3). You may then discard up to 30 cards from your draw deck 3 at a time.

name: Gimli, Dwarf of the Mountain-race
subtitle: Dwarf of the Mountain-race
lore: 'In the ruins of the Dwarves, a dwarf's head will be less easy to bewilder than Elves or Men or Hobbits.'
text: Damage +1. Each underground site's Shadow number is -1. While the fellowship is at an underground site, Gimli is strength +1.

name: Secret Sentinels
lore: 'Yet so little faith and trust do we find now in the world beyond Lothlórien... that we dare not by our own trust endanger our land.'
text: Exert an Elf ally to discard a condition (and hinder another Shadow condition if you can spot an Orc).

name: Flaming Brand
lore: ...a glimpse of Strider leaping out of the darkness with a flaming brand of wood in either hand.
text: Bearer must be a ranger. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Skirmish: Make bearer strength +2 and damage +1 while bearing this item and skirmishing a Nazgul until the regroup phase (limit once per turn). Discard this possession at the start of the regroup phase.

name: Shield of Boromir
lore: Boromir bore the heirlooms of the Steward's house with pride.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. The minion archery total is -1. If bearer is Boromir, each minion skirmishing him does not gain strength bonuses from weapons.\Skirmish: If bearer is Boromir, discard this to make him take no wounds.

name: Beyond the Height of Men
lore: 'Whom do you serve?'
text: Exert an Uruk-hai to discard a Free Peoples armor, helm, or shield.  Hinder up to 4 Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 6 companions or 8 [Isengard] cards.

name: Demands of the Sackville-Bagginses
lore: In the middle of the commotion, the Sackville- Bagginses arrived.
text: To play, spot an [isengard] minion.  Each time an ally exerts, add (1) (or (2) if that ally is [shire]).

name: Lurtz's Sword
lore: The Uruk giant laid down his bow and drew a broad-bladed weapon.
text: Bearer must be a unique Uruk-hai. If bearer is Lurtz, he is damage +1. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must wound a companion or discard the top 3 cards of their draw deck.

name: No Business of Ours
lore: 'Goblins? Cobblers! Far-off tales and children's stories, that's all that is!'
text: While you can spot an [isengard] minion, this card is twilight cost -3.\The Free Peoples player may not look at or reveal cards in any Shadow player's hand.

name: Too Much Attention
lore: 'A little more caution from you – that is not a trinket you carry.'
text: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot an [isengard] minion to take a minion into hand from your draw deck.  The Free Peoples player may discard the top 6 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.

name: Uruk Captain
lore: The captains marched the Uruk-hai to the great river without halting.
text: Damage +1. Shadow: Remove (1) and exert an Uruk-hai to play an Uruk-hai from your discard pile.

name: Foul Things
lore: 'Something has crept, or has been driven out of dark waters under the mountains.'
text: Shadow: Play a [Moria] card from your discard pile.

name: Fror, Gimli's Kinsman
subtitle: Gimli's Kinsman
lore: Among the envoys sent to represent the Dwarves of Erebor at the Council of Elrond was Farin, a young but wise Dwarf, and a fierce foe in battle.
text: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Uruk-hai, Fror is strength +3.

name: Gloin, Friend to Thorin
subtitle: Friend to Thorin
lore: 'But what then would happen, if the Ruling Ring were destroyed, as you counsel?'
text: For each [Dwarven] tale you can spot, Gloin is strength +1 (limit +4).

name: Bill Ferny, Swarthy Sneering Fellow
subtitle: Swarthy Sneering Fellow
lore: '...as for Ferny, he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'
text: Nazgul are not roaming. While you can spot a Hobbit, the Free Peoples player may not assign a character to skirmish Bill Ferny. Discard Bill Ferny if underground.

name: Helpless
lore: He heard Frodo's voice, but it seemed to come from a great distance...crying out strange words.
text: Bearer's special abilities cannot be used. Maneuver: Exert a Nazgul to transfer this from your support area to a Ring-bound companion.

name: The Witch-king, Lord of the Nazgul
subtitle: Lord of the Nazgul
lore: A great king and sorcerer was he of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'
text: Twilight. Return to Its Master cannot be played. Skirmishes involving The Witch-king cannot be canceled. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer twice.

name: Southern Spies
lore: 'They will know all the news now, for they have visited Bill Ferny; and probably that Southerner was a spy as well.'
text: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot a [sauron] minion to add a burden for each card in the Free Peoples player's hand. The Free Peoples player may discard their hand to prevent this.

name: Galadriel, Bearer of Wisdom
subtitle: Bearer of Wisdom
lore: '...I shall not be dark, but beautiful and terrible as the Morning and the Night!...Dreadful as the Storm and the Lightning!'
text: While Galadriel bears an artifact or The One Ring, she is resistance +1 for each [elven] companion you can spot.

name: Glorfindel, Revealed in Wrath
subtitle: Revealed in Wrath
text: Skirmish: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may exert Glorfindel to make a Nazgûl he is skirmishing strength –X, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

name: Radagast, The Brown
subtitle: The Brown
lore: '...a master of shapes and changes of hue; and he has much lore of herbs and beasts....'
text: The move limit is +1. When Radagast leaves play, this bonus is immediately lost. Each time the fellowship moves, each opponent may discard 2 cards from hand to draw 2 cards.

name: Sent Back
lore: 'The Sun shines through you.'
text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to discard each minion skirmishing your Wizard. Place that Wizard in your dead pile. Fellowship: Play a Wizard (even if another copy of that Wizard is in your dead pile).

name: Smeagol, Bearer of Great Secrets
subtitle: Bearer of Great Secrets
lore: '...he used it to find out secrets, and he put his knowledge to crooked and malicious uses.'
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each time the fellowship moves, place an unbound companion in the dead pile. Regroup: If Sméagol is the Ring-bearer, add 2 burdens to discard each minion.

name: Boromir, Bearer of Council
subtitle: Bearer of Council
lore: 'True-hearted Men, they will not be corrupted. We of Minas Tirith have been staunch....'
text: While Boromir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or wound him twice.  Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, discard each minion he is skirmishing.

name: Elendil, The Tall
subtitle: The Tall
lore: ...and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....
text: To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men. Fellowship: Play an artifact on Elendil to make the move limit +1 for this turn. Regroup: Discard a [gondor] artifact borne by a companion to liberate a site.

name: Isildur, Bearer of Heirlooms
subtitle: Bearer of Heirlooms
lore: 'But for my part I will risk no hurt to this thing: of all the works of Sauron the only fair.'
text: While Isildur is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or exert 3 companions.  While Isildur bears The One Ring or an artifact, each [gondor] knight is strength +1.

name: Sapling of the White Tree
lore: 'Verily this is a sapling of the line of Nimloth the fair; and that was a seedling of Galathilion, and that a fruit of Telperion of many names, Eldest of Trees.'
text: To play, spot an unbound [gondor] Man. Response: If a [gondor] Man is about to take a wound, discard this artifact to prevent that wound and heal that Man.

name: The Red Arrow
lore: 'The Red Arrow has not been seen in the Mark in all my years! Has it indeed come to that?'
text: Fellowship: Exert a Man to take a Man of a different culture into hand from your draw deck. Discard this artifact. \Regroup: Exert 2 of your Men to discard a Man from your dead pile. Remove this artifact from the game.

name: Bilbo, Bearer of Things Burgled
subtitle: Bearer of Things Burgled
lore: 'But what has it got in its pocketses, eh?'
text: Ring-bound. Each time the fellowship moves, if the twilight pool has 2 or fewer twilight tokens, add 2 burdens or add (3). Regroup: Add a burden to play a [shire] tale.

name: Terrible as the Dawn
lore: 'In the place of the Dark Lord, you would have a Queen... All shall love me and despair!'
text: If a companion or ally's special ability is used, you may spot a [sauron] card to wound that character.  The Free Peoples player may discard another companion to prevent this.

name: Tower of Barad-dur
lore: The Dark Tower had been rebuilt, it was said. From there the power was spreading....
text: To play, exert a [sauron] minion. Each time the fellowship moves, draw 2 cards.  The Free Peoples player may discard a card from hand to prevent this.

name: Bill the Pony
lore: 'That animal can nearly talk.... He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak....'
text: Stealth. Bearer must be Sam. Each site's Shadow number is -1. Discard this possession when at an underground site.

name: Frying Pan
lore: 'I think I'm getting the hang of this!'
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Skirmish: Exert bearer to wound an Orc he or she is skirmishing.

name: The Shire Countryside
lore: 'Life in the wide world goes on... scarcely even aware of the existence of hobbits....'
text: To play, spot 2 [Shire] companions. Plays to your support area. Each time you remove a burden (except by a Hobbit's game text), you may heal up to 2 companions (limit once per phase).

name: Wastes of Emyn Muil
text: Shadow: Heal a companion to play an [Isengard] Orc from your discard pile.

name: Elrond, Herald to Gil-galad
subtitle: Herald to Gil-galad
lore: Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior....
text: At the start of each of your turns, you may spot an ally whose home is site 3 to heal that ally up to 2 times.  Add (1) per wound healed. Regroup: Exert Elrond twice to heal a companion.

name: Erestor, Chief Advisor to Elrond
subtitle: Chief Advisor to Elrond
lore: 'Then there are but two courses... to hide the Ring for ever, or to unmake it.'
text: To play, spot an Elf. Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound from a [sauron] or [ringwraith] card, exert Erestor to prevent that wound.

name: Galadriel, Lady of the Golden Wood
subtitle: Lady of the Golden Wood
lore: 'There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware!'
text: Response: If the fellowship is about to move to an opponent's site during the Fellowship phase, exert Galadriel to replace that site with a forest site of the same site number from your adventure deck.

name: Golradir, Councilor of Imladris
subtitle: Councilor of Imladris
lore: Their stay at Rivendell provided the Fellowship with counsel from many sources.
text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Golradir to make a minion strength -1 (or -1 for each Elf you can spot if that minion is an Orc).

name: Phial of Galadriel
lore: 'May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out. Remember Galadriel and her Mirror!'
text: To play, exert an Elf.  Bearer must be the Ring-bearer.  Bearer's resistance is +2.

name: Saelbeth, Elven Councilor
subtitle: Elven Councilor
lore: The wisdom of Saelbeth prepared the Company for the dangers they would face.
text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Saelbeth to make a minion strength -1 (or -1 for each Elf you can spot if that minion is an Uruk-hai).

name: Vilya
lore: Upon his finger was a ring of gold with a great blue stone, Vilya, mightiest of the Three.
text: Bearer must be Elrond. Maneuver: Exert Elrond twice to hinder a Shadow condition.

name: Deep in Thought
lore: He was... trying to recall every memory of his former journey in the Mines, and considering anxiously the next course that he should take....
text: Spell.\Spot Gandalf and 4 twilight tokens to discard a Shadow condition. Hinder all other Shadow conditions.

name: Aragorn, Heir to the White City
subtitle: Heir to the White City
lore: '...his hood was cast back, and his dark hair was blowing in the wind, a light was in his eyes: a king returning from exile in his own land.'
text: Ranger. Each time the fellowship moves during the fellowship phase, remove (1).

name: A Royal Welcome
text: Fellowship: Exert a [dwarven] companion to heal a [dwarven] ally. Skirmish: Exert a [dwarven] ally to add that ally's strength or damage bonuses to an unbound [dwarven] companion (limit once per phase). Regroup: Exert a [dwarven] ally to heal a [dwarven] companion.

name: Gondor Bowmen
lore: Arrows of the Last Alliance brought death to Sauron's forces.
text: Tale. Archery: Exert a [gondor] companion and discard this condition to make the fellowship archery total +2.

name: Horn of Boromir
lore: On a baldric he wore a great horn tipped with silver....
text: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir and discard this possession to spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.

name: Song of Durin
lore: No harp is wrung, no hammer falls: / The darkness dwells in Durin's halls....
text: Tale. To play, exert a Dwarf. \The twilight cost of each [moria] weapon is +1.\Fellowship: Discard this condition to hinder a Shadow condition (or discard up to 2 [moria] conditions).

name: Can You Protect Me From Yourself?
lore: 'Where is the Ring?'
text: Bearer must be a companion or ally. Limit 1 per bearer. Each time bearer wins a skirmish against an [isengard] minion, add a burden. At the start of the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player may exert bearer twice to discard this condition.

name: Hate and Anger
lore: The frenzy of Uruks is born of the fear of the very Goblins that work the pits.
text: Spot an Uruk-hai and an Orc to draw 3 cards.

name: Hollowing of Isengard
lore: 'Rip them all down!'
text: To play, spot an [isengard] minion.\At the start of your Shadow phase, you may discard an [isengard] card from hand to add (3) (or (5) if that card was an Orc).

name: Orthanc Berserker
lore: The voice of Saruman compels his minions to stop at nothing to earn his favor.
text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 5 burdens or 5 [isengard] cards and exert Orthanc Berserker twice to exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: The Palantir of Orthanc
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert an [isengard] minion. The Free Peoples player may place any number of cards from hand on top of their draw deck, then reveals their hand. For each Free Peoples card revealed, make that minion strength +1 until the regroup phase. Limit once per phase.

name: Saruman, Keeper of Isengard
subtitle: Keeper of Isengard
text: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. Maneuver: Exert Saruman to make an Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase. Response: If an Uruk-hai is about to take a wound, discard (or exert) Saruman to prevent that wound.

name: Arwen, Elven Rider
subtitle: Elven Rider
lore: 'If I can cross the river, the power of my people will protect him.'
text: Ranger. Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, discard X cards from hand to prevent that wound, where X is the current region number.

name: Servants to Saruman
lore: 'This is grievous news concerning Saruman... for we trusted him and he is deep in all our counsels.'
text: Skirmish: Make an [isengard] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if that Orc is strength 7 or less).

name: Trapped and Alone
lore: '...I had no chance of escape, and my days were bitter.'
text: Each character skirmishing an [isengard] Orc loses all damage bonuses from weapons. Skirmish: Spot a skirmishing [Isengard] Orc. Make the Free Peoples shuffle another [Isengard] Orc into your draw deck to cancel the active skirmish.

name: Uruk Raider
lore: 'There is no safety where Saruman's emblem is shown.'
text: Tracker. While an ally is in the dead pile, this minion is strength +3 and damage +1. Each time an ally exerts, you may spot another [isengard] card and exert this minion to wound that ally.

name: Malice
lore: Fueled by Sauron's hatred of living things, Orcs searched for the Ring of Power.
text: Spot a [moria] Orc and a [sauron] Orc to play up to 2 [sauron] or [moria] items from your discard pile.  Wound a Free Peoples archer for each item played.

name: Arwen, Lady Undomiel
subtitle: Lady Undomiel
lore: Queenly she looked, and thought and knowledge were in her glance, as of one who has known many things that the years bring.
text: Each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -1 for each home 3 [elven] ally you can spot (limit -4).

name: Such a Little Thing
text: Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer and a [moria] minion, discard a possession borne by bearer. The Free Peoples player may exert bearer or discard another Free Peoples item to prevent that.

name: News of Mordor
lore: 'Build me an army worthy of Mordor.'
text: Choose one: exert an [isengard] minion to make a Nazgul damage +1 until the regroup phase, or exert a Nazgul to prevent all wounds to an [isengard] minion until the regroup phase.

name: Too Great and Terrible
lore: 'Do not tempt me!'
text: To play, exert a [ringwraith] minion. Bearer must be a companion or ally (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per bearer. Each time bearer is exerted by a Free Peoples card, exert bearer unless the Free Peoples player discards a card from hand of bearer's culture.

name: The Dark Lord Advances
text: Exert a [sauron] minion to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand.  You may take a minion into hand from your draw deck costing up to X, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.  The Free Peoples player may discard X cards from hand to prevent this.

name: Get Off the Road!
lore: 'The Morgul-lord and his Black Riders have come forth. War is preparing!'
text: Search.Spot a [sauron] card and a Nazgul to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each burden you can spot. The Free Peoples player may make the move limit -1 to prevent this.

name: Hand of Sauron
lore: 'The power of the Ring could not be undone.'
text: Exert a unique [sauron] minion to exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer) and discard a possession attached to that companion.  The Free Peoples player may discard 1 card at random from their hand to prevent this.

name: His Cruelty and Malice
lore: 'Into this Ring he poured his cruelty, his malice, and his will to dominate all life.'
text: Regroup: Discard a [sauron] minion to reveal the top 2 cards of your opponent's draw deck.  If at least 1 is a Free Peoples card, exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer).  Your opponent may discard all revealed Free Peoples cards to prevent this.

name: Massing in the East
lore: 'The power of the Black Land grows....'
text: To play, discard a [sauron] minion. Return up to X [sauron] minions to hand, where X is the number of races you can spot in the fellowship.  The Free Peoples player may discard X cards from hand to prevent this.

name: Morgul Destroyer
text: When you play this minion, you may spot a Nazgûl to add a threat. The Free Peoples player may make you wound a companion to prevent this. Skirmish: Remove a threat to make this minion strength +4.

name: Herugrim, Sword of the Mark
subtitle: Sword of the Mark
lore: Out swept his sword, and he spurred to the standard, hewed staff and bearer....
text: Bearer must be Théoden. He is damage +1. Response: If Théoden is about to take a wound and you cannot spot 3 threats, add 2 threats to prevent that wound.

name: Merry's Sword
lore: Merry's sword had stabbed him from behind, shearing through the black mantle....
text: Bearer must be Merry. Maneuver: Exert Merry X times to exert a minion once for each [rohan] companion you spot (limit X).

name: They Sang as They Slew
lore: ...for the joy of battle was on them, and the sound of their singing that was fair and terrible came even to the City.
text: Exert X mounted companions to wound X minions and remove X burdens.

name: Rohirrim Road
text: Fellowship: Exert a [Rohan] Man to make the twilight cost of each Shadow condition and possession +2 until the regroup phase.

name: Fool's Hope
lore: 'There never was much hope....'
text: Spot Gandalf and discard X cards from hand to make an opponent choose to discard X Shadow conditions or make you hinder X Shadow conditions.

name: Northern Ithilien
text: Shadow: Remove 2 threats and play Gollum from your discard pile to add 2 burdens (limit once per phase).

name: Steadfast Champion
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to Gandalf." At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard this condition to discard a minion and heal a companion 3 times.

name: Clever Hobbits
lore: 'Clever hobbits to climb so high, very clever hobbits!'
text: Spot any number of [gollum] conditions. Make Smeagol strength +3 and damage +1 for each condition spotted. Discard each of yours spotted and hinder each of your opponent's spotted.

name: Andúril, King's Blade
subtitle: King's Blade
lore: The Sword of Elendil was forged anew by Elvish smiths... for Aragorn son of Arathorn was going to war upon the marches of Mordor.
text: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is strength +2 for each minion he is skirmishing.\Assignment: Add a threat to make Aragorn defender +1 (limit +1).

name: Cirion
lore: So now at last the City was besieged....
text: While you have only 4 or 5 cards in hand, Cirion is strength +2. Fellowship: Exert Cirion to play a beacon from your draw deck (limit once per turn).

name: Faramir, Wizard's Pupil
subtitle: Wizard's Pupil
text: Ranger. Fellowship: Play a [rohan] Man to heal Faramir. Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Gandalf to make Faramir unable to take wounds.

name: Gondorian Captain
lore: 'The Captains of the Outlands are expected up the South Road ere sundown.'
text: Knight. Maneuver: Discard a fortification to remove a threat.

name: Aggression
lore: 'Certainty of death, small chance of success....'
text: While you have initiative, each Dwarf is damage +1. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf and discard this condition to draw a card.

name: Great Hill Troll
lore: ...and wielded heavy hammers in their knotted hands.
text: Besieger. Fierce. The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each [Sauron] engine you can spot (limit -5). When you play this minion at any site 5 or higher, you may discard an engine to discard a Free Peoples condition.

name: Grond, Hammer of the Underworld
subtitle: Hammer of the Underworld
text: Engine. Shadow: Play a [sauron] minion to add a [sauron] token here. Regroup: Discard a [sauron] minion and remove X [sauron] tokens here to discard a Free Peoples card (except a companion) with a twilight cost of X. If that card is not in the support area, discard this possession.

name: Saved From the Fire
lore: '...we will bear Faramir, Steward of Gondor, to a place where he can sleep in peace....'
text: Spot Gandalf and place a companion (except the Ring-bearer) in the dead pile to take up to X cards from that companion's culture into hand from your draw deck, where X is the current region number +1.

name: Promise Keeping
lore: 'And we'll save the Precious, as we promised.... Then we'll pay everyone back'
text: Each time a companion skirmishing a [Gollum] minion takes a wound, exert a companion.

name: Blood Runs Chill
lore: ...the Dark Door gaped before them like the mouth of night.
text: If the fellowship moves, spot a Dwarf who is damage +X and exert that Dwarf to make an opponent hinder X Shadow cards.

name: Shadow Host
lore: ...fear went on before them, until they came to Calembel upon Ciril, and the sun went down like blood behind Pinnath Gelin....
text: Enduring. To play, spot 2 [gondor] Wraiths and add 2 threats. While Shadow Host is exhausted, it is defender +1.

name: Swept Away
text: Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition.  While you have initiative, exhausted [gondor] Wraiths cannot take wounds.\Response: If a Shadow card is about to discard this condition, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that.

name: Castamir of Umbar
lore: 'They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor.'
text: Corsair. Enduring. While in region 2 or 3, this minion is fierce. Shadow: Exert Castamir of Umbar and play a corsair to reinforce a [raider] card twice.

name: Corsair Marauder
lore: Umbar remained at war with Gondor for many lives of men....
text: Corsair. When you play this minion, if you can spot another corsair, you may discard a Shadow possession to reinforce a [raider] card twice.

name: Corsair War Galley
text: When you play this possession, you may add a [raider] token here. While you can spot 6 [raider] tokens and a [raider] Man, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand. Regroup: Add (1) for each [raider] token you can spot. Discard this possession.

name: Rohirrim Army
lore: 'Begone, foul dwimmerlaik, lord of carrion!'
text: To play, spot 2 [rohan] companions.  You may play Rohirrim Army any time you could play a regroup event.   When you play Rohirrim Army, you may discard a minion.

name: Rath Dínen
text: When sanctuary healing at this site, the Free Peoples player heals only 3 wounds instead of 5.

name: Come Down
text: Maneuver: If you can spot an [isengard] minion, spot a fortification. Make the Free Peoples player distribute X + 1 wounds among your [isengard] minions to discard that fortification, where X is its twilight cost.\Archery: Spot 2 [isengard] archers to make allies take wounds from archery fire instead of companions.

name: Grima, Son of Galmod
subtitle: Son of Galmod
lore: 'Did I not counsel you, lord, to forbid his staff?'
text: Lurker. Each unbound companion (or ally) bearing a Shadow condition is strength -1.

name: Grima, Wormtongue
subtitle: Wormtongue
lore: 'I care for you and yours as best I may. But do not weary yourself, or tax too heavily your strength.'
text: Maneuver: Exert Grima to hinder a weapon borne by an unbound companion (or all Free Peoples cards borne by that companion if they are bearing 3 or more cards).

name: Uruk Regular
lore: 'We are the Uruk-hai; we do not stop the fight for night or day, for fair weather or for storm.'
text: Damage +1. Shadow: Exert this minion to play an Uruk-hai; its twilight cost is -1 for each other Uruk-hai you can spot (limit -2).

name: Southron Archer
lore: 'They have passed on to the Black Gate; but more may follow.'
text: Southron. Archer. While you can spot another Southron, the minion archery total is +1 for each site you control.

name: Fortress Never Fallen
lore: '...it was the spirit of your people that held it strong.'
text: Fortification. Each time a [Rohan] Man wins a skirmish, you may place a [Rohan] token on this card. Regroup: Discard a Shadow condition for each [Rohan] token here (limit 4). Discard this condition.

name: Herugrim
lore: 'Here, lord, is Herugrim, your ancient blade....'
text: Bearer must be Théoden. He is damage +1.

name: Simbelmynë
lore: 'How fair are the bright eyes in the grass! Evermind they are called... for they blossom in all seasons of the year, and grow where dead men rest.'
text: Fellowship: Spot 2 [rohan] Men (or 1 valiant [rohan] Man) to play a [rohan] character or [rohan] item from your draw deck.

name: Get On and Get Away
lore: 'The Dead can't be really there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'
text: Fellowship: Spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits (or Smeagol) and add 2 burdens to play the fellowship's next 2 sites (replacing opponent's sites if necessary).

name: Cavern Entrance
text: At the start of each skirmish, you may exert your character in that skirmish to prevent special abilities being used.

name: Ever My Heart Rises
text: Tale. When you play this condition, reveal the top 6 cards of your draw deck and stack them here. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf and discard the top card of your draw deck to take a Free Peoples card stacked here into hand.\Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to discard the top 5 cards of your draw deck.

name: From the Armory
lore: 'It's a bit tight around the chest.'
text: Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf and stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to make that Dwarf unable to take wounds.

name: Erethón, Naith Lieutenant
subtitle: Naith Lieutenant
lore: At close range, Erethón's accuracy is uncanny.
text: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While Erethón bears a ranged weapon, he is strength +1 and damage +1, and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Fereveldir, Son of Thandronen
subtitle: Son of Thandronen
lore: Thandronen's sons patrol the borders of Lórien together.
text: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Fereveldir and discard an [elven] token from your condition to wound a minion Fereveldir is skirmishing.

name: Ferevellon, Son of Thandronen
subtitle: Son of Thandronen
lore: The Uruks at Helm's Deep fell to his blade as easily as Goblins from the mountains.
text: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Ferevellon to make a minion skirmishing him strength -2.

name: Haldir, Emissary of the Galadhrim
subtitle: Emissary of the Galadhrim
lore: 'In days of old, my people stood beside the King of Gondor – we come to honor that allegiance.'
text: Valiant. While no opponent controls a site, Haldir is strength +2. Regroup: Exert Haldir at a battleground and exert another Elf to liberate a site.

name: Legolas, Dauntless Hunter
subtitle: Dauntless Hunter
lore: 'They are far, far away.... I know in my heart that they have not rested this night.'
text: Archer. Each time a Shadow event or Shadow condition is played, remove (1) for each unbound Hobbit you can spot (limit (2)).

name: Lórien Guardian
lore: Haldir's Elven bowmen were experienced defenders of the borders of the Golden Wood
text: Valiant. Regroup: Exert this companion to make a Shadow player wound a minion.

name: Lórien Swordsman
lore: Long, curved Elven steel cut down Uruks already weakened by Elven arrows.
text: <b>Valiant.</>  Each minion skirmishing this companion is strength -2 for each wound on that minion.

name: Ordulus, Young Warrior
subtitle: Young Warrior
lore: Ordulus always has an arrow nocked and a full quiver too.
text: <b>Valiant.</>  To play, spot an Elf.   The twilight cost of each ranged weapon played on Ordulus is -1.

name: Pengedhel, Naith Warrior
subtitle: Naith Warrior
lore: Pengedhel can wield an arrow like a short spear.
text: <b>Valiant.</>  To play, spot an Elf.  While Pengedhel bears a ranged weapon, he is strength +2 and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Thandronen, Veteran Protector
subtitle: Veteran Protector
lore: The twin sons of Thandronen marched with their father to defend Helm's Deep.
text: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. Regroup: Exert Thandronen to discard a minion stacked on a condition or stacked on a site.

name: Thónnas, Naith Captain
subtitle: Naith Captain
lore: Elves of Lórien hone their knife-work fighting Goblin raiders.
text: <b>Valiant.</>  To play, spot an Elf.  While Thónnas bears a ranged weapon, each minion skirmishing him is strength -2 and Thónnas does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Grown Suddenly Tall
lore: His hood and grey rags were flung away. His white garments shone.
text: Spell. Spot Gandalf to hinder all conditions. Add (1) for each Shadow condition hindered (limit (5)).

name: Keep Your Forked Tongue
lore: 'A witless worm you have become.'
text: Skirmish: Spot Gandalf and 3 twilight tokens to make a companion who has the Gandalf signet unable to take wounds.

name: Long I Fell
lore: 'His fire was about me. I was burned.'
text: Spell. Skirmish: Spot Gandalf to make him unable to take wounds. Any Shadow player may make you wound a minion to prevent this.

name: Roll of Thunder
lore: 'I have not passed through fire and death to bandy crooked words with a serving-man till the lightning falls.'
text: Fellowship or Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to discard a Shadow possession or hinder a Shadow artifact.

name: Ghân-buri-Ghân, Chieftain of the Woses
subtitle: Chieftain of the Woses
lore: 'Kill gorgûn! Kill orc-folk! No other words please Wild Men....'
text: While you can spot 2 other Men, Ghân-buri-Ghân cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled. While at a forest site, Ghân-buri-Ghân is defender +1.

name: Radagast's Staff
lore: 'It would have been useless in any case to try and win over the honest Radagast to treachery.'
text: Bearer must be Radagast. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may draw 2 cards.

name: Anárion, Lord of Anórien
subtitle: Lord of Anórien
lore: ...Elendil the Tall and his mighty sons, Isildur and Anárion, became great lords....
text: Skirmish: Play a [gondor] skirmish event to make each minion skirmishing Anárion strength -X, where X is Anárion's vitality.

name: Erkenbrand, Master of Westfold
subtitle: Master of Westfold
lore: As he came to the valley's brink, he set to his lips a great black horn and blew a ringing blast.
text: If you can spot a [rohan] Man, you may play Erkenbrand any time you could play a skirmish event. When you play Erkenbrand, you may discard a Shadow possession.

name: Tom Bombadil's Hat
lore: ...there appeared above the reeds an old battered hat a tall crown and a long blue feather....
text: To play, spot 2 [shire] companions. Each time a Shadow card adds a burden or a threat, add a [shire] token here. Fellowship: Remove 2 [shire] tokens from here to remove a burden.

name: Gimli, Dwarven Delegate
subtitle: Dwarven Delegate
lore: 'The ring cannot be destroyed, Gimli, son of Glóin, by any craft that we here possess.'
text: Damage +1.

name: Arwen, Maiden of Rivendell
subtitle: Maiden of Rivendell
lore: ...and she was called Undómiel, for she was the Evenstar of her people.
text: Ranger. Skirmish: Exert Arwen to make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -2.

name: Gandalf, Stormcrow
subtitle: Stormcrow
lore: His real business was far more difficult and dangerous, but the Shire-folk knew nothing about it.

name: Boromir, Steward's Heir
subtitle: Steward's Heir
lore: ...but at once, Boromir stood up, tall and proud before them.
text: Ring-bound. Knight. Ranger.

name: Éomer, Forthwith Banished
subtitle: Forthwith Banished
lore: 'Do I hope in vain that you have been sent to me for a help in doubt and need?'
text: Valiant. Damage +1. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1.

name: Frodo, Mr. Underhill
subtitle: Mr. Underhill
lore: '...I nearly tried on Bilbo's ring. I longed to disappear.'
text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). The twilight cost of each artifact, possession, and [shire] tale played on Frodo is -1.

name: The Shire
lore: `"Forty leagues it stretched from the Far Downs to the Brandywine Bridge, and fifty from the northern moors to the marshes in the south.  The Hobbits named it the Shire..."`

name: The Dead Marshes
lore: `"'Unless indeed it is some lying trick of the Enemy.  I have seen the faces of fair warriors of old laid in sleep beneath the pools of the Dead Marshes, or seeming so by his foul arts.'"`

name: The Paths of the Dead
lore: `"...and there stood a sheer wall of rock, and in the wall the Dark Door gaped before them like the mouth of night. Signs and figures were carved above its wide arch...and fear flowed from it like a grey vapour."`

name: Isengard
lore: `"Beneath the mountain's arm within the Wizard's Vale through years uncounted had stood that ancient place that Men called Isengard....Saruman had dwelt there long and had not been idle."`

name: Cirith Ungol
lore: `"...they were out in the open again now, and terror ran along the walls.  All might be dead in the Tower of Cirith Ungol, but it was steeped in fear and evil still."`

name: The Black Pit of Moria
lore: `"Only once before have I seen them from afar in waking life, but I know them and their names, for under them lies Khazad-dûm, the Dwarrowdelf, that is now called the Black Pit, Moria in the Elvish tongue.'"`

name: Minas Morgul
lore: `"'And on a time evil things came forth, and they took Minas Ithil and abode in it, and they made it into a place of dread; and it is called Minas Morgul, the Tower of Sorcery.'"`

name: Shelob's Lair
lore: `"'This is the entrance to the tunnel.' He did not speak its name: Torech Ungol, Shelob's Lair.  Out of it came a stench... a foul reek, as if filth unnameable were piled and hoarded in the dark within."`

name: The Black Gate
lore: `"Across the mouth of the pass, from cliff to cliff, the Dark Lord had built a rampart of stone.  In it there was a single gate of iron, and upon its battlement sentinels paced unceasingly."`

name: Mount Doom
lore: `"...and it looked upon Gorgoroth, the valley of terror in the Land of Mordor.  Darkness lay there under the Sun.  Fire glowed amid the smoke.  Mount Doom was burning, and a great reek rising."`

name: Rivendell
lore: `"'Here in Rivendell there live still some of his chief foes: the Elven-wise, lords of the Eldar from beyond the furthest seas.  They do not fear the Ringwraiths...'"`

name: Lothlorien
lore: `"`There lie the woods of Lothlórien! ' said Legolas. `That is the fairest of all the dwellings of my people. There are no trees like the trees of that land...and the floor of the wood is golden, and golden is the roof, and its pillars are of silver, for the bark of the trees is smooth and grey."`

name: Edoras
lore: `"'Edoras those courts are called,' said Gandalf, 'and Meduseld is that golden hall. There dwells Théoden son of Thengel, King of the Mark of Rohan...But we must ride more warily; for war is abroad, and the Rohirrim, the Horse-lords, do not sleep, even if it seem so from afar.'"`

name: Minas Tirith
lore: `"For the fashion of Minas Tirith was such that it was built on seven levels, each delved into the hill, and about each was set a wall, and in each was a gate. But the gates were not set in a line..."`

name: Helm's Gate
lore: `"At Helm's Gate, before the mouth of the Deep, there was a heel of rock thrust outward by the northern cliff.  There upon its spur stood high walls of ancient stone, and within them was a lofty tower."`

name: Ruins of Osgiliath
lore: `"...Osgiliath, through the midst of which the Great River flowed; and the Numenoreans built there a great bridge, upon which tehre were towers and houses of stone wonderful to behold..."`

name: Emyn Muil
lore: `"'On the further side are the bleak hills of the Emyn Muil.  The wind blows from the East there, for they look out over the Dead Marshes and the Noman-lands to Cirith Gorgor and the black gates of Mordor.'"`

name: Caradhras the Cruel
lore: `"'The heights away north are whiter than they were; snow is lying far down their shoulders. Tonight we shall be on our way high up towards the Redhorn Gate. We may well be seen by watchers on that narrow path...but the weather may prove a more deadly enemy than any.'"`

name: Book of Mazarbul
lore: 'It seems to be a record of the fortunes of Balin's folk....'
text: Tale. Bearer must be a Dwarf. At the start of each fellowship phase when the fellowship is at site 4 or higher, you may draw a card for each Dwarf companion.

name: Calaglin, Elf of Lórien
subtitle: Elf of Lórien
lore: 'We have been keeping watch on the rivers, ever since we saw a great troop of Orcs going north toward Moria....'
text: Archer. Regroup: Exert Calaglin to wound a minion.

name: Orc Veteran
lore: 'There was war, and the land was laid waste....'
text: Skirmish: Discard your [sauron] condition to make a character skirmishing this minion strength -1.

name: Orc Warrior
lore: Orcs were multiplying again in the mountains.
text: Maneuver: Exert this minion and discard your [sauron] condition to make the Free Peoples player discard the top 2 cards from his or her draw deck.

name: Our List of Allies Grows Thin
lore: 'The enemy is moving.... His eye is fixed on Rivendell. And Saruman, you tell me, has betrayed us.'
