text: To play, exert a [sauron] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, add (1) for each ally you can spot.

name: Terrible as the Dawn
lore: 'In the place of the Dark Lord, you would have a Queen... All shall love me and despair!'
text: Maneuver: Spot a [sauron] minion to wound Galadriel 3 times. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Elves to prevent this.

name: Tower of Barad-dûr
lore: The Dark Tower had been rebuilt, it was said. From there the power was spreading....
text: To play, exert a [sauron] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must discard a card from hand.

name: Why Shouldn't I Keep It?
lore: 'No, wait, it's here in my pocket. Isn't that... isn't that odd now?'
text: Maneuver: Spot a [sauron] minion to discard Bilbo. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Free Peoples conditions to prevent this.

name: Bill the Pony
lore: 'That animal can nearly talk.... He gave me a look as plain as Mr. Pippin could speak....'
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit companion. The Shadow number of each site is -1. Discard Bill the Pony when at an underground site.

name: Frodo's Pipe
lore: 'All the same, observations that I have made on my own many journeys south have convinced me that the weed itself is not native to our parts of the world.'
text: Bearer must be Frodo. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to heal a companion with the Frodo signet X times.

name: Frying Pan
lore: 'I think I'm getting the hang of this!'
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Skirmish: Exert bearer to wound an Orc he or she is skirmishing.

name: Meant to Be Alone
lore: 'You are a Ring-bearer, Frodo... to bear a Ring of Power is to be alone.'
text: Fellowship: Spot a Hobbit companion (except the Ring-bearer) to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Remove (X), where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

name: Cast It Into the Fire!
lore: 'It should have been cast then into Orodruin's fire nigh at hand where it was made.'
text: Maneuver: Spot an Elf to make each opponent discard a card from his or her hand. Draw a card for each card discarded in this way.

name: Melilot Brandybuck, Merry Dancer
subtitle: Merry Dancer
lore: Master Everard Took and Miss Melilot Brandybuck got on a table and with bells in their hands began to dance the Springle-ring: a pretty dance, but rather 'vigorous.
text: Response: If a burden is about to be added by a Shadow card, exert Melilot Brandybuck to prevent that burden.

name: Old Noakes, Purveyor of Wisdoms
subtitle: Purveyor of Wisdoms
lore: 'There's been some strange folk crossing the Shire – Dwarves and others of a less than savoury nature.'
text: Each time a Shadow card makes you discard a card from hand, you may also discard a minion or Shadow condition.

name: Seek and Hide
lore: A Hobbit's best friends in Moria are the very pillars that support its structure.
text: Stealth. Skirmish: Spot 2 [shire] companions to make a minion lose all damage bonuses.

name: The Shire Countryside
lore: 'Life in the wide world goes on... scarcely even aware of the existence of hobbits....'
text: To play, spot 2 [shire] companions. Plays to your support area. Each time you remove a burden (except by a Hobbit's game text), you may heal a companion.

name: Three Monstrous Trolls
lore: 'Great big nasty twenty foot high smelly things – and they're arguing... arguing about how they were going to cook us!'
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Response: If a Shadow card is about to add any number of twilight tokens, exert a Hobbit ally to prevent this.

name: Caras Galadhon
text: Forest. Sanctuary. While the fellowship is at Caras Galadhon, no more than one minion may be assigned to each skirmish.

name: Eregion Hills
text: When the fellowship moves to Eregion Hills, add a burden.

name: Gates of Argonath
text: River. Maneuver events may not be played.

name: The Great River
text: River. While the fellowship is at The Great River, cards may not be played from draw decks or discard piles.

name: House of Elrond
text: Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves to House of Elrond, the Free Peoples player may spot 2 Elves to remove a burden.

name: Dínendal, Silent Scout
subtitle: Silent Scout
lore: He was almost certain that he could hear stealthy movements.... Not Elves; for the woodland folk were altogether noiseless in their movements.
text: Archer. Regroup: Exert Dínendal to remove (2).

name: Wastes of Emyn Muil
text: Maneuver: Spot 4 companions and exert your [isengard] Orc to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

name: Legolas, Son of Thranduil
subtitle: Son of Thranduil
lore: 'Praised be the bow of Galadriel, and the hand and eye of Legolas!... That was a mighty shot in the dark, my friend!'
text: Archer. While Legolas is at a river or forest, add 1 to the fellowship archery total.

name: Boromir, Defender of Minas Tirith
subtitle: Defender of Minas Tirith
lore: ...seated a little apart was a tall man with a fair and noble face... proud and stern of glance.
text: Ranger. Fellowship: Add (2) to heal Boromir.

name: Elrond, Herald to Gil-galad
subtitle: Herald to Gil-galad
lore: Venerable he seemed as a king crowned with many winters, and yet hale as a tried warrior....
text: At the start of each of your turns, you may spot an ally whose home is site 3 and heal that ally up to 2 times. Regroup: Exert Elrond twice to heal a companion.

name: Erestor, Chief Advisor to Elrond
subtitle: Chief Advisor to Elrond
lore: 'Then there are but two courses... to hide the Ring for ever, or to unmake it.'
text: To play, spot an Elf. Response: If an Elf is about to take a wound from a [sauron] minion or [sauron] event, exert Erestor to prevent that wound.

name: Forests of Lothlórien
lore: 'Alas for Lothlórien that I love! It would be a poor life in a land where no mallorn grew.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot 3 [elven] allies to wound a minion.

name: Friends of Old
lore: 'You have been summoned here to answer the threat of Mordor.'
text: Fellowship: Reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Heal X [elven] allies, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

name: Galadriel, Lady of the Golden Wood
subtitle: Lady of the Golden Wood
lore: 'There is in her and in this land no evil, unless a man bring it hither himself. Then let him beware!'
text: At the start of each of your turns, you may heal an Elf. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play the fellowship's next site if it is a forest (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

name: Galdor, Councilor From the West
subtitle: Councilor From the West
lore: 'My heart tells me that Sauron will expect us to take the western way, when he learns what has befallen. He soon will.'
text: To play, spot an Elf. Regroup: Exert Galdor and spot a minion to return that minion to its owner's hand.

name: Gift of the Evenstar
lore: 'It is mine to give to whom I will... like my heart.'
text: To play, spot Arwen. Bearer must be Aragorn. Skirmish: Exert Aragorn or discard 2 cards from hand to make a minion skirmishing Aragorn strength -1.

name: Gimli's Pipe
lore: 'And certainly it was from Bree that the art of smoking the genuine weed spread in the recent centuries among Dwarves and such other folk....'
text: Bearer must be Gimli. Fellowship: Exert Gimli to add 1 to the number of pipes you can spot.

name: Golradir, Councilor of Imladris
subtitle: Councilor of Imladris
lore: Their stay at Rivendell provided the Fellowship with counsel from many sources.
text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Golradir to make an Orc strength -1.

name: Long-knives of Legolas
lore: Sharp, bone-handled knives defend the Elves of Mirkwood at close quarters.
text: Bearer must be Legolas. Each Orc or Uruk-hai skirmishing Legolas is strength -2.

name: Master of Healing
lore: 'Elrond has cured you: he has tended you for days, ever since you were brought in.'
text: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot Elrond (or 2 [elven] allies) to heal a companion or ally.

name: Nenya
lore: 'Verily it is in the land of Lórien upon the finger of Galadriel that one of the Three remains. This is Nenya, the Ring of Adamant, and I am its keeper.'
text: Bearer must be Galadriel. At the start of each regroup phase, you may discard up to 2 cards from hand to draw the same number of cards.

name: Phial of Galadriel
lore: 'May it be a light to you in dark places, when all other lights go out. Remember Galadriel and her Mirror!'
text: To play, exert an Elf. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer. Bearer's resistance is +2.

name: Saelbeth, Elven Councilor
subtitle: Elven Councilor
lore: The wisdom of Saelbeth prepared the Company for the dangers they would face.
text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Saelbeth to make an Uruk-hai strength -1.

name: Something Draws Near
lore: 'We have hunted and slain many Orcs in the woods....'
text: Fellowship or Maneuver: Exert an Elf to discard an [isengard] possession or [isengard] artifact.

name: Vilya
lore: Upon his finger was a ring of gold with a great blue stone, Vilya, mightiest of the Three.
text: Bearer must be Elrond. Maneuver: Exert Elrond twice and spot a Shadow condition to return that condition to its owner's hand.

name: Voice of Nimrodel
lore: 'Beside the falls of Nimrodel, / By water clear and cool, / Her voice as falling silver fell / Into the shining pool.'
text: Tale. Skirmish: Exert an Elf at a river or forest to cancel a skirmish involving that Elf.

name: Betrayal of Isengard
lore: 'There is only one Lord of the Ring.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time an opponent draws a card (or takes a card into hand) during the Shadow phase, you may remove (1). Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound Saruman twice.

name: Mines of Khazad-Dûm
lore: 'Moria! Moria! Wonder of the Northern world!'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time you play a [dwarven] tale, you may heal a Dwarf companion.

name: Deep in Thought
lore: He was... trying to recall every memory of his former journey in the Mines, and considering anxiously the next course that he should take....
text: Spell. Maneuver: Spot Gandalf and 4 twilight tokens to discard all Shadow conditions.

name: Depart Silently
lore: 'Be careful, both of you.'
text: Stealth. Maneuver: At sites 1 to 5, spot Gandalf to prevent Hobbits from being assigned to skirmishes until the regroup phase. At any other site, spot Gandalf to make a Hobbit strength +3 until the regroup phase.

name: Fireworks
lore: 'The finest rockets ever seen: / they burst in stars of blue and green....'
text: Spell. Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to shuffle up to 2 [gandalf] or up to 2 [shire] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.

name: His First Serious Check
lore: ...a false turn now might be disastrous.
text: Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. You may add (X) to discard that card, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

name: Narya
lore: 'For this is the Ring of Fire, and with it you may rekindle hearts in a world that grows chill.'
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. At the start of each of your turns, you may add (3) to remove a burden.

name: Trust Me as You Once Did
lore: 'Do not take me for some conjurer of cheap tricks! I am not trying to rob you. I am trying to help you.'
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert Gandalf to make a companion strength +1 for each companion with the Gandalf signet you can spot (limit +3).

name: Unknown Perils
lore: Suddenly he stopped as if listening. Frodo became aware that all was very quiet, inside and outside.
text: Plays to your support area. Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot 4 twilight tokens and exert Gandalf to prevent that wound.

name: Answering the Cries
lore: Drawing his bright sword and crying Elendil! Elendil! he crashed through the trees.
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard a [gondor] tale from hand to make a [gondor] companion strength +2.

name: Aragorn, Heir to the White City
subtitle: Heir to the White City
lore: '...his hood was cast back, and his dark hair was blowing in the wind, a light was in his eyes: a king returning from exile in his own land.'
text: Ranger. Each time the fellowship moves during the fellowship phase, remove (2).

name: Banner of the White Tree
lore: 'Many Elves and many mighty Men, and many of their friends, had perished in the war.'
text: Tale. Maneuver: Exert a [gondor] companion to make that companion strength +3 and defender +1 until the regroup phase.

name: A Royal Welcome
lore: 'There is even a chance that Dwarves are there, and that in some deep hall of his fathers, Balin son of Fundin may be found.'
text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a Dwarf ally to heal a Dwarf companion.

name: Citadel of Minas Tirith
lore: 'One day our paths will lead us there, and the Tower guards shall take up the call – The Lords of Gondor have returned.'
text: Plays to your support area. You may heal a [gondor] companion at the end of each turn during which no companion or ally lost a skirmish.

name: Gondor Bowmen
lore: Arrows of the Last Alliance brought death to Sauron's forces.
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Archery: Exert a [gondor] companion and discard this condition to make the fellowship archery total +2.

name: Horn of Boromir
lore: On a baldric he wore a great horn tipped with silver....
text: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir and spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.

name: Might of Númenor
lore: 'But the lords of Minas Tirith still fight on....'
text: Tale. Maneuver: Spot a [gondor] companion to reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Heal X companions, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

name: The Shards of Narsil
lore: '...Narsil was broken and its light extinguished, and it had not yet been forged again.'
text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Stack a [gondor] card from hand here. Fellowship: Add (1) to take a card stacked here into hand.

name: Some Who Resisted
lore: 'In the South the realm of Gondor long endured; and for a while its splendour grew....'
text: Tale. Maneuver: Spot a [gondor] companion to make the twilight cost of each maneuver event +2.

name: Still Sharp
lore: 'The shards of Narsil... the blade that cut the Ring from Sauron's hand.'
text: Skirmish: Spot The Shards of Narsil to make a [gondor] companion strength +3 and damage +1.

name: Voice of Rauros
lore: As he ran the cries came louder, but fainter now and desperately the horn was blowing.
text: Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to make each companion with the Aragorn signet damage +1 until the regroup phase.

name: We Must Go Warily
lore: 'This is the lawn of Parth Galen: a fair place in the summer days of old. Let us hope that no evil has yet come here.'
text: Response: If the fellowship moves in the regroup phase, exert a [gondor] companion twice to make each minion's twilight cost +1 until the next regroup phase.

name: Abandoning Reason for Madness
lore: 'And why not, Gandalf?... Why not? The Ruling Ring? If we could command that, then the power would pass to us.'
text: Shadow: Spot an [isengard] minion to discard up to 3 cards from hand and draw an equal number of cards.

name: Song of Durin
lore: No harp is wrung, no hammer falls: / The darkness dwells in Durin's halls....
text: Tale. To play, exert a Dwarf. Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each [moria] weapon is +2. Fellowship: Discard this condition to discard up to 2 [moria] conditions.

name: Can You Protect Me From Yourself?
lore: 'Where is the Ring?'
text: Maneuver: Spot an [isengard] minion to exhaust Aragorn. The Free Peoples player may add 2 burdens to prevent this.

name: Coming for the Ring
lore: 'This evil cannot be concealed by the power of the Elves....'
text: Regroup: Reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Heal X [isengard] minions, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

name: A Fell Voice on the Air
lore: 'He's trying to bring down the mountain!'
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert Saruman to play an [isengard] weather condition from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.

name: Hate and Anger
lore: The frenzy of Uruks is born of the fear of the very Goblins that work the pits.
text: Shadow: Spot an Uruk-hai and a [moria] minion to draw 3 cards.

name: Hollowing of Isengard
lore: 'Rip them all down!'
text: To play, spot an [isengard] Orc. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Discard this condition to add (3).

name: Isengard Axe
lore: Axes eat into the forests of Isengard as well as the victims of Saruman's Orcs.
text: Bearer must be an [isengard] Orc. When you play this weapon, add (1).

name: Isengard Forger
lore: 'I looked on it and saw that, whereas it had once been green and fair, it was now filled with pits and forges.'
text: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (1).

name: Isengard Retainer
lore: '...the Eagles of the mountain went far and wide, and they saw many things: the gathering of wolves and the mustering of Orcs....'
text: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

name: Isengard Servant
lore: The servants of Isengard worked tirelessly to spread the influence of their master.
text: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

name: Isengard Shaman
lore: 'Over all his works a dark smoke hung and wrapped itself about the sides of Orthanc.'
text: Response: If an [isengard] Orc is about to take a wound, remove (2) to prevent that wound.

name: Storm of Argument
lore: 'I will be dead before I see the Ring in the hands of an Elf!'
text: Fellowship: Reveal a card at random from an opponent's hand. Shuffle up to X [dwarven] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

name: Isengard Smith
lore: 'No other folk make such a trampling....'
text: Regroup: Exert this minion to discard a weapon (or all Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 5 companions).

name: Isengard Warrior
lore: 'There is evil afoot in Isengard, and the West is no longer safe.'
text: While you can spot another [isengard] Orc, no player may use archery special abilities. Regroup: Exert this minion and spot 3 wounds on the Ring-bearer to exert every companion.

name: Isengard Worker
lore: 'They were Elves once. Taken by dark powers – tortured and mutilated....'
text: Regroup: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

name: One of You Must Do This
lore: 'And if we fail, what then? What happens when Sauron takes back what is his?'
text: Maneuver: Exert an [isengard] minion to make the Free Peoples player exert X companions, where X is the number of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Dwarf, Elf, Man, and Wizard.

name: Orc Commander
lore: 'It seems their delight to slash and beat down growing things that are not even in their way.'
text: Each other [isengard] Orc is strength +1. Regroup: Exert Orc Commander to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

name: Orc Overseer
lore: 'What orders from Mordor, my Lord? What does the Eye command?'
text: Regroup: Exert Orc Overseer twice to exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Orthanc Berserker
lore: The voice of Saruman compels his minions to stop at nothing to earn his favor.
text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 5 burdens and exert Orthanc Berserker twice to exhaust a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: The Palantír of Orthanc
lore: 'Seven stars and seven stones....'
text: To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Spot an [isengard] minion and remove (1) to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Place that card on top of that player's draw deck.

name: Saruman, Keeper of Isengard
subtitle: Keeper of Isengard
text: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. Uruk-hai are fierce. Response: If an Uruk-hai is about to take a wound, exert Saruman to prevent that wound.

name: Saruman, Servant of the Eye
subtitle: Servant of the Eye
text: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. Assignment: Exert Saruman to assign an [isengard] minion to a companion (except the Ring-bearer). That companion may exert to prevent this.

name: Arwen, Elven Rider
subtitle: Elven Rider
lore: 'If I can cross the river, the power of my people will protect him.'
text: Ranger. Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, discard 3 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

name: Servants to Saruman
lore: 'This is grievous news concerning Saruman... for we trusted him and he is deep in all our counsels.'
text: Skirmish: Make an [isengard] Orc strength +2 (or +3 if you have fewer than 3 cards in hand).

name: Tower of Orthanc
lore: 'It was not made by Saruman, but by the men of Númenor long ago; and it is very tall and has many secrets; yet it looks not to be a work of craft.'
text: To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot an exhausted companion to add (3).

name: Trapped and Alone
lore: '...I had no chance of escape, and my days were bitter.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each character skirmishing an [isengard] Orc loses all damage bonuses from weapons.

name: The Trees Are Strong
lore: 'Their roots go deep.'
text: Regroup: Discard X [isengard] Orcs to make the Free Peoples player wound X companions.

name: Uruk Raider
lore: There is no safety where Saruman's emblem is shown.
text: Damage +1. While an ally is in the dead pile, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.

name: Uruk Ravager
lore: '...a ruined and terrible form of life.'
text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may spot Saruman to add (2).

name: Dangerous Gamble
lore: Almost they began to hope that they would escape.
text: Shadow: Spot a [moria] minion to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Add (X), where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

name: Depths of Moria
lore: ...a great fissure had opened. Out of it a fierce red light came, and now and again flames licked at the brink.... Wisps of dark smoke wavered in the hot air.
text: To play, spot a [moria] Orc. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, add (2).

name: Hide and Seek
lore: 'Which way shall we go?'
text: Search. Skirmish: Spot 2 [shire] companions to make a [moria] minion damage +1.

name: Malice
lore: Fueled by Sauron's hatred of living things, Orcs searched for the Ring of Power.
text: Archery: Spot a [moria] Orc and a [sauron] Orc to wound an archer.

name: Arwen, Lady Undómiel
subtitle: Lady Undómiel
lore: Queenly she looked, and thought and knowledge were in her glance, as of one who has known many things that the years bring.
text: While you can spot 3 [elven] allies whose home is site 3, each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -3.

name: Such a Little Thing
lore: 'Boromir... give the Ring to Frodo.'
text: Maneuver: Spot a [moria] minion to wound Boromir 3 times. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 Free Peoples possessions to prevent this.

name: Gates of the Dead City
lore: '...and they took Minas Ithil and abode in it, and they made it into a place of dread....'
text: To play, spot a Nazgûl. Plays to your support area. Each time a [wraith] card adds a burden, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.

name: News of Mordor
lore: 'Build me an army worthy of Mordor.'
text: Skirmish: Spot an [isengard] minion to make a Nazgûl damage +1.

name: The Ring Draws Them
lore: 'If I move I shall be seen and hunted!'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, add (1) for each burden you can spot. At the end of each of your Shadow phases, exert a Nazgûl or discard this condition.

name: They Will Never Stop Hunting You
lore: 'They're looking for Baggins, and if they mean well, then I'm a hobbit.'
text: Maneuver: Spot a Nazgûl to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. Exert a companion bearing a ranged weapon X times, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

name: Too Great and Terrible
lore: 'His eyes flashed and his face was lit as by a fire within. 'Do not tempt me! For I do not wish to become like the Dark Lord himself.'
text: Maneuver: Spot a Nazgûl to wound Gandalf twice. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 [gandalf] cards from hand to prevent this.

name: Úlairë Otsëa, Ringwraith in Twilight
subtitle: Ringwraith in Twilight
lore: '...at all times they smell the blood of living things, desiring and hating it.'
text: Twilight. Each time Úlairë Otsëa wins a skirmish, you may exert him to transfer Blade Tip from your support area to the Ring-bearer.

name: The Dark Lord Advances
lore: 'A power was there that we have not felt before.'
text: Regroup: Exert a [sauron] minion to reveal a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand. That player must discard X cards from hand, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

name: Get Off the Road!
lore: 'The Morgul-lord and his Black Riders have come forth. War is preparing!'
text: Search. Shadow: Spot a [sauron] minion and a Nazgûl to make the Free Peoples player discard a card from the top of his or her deck for each burden you can spot.

name: Gleaming in the Snow
lore: 'A Ring of Power looks after itself... It may slip off treacherously, but its keeper never abandons it.'
text: Regroup: Exert a [sauron] Orc and spot a [gondor] companion to add a burden.

name: Beren and Lúthien
lore: 'Tinúviel! Tinúviel! / He called her by her elvish name; / And there she halted listening.'
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert an [elven] ally to discard the bottom card of your draw deck. If that card is an [elven] card, make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1.

name: Hand of Sauron
lore: 'The power of the Ring could not be undone.'
text: Maneuver: Exert a [sauron] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from his or her hand.

name: His Cruelty and Malice
lore: 'Into this Ring he poured his cruelty, his malice, and his will to dominate all life.'
text: Plays to your support area. Regroup: Exert a [sauron] minion to make the Free Peoples player discard the top card from his or her draw deck.

name: Massing in the East
lore: 'The power of the Black Land grows....'
text: Regroup: Exert a [sauron] minion to discard a card from the top of the Free Peoples player's draw deck for each of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Dwarf, Elf, Man, and Wizard.

name: Morgul Slayer
lore: 'Sauron was diminished, but not destroyed. His Ring was lost but not unmade.'
text: Regroup: Exert this minion to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Orc Butcher
lore: 'And yet we see that Sauron can torture and destroy the very hills.'
text: For each [sauron] condition you can spot, this minion is strength +1.

name: Orc Guard
lore: The malice of the Dark Tower thins the hopes of Men.
text: Maneuver: Exert this minion and discard your [sauron] condition to discard a Free Peoples condition.

name: Orc Pillager
lore: Weapons of the West are often powerless against the threat of Sauron.
text: For each Free Peoples card borne by a character this minion is skirmishing, that character is strength -1.

name: Orc Slayer
lore: For it is a long tale, full of deeds great and terrible....
text: Regroup: Exert this minion to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Orc Swordsman
lore: 'Many evil things there are that your strong walls and bright swords do not stay.'
text: While this minion bears a weapon, he is strength +2.

name: Orc Trooper
lore: The Dark Lord's power grows in unseen ways.
text: For each card in your hand, this minion is strength +1.

name: The One Ring, The Binding Ring
subtitle: The Binding Ring
lore: One Ring to bring them all....
text: Fellowship: Add 2 burdens to play a ring from your draw deck. Maneuver: Exert bearer to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.

name: Sindri, Dwarven Lord
subtitle: Dwarven Lord
lore: Concerning the beginning of the Dwarves strange tales are told both by the Eldar and by the Dwarves themselves....
text: You may play [dwarven] skirmish events stacked on [dwarven] conditions as if from hand.

name: Úri, Dwarven Lord
subtitle: Dwarven Lord
lore: ...the Dwarves had the victory through their strength, and their matchless weapons, and the fire of their anger, as they hunted for Azog in every den under 'mountain.
text: Skirmish: If Úri is damage +X, exert him to make him strength +X.

name: Aiglos
lore: '...for the spear of Gil-galad... none could withstand.'
text: Bearer must be an Elf. If bearer is Gil-galad, he is strength +1 for each [elven] artifact you can spot (limit +6). Regroup: Discard Aiglos to wound a minion for each Elf you spot.

name: Elven Rope
lore: 'It freezes, it bites! Elves twisted it, curse them!'
text: To play, spot an Elf. Bearer must be an Elf or Hobbit. Maneuver: Discard this possession to make a Shadow player return a minion with strength 6 or less to its owner's hand.

name: Galadriel, Bearer of Wisdom
subtitle: Bearer of Wisdom
lore: '...I shall not be dark, but beautiful and terrible as the Morning and the Night!... Dreadful as the Storm and the Lightning!'
text: While Galadriel bears an artifact or The One Ring, she is resistance +1 for each [elven] companion you can spot.

name: Gil-galad, Elven High King
subtitle: Elven High King
lore: 'Gil-galad was an Elven-king. / Of him the harpers sadly sing: / the last whose realm was fair and free / between the Mountains and the Sea.'
text: To play, spot 2 [elven] companions. Regroup: Exert Gil-galad to wound each wounded minion.

name: Glorfindel, Revealed in Wrath
subtitle: Revealed in Wrath
text: When Glorfindel is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -2. Skirmish: Reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may exert Glorfindel to make a Nazgûl he is skirmishing strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the card revealed.

name: Knife of the Galadhrim
lore: It was overlaid with a tracery of flowers and leaves wrought of silver and gold....
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. If bearer is Aragorn, he may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Skirmish: Discard this weapon to wound a minion bearer is skirmishing.

name: Merry's Dagger
lore: 'They have already seen service in war.'
text: Bearer must be Merry. Skirmish: Exert Merry twice or discard this possession to wound a minion he is skirmishing. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.

name: Narya, Ring of Fire
subtitle: Ring of Fire
lore: ...the Third Ring, Narya the Great, and the stone upon it was red as fire.
text: Bearer must be Círdan or Gandalf. Fellowship: Remove X culture tokens, where X is equal to bearer's vitality. Discard this artifact.

name: Freca, Hungry Savage
subtitle: Hungry Savage
lore: 'We will die for Saruman.'
text: When you play Freca, you may spot another [dunland] Man to take control of a site. When Freca is killed, the Free Peoples player may liberate a site.

name: Nenya, Ring of Adamant
subtitle: Ring of Adamant
lore: ...Nenya, the ring wrought of mithril, that bore a single white stone flickering like a frosty star.
text: Bearer must be Galadriel. Maneuver: Heal 2 companions and place up to 2 cards from your hand on top of your draw deck. Discard this artifact.

name: Pippin's Dagger
lore: 'These are the daggers of the Noldorin.'
text: Bearer must be Pippin. Skirmish: Exert Pippin twice or discard this possession to wound a minion an Elf is skirmishing. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.

name: Strands of Elven Hair
text: To play, spot a Dwarf. When you play this possession, add 2 [elven] tokens here. Fellowship: Discard this possession or remove an [elven] token from here to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a [dwarven] or [elven] card, you may take it into hand.

name: Vilya, Ring of Air
subtitle: Ring of Air
lore: Gil-galad before he died gave his ring to Elrond....
text: Bearer must be Elrond or Gil-galad. Skirmish: Discard the top card of your draw deck. Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -X, where X is the twilight cost of the discarded card. Discard this artifact.

name: Ent Draught
lore: Indeed the hobbits felt that the hair on their heads was actually standing up, waving and curling and growing.
text: To play, spot an Ent. Bearer must be a companion. Limit 1 per bearer. Skirmish: Exert bearer to make him or her damage +1.

name: Huorn
lore: '...the Forest itself was moving behind us.'
text: Damage +1. This companion is strength +1 for each Ent you can spot. Response: If this companion is about to take a wound, exert an Ent to prevent that.

name: Radagast, The Brown
subtitle: The Brown
lore: '...a master of shapes and changes of hue; and he has much lore of herbs and beasts....'
text: The move limit is +1. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, each opponent may discard 2 cards from hand to draw 2 cards.

name: Sent Back
lore: 'The Sun shines through you.'
text: Skirmish: Discard this condition to discard each minion skirmishing a Wizard. Place that Wizard in your dead pile. Fellowship or Regroup: Play a Wizard (even if another copy of that Wizard is in your dead pile).

name: Gollum, Dark as Darkness
subtitle: Dark as Darkness
text: Shadow: Exert Gollum twice to exert the Ring-bearer. Shadow: Remove a burden to add (1). Skirmish: Remove a burden to add (2). Regroup: Remove a burden to add (3). Regroup: Exert Gollum twice to wound the Ring-bearer.

name: Slippery as Fishes
lore: 'I hoped the river-voyage would beat him, but he is too clever a waterman.'
text: While Gollum is at a mountain, river, or underground site, he is strength +2. Regroup: Spot Gollum to reveal your hand. Place all Shadow cards revealed beneath your draw deck. Discard this condition.

name: Durin III, Dwarven Lord
subtitle: Dwarven Lord
lore: Durin is the name that the Dwarves used for the eldest of the Seven Fathers of their race....
text: Damage +1. While you can spot 2 Dwarves, Durin III is twilight cost -2. Durin III is strength +1 for each artifact and each possession he bears.

name: Sméagol, Bearer of Great Secrets
subtitle: Bearer of Great Secrets
lore: '...he used it to find out secrets, and he put his knowledge to crooked and malicious uses.'
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each time the fellowship moves, place an unbound companion in the dead pile. Regroup: If Sméagol is the Ring-bearer, add 2 burdens to discard each minion.

name: Boromir, Bearer of Council
subtitle: Bearer of Council
lore: 'True-hearted Men, they will not be corrupted. We of Minas Tirith have been staunch....'
text: While Boromir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 3 burdens or wound him twice. Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, discard each minion he is skirmishing.

name: Elendil, The Tall
subtitle: The Tall
lore: ...and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....
text: To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men. Fellowship: Play an artifact on Elendil to make the move limit +1 for this turn. Regroup: Discard a [gondor] artifact to liberate a site.

name: Isildur, Bearer of Heirlooms
subtitle: Bearer of Heirlooms
lore: But for my part I will risk no hurt to this thing: of all the works of Sauron the only fair.
text: While Isildur is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or exert 3 companions. While Isildur bears The One Ring or an artifact, each [gondor] knight is strength +1.

name: Narsil, Blade of the Faithful
subtitle: Blade of the Faithful
lore: '...Isildur cut the Ring from his hand....'
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. If bearer is Elendil or Isildur, he is strength +1 for each [gondor] artifact you can spot (limit +6). Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, exert 2 [gondor] Men to prevent that.

name: Sapling of the White Tree
lore: Verily this is a sapling of the line of Nimloth the fair; and that was a seedling of Galathilion, and that a fruit of Telperion of many names, Eldest of 'Trees.'
text: To play, spot an unbound [gondor] Man. Response: If a [gondor] Man is about to take a wound, discard this artifact to prevent that.

name: Scroll of Isildur
lore: What evil it saith I do not know; but I trace here a copy of it, lest it fade beyond recall.
text: Tale. To play, spot a [gondor] Man. The Ring-bearer is resistance +1 for each [gondor] artifact you can spot (limit +3). Fellowship: Discard this artifact to play a ring from your discard pile.

name: Seeing Stone of Minas Anor
lore: 'Didst thou think that the eyes of the White Tower were blind?'
text: To play, spot a [gondor] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [gondor] Man and add 2 threats). Regroup: Exert a [gondor] Man or discard this artifact to discard your hand and draw 3 cards.

name: Seeing Stone of Orthanc
lore: 'I am the lawful master of the Stone, and I had both the right and the strength to use it, or so I judged.'
text: To play, spot a [gondor] Man with 3 or more vitality (or spot a [gondor] Man and add 2 threats). Regroup: Add a threat or discard this artifact to remove (2) or to draw a card.

name: Library of Orthanc
text: Shadow: Play an [isengard] minion to stack the top card of your draw deck on this card. Skirmish: Remove (1) and discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to make an [isengard] minion strength +1. Regroup: Remove (1) to take an [isengard] card stacked here into hand.

name: Gimli, Bearer of Grudges
subtitle: Bearer of Grudges
lore: 'Never trust an Elf.'
text: Damage +1. While Gimli is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or 2 threats. While Gimli is damage +X, he is resistance +X.

name: Sack of the Shire
lore: 'There's some devilry at work in the Shire....'
text: If an [isengard] minion wins a skirmish, until the regroup phase, make that minion strength +1 for each site you control and fierce.

name: Host of Moria, Legion of the Underdeeps
subtitle: Legion of the Underdeeps
lore: There was a horn-blast and a rush of feet, and orcs one after another leaped into the chamber.
text: When you play Host of Moria, you may play a [moria] card from your discard pile.

name: Ring of Asperity
lore: 'The Nine, the Seven, and the Three... had each their proper gem.'
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. When you play this artifact, you may wound an unwounded companion. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

name: Ring of Ire
lore: 'Nine he gave to Mortal Men, proud and great, and so ensnared them.'
text: Bearer must be The Witch-king. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a [wraith] minion damage +1. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

name: Ring of Rancor
lore: 'So it is now: the Nine he has gathered to himself....'
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. Maneuver: Remove a burden to heal each Nazgûl. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

name: Horn of the Mark
lore: 'He that blows it at need shall set fear in the hearts of his enemies and joy in the hearts of his friends....'
text: Bearer must be Merry or Pippin. Bearer gains the Théoden signet. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, exert him to discard each minion involved in that skirmish.

name: The Red Arrow
lore: 'The Red Arrow has not been seen in the Mark in all my years! Has it indeed come to that?'
text: Assignment: Exert a [gondor] Man to play a [rohan] Man. You may exert that [rohan] Man to play a possession on him or her. Discard this artifact.

name: Ithil Stone
lore: '...and in it there was a stone like the Moon....'
text: To play, exert a [wraith] or [sauron] minion. At the start of each of your Shadow phases, you may draw a card. Shadow: Discard this artifact to play a [sauron] minion. Its twilight cost is -3.

name: Sauron, The Lord of the Rings
subtitle: The Lord of the Rings
lore: One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne / In the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie.
text: Damage +2. Enduring. Fierce. For each burden you spot, threat you spot, and site you control, Sauron's twilight cost is -1.

name: Bilbo, Bearer of Things Burgled
subtitle: Bearer of Things Burgled
lore: 'But what has it got in its pocketses, eh?'
text: Ring-bound. Each time the fellowship moves, if the twilight pool has 2 or fewer twilight tokens, add 2 burdens or add (3). Regroup: Add a burden to play a [shire] tale.

name: Linnar, Dwarven Lord
subtitle: Dwarven Lord
lore: ...they were joined by great forces sent from the Houses of the other Fathers....
text: Each time a Dwarf wins a fierce skirmish, you may heal that Dwarf. Skirmish: Discard a [dwarven] card from hand to make a Dwarf damage +1.

name: Everyone Knows
lore: '...I'm the tall one, you're the short one.'
text: Tale. Each unbound Hobbit is strength +1 for each vitality over 3 he or she has. Skirmish: Prevent an unbound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. Discard this condition.

name: Goldberry, River-daughter
subtitle: River-daughter
lore: 'Slender as the willow-wand, clearer than the water.'
text: Each time the fellowship moves to a river, heal Goldberry and Tom Bombadil. Skirmish: If the fellowship is at a river, exert Goldberry to make a companion strength +1.

name: Tom Bombadil, The Master
subtitle: The Master
lore: 'Hey! Come derry dol! Can you hear me singing?'
text: To play, remove 2 burdens or 2 threats. Skirmish: Spot 2 [shire] companions and exert Tom Bombadil X times, where X is the fellowship's site number, to cancel a skirmish involving a [shire] companion.

name: Ring of Accretion
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer is damage +1. Maneuver: For each Dwarf you spot, reveal a card from the top of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the rest. Discard this artifact.

name: Ring of Fury
lore: 'Azog! If you are in come out! Or is the play in the valley too rough?'
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer is damage +2. Regroup: Spot a Dwarf that is damage +X to heal X Dwarves. Discard this artifact.

name: Ring of Guile
lore: But, as Thrór had said, the Ring needed gold to breed gold....
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer is damage +1. Maneuver: Take a [dwarven] event into hand from your discard pile. Discard this artifact.

name: Ring of Retribution
lore: 'We fought this war for vengeance, and vengeance we have taken. But it is not sweet.'
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Response: If bearer wins a skirmish, discard this artifact to exert each Orc.

name: Armor of Khazâd
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time bearer is about to take a wound, you may add a threat to prevent that. Regroup: Discard this possession to take up to 2 other [dwarven] possessions into hand from your discard pile.

name: Namárië
lore: We shall not meet again, Elessar.
text: When you play this, add an [elven] token here for each hunter you can spot. Maneuver: Discard this or remove a token from here and spot an [elven] hunter to discard a condition.

name: Into the Caves
lore: Saruman's arm will have grown long indeed if he thinks he can reach us here.
text: To play, spot 3 [rohan] companions. Assignment: Assign a minion to Frodo to make that minion lose all game text keywords of your choice and unable to gain game text keywords until the regroup phase.

name: Soldier of Rohan
lore: For ages, the people of Rohan have been allied to Gondor.
text: While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, this companion is strength +2.

name: Théoden, Northman, King of Rohan
subtitle: Northman, King of Rohan
lore: When last I looked, Théoden, was King of Rohan.
text: While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each [rohan] companion is strength +1. Regroup: Spot 2 [rohan] followers and exert Théoden to liberate a site.

name: Where Now The Horse
lore: 'They have passed like rain in the mountains, like the wind in the meadow.'
text: Spot a [rohan] companion to make Frodo strength +5. If Frodo loses the skirmish, discard that [rohan] companion.

name: Warrior of Rohan
lore: Rohirrim territories are not easily taken.
text: Possessions cannot be transferred from this companion to another character. Fellowship: Play a possession on this companion to liberate a site.

name: Throne of the Dark Lord
lore: One for the Dark Lord on his dark throne.
text: To play, spot 2 minions. While you can spot Sauron, each other minion is damage +1. While the fellowship is in the same region as Mount Doom, each companion is resistance -2.

name: Halfling Leaf
lore: 'It feels good, and it smells good.'
text: Pipeweed. To play, spot a Hobbit. Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to cancel a skirmish involving an unbound Hobbit.

name: Merry, In the Bloom of Health
subtitle: In the Bloom of Health
lore: 'I think we may have made a mistake leaving the Shire, Pippin.'
text: Add 1 to the number of Ents you can spot. Regroup: Exert Merry to place a pipeweed from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.

name: Hornblower Leaf
lore: 'These are the Hornblower brandmarks....'
text: Pipeweed. To play, spot an unbound Hobbit. Regroup: Discard a pipeweed from play to remove a threat. Regroup: Discard a pipeweed from play to discard a minion.

name: Pippin, In the Bloom of Health
subtitle: In the Bloom of Health
lore: Ents are – well Ents are all different for one thing.
text: Add 1 to the number of Ents you can spot. Maneuver: Discard 2 pipeweed cards from play to remove a burden.

name: Orophin, Silvan Elf
subtitle: Silvan Elf
lore: Guardian of the Golden Wood.
text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) While Orophin is skirmishing a wounded minion, he is strength +3. Archery: Exert another [elven] hunter and add a threat to wound a minion.

name: Southfarthing Leaf
text: Pipeweed. To play, spot an unbound Hobbit. Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2. Regroup: Discard this pipeweed from play to play a pipeweed from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck.

name: Southlinch Leaf
lore: 'How it came here, I can't imagine. For Saruman's private use, I fancy.'
text: Pipeweed. To play, spot a Hobbit. Skirmish: Discard a pipeweed from play to prevent an unbound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless that Hobbit's strength is tripled.

name: Blade of the White Hand
lore: The servants of the White Hand laid waste to the pride of Gondor.
text: Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai. While you can spot 2 controlled sites, this minion is damage +1. While you can spot 4 controlled sites, this minion is damage +3.

name: Deathly Roar
lore: The Uruk-hai assault on Helm's Deep was relentless.
text: Each time the Free Peoples player plays a possession or artifact, place an [uruk-hai] token here. Each time an [uruk-hai] minion wins a skirmish, you may remove an [uruk-hai] token to exert a companion.

name: Land Had Changed
lore: 'The Deeping Wall is taken, lord, and all the defense swept away....'
text: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2 (or spot a site you control to make that Uruk- hai strength +3 instead). You may then liberate a site to make that Uruk-hai strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Saruman, Curunír
subtitle: Curunír
lore: 'He has claimed lordship over all this land....'
text: Each time an [uruk-hai] hunter wins a skirmish, heal a different [uruk-hai] minion. Skirmish: Exert Saruman twice to make a companion lose the hunter keyword until the start of the regroup phase.

name: Saruman, Master of the White Hand
subtitle: Master of the White Hand
lore: A new power is rising. Its victory is at hand.
text: Each companion is resistance -1. Skirmish: Exert Saruman to discard a condition borne by a companion skirmishing an [uruk-hai] minion.

name: Spear of the White Hand
lore: We will drive the machine of war with the sword and the spear....
text: Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai.

name: Vile Pit
lore: Saruman gazed on his creations with great pride.
text: To play, spot an [uruk-hai] hunter. At the start of each Shadow phase, you may discard 2 [uruk-hai] cards from hand to play an [uruk-hai] hunter from your discard pile. Regroup: Discard this possession to return an [uruk-hai] hunter from play to your hand.

name: White Hand Aggressor
lore: It's Saruman's army! The war has started.
text: Damage +1. While you control a site, this minion cannot take wounds, except during the skirmish phase.

name: Rúmil, Silvan Elf
subtitle: Silvan Elf
lore: Guardian of Nimrodel.
text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) While you can spot a wounded minion, Rúmil is strength +1 and gains archer. Archery: Exert another [elven] hunter and add a threat to wound a minion.

name: White Hand Attacker
lore: You will taste Man-flesh.
text: Damage +1. While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each site on the adventure path gains each terrain keyword from each site you control.

name: White Hand Berserker
lore: ...there was a crash and a flash of flame and smoke.
text: Damage +1. At the start of the archery phase, if you control a site, you may add 2 to the minion archery total for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.

name: White Hand Butcher
lore: 'Bring out your skulking king!'
text: Hunter 6. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +6.)

name: White Hand Captain
lore: They wore black armor and mail that was marked with the white hand of Saruman.
text: Fierce. While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each hunter character is strength +1.

name: White Hand Destroyer
lore: 'This is no parley. You have nothing to say.'
text: Fierce. This minion gains hunter 3 for each site you control.

name: White Hand Enforcer
lore: The Uruks were tireless in the pursuit of their prey.
text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may liberate a site to add (X), where X is the Shadow number of the liberated site.

name: White Hand Guard
lore: Under the banner of the white hand, they came in great numbers.
text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Skirmish: Exert this minion to make an [uruk-hai] hunter minion strength +2.

name: White Hand Intruder
lore: March to Helm's Deep!
text: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if you do not control a site, you may take control of a site.

name: White Hand Invader
lore: There will be no dawn for men.
text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, exert a companion for each site you control.

name: White Hand Legion
lore: The Orcs yelled and jeered.
text: Damage +1. To play, remove 2 threats.

name: The World Ahead
text: To play, spot an Elf. Each time the fellowship moves to a region one site, add a threat. Each time the fellowship moves to a region two site, heal an Elf. Each time the fellowship moves to a region three site, draw a card.

name: White Hand Scout
lore: 'You've got no guts outside your own sties.'
text: Damage +1. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) The roaming penalty for each [uruk-hai] minion you play is -1.

name: White Hand Slayer
lore: '...and there has been war between us for many months.'
text: Fierce. Each time a player plays an event in a skirmish involving this minion, that player may exert a non-hunter character.

name: White Hand Taskmaster
lore: White Hand warriors fell to evil deeds with a passion.
text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) When you play this minion, you may spot another [uruk-hai] minion to add a threat for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.

name: White Hand Trooper
lore: ...the West is no longer safe.
text: Fierce. While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each hunter companion loses its special abilities and skirmish events can not be played in those companions skirmishes.

name: White Hand Vanquisher
lore: 'They have a blasting fire, and with it they took the Wall.'
text: Fierce. This minion is damage +1 for each [uruk-hai] hunter assigned to a skirmish.

name: White Hand Veteran
lore: To War!
text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, if you control a site, you may take an [uruk-hai] event into hand from your discard pile.

name: White Hand Warrior
lore: Leave none alive!
text: Fierce. Hunter 4. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +4.) Each time this minion is assigned to a non-hunter companion, you may heal a hunter.

name: You Do Not Know Fear
lore: Endangering and entangling all those that stood before them, the Uruk-hai shrunk before none.
text: Discard a condition for each [uruk-hai] minion you can spot.

name: You Do Not Know Pain
lore: If the wall is breached, Helm's Deep will fall.
text: Each time you take control of a site, you may spot 3 [uruk-hai] minions to exert an unbound companion. Skirmish: Liberate a site to make an [uruk-hai] minion damage +1.

name: Úlairë Cantëa, Duplicitous Assassin
subtitle: Duplicitous Assassin
lore: Drawn to the power of the one. They will never stop hunting you.
text: Fierce. Each unbound companion is resistance -1 for each card he or she bears. Skirmish: Exert Úlairë Cantëa to exert a companion with resistance 2 or less.

name: Weapons of Lothlórien
lore: Leithio i philinn!
text: Spot an [elven] archer and add a threat to wound a minion (or add three threats to exert three minions).

name: Úlairë Enquëa, Duplicitous Lieutenant
subtitle: Duplicitous Lieutenant
lore: At all times they feel the presence of the ring.
text: Fierce. Each time the Free Peoples player heals a companion, you may add a burden. Maneuver: Exert Úlairë Enquëa twice to discard a condition (or two conditions if you can spot 5 Free Peoples player's conditions).

name: Úlairë Otsëa, Duplicitous Specter
subtitle: Duplicitous Specter
lore: Blinded by their greed, they took them without question.
text: Fierce. When you play Úlairë Otsëa, you may spot another Nazgûl to draw a card for each wounded companion you can spot. Regroup: Exert Úlairë Otsëa and discard a [wraith] card from hand to add a burden.

name: Ring of Savagery
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must either add a burden or exert a companion. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

name: Ring of Terror
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. Bearer is damage +1. When you play this artifact, you may remove two threats to take a [wraith] card into hand from your discard pile. Response: If a player reconciles, return bearer to his owner's hand.

name: The Witch-king, Conqueror of Arthedain
subtitle: Conqueror of Arthedain
text: Fierce. Each time the Witch-king wins a fierce skirmish, you may exert a companion for each companion you can spot over 4.

name: Dol Guldur
text: Regroup: Exert your minion and remove a threat to make the Free Peoples player discard one of his or her conditions.

name: Falls of Rauros
text: River. When the Fellowship moves to this site in region 2, the Free Peoples player places a card from the dead pile out of play.

name: Imladris
text: River. When the fellowship moves to this site, if it is a sanctuary, remove 2 burdens.

name: Nurn
text: Plains. While you control this site, each of your hunter minions is strength +1.

name: A New Light
lore: 'I once knew every spell in all the tongues of Elves or Men or Orcs....'
text: Spell. Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to search a Shadow player's discard pile and choose a minion, then return that minion to its owner's hand. If you do, you may reveal that Shadow player's hand and discard a minion found there.

name: Barliman Butterbur, Red-faced Landlord
subtitle: Red-faced Landlord
lore: 'Barliman Butterbur at your service!'
text: Barliman Butterbur is strength +1 for each attached [gandalf] follower. Maneuver: Exert Barliman Butterbur to reveal the top 2 cards of your deck. Take any [gandalf] cards into hand and discard the rest.

name: Gandalf, Returned
subtitle: Returned
text: When you play Gandalf (except in your starting fellowship), you may play a [gandalf] possession on him from your draw deck or discard pile. Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may reinforce a Free Peoples token.

name: Glamdring, Orc Beater
subtitle: Orc Beater
lore: ...in his other hand Glamdring gleamed, cold and white.
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Bearer is damage +1. Each time a companion is about to take a wound, you may discard a companion from hand to prevent that.

name: Guidance of the Istari
lore: Hold them back. Do not give in to fear! Stand your posts! Fight!
text: Make a [gandalf] companion strength +1 for each [gandalf] Man you can spot.

name: Balin Avenged
text: When you play this condition, you may add a [dwarven] token here. While you can spot 4 [dwarven] tokens and 2 Dwarves, each [orc] Orc gains this text "To play, remove an [orc] card from your discard pile from the game." Skirmish: Discard this condition to exert a minion for each Dwarf you can spot.

name: Gwaihir, The Windlord
subtitle: The Windlord
lore: '...swiftest of the Great Eagles....'
text: Aid – Add a threat. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a threat to transfer this to a companion.) If bearer is a [gandalf] Wizard, each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a minion (if that minion is a Wizard, wound it instead).

name: Long-stemmed Pipe
lore: The smoke from his pipe drifted up, obscuring his face.
text: Pipeweed. When you play this, you may search your deck for a [gandalf] card and place it in your discard pile. Regroup: Discard another pipeweed from play to discard a condition. Discard this condition.

name: Meneldor, Misty Mountain Eagle
subtitle: Misty Mountain Eagle
lore: To many he was known as the Swift.
text: Aid – (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a [gandalf] follower. Bearer is strength +1 for each other [gandalf] follower you can spot.

name: Scintillating Bird
text: Spell. Fellowship: Exert your Wizard and choose an opponent to name either Free Peoples or Shadow. Reveal the top three cards of your deck. If you revealed at least two of the chosen card type, take those cards into hand, otherwise, discard those cards.

name: Shadowfax, Greatest of the Mearas
subtitle: Greatest of the Mearas
lore: There are no horses like those that are bred in that great vale between the Misty Mountains and the White.
text: Bearer must be a [gandalf] Wizard. Discard all other possessions on bearer and bearer may not bear a hand weapon. Fellowship: Add a threat to remove a burden.

name: The Sap is in the Bough
lore: 'Together we will take the road that leads into the west / and far away, we'll find a land where both our hearts may rest.'
text: Discard a companion from hand to make a [gandalf] companion strength +3 (or +4 if you can spot 3 Ents).

name: Woodland Onod
lore: 'Ent the earthborn, old as mountains....'
text: Skirmish: Discard a companion from hand to make an Ent strength +2.

name: Andúril, Sword That Was Broken
subtitle: Sword That Was Broken
lore: It has been Remade.
text: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is damage +1. Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, you may exert him to liberate a site or discard a condition borne by a companion.

name: Faramir, Bearer of Quality
subtitle: Bearer of Quality
text: While Faramir is the Ring-bearer, at the start of each skirmish involving him, add 2 burdens or 2 threats. Skirmish: While Faramir is the Ring- bearer, you may wound Faramir to make a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man roaming until the end of turn.

name: Faramir's Bow, Ithilien Longbow
subtitle: Ithilien Longbow
lore: ...great bows. Almost their own height....
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] ranger. If bearer is Faramir, he is an archer. The site number of each minion skirmishing a [gondor] ranger is +1. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to exhaust a minion Faramir is skirmishing.

name: Dwarven Stratagem
lore: Always well armed, a Dwarf has many options in battle.
text: Spot a Dwarf hunter and choose one: exert a minion for each hunter you can spot or reinforce a [dwarven] token for each hunter you can spot.

name: Madril, Loyal Lieutenant
subtitle: Loyal Lieutenant
text: Ranger. Hunter 1. While you can spot a roaming minion, your [gondor] conditions cannot be discarded from play by Shadow cards. Maneuver: Exert 2 rangers to make a minion's site number +2 until the regroup phase.

name: Narsil, Forged by Telchar
subtitle: Forged by Telchar
lore: ...and the sword of Elendil filled Orcs and Men with fear....
text: Bearer must be Elendil or Isildur. Bearer is damage +1. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a Shadow possession.

name: Nimble Attack
lore: 'We shall be pursued as soon as news of our deed reaches the Enemy....'
text: Spot 2 [gondor] companions and add a threat to discard a Shadow possession.

name: Ranger of the White Tree
text: Ranger. Hunter 1. When this is in your starting fellowship and you can spot an unbound [gondor] companion with cost 3 or more, his twilight cost is -2. Maneuver: Exert this companion and spot a roaming minion to make him defender +1 until the start of the regroup phase.

name: Spirit of the White Tree
lore: A blossom of hope.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. An opponent can not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving bearer. Each time a Shadow player adds a burden, discard this condition.

name: Soldier's Cache
text: Fortification. At the start of your maneuver phase, you may spot 3 rangers or exert a [gondor] Man to transfer this condition to a minion. Wound that minion. Regroup: Exert a ranger to reinforce a [gondor] token.

name: Throne of Minas Tirith
text: To play, spot Denethor (or 2 [gondor] companions). Each time a minion is killed or discarded from play during a skirmish, you may reinforce a [gondor] token. Skirmish: Remove 3 [gondor] tokens to discard a possession.

name: Saruman, Instigator of Insurrection
subtitle: Instigator of Insurrection
text: Saruman cannot be assigned to a skirmish. While you can spot 6 companions, each minion gains hunter 2. Response: If a hunter minion is about to take a wound, exert Saruman to prevent that.

name: Saruman, Servant of Sauron
subtitle: Servant of Sauron
lore: 'I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly, but you have elected the way of pain.'
text: Aid – (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may remove (1) to transfer this to a minion.) Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a companion.

name: Throne of Isengard
lore: From the heights of Orthanc, Saruman spied on Middle-earth and plotted his rise to power.
text: Each time you play Saruman, spot a minion. That minion is fierce until the start of the regroup phase. Each Wizard is strength +3 and damage +1.

name: Ring of Artifice
lore: 'Beyond the shadow it waits for you still....'
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer is damage +1. Bearer is strength +1 for each [dwarven] artifact in your discard pile. Regroup: Discard this to take a non-event [dwarven] card into hand from your discard pile.

name: Beast of War
lore: ...mûmakil were bellowing as they were goaded to war.
text: Bearer must be a [men] Man. While you can spot a threat, bearer is fierce. While you can spot 3 threats, bearer is damage +1. While you can spot 5 threats, you may play this from your discard pile.

name: Ceremonial Armor
lore: Scarlet cloaks and bronze armor adorned the marching forces.
text: Each time a [men] minion is discarded during the maneuver phase, you may stack it here. Response: Discard a minion stacked here or discard this to prevent a wound to a [men] minion.

name: Easterling Dispatcher
lore: The men of Rhûn's preparation for battle was second to none.
text: When you play this minion, you may spot 2 other [men] Men to add (1) for each possession you spot.

name: Easterling Sneak
lore: The dark is gathering all armies to him.
text: While you control 2 sites, Easterling Sneak is fierce. While you control 4 sites, each [men] minion is strength +1 and fierce.

name: Gríma's Dagger
lore: The blade of a pathetic creature.
text: Bearer must be a [men] Man. If bearer is Gríma, he is strength +1 for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2. Response: If a skirmish event is played, discard this possession to cancel that event.

name: In the Wild Men's Wake
lore: Too long have these peasants stood against you.
text: Spot a [men] possession in your support area and a [men] minion. Make that minion strength +1 for each minion stacked on that possession. You may discard that possession to make that minion damage +1.

name: Pandemonium
lore: Few could escape the oncoming pillage of the Dunlending's savage stampede.
text: Play a [men] minion stacked on a [men] possession as if from hand.

name: Primitive Brand
lore: The men of Dunland took even the most basic of tools to be weapons against Rohan.
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may transfer this possession to another [men] minion. If you do, stack a [men] minion from play on a [men] possession in your support area.

name: Saruman, Coldly Still
subtitle: Coldly Still
lore: Take back the lands they stole from you!
text: Each [men] minion bearing a possession is strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Saruman to play a [men] possession from your discard pile.

name: Stampeding Chief
lore: But no more would Rohan stand against his kind.
text: Damage +1. Fierce. If you play Stampeding Chief from your hand, remove (3) and spot another [men] minion or discard Stampeding Chief.

name: Axe-work
lore: Brave in battle, Dwarven pride and will cannot be broken.
text: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or if you cannot spot a threat, make that Dwarf strength +1 for each Dwarf you can spot).

name: Stampeding Hillsman
lore: Argh!!
text: Regroup: Spot a [men] minion in your discard pile and discard this minion to place that minion on your [men] support area possession.

name: Stampeding Madman
lore: Death to the robbers of the North!
text: To play, spot 2 [men] Men. When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each site you control.

name: Stampeding Ransacker
lore: Death to the Forgoil!
text: To play, spot 2 [men] Men. Each time this minion wins a skirmish and you can spot a site you control, exhaust an unbound companion.

name: Stampeding Savage
lore: We will fight for you!
text: Maneuver: Discard this minion and X minions stacked on a [men] possession to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is twilight cost -X.

name: Stampeding Shepherd
lore: We will die... for Saruman!
text: Fierce. Maneuver: Discard this minion and a [men] minion with a twilight cost 2 or less from play to play Stampeding Chief from your draw deck. It is twilight cost -8.

name: Sunland Guard
lore: They prepare for the last war.
text: Maneuver: Exert this minion to play a [men] minion (or 2 if you spot 6 companions) from a [men] possession as if from hand.

name: Sunland Scout
lore: The Southrons did not march into war blindly.
text: This minion is strength +1 for each [men] possession with a [men] minion stacked on it. Maneuver: Spot a [men] possession and discard this minion from play to discard a condition.

name: Sunland Skirmisher
lore: Vile servants of Sauron marched to their master.
text: This minion is strength +1 for each [men] minion stacked on each [men] possession. At the start of your maneuver phase, you may play a minion stacked on a [men] possession as if from hand.

name: Sunland Sneak
lore: Southron men were always ready for war.
text: This minion is twilight cost -1 for each [men] minion stacked on a [men] possession.

name: Sunland Trooper
lore: ...legions of Haradrim from the South....
text: This minion is strength +2 for each [men] possession with a [men] minion stacked on it. Maneuver: Spot X [men] minions stacked on a [men] possession and discard this minion to add (X).

name: Thorin III, Stonehelm
subtitle: Stonehelm
lore: Veteran warrior and keen leader, Stonehelm drove the enemy from the land of Dale.
text: Damage +1. Each time a minion loses a skirmish involving Thorin III, its owner discards the top card from his or her draw deck.

name: Sunland Warrior
lore: They were wicked men.
text: Maneuver: Spot a [men] possession and discard this minion from play to make each [men] minion you spot strength +2 until the start of the regroup phase.

name: Sunland Weaponmaster
lore: War will make corpses of us all.
text: To play, spot 2 [men] Men. While this minion bears a possession, he is strength +2 for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.

name: Vengeful Savage
lore: We will take their king.
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may stack a [men] minion from your discard pile on a [men] possession in your support area.

name: Vengeful Wild Man
lore: The pawns of Saruman are relentless in their tasks.
text: At the start of the maneuver phase, spot another [men] Man and exert this minion to add a threat. Then add an additional threat for each companion you spot over 4.

name: Vengeful Pillager
lore: Murderers!
text: When you play this minion from your draw deck or from your [men] possession, it is fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Vengeful Primitive
lore: Incited by Saruman, they created pandemonium in the land of Rohan.
text: You may play this minion any time you could play a maneuver event. When you play this minion in the maneuver phase, you may discard X [men] minions from play to add (X).

name: Wildman's Oath
lore: Take back the lands they stole from you!
text: Each time a [men] minion is discarded during the maneuver phase, you may stack it here. Skirmish: Discard this possession to make a [men] Man strength +2.

name: A Defiled Charge
lore: The wolf snarled and sprang towards them with a great leap.
text: To play, exert your mounted [orc] Orc. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns a mounted [orc] Orc to a companion, he or she must choose to either exert that companion or add (2).

name: Chaotic Clash
lore: An Orc often was spurred into battle as if death was preferable to the torment of its orkish life.
text: To play, spot no minions. Each time you play a minion, it is twilight cost +1. While you can spot an [orc] minion, each companion is strength -1.

name: Cry and Panic
lore: Wargs! We are under attack!
text: Each time a mounted [orc] Orc wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must reveal his or her hand and place two Free Peoples cards revealed on the bottom of his or her draw deck.

name: Elven Guardian
lore: We are proud to fight alongside men, once more.
text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) While this companion is skirmishing a wounded minion, he is strength +2. Maneuver: Exert this companion to heal another hunter.

name: Feral Ride
lore: It was hard at times to tell who was truly the master, the warg or the Orc.
text: Make an [orc] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is mounted).

name: Grishnákh, Treacherous Captain
subtitle: Treacherous Captain
text: Hunter 2. While you can spot an [uruk-hai] minion, each [orc] Orc gains hunter 1 (if that [uruk-hai] minion is Uglúk, each [orc] Orc gains an additional hunter 1). Shadow: Exert Grishnákh twice to play an [uruk-hai] hunter minion from your draw deck.

name: Orkish Assassin
lore: Vile villain of all that opposed his master.
text: While you can spot a follower attached to a companion, each [orc] minion is strength +2.

name: Orkish Berserker
lore: These Orcs were fearsome warriors.
text: When this minion wins a skirmish, discard an [orc] minion from play.

name: Orkish Cavalry
lore: With speed and numbers, these feared riders were not easily avoided.
text: Each time you play an [orc] mount, you may draw a card. Assignment: If this minion is mounted, exert it twice to assign it to a companion of strength 9 or more.

name: Orkish Dreg
lore: Under the cover of darkness the Orcs came.
text: Each time you play this minion, you may spot another [orc] minion to exert a companion for each Free Peoples culture you can spot over 2.

name: Orkish Fiend
lore: Dwellers of foul pits and tunnels.
text: To play, spot an [orc] Orc. While at an underground site, this minion is fierce and the Free Peoples player may not replace sites or play a site from his or her adventure deck.

name: Orkish Flanker
lore: Quick to contain their fleeing victims, the Orkish riders were always feared.
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if it is mounted, exert a companion. Shadow: Exert 3 [orc] minions and spot an [orc] mount to discard a condition.

name: Orkish Footman
lore: They feared their master more than any enemy.
text: This minion is strength +1 for each twilight token you can spot.

name: Orkish Invader
lore: Spawned from terrible acts, the Orcs emerged as ruined and terrible forms of life.
text: At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may reveal an [orc] condition from hand to wound the companion this minion is skirmishing twice and then discard this minion.

name: Hearth and Hall
lore: Until at last our toil be past / our journey done, our errand sped.
text: Spot an [elven] hunter and choose one: draw a card for each hunter you can spot or reinforce an [elven] token for each hunter you can spot.

name: Orkish Lackey
lore: They came from dark and evil places.
text: Maneuver: Spot 2 [orc] conditions and discard this minion from play to wound an unbound companion.

name: Orkish Maurader
lore: As the Orcs silently approached, the fear they brought multiplied.
text: This minion is strength +1 for each [orc] condition in your discard pile.

name: Orkish Rider
lore: They formed the cavalry of the Orc legions.
text: Each mounted [orc] Orc is strength +1. Shadow: Discard an [orc] card from your hand to play an [orc] mount from your discard pile.

name: Orkish Runner
lore: Orcs were kept in check by the light of the sun.
text: Shadow: Exert this minion and spot another [orc] minion to add (X), where X is the number of the current region.

name: Orkish Scout
lore: Bred in dark sorcery.
text: Shadow: Exert this minion to add (X), where X is the current site's Shadow number.

name: Orkish Traveler
lore: There is not much that is fouler than Orcs.
text: Each [orc] mount is twilight cost -1. Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a mounted [orc] Orc strength +2.

name: Orkish Veteran
lore: Skin as dark as wood that has been charred by flame.
text: Each time you play an [orc] mount, you may reinforce an [orc] token. Regroup: Exert Orkish Veteran to make the Free Peoples player wound a companion.

name: Orkish Warg-master
lore: Argh!!
text: Each time a mounted [orc] minion wins a skirmish, you may make the Free Peoples player place a card from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck. Shadow: Exert Orkish Warg-master to play an [orc] mount from your discard pile.

name: Orkish Warrior
lore: These Orcs were loathsome as Elves were fair.
text: While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +4. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, discard this minion.

name: Relentless Warg
lore: The wolves of Isengard will return.
text: Bearer must be an [orc] Orc with strength 10 or less. Bearer is fierce. When you play this possession, spot a race. While bearer is skirmishing a companion of that race, bearer is strength +3 and damage +1.

name: Lothlórien Guides
lore: The road is very dangerous.
text: Spot 2 Elves (or an Elf and an [elven] follower) to discard a condition (or discard two conditions if you can spot 4 or more Shadow conditions).

name: Rider's Gear
lore: Foul of smell but light to bear, a warg would often allow its rider little leeway.
text: Bearer must be an [orc] Orc. While bearer is mounted, it cannot take wounds except during the skirmish phase.

name: Threatening Warg
lore: 'The wolf that one hears is worse than the orc that one fears.'
text: Bearer must be an [orc] Orc with strength 10 or less. Bearer is fierce. When you play this, you may spot 2 [orc] Orcs that are not bearing mounts to play an [orc] mount from your draw deck.

name: Vicious Warg
lore: '...where the warg howls, there also the orc prowls.'
text: Bearer must be an [orc] Orc with strength 9 or less. Bearer is fierce.

name: Aragorn, Defender of Rohan
subtitle: Defender of Rohan
lore: 'No enemy has yet taken the Hornburg. Depart, or not one of you will be spared.'
text: Valiant. While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each [rohan] companion gains hunter 1.

name: Dispatched With Haste
lore: Assemble the army at Dunharrow, as many men as can be found.
text: While at a plains site, each mounted companion is strength +1. Regroup: Spot 2 [rohan] Men and discard a [rohan] possession to discard a possession.

name: Éomer, Northman
subtitle: Northman
lore: We cannot achieve victory through strength of arms.
text: Damage +1. While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, Éomer is strength +3. Maneuver: If Éomer is mounted, exert him to make him defender +1 until the end of turn.

name: Éowyn, Northwoman
subtitle: Northwoman
text: While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, Éowyn cannot take wounds while skirmishing. Assignment: Exert Éowyn and assign a minion to the Ring-bearer to make that minion lose all game text keywords and unable to gain game text keywords until the regroup phase.

name: For Death and Glory
text: While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each minion skirmishing a [rohan] companion loses hunter and is unable to gain hunter. Skirmish: Exert a [rohan] companion to make that companion gain hunter 1 until the start of the regroup phase.

name: Throne of the Golden Hall
text: To play, spot Théoden (or 2 [rohan] companions). Saruman and Gríma cannot be assigned to skirmishes. Response: If a [rohan] Man is about to take a wound, exert another [rohan] Man and add (2) to prevent that.

name: Háma, Northman
subtitle: Northman
lore: Hail, Théoden King!
text: While the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish, each minion skirmishing Háma loses strength bonuses and damage bonuses from possessions.

name: Galadriel, Lady Redeemed
subtitle: Lady Redeemed
lore: 'I pass the test,' she said. 'I will diminish, and go into the West, and remain Galadriel.'
text: Fellowship or Regroup: Discard an [elven] event from hand to hinder a Shadow condition or possession.

name: Glimpse of Fate
lore: 'The uttermost choice is before you: to repent and go to the Havens... or else to abide the Doom of Men.'
text: To play, spot 2 Elves.  When you lose initiative, you may make a minion strength –3 until the regroup phase (limit once per turn).

name: Out of the High Airs
lore: ...the Nazgûl turned and fled, and vanished into Mordor's shadows....
text: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert your Wizard X times to hinder X minions.

name: Memories of Darkness
lore: 'Had I known what was before me, I think that not for any friendship would I have taken the Paths of the Dead.'
text: To play, spot a Dwarf. Each time you lose initiative (except during the fellowship phase), you may play a [Dwarven] condition or [Dwarven] possession from hand.

name: Denethor, Lord of Minas Tirith
subtitle: Lord of Minas Tirith
lore: There Denethor sat in a grey gloom, like an old patient spider....
text: To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men. Fellowship: If at a sanctuary, exert Denethor to take a [gondor] item or condition into hand from your draw deck. Choose an opponent who may draw a card.

name: Under Foot
lore: 'I make the earth shake, / As I tramp through the grass; / Trees crack as I pass.'
