text: Shadow: If you have initiative, spot a [raider] Man to reconcile your hand (limit once per phase). At the start of the regroup phase, discard this condition. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [raider] Man strength +2.

name: Ulaire Enquea, Thrall of The One
subtitle: Thrall of The One
lore: Ever they circled above the City, like vultures that expect their fill of doomed men's flesh.
text: Enduring. Shadow cards cannot exert Ulaire Enquea during a skirmish phase. Skirmish: If Ulaire Enquea is skirmishing, remove (1) and heal him to add a burden.

name: Eowyn, Lady of Ithilien
subtitle: Lady of Ithilien
lore: 'Yet now that I have leave to depart, I would remain. For this House has become to me of all dwellings the most blessed.'
text: Skirmish: Exert Eowyn to make an opponent wound or hinder a minion for each wound on each minion skirmishing Eowyn.

name: Cirdan, The Shipwright
subtitle: The Shipwright
lore: ...he was grey and old, save that his eyes were keen as stars....
text: To play, spot 2 Elves. Skirmish: Exert Cirdan to make a minion he is skirmishing strength -1 for each [elven] event in your discard pile. If that minion is overwhelmed, remove half of the [elven] events in your discard pile from the game (rounded down).

name: Mordor Fiend
lore: The onslaught of Mordor broke like a wave on the beleaguered hills....
text: When you play this minion, if you cannot spot another minion and there are 3 or fewer twilight tokens, you may add (3) (or (5) if this minion is roaming).

name: Strange-looking Men
lore: The strangers, especially those that had come up the Greenway, stared at them curiously.
text: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert this minion to transfer a possession or condition borne by a character to another eligible bearer.

name: Demoralized
lore: But soon there were few left in Minas Tirith  who had the heart to stand up and defy the hosts of Mordor.
text: To play, spot an [orc] minion.  Each time a companion exerts, you  may add (1) (or (2) if you can spot 6 companions).

name: Orkish Smith
lore: 'There is always a smoke rising from Isengard these days.'
text: When you play this minion, you may shuffle up to 2 [orc] conditions from your discard pile into your draw deck.

name: Anduin Banks
text: River. The minion archery total is +X for each companion you can spot over 5, where X is the current region number.

name: Neekerbreekers' Bog
text: Marsh. When the fellowship moves here in region 1 or 2, heal each character who has resistance 5 or more and exert all others.

name: Final Account
lore: Gandalf lifted it carefully, but the leaves crackled and broke as he laid it on the slab.
text: To play, exert a [gandalf] Wizard. Discard a card from hand to take a Shadow card from your discard pile into hand.

name: Courtyard Parapet
text: Dwelling.When the fellowship moves to this site in region 2, the first Shadow player may discard 2 cards from hand to add a burden.

name: Lorien Protector
lore: There was a sound of soft laughter over their heads, and then another clear voice spoke in an elven-tongue.
text: Valiant. While another companion is assigned to a skirmish, during each skirmish, prevent all wounds to this companion after the first wound.

name: Shrouded Elf
lore: Cloaked by Elven garments and by darkness, warriors led by Haldir reinforced Helm's Deep.
text: Valiant. Response: If you play an event during a skirmish involving this companion, exert this companion to place that event on top of your draw deck.

name: Mountain-troll
lore: Suddenly on the last stroke the Gate of Gondor broke.
text: When you play this minion, you may discard 5 [orc] minions from play to make it strength +10 and fierce until the regroup phase. Shadow: Remove (2) to play an [orc] Orc from your discard pile. It comes into play exhausted.

name: Elven Warrior
lore: Elven warriors used their strength and wisdom equally in battle.
text: Valiant. While this companion is bearing a possession, he is strength +2. Maneuver: Exert this companion to place an [elven] card from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck.

name: Little Golden Flower
lore: '...she is very beautiful, and is going to be beautifuller still.'
text: Each Hobbit bearing a hand weapon takes no more than 1 wound per skirmish.\Each Hobbit bearing a follower is resistance +1.\Each unwounded Hobbit is strength +1.

name: Focus
lore: '...not even my eyes can see him, my good Legolas...'
text: Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a hunter [dwarven] Dwarf or hunter [gondor] Man. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [elven] Elf strength +2.

name: Haldir, Sentry of the Golden Wood
subtitle: Sentry of the Golden Wood
lore: '...since you come with an Elf of our kindred, we are willing to befirend you, as Elrond asked...'
text: Valiant. To play, spot an Elf. While the fellowship is at a battleground site, Haldir is strength +2. While the fellowship is at a forest site, Haldir is an archer.

name: Ithilien Blade
lore: Most Rangers of Ithilien carried spears, bows, and swords while marching.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. While you can spot a roaming minion, bearer is strength +1. Maneuver: Exert bearer twice to wound a roaming minion twice.

name: Madril, Defender of Osgiliath
subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath
lore: 'For that is the ruin of Osgiliath...'
text: Ranger. Hunter 1. While you can spot 2 [gondor] rangers, Madril is twilight cost –2. At the start of the Maneuver phase, for each threat you can spot, make a minion's site number +1 until the start of the regroup phase.

name: Namárië
lore: 'We shall not meet again, Elessar.'
text: When you play this, add an [elven] token here for each hunter you can spot (limit 3).\Maneuver: Remove an [elven] token from here (or discard this) and discard a card from hand to discard a condition.

name: A New Light
lore: 'I once knew every spell in all the tongues of Men or Elves or Orcs...'
text: Spell.\Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to return 2 minions to a Shadow player's hand from their discard pile. Reveal their hand and discard a minion revealed.

name: Shadowfax, Greatest of the Mearas
subtitle: Greatest of the Mearas
text: Bearer must be a [gandalf] Wizard. When you play this, discard all other possessions and weapons on bearer. Bearer may not bear a hand weapon. Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert bearer and add a threat to remove a burden.

name: Elven Guardian
lore: We are proud to fight alongside Men, once more
text: Valiant. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) While this companion is skirmishing a wounded minion, he is strength +2. Maneuver: Exert this companion to heal another hunter.

name: Galadriel's Silver Ewer
lore: 'Will you look into the mirror?'
text: To play, spot Galadriel or Celeborn.\While Galadriel is the Ring-bearer, she is strength +1 and resistance +2. Each time you play an [elven] skirmish event, you may exert Galadriel to reinforce an [elven] token.

name: Prized Lagan
text: At the start of each turn, you may add (2) to heal a [shire] companion.\Maneuver: Add a threat to spot a minion. That minion loses fierce and cannot gain fierce until the regroup phase. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.

name: Robin Smallburrow, Shirriff Cock-Robin
subtitle: Shirriff Cock-Robin
text: Aid - (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.)\Each time you attach this follower to a [shire] companion, you may discard up to 3 cards from hand and draw an equal amount.

name: Scouring of the Shire
text: Tale. When there are 3 [shire] tokens here, discard this condition from play. Response: If a [shire] condition or [shire] possession is about to be discarded from play by a Shadow card, add a [shire] token here to prevent that.

name: Final Triumph
lore: Now left alone, it stopped before its foe. With a snarl it pulled back the bow, ready to deliver the last blow.
text: Spot your Uruk-hai skirmishing a companion to use vitality to resolve that skirmish instead of strength.  Characters in this skirmish cannot be overwhelmed.

name: Gil-galad, High King of the Noldor
subtitle: High King of the Noldor
text: To play, spot 2 [elven] companions. Maneuver: Add a threat to take an [elven] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile. Regroup: Remove an [elven] token to take an [elven] condition into hand from your discard pile.

name: Doorway to Doom
text: Mountain. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player wounds two of their characters. This site cannot be replaced.

name: Mithlond
text: River. When the fellowship moves to this site in region 3, each player heals each of his or her characters.

name: Steward's Tomb
text: If this site is not a sanctuary, wounds cannot be prevented or healed, and burdens cannot be removed.

name: Haldir, Warrior Messenger
subtitle: Warrior Messenger
lore: I bring word from Elrond of Rivendell.
text: Valiant. Skirmish: Exert Haldir or discard a [elven] card from hand to make a minion skirmishing Haldir strength -2.

name: Beorning Axe
lore: No Orc or wolf dared enter the land of the Beornings.
text: Bearer must be a [gandalf] Man.\While bearer is Grimbeorn, each time he wins a skirmish you may take a [gandalf] event into hand from your discard pile (limit once per turn).

name: Deceit
lore: Presently they were under the shadow, and there in the midst of it they saw the opening of a cave. 'This is the way in,' said Gollum softly.
text: Response: If the Free Peoples player is about to discard your other [gollum] condition, remove (2) to prevent that.

name: Faramir, Captain of Ithilien
subtitle: Captain of Ithilien
lore: 'There are no travelers in this land. Only servants of the Dark Tower.'
text: Ranger. Hunter 2.\If Faramir is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1.\Maneuver: Spot another wounded companion with resistance 5 or more and exert Faramir to heal that companion.

name: The Faithful Stone
text: Tale. Each time a non-[wraith] minion is played, you may spot a Man to put a [gondor] token here. Maneuver: Remove 3 [gondor] tokens from here to spot a minion. That minion cannot be assigned to a skirmish until the regroup phase. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.

name: Frenzy of Arrows
lore: The black fletched arrows of Sauron's armies found many targets.
text: Make 2 [orc] Orcs gain archer until the regroup phase. Then add 1 to the minion archery total for each follower you can spot.

name: Grond, Forged With Black Steel
subtitle: Forged With Black Steel
lore: 'Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond!'
text: To play, spot an [orc] minion. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may discard this possession to make the Free Peoples player shuffle 2 cards from their hand into their draw deck.  Search that draw deck and discard 2 Free Peoples cards.

name: Elven Defender
lore: While they may prefer to avoid conflict, the elves can be ferocious warriors in defense of their ideals.
text: Valiant. While you can spot an [elven] token, this companion is strength +2.

name: Erkenbrand's Horn
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. Fellowship: Exert bearer to play a [rohan] follower from your draw deck. Skirmish: Discard your follower to make bearer strength +4 (or +5 if bearer is Erkenbrand).

name: The One Ring, The Great Ring
subtitle: The Great Ring
text: While wearing The One Ring, burdens may not be removed and each time bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead. Maneuver: Wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.\Skirmish: If wearing the One Ring, add a burden to make bearer strength +3.

name: Brought Down From Inside
lore: 'Bring it down! Bring it down! Bring it down!'
text: Plays on a [rohan] Man.\At the start of each skirmish you may transfer this condition to a [rohan] Man.\At the end of each turn, if bearer did not win a skirmish this turn, return this condition to hand.

name: Pippin, Steadfast Friend
subtitle: Steadfast Friend
lore: 'You must go - and therefore we must, too. Merry and I are coming with you.'
text: Fellowship. Pippin is strength +1 for each tale you can spot (limit X, where X is the number of [shire] companions you can spot).

name: Úlairë Lemenya, Dark Enemy
subtitle: Dark Enemy
lore: 'Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'
text: Fierce. Úlairë Lemenya is strength +1 for each [wraith] possession in your discard pile (limit +9).

name: Ulaire Nertea, Dark Horseman
subtitle: Dark Horseman
lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.
text: Fierce. When you play Úlairë Nertëa, name a race. The Free Peoples player must add a burden to assign Úlairë Nertëa to skirmish a companion of the named race.

name: Hospitality of the Dwarves
lore: 'Roaring fires, malt beer, red meat off the bone...'
text: Maneuver: Spot an unbound Dwarf bearing 2 or more items and hinder this condition to choose one: make that Dwarf damage +1 until the regroup phase, or make that Dwarf take no more than 1 wound until the regroup phase. If at an underground site, do both.

name: Let Fly the Darts of Lindon
lore: 'It recalled to me the glory of the Elder Days and the hosts of Beleriand, so many great princes and captains were assembled.'
text: Tale. Bearer must be a unique [elven] companion. Archery: Exert bearer to make all Free Peoples archers lose archer and gain damage +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Library of Rivendell
text: Fellowship: Stack your tale or artifact from play or from hand here to draw a card. Regroup: Exert an [elven] ally to draw X cards, exert X minions, and remove up to X wounds from companions, where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures on cards stacked here. Discard this artifact.

name: Three for the Elven-Kings
lore: 'The Three, fairest of all, the Elf-lords hid from him, and his hand never touched them or sullied them.'
text: Tale. Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot an [elven] or [gandalf] ring to place a card from hand beneath your draw deck and draw a card (and heal a companion if you can spot 3 [elven] or [gandalf] rings).

name: Counsel of the Wise
lore: Beside Glorfindel there were several other counsellors of Elrond's household, of whom Erestor was the chief; and with him was Galdor, an Elf from the Grey Havens...
text: Spot Gandalf to reveal an [elven] ally from your draw deck.  You may add (X) to take that ally into hand, where X is that ally's twilight cost.

name: Gandalf, Olorin
subtitle: Olorin
text: At the start of your fellowship phase, you may spot 3 [elven] allies and exert Gandalf to take a [Gandalf] or [elven] event from your discard pile into your hand. Gandalf is strength +1 for each of these characters you can spot: Celeborn, Elrond, Galadriel, Saruman.

name: Gwaihir, Lord of Eagles
subtitle: Lord of Eagles
text: To play, spot Gandalf. Each time the fellowship moves to an opponent's site, you may heal a companion with the Gandalf signet. Regroup: Discard Gwaihir to make the move limit for this turn +1; the Shadow player may take up to 2 Shadow cards into hand from their discard pile.

name: My Heart Tells Me
lore: 'Then do not be too eager to deal out death in judgement.'
text: Each time a minion is about to take a wound, you may spot Gandalf to prevent that wound and heal a companion (limit once per turn).

name: Two Eyes, as Often as I Can Spare Them
lore: 'You'll keep an eye on Frodo, won't you?'
text: Spot Gandalf and Frodo to draw X cards, where X is Frodo's vitality.

name: The White Council
lore: 'For even the very wise cannot see all ends.'
text: While you can spot Gandalf and 2 [elven] allies, the first sentence of Saruman's game text does not apply. Regroup: Exert 2 [elven] allies to heal Gandalf or a companion with the Gandalf signet (limit 2 per phase).

name: Aragorn, Estel
subtitle: Estel
lore: 'I gave Hope to the Dúnedain, I have kept no hope for myself.'
text: When you play Aragorn (except in your starting fellowship), you may play an Elf with a twilight cost of 2 or less from your draw deck. Skirmish: Discard an [elven] card from hand to make Aragorn strength +2 or damage +1.

name: Deepest Delvings
lore: 'Far, far below the deepest delvings of the Dwarves, the world is gnawed by nameless things.'
text: Each time a [dwarven] card is discarded from the top of your draw deck, you may add (1) to stack that card here.  Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to take a card stacked here into hand.

name: Boromir, Redeemed
subtitle: Redeemed
lore: 'Few have gained such a victory. Be at peace!'
text: Boromir is strength +2 for each minion he is skirmishing. At the start of each assignment phase, make Boromir defender +1 if you can spot an unbound Hobbit or another companion with the Aragorn signet.

name: The Sons of Gondor Have Returned
lore: They blew a great fanfare, and the heralds cried aloud:...
text: While Boromir is assigned to skirmish more than one minion, Aragorn is strength +3. While Aragorn is assigned to skirmish more than one minion, Boromir is strength +3.

name: Gilraen's Memorial
lore: 'Ónen i-estel edain, ú-chebin estel anim.'
text: To play, exert Aragorn. When Aragorn is killed, discard this artifact. Fellowship: Exert a companion with the Aragorn signet to remove a burden.  Then exert Aragorn or discard this artifact.

name: I Would Have Gone With You to the End
text: Each time you play a skirmish event during a skirmish involving a companion with the Aragorn signet, you may spot Aragorn to stack that event here. Skirmish: Spot Aragorn and discard X cards here to make a skirmishing companion with the Aragorn signet strength +X (limit +3).

name: You Have My Sword
lore: 'I am Aragorn son of Arathorn; and if by life or death I can save you, I will.'
text: To play, spot Aragorn. Plays on a companion with the Aragorn signet (except Aragorn). Each time bearer wins a skirmish, exert Aragorn or discard this condition.

name: Crebain Flock
lore: '...one harsh croak was heard.'
text: This minion is twilight cost -1 for each companion you can spot over 3. Shadow: Spot 2 wounded companions (or spot Saruman) to take an [isengard] weather into hand from your draw deck or discard pile (limit once per phase).

name: Crows of Isengard
text: When you play this minion, spot a companion to add (1) for each Free Peoples card borne by that companion. Shadow: Spot 2 Free Peoples items (or spot Saruman) to take an [isengard] item into hand from your draw deck or discard pile (limit once per phase).

name: Frostbite
lore: 'Gandalf, we must turn back!'
text: To play, spot a weather condition.  Plays on a companion. Limit 1 per bearer. Each time a weather card is played, add (2).  When this condition is discarded by a Free Peoples card, wound bearer.

name: Just a Wisp of Cloud
lore: 'It is moving fast...and against the wind.'
text: Spell. Weather.  Discard a Free Peoples card from hand to play Saruman from your draw deck or discard pile; his twilight cost is -1 for each Crow you can spot.

name: Murder of Crows
lore: ...a whole regiment of birds had broken away...
text: While you can spot 3 Free Peoples conditions, this minion is twilight cost -3.  Shadow: Spot 3 Free Peoples conditions (or spot Saruman) to take an [isengard] condition into hand from your draw deck or discard pile (limit once per phase).

name: Gimli, Vengeful Longbeard
subtitle: Vengeful Longbeard
lore: '...there is one dwarf in Moria who still draws breath!'
text: Damage +1.\ While Gimli bears 2 items, he is damage +1.\While Gimli bears 3 items, he is strength +2.

name: Saruman, Fell Voice
subtitle: Fell Voice
text: While you cannot spot a weather, Saruman may not take wounds in the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. While at a site bearing a weather, each [isengard] minion is strength +2. Response: If the fellowship moves from a site bearing a weather, discard this minion to exert each companion.

name: Guided by One Purpose
lore: 'Something has crept, or has been driven out of dark waters under the mountains. There are older and fouler things than Orcs in the deep places of the world.'
text: Spot 3 tentacles to add a burden.  Then you may make the Free Peoples player discard a tentacle to shuffle a [moria] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.

name: Terror at Its Coming
lore: The orcs stood still, and a dead silence fell.
text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may reveal The Balrog from your hand to  add (2).

name: Thrashing Tentacle
lore: The others swung round and saw the waters of the lake seething...
text: Tentacle. Fierce. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh. Each time this minion loses a skirmish, add a burden (or 2 burdens if you cannot spot a burden).

name: Out of Dark Waters
text: Each time a tentacle takes a wound, you may stack that tentacle here. Shadow: Play a tentacle from here as if from hand. Response: If this condition is about to be discarded, discard 2 tentacles stacked here to prevent that.

name: The Darkness Grew
lore: ... he seemed small, and altogether alone: grey and bent, like a wizened tree before the onset of a storm.
text: Shadow: Stack a [moria] item from hand here. Shadow: Spot The Balrog to take a [moria] card stacked here into hand.

name: Vile Tentacle
lore: ...it was pale-green and luminous and wet.
text: Tentacle. This minion may not bear possessions and is strength -4 while not at a marsh. Shadow: Discard a [moria] card from hand to make the fellowship's current site gain marsh until the end of the turn.

name: Fell Voices Call
lore: A breath of deadly cold pierced him like a spear...
text: Play a [ringwraith] item from your draw deck or discard pile.

name: Harry Goatleaf, In Thrall to the Nine
subtitle: In Thrall to the Nine
lore: 'But you'll find maybe that more folk than old Harry at the gate will be asking you questions.'
text: Nazgul are twilight cost -1. Assignment: Make the Free Peoples player assign a companion with 5 strength or more to skirmish this minion.

name: Pale Crown
lore: 'They were once men.  Great kings of men.'
text: Plays to your support area. While bearer is twilight, characters skirmishing bearer do not receive strength or damage bonuses from cards they bear. Skirmish: Remove (1) to transfer this artifact from your support area to a Nazgul.

name: I Name You Elf-Friend
lore: '...and may the stars shine upon the end of your road.'
text: Exert an Elf to make a Dwarf strength +3 and damage +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Ringwraith in Twilight
text: Twilight. This minion is strength +1 for each wound on the Ring-bearer. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert this minion to make it fierce until the regroup phase. The Free Peoples player may exert the Ring-bearer to prevent this.

name: Their Eyes Fell Upon Him
lore: '...you had become visible to them, being already on the threshold of their world.'
text: To play, spot a twilight Nazgul. Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot a wound on the Ring-bearer to draw a card (or 2 cards if the Ring-bearer is exhausted).

name: Walks in Twilight
lore: The Riders made straight for you, as soon as you fled.'
text: Each time a twilight Nazgul wins a skirmish, you may exert a twilight Nazgul to shuffle a [ringwraith] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.

name: White Faces Burned
lore: Immediately, though everything else remained as before, dim and dark, the shapes became terribly clear.
text: Make a skirmishing twilight Nazgul strength +1 for each wound on the Ring- bearer (and damage +1 if that Nazgul is The Witch-king).

name: Fell to Its Power
lore: 'If the Dark Lord knows so much as you say, Mithrandir, will he not rather smile than fear, and with his little finger crush us like a fly that tries to sting him?'
text: Discard a [Sauron] Orc to add a burden. The Free Peoples player may discard a Free Peoples condition to prevent this.

name: Gaze of the Eye
lore: Then the Eye began to rove, searching this way and that; and Frodo knew with certainty and horror that among the many things that it sought he himself was one.
text: Response: If your [Sauron] condition is about to be discarded, remove a burden to prevent this.

name: I See You
lore: ...to pin you under its deadly gaze, naked, immovable.
text: The site number of each [Sauron] minion is  -1 for each burden you can spot. Each [sauron] minion with site number of  1 or less is strength +1.  When the Ring-bearer takes off The One Ring, discard this condition.

name: It Betrayed Isildur
lore: 'He leaped into the waters, but the Ring slipped from his finger as he swam, and then the Orcs saw him and killed him with arrows.'
text: Spot 5 burdens and discard a [Sauron] Orc to choose one: make the move limit for this turn -1; or make the Free Peoples player choose to move again (if the move limit allows).

name: Orc Ambush Troop
lore: '...he was waylaid by the Orcs of the Mountains, and almost all his folk were slain.'
text: Tracker. While you can spot an exhausted companion, this minion is an archer. While you can spot 3 exhausted companions, this minion is strength +3.

name: A Shadow of the Past
lore: 'He has indeed arisen again... and returned to his ancient fastness in the Dark Tower of Mordor.'
text: While you can spot 4 burdens, each [sauron] Orc is damage +1.\While you can spot 6 burdens, each [Sauron] Orc is fierce.\At the end of each Shadow phase, exert 2 [sauron] Orcs or hinder this condition.

name: One Dwarf in Moria
lore: 'Let them come...!'
text: Spot a Dwarf bearing 2 or more items to heal that Dwarf.  Return X items on that Dwarf to their owners' hands to wound X minions.

name: Bilbo, Of Bag End
subtitle: Of Bag End
lore: 'There has always been a Baggins in Bag End, and there always will be.'
text: To play, spot 2 companions with the Frodo signet.  Fellowship: If the fellowship is at a sanctuary, exert Bilbo twice to play 2 items from your draw deck on [shire] companions.

name: Griffo Boffin, Uncouth Fellow
subtitle: Uncouth Fellow
lore: 'Neither are they counted amongst the very wise...'
text: Each time you play a [shire] ally, you may add (1) to draw a card.

name: Merry, Of Buckland
subtitle: Of Buckland
lore: '...we are going to do our best to help you against the Enemy.'
text: Assignment: Exert Merry twice to prevent a minion from being assigned to a skirmish until the regroup phase.  The Shadow player may exhaust that minion to prevent this.

name: Pippin, Of Tuckborough
subtitle: Of Tuckborough
lore: 'You must go - and therefore we must, too. Merry and I are coming with you.'
text: Skirmish: Exert Pippin to prevent a skirmishing [shire] companion from being overwhelmed unless their strength is tripled (and make them strength +1 if you can spot 3 companions with the Frodo signet).

name: Sam, Of Bagshot Row
subtitle: Of Bagshot Row
lore: 'Don't turn me into anything... unnatural.'
text: Each time a companion with the Frodo signet wins a skirmish, you may spot Frodo to heal that companion.\Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: We May Yet
lore: 'I don't suppose we'll ever see them again.'
text: Exert a skirmishing companion with the Frodo signet to make that companion strength +1 for each companion with the Frodo signet you can spot (limit +4).

name: We're Coming, Too!
lore: 'We hobbits ought to stick together, and we will. I shall go, unless they chain me up.'
text: Spot Merry and Pippin to heal two companions with the Frodo signet.

name: Bag End Study
text: When the fellowship moves from here, you may exert a [shire] companion to play a [shire] condition from your draw deck.

name: Prancing Pony Spare Room
text: Each time a minion of strength 6 or less is played, make it strength +3 until the regroup phase (unless you can spot a [gandalf] card).

name: Rivendell Gateway
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert an unbound companion to make one of another culture strength +1 until the end of the turn (limit +6).

name: So Bold and So Courteous
lore: 'Let none say again that Dwarves are grasping and ungracious.'
text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert an Elf to make a Dwarf defender +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Moria Crossroads
text: Underground. While you can spot a unique [moria] minion, skirmishes involving [moria] minions may not be canceled.

name: Lorien Throne Room
text: Forest. Sanctuary. Each time a companion exerts here, you may exert an [elven] ally to heal that companion (limit once per phase).

name: Valley of the Anduin
text: River. At the start of each skirmish phase, wound each unwounded character in that skirmish.

name: Nen Hithoel
text: River. When the fellowship moves to Nen Hithoel, each Shadow player may draw a card for each companion over 4.

name: Amon Hen Ruins
text: Forest. Each minion is damage +1 for each wound on that minion.

name: Sirannon Dam
lore: But either Gandalf was astray, or else the land had changed in recent years...
text: Rivers and sites with no other terrain keywords gain marsh. Companions are defender +1. Skirmish: Remove 2 burdens to have Watcher in the Water replace a tentacle skirmishing an unbound companion.

name: Writhing Tentacle
lore: Many coiling arms seized the doors on either side, and with horrible strength, swung them round.
text: Tentacle. This minion may not bear possessions and is discarded if not at a marsh. Shadow: If this minion is stacked on a Shadow card, play it to stack 2 tentacles (except Writhing Tentacle) from your discard pile on that card.

name: I Was There
lore: '...the day the strength of men failed.'
text: Tale. Spot a minion skirmishing an Elf and discard your [elven] tale to wound that minion.

name: Lament for the Fallen
text: To play, exert an Elf and spot a unique companion in the dead pile.  Bearer must be an unbound companion. Bearer cannot be exerted, wounded, or assigned to a skirmish. At the start of the regroup phase, discard a condition on bearer (and heal bearer if Gandalf is in the dead pile).

name: Legolas, Keen-eyed
subtitle: Keen-eyed
lore: He saw not a shadow, nor a blur, but the small figures of horsemen.
text: Archer. Each time a minion takes a wound during the archery phase, make Legolas strength +1 until the regroup phase.

name: The One Ring, The Ring of Rings
subtitle: The Ring of Rings
lore: '...ash nazg thrakatulûk agh burzum-ishi krimpatul.'
text: Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, he or she wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While the Ring-bearer is wearing The One Ring, each time he or she is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.

name: Grimir, Dwarven Emissary
subtitle: Dwarven Emissary
lore: '...we crave the advice of Elrond. For the Shadow grows and draws nearer.'
text: Response: If a [dwarven] companion is about to take a wound in a skirmish, discard 2 [dwarven] cards from play (except characters) to prevent that.

name: Strange-looking Men
lore: The strangers, especially those that had come up the Greenway, stared at them curiously.
text: Maneuver: Exert this minion to transfer a possession or condition borne by a character to another eligible bearer.

name: Swarthy Bree-lander
lore: But there was one... who stood looking at them with a knowing and half-mocking expression that made them feel very uncomfortable.
text: At the start of the maneuver phase, you may remove (2) to transfer a condition borne by a character to another eligible bearer.

name: Throng of Harad
lore: Only the strongest fighters can withstand a Southron attack.
text: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a character who has resistance 5 or less, it is fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Warrior of Dunland
lore: The open plain affords no shelter, no defense against the Dunlendings.
text: Ambush (1). While this minion is at a plains site, it gains an additional ambush (1).

name: Whistling Death
lore: As deadly as the Southron arrows, their polearms cut a whirling swath through their enemies.
text: Wound a character skirmishing a [men] minion. If the fellowship is at a battleground site, you may remove (3) to wound that character again.

name: Wielding the Ring
lore: 'Why should we not think that the Great Ring has come into our hands to serve us in the very hour of need?'
text: To play, spot a [men] minion. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Armed for Battle
lore: Fashioned by the hands of Orcs, or plundered from the hands of defeated enemies, the weaponry of Mordor is bounteous.
text: Spot your [orc] minion to play an [orc] possession from your discard pile (or, if that minion is at a battleground site, from your draw deck or discard pile).

name: Barbarous Orc
lore: Fiercely tribal, rival Orc bands unite only against a more hated enemy.
text: Skirmish: Exert another [orc] minion to make this minion strength +2 (or +4 if this minion is skirmishing a companion who has resistance 4 or less).

name: Beastly Olog-hai
lore: Some held that they were not Trolls, but giant Orcs....
text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [orc] minion. Assignment: Exert this minion to assign it to a companion bearing an artifact. The Free Peoples player may discard an artifact from play to prevent this.

name: Bladed Gauntlets
lore: One cannot easily discern Orc armor from weapon.
text: Bearer must be an [orc] minion. Bearer is a lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Exert bearer to make an [orc] minion strength +2.

name: Hall of Our Fathers
lore: '...at last we had the power and numbers to return.'
text: When you play this condition, stack the top 8 cards of your draw deck here. At the start of your maneuver phase, you may spot a Dwarf to exchange the cards stacked here with your hand.

name: Bound to its Fate
lore: 'Now it comes to it, I don't like parting with it at all, I may say.'
text: Spot an [orc] minion to reveal the Free Peoples player's hand. The Free Peoples player chooses to either discard a revealed Free Peoples event or add a burden.

name: Champion Orc
lore: A few Orcs are veterans of single combats to settle disputes in the mountain tribes.
text: Toil 2. (For each [orc] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)

name: Conquered Halls
lore: They brandished spears and scimitars which shone red as blood in the firelight.
text: Make an [orc] minion strength +1 for each underground site you can spot.

name: Cutthroat Orc
lore: The smell of human flesh is often enough to frenzy an Orc warrior.
text: This minion is strength +1 for each companion who has resistance 5 or less.

name: Demoralized
lore: But soon there were few left in Minas Tirith who had the heart to stand up and defy the hosts of Mordor.
text: To play, spot an [orc] minion. Each time a companion exerts, you may add (1) (or (2) if you can spot 6 companions).

name: Denizen of Khazad-dûm
lore: The spiny helms forged by the Orcs of Moria can inflict as much damage as their scimitars.
text: While this minion is at an underground site, it is strength +2.

name: Denizen of Moria
lore: The vast tunnels of Khazad-dûm are the veins through which a foul Orc ichor can flow unchecked.
text: While this minion is at an underground site, it is strength +3.

name: Denizen of the Black Pit
lore: The great Dwarf mansion of Khazad-dûm is now more commonly known by other, darker names.
text: While this minion is at an underground site, it is strength +2.

name: Dread and Despair
lore: ...yet another weapon, swifter than hunger, the Lord of the Dark Tower had....
text: Spot 2 [orc] minions to discard a condition from play. The Free Peoples player may discard the top 6 cards of his or her draw deck to prevent this.

name: Emboldened Orc
lore: Orcs are seldom intimidated, and often goaded, by superior forces.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) This minion is strength +1 for each companion who is not assigned to a skirmish.

name: Mountain Homestead
lore: The Dwarves are as hard and stalwart as the lands in which they've made their homes.
text: To play, spot 2 Dwarf companions. While the fellowship is at a mountain site, each Dwarf is strength +2.

name: Entrapping Orc
lore: Orcs relish the kill more than the fight itself, and will often rush to engage a weakened foe.
text: Assignment: Assign this minion to an unbound companion who has resistance 4 or less.

name: Foraging Orc
lore: Though most Orcs are small in stature, seldom can one be found without another nearby.
text: When you play this minion, you may spot another [orc] minion and a companion who has resistance 3 or less to add (2).

name: Frenzied Orc
lore: More enemies seem only to further fuel their rage.
text: While this minion is at an underground site, each character skirmishing it is strength -2. While you can spot 6 companions, each character skirmishing an [orc] minion is strength -2.

name: Goblin Hordes
lore: ...he saw swarming black figures: there seemed to be hundreds of orcs.
text: To play, spot an [orc] minion. Each time the fellowship moves from an underground site, you may take an [orc] minion from your discard pile into hand.

name: Hill Orc
lore: The foul Orcs who slaughtered the last of Balin's followers still thrive in the halls of Khazad-dûm and the surrounding countryside.
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert each companion who has resistance 4 or less.

name: Isengard Underling
lore: Saruman's workers would exploit any resource to prepare for the coming battle.
text: When you play this minion, you may take an [orc] event from your discard pile into hand.

name: Marauding Orcs
lore: Orcs that would only seek out violence at random on their own were brought together to serve Sauron's purpose.
text: When you cannot spot another [orc] minion, discard this minion from play.

name: Mocking Goblin
lore: There was a rush of hoarse laughter, like the fall of sliding stones into a pit....
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, add a burden unless the Free Peoples player discards a Free Peoples event from hand.

name: Mordor Scimitar
lore: Though Orcs will employ a wide variety of weaponry, they tend to favor long, curved blades.
text: Bearer must be an [orc] minion. Each time bearer is assigned to skirmish a companion, you may exert that companion.

name: Mountain Orc
lore: Larger Orcs are strong enough to run for many miles, and can tire out their prey before attacking.
text: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a companion who has resistance 5 or less, exert that companion.

name: On Guard
lore: 'Well, here's one Dwarf she won't ensnare so easily.'
text: If a Dwarf who has resistance 3 or more is about to take a wound, prevent that.

name: Orc Hammer
lore: The strongest members of an Orc tribe often wield hammers rather than blades.
text: Bearer must be an [orc] Orc. When you play this possession, you may exert a companion.

name: Orc Miscreant
lore: 'Some of the trees they just cut down and leave to rot – orc-mischief that....'
text: To play, spot an [orc] minion. Regroup: Exert this minion to add a burden.

name: Orkish Smith
lore: 'There is always a smoke rising from Isengard these days.'
text: When you play this minion, you may take an [orc] condition from your discard pile into hand.

name: Orkish Worker
lore: Saruman's Orcs labor day and night to provide him with the resources he needs to wage war.
text: When you play this minion, you may spot another [orc] minion to reveal the top card of the Free Peoples player's deck. If it is a Shadow card, add (X), where X is its twilight cost.

name: Persistent Orc
lore: An enemy can do little worse to an Orc than what it would willingly have done to itself.
text: Each time this minion is about to be killed or discarded from play, you may spot another [orc] card to place this minion on top of your draw deck instead.

name: Porter Troll
lore: The mammoth battering ram Grond required equally mammoth strength to wield it.
text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot an [orc] minion. When you play this minion, add a burden unless the Free Peoples player reveals a Free Peoples event from his or her hand.

name: Prowling Orc
lore: Orcs use numbers to fell a powerful foe, though it would be generous to think of it as working together.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Remove (2) to make an [orc] minion strength +1.

name: Scurrying Goblin
lore: But it was not an echo, for when they halted it pattered on for a little all by itself, and then grew still.
text: When you play this minion at an underground site, you may spot another [orc] minion to add (2).

name: Skulking Goblin
lore: 'It is a mark of evil things that came in the Great Darkness that they cannot abide the Sun....'
text: The fellowship's current site gains underground.

name: Spurred to Battle
lore: Even victory does not long slake the Orkish thirst for blood. It merely drives them onward to a new confrontation.
text: To play, exert an [orc] minion. At the start of the Shadow phase, add (1).

name: Well-equipped
lore: Stout and unmindful of the most ample load, Dwarven warriors laden themselves with heavy armor and myriad weaponry.
text: Discard a [dwarven] card from hand to play a [dwarven] possession from your draw deck on a [dwarven] companion who has resistance 5 or more.

name: Strength in Shadows
lore: Weakened by the Sun, Orcs thrive in darkness and shadow.
text: Make an [orc] minion strength +2 (or +4 if it is a lurker).

name: Undisciplined
lore: Easily caught by the heat of battle, Orc soldiers often break formation and attack where their bloodlust takes them.
text: Toil 3. (For each [orc] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -3.) Assign an [orc] minion to a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Unyielding Goblin
lore: In the rush of battle, some Orcs can carry on heedless of their own wounds until their enemy is vanquished.
text: Skirmish: If this minion is at an underground site, exert it to exert a companion it is skirmishing.

name: Watchful Orc
lore: Some Orcs have learned basic tracking skills.
text: When you play this minion, you may spot another [orc] minion to replace the fellowship's current site with an underground site from your adventure deck.

name: Border Patrol
lore: 'Who are you, and what are you doing in this land?'
text: When you play this condition, spot a mounted [rohan] Man to add 3 [rohan] tokens here. Response: If a minion is played at a plains site, discard this condition or remove a [rohan] token from here to exert that minion.

name: Éomer, Guardian of the Eastmark
subtitle: Guardian of the Eastmark
lore: '...wanderers in the Riddermark would be wise to be less haughty in these days of doubt.'
text: While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1. Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert Éomer to return a minion to its owner's hand.

name: Éowyn, Shieldmaiden of Rohan
subtitle: Shieldmaiden of Rohan
lore: 'The women of this country learned long ago: those without swords can still die upon them.'
text: Each time Éowyn wins a skirmish, each other [rohan] Man is strength +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Gamling, Defender of the Hornburg
subtitle: Defender of the Hornburg
lore: 'If they come to bargain for our goods at Helm's Gate, they will pay a high price....'
text: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may add (1) to play a possession on Gamling from your draw deck.

name: Hrothlac, Man of Rohan
subtitle: Man of Rohan
lore: '...we desire only to be free, and to live as we have lived, keeping our own, and serving no foreign lord, good or evil.'
text: Response: If a [rohan] companion who has resistance 4 or more is about to take a wound, exert Hrothlac to prevent that.

name: Protecting the Hall
lore: 'None are welcome here in days of war but our own folk....'
text: Toil 2. (For each [rohan] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. Assignment: Discard this condition from play to make bearer defender +1.

name: Arwen, Staunch Defender
subtitle: Staunch Defender
lore: 'What grace is given me, let it pass to him. Let him be spared. Save him.'
text: Each minion skirmishing Arwen is strength -1 for each forest site on the adventure path.

name: Rally Cry
lore: '...a sword-day, a red day, ere the sun rises!'
text: Make a [rohan] Man who has resistance 4 or more strength +2 for each wound on each minion he or she is skirmishing.

name: Riddermark Javelin
lore: Short-hafted throwing spears are wielded by the Riders of Rohan in addition to their long lances.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. Archery: Discard this possession to make the fellowship archery total +1 (or +2 if the fellowship is at a plains site).

name: Riddermark Soldier
lore: ...their faces were stern and keen.
text: When you play this companion, each [rohan] companion is strength +2 until the regroup phase.

name: Rider's Spear
lore: Shafts of the sun flared above the eastern hills and glimmered on their spears.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. If bearer is mounted, bearer is damage +1.

name: Riders of the Mark
lore: With astonishing speed and skill they checked their steeds, wheeled, and came charging round.
text: To play, spot 2 [rohan] companions. You may play Riders of the Mark any time you could play a skirmish event. When you play Riders of the Mark, you may exhaust a minion.

name: Riding Like the Wind
lore: The horsemen, following the trail, had turned from the river and were drawing near the downs.
text: To play, exert a [rohan] Man. While you can spot 2 [rohan] mounts, the move limit is +1. Each of your companions that is not mounted is strength -1.

name: Rohirrim Mount
lore: The Eorlingas raise horses both peerless and cherished.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert. While bearer is at a plains site, he or she is defender +1.

name: Rush of Steeds
text: To play, spot a [rohan] Man. Each time a Shadow condition is played, you may exert a minion. Response: If a minion exerts as a cost of its special ability, discard this condition to prevent that and return that minion to its owner's hand.

name: Sword Rack
lore: In Rohan, equal craft is brought to the exhibition of a blade as to the forging.
text: Response: If a [rohan] possession is discarded from play and no more than one possession is stacked here, stack it here. Fellowship: Add (1) to play a possession stacked here as if from hand.

name: Théoden, King of the Eorlingas
subtitle: King of the Eorlingas
lore: 'Let all my folk get ready!'
text: While you can spot a [gandalf] companion, Théoden gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) While Théoden is at a battleground or plains site each [rohan] Man is strength +1.

name: Blade of Lindon
lore: To this day, many Elven weapons are forged in the fashion of those wielded by Gil-galad's forces.
text: Bearer must be an Elf. While bearer is at a forest or river site, each minion he or she is skirmishing is strength -1.

name: War Now Calls Us
lore: 'Mourn not overmuch! Mighty was the fallen, / meet was his ending. When his mound is raised, / women then shall weep.'
text: Exert a [rohan] companion to make him or her strength +3 (and damage +1 if he or she has resistance 5 or more).

name: Concerning Hobbits
lore: ...they love peace and quiet and good tilled earth; a well-ordered and well-farmed countryside was their favorite haunt.
text: For each dwelling and forest site on the adventure path, make a Hobbit strength +1.

name: Crouched Down
lore: Frodo felt a sudden chill running through him and clutching at his heart....
text: Stealth. Cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit and a minion whose strength is lower than that Hobbit's resistance.

name: Farmer Maggot, Hobbit of the Marish
subtitle: Hobbit of the Marish
lore: 'I didn't like the looks of him; and when Grip came out, he took one sniff and let out a yelp as if he had been stung....'
text: While Farmer Maggot is at a dwelling or forest site, he is strength +4.

name: Frodo, Protected by Many
subtitle: Protected by Many
lore: 'I will take the Ring... though I do not know the way.'
text: Ring-bearer. Ring-bound. At the start of the regroup phase, you may exert Frodo to make him gain muster until the end of the regroup phase. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)

name: Habits of Home
lore: 'What about second breakfast?'
text: Toil 2. (For each [shire] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Bearer must be a Hobbit. Limit 1 per bearer. Each time the fellowship moves from a dwelling or forest site, remove (1).

name: Hobbit Sword
lore: 'Strap these on....'
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit.

name: Incognito
lore: 'I am Mr. Underhill, if any name must be given.'
text: Stealth. If the fellowship is at a dwelling site, exert 2 Hobbits to cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, exert 2 Hobbits to make a Hobbit strength +3.

name: Merry, Loyal Companion
subtitle: Loyal Companion
lore: 'We can't leave Frodo! Pippin and I always intended to go wherever he went, and we still do.'
text: For each other unbound companion assigned to a skirmish, Merry is strength +2.

name: The More, The Merrier
lore: 'This, my friend, is a pint!'
text: Toil 2. (For each [shire] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot 2 [shire] companions to remove 2 burdens.

name: Elven Marksmanship
lore: Sighted by keen vision and loosed with blinding swiftness, Elven arrows rarely miss their targets.
text: To play, spot an Elf. Toil 2. (For each [elven] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Archery: Discard this condition to make the fellowship archery total +2.

name: Pippin, Brave Decoy
subtitle: Brave Decoy
lore: Merry and he had drawn their swords, but the Orcs did not wish to fight....
text: Skirmish: If Pippin is not assigned to a skirmish, spot an unbound companion who has less resistance than Pippin to have Pippin replace him or her in a skirmish.

name: Salt from the Shire
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard this possession to remove a burden. Skirmish: If bearer is an unbound Hobbit, discard this possession to prevent him or her from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

name: Sam, Steadfast Friend
subtitle: Steadfast Friend
lore: 'I'm coming too, or neither of us is going. I'll knock holes in all the boats first.'
text: Ring-bound. Each other companion is resistance +1.

name: Sting, Weapon of Heritage
subtitle: Weapon of Heritage
lore: This blade has dealt many wounds, by many hands.
text: Bearer must be Bilbo, Frodo, or Sam. Maneuver: If bearer is Bilbo or Frodo, exert him to make another companion resistance +2 until the regroup phase. If bearer is Sam, each time he wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.

name: Sworn Companion
lore: 'It's just something Gandalf said. ... \"Don't you lose him, Samwise Gamgee.\" And I don't mean to.'
text: Make a Hobbit strength +1 for each companion who has resistance 7 or more.

name: A Task Now to Be Done
lore: Another opportunity for one of the shire-folk to prove their great worth. You must not fail me.
text: Spot X Hobbits to make an unbound Hobbit resistance +X.

name: Unharmed
lore: 'So far so good; but how are we to avoid being spitted?'
text: Heal a Hobbit for each minion you spot.

name: Army of Uruk-hai
lore: Volleys of arrows are no defense against the onslaught of Saruman's servants.
text: Damage +1. Each Free Peoples archer who has resistance 5 or less does not add to the Free Peoples archery total.

name: Bloodthirsty Uruk
lore: Bred for endurance, the Uruk-hai pursue their foes tirelessly.
text: Damage +1. While you can spot an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3.

name: Brawling Uruk
lore: They are trained to parry the swords of their enemies.
text: Damage +1. Response: If a special ability of a companion who has resistance 5 or less is used, exert this minion to cancel its effect.

name: Elven Scout
lore: None who draw within a league of the Celebrant escape unnoticed the patrols from Caras Galadhon.
text: While you can spot another Elf, this companion has muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)

name: Brutality
lore: Uruks are drawn to the sounds of battle.
text: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +1 for each battleground site you can spot.

name: Determined Uruk
lore: As their prey grows tired, the Uruks gain the advantage.
text: To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion. Each time a companion exerts, you may draw a card.

name: Devastation
lore: The villages hold nothing of value to the Uruk-hai; they are simply things to be destroyed.
text: If your [uruk-hai] minion wins a skirmish, discard a condition from play.

name: Feral Uruk
lore: Only in combat is an Uruk-hai truly fulfilling its purpose.
text: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is strength +1 and damage +1.

name: Force of Uruk-hai
lore: Despite their bloodthirsty nature, Saruman's creations form armies and fight united for him.
text: Damage +1. Each time this minion is about to take a wound at a battleground site, you may spot another [uruk-hai] card to make the Free Peoples player draw a card instead.

name: Fortitude
lore: Resiliency is bred into the fighting Uruk-hai.
text: When you play this condition, spot an [uruk-hai] minion to add 3 [uruk-hai] tokens here. Response: If an [uruk-hai] minion is about to take a wound, discard this condition or remove an [uruk-hai] token from here to prevent that.

name: Furious Uruk
lore: The Uruk-hai attack with such ferocity that their victims find no way to strike back.
text: Damage +1. While this minion is assigned to a skirmish, each companion and Free Peoples possession loses its special abilities.

name: Furor
lore: Uruk soldiers have learned to save their rage for the field of battle.
text: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +2 (or +3 if you can spot an exhausted companion).

name: Hounding Uruk
lore: An enemy on the move is an enemy unprepared.
text: Damage +1. While you can spot an exhausted companion, this minion is strength +3.

name: Intimidating Uruk
lore: In battle, the Uruk-hai inspire terror in even the bravest of their enemies.
text: Damage +1. When you play this minion at a battleground site, spot an unbound companion to make that companion resistance -2 until the end of the turn.

name: Farewell to Lórien
lore: '...the memory of Lothlórien shall remain ever clear and unstained in your heart, and shall neither fade nor grow stale.'
text: Spot an Elf to heal each companion who has resistance 5 or more.

name: Invincible Uruk
lore: Like a force of nature, the Uruks are unstoppable.
text: Damage +1. While this minion is at a battleground site, it cannot take wounds. While you can spot 6 companions, each [uruk-hai] minion cannot take wounds.

name: Isengard Siege Bow
lore: Saruman's machine works also makes formidable heavy bows for the Uruk-hai.
text: Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] minion. While bearer is at a battleground site, it is an archer.

name: Isengard Sword
lore: The heavy-backed Uruk blades hack through armor and flesh alike.
text: Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] minion. Each character skirmishing bearer is strength -2.

name: Lookout Uruk
lore: Choice of terrain is important when engaging the enemy.
text: Damage +1. The fellowship's current site gains battleground.

name: Lurtz, Minion of the White Wizard
subtitle: Minion of the White Wizard
lore: Saruman bred this ruthless commander, whose brutality matched his own ambition, to track the Nine Walkers.
text: Archer. Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) Lurtz is strength +3 for each exhausted companion you can spot.

name: Murderous Uruk
lore: Like a machine of Saruman, his minions are created for one purpose – killing.
text: Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)

name: Our Foes Are Weak
lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai are instilled with his ideas of destiny and supremacy.
text: To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion. Bearer must be an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer.

name: Overpowering Uruk
lore: They make short work of the weak.
text: Damage +1. Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) While this minion is skirmishing a character who has resistance 3 or less, this minion is strength +3.

name: Patrol of Uruk-hai
lore: Their toughness comes from both armor and hide.
text: Damage +1. While this minion is skirmishing a Free Peoples character who has resistance 5 or less, this minion cannot take wounds.

name: Relentless Uruk
lore: Single-minded in purpose, the Uruk-hai are not easily swayed from their intended path.
text: Damage +1. Each time a Free Peoples event is played during a skirmish involving this minion, this minion is strength -2 until the regroup phase.

name: The One Ring, The Ruling Ring
subtitle: The Ruling Ring
lore: One Ring to rule them all....
text: Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he or she wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While the Ring-bearer is wearing The One Ring, each time he or she is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead.

name: The Lady's Blessing
lore: 'We have come to bid our last farewell,' she said, 'and to speed you with blessings from our land.'
text: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +3 at a river site).

name: Ruthless Uruk
lore: Weapons mean little against the strength of Uruks.
text: Each time this minion is assigned to skirmish a character who has resistance 3 or less, you may exert this minion to discard a possession borne by that character.

name: Sentinel Uruk
lore: Uruks are trained to safeguard their commanders.
text: Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Response: If an [uruk-hai] minion is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert or discard this minion to prevent that.

name: Squad of Uruk-hai
lore: Fighting in packs, the Uruk-hai feast on the weak.
text: Damage +1. While this minion is skirmishing a character who has resistance 4 or less, this minion is damage +1.

name: Swarming Uruk
lore: Like pack animals, the Uruk-hai find strength in numbers.
text: Damage +1. While you can spot another [uruk-hai] minion assigned to a skirmish, this minion cannot take wounds.

name: Tyrannical Uruk
lore: Huge, terrifying Uruks become tribal leaders.
text: Damage +1. Toil 1. (For each [uruk-hai] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -1.)

name: Vigilant Uruk
lore: Some of the Uruks watch for stragglers and make certain they don't escape alive.
text: Damage +1. Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) This minion is strength +2 for each [uruk-hai] minion not assigned to a skirmish.

name: Watchman Uruk
lore: Advanced Uruk scouts search for enemy weaknesses.
text: Damage +1. When you play this minion at a battleground site, you may draw a card.

name: Dark Powers Strengthen
lore: The Witch-king nearly seized the Ring in Frodo's moment of weakness.
text: Toil 2. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a Nazgûl to draw 3 cards.

name: Dark Wings
lore: The wicked, flying beasts of the Ringwraiths snatched warriors from the battlefield and flung them like leaves in the wind.
text: Each time your [wraith] minion wins a skirmish, you may discard this condition to discard a Free Peoples condition from play.

name: Drawn to Its Power
lore: 'And also the Ring drew them.'
text: Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving a Nazgûl, add a burden.

name: Legolas, Companion of the Ring
subtitle: Companion of the Ring
lore: 'I am one of the Nine Companions who set out with Mithrandir from Imladris... and with this Dwarf, my friend, I came with the Lord Aragorn.'
text: While Legolas is at a battleground or forest site, he is strength +2 and resistance +2.

name: Hatred Stirred
lore: Suddenly the foremost Rider spurred his horse forward.
text: Each time a companion loses a fierce skirmish involving a [wraith] minion, you may shuffle a [wraith] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.

name: Keening Wail
lore: The piercing cries of the Nazgûl paralyze their enemies with fear.
text: Toil 2. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a Nazgûl to add a burden.

name: Lost in the Woods
text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a companion your Nazgûl is skirmishing. Limit 1 per companion. Each [wraith] minion skirmishing bearer is strength +1 for each forest site you can spot.

name: Moving This Way
lore: 'I thought there were two or three black shapes.'
text: Shadow: Spot a Nazgûl and reveal a Nazgûl from hand to place the revealed card beneath your draw deck and draw a card.

name: The Pale Blade, Sword of Flame
subtitle: Sword of Flame
lore: Die now and curse in vain!' And with that he lifted high his sword and flames ran down the blade.
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. If bearer is The Witch-king, each time he wins a skirmish, you may exert him to add a burden.

name: Riders in Black
lore: 'The Nine are abroad again.'
text: Reveal your hand to make a [wraith] minion strength +1 for each [wraith] minion in your hand.

name: A Shadow Rises
text: Maneuver: Remove (5) to make this condition a fierce [wraith] minion until the start of the regroup phase that has 10 strength and 3 vitality, and cannot bear other cards. This card is still a condition. At the start of the regroup phase, remove all tokens from here.

name: Shapes Slowly Advancing
text: Regroup: Discard your Nazgûl from play to add a [wraith] token here. The Free Peoples player may return a companion to hand to prevent the placement of that token. When you can spot 4 [wraith] tokens on this condition, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.

name: Surrounded by Wraiths
lore: Encircled, with nowhere to retreat, Aragorn could only hope to drive back the Nazgûl.
text: To play, spot a Nazgûl. Each time the Free Peoples player plays a companion, that companion is exhausted unless the Free Peoples player pays its twilight cost again.

name: Úlairë Attëa, Second of the Nine Riders
subtitle: Second of the Nine Riders
lore: 'Hissed at me, he did. It gave me quite a shudder.'
text: Fierce. Each time Úlairë Attëa is assigned to a fierce skirmish involving a character who has resistance 4 or less, you may exert Úlairë Attëa to add a burden.

name: Legolas, Woodland Emissary
subtitle: Woodland Emissary
lore: Travelling to the council at Imladris was only the beginning of a much greater journey for the Elven Prince. 'Few can foresee whither their road will lead 'them, till they come to its end.'
text: At the start of the archery phase, you may spot another Elf to exert a minion.

name: Úlairë Cantëa, Fourth of the Nine Riders
subtitle: Fourth of the Nine Riders
lore: 'It's from Hobbiton that this here black rider comes, unless there's more than one.'
text: While Úlairë Cantëa is at a forest or dwelling site, he is strength +2 and fierce.

name: Úlairë Lemenya, Fifth of the Nine Riders
subtitle: Fifth of the Nine Riders
lore: Terror overcame Pippin and Merry, and they threw themselves flat on the ground.
text: Each character skirmishing Úlairë Lemenya who has resistance 5 or less is strength -3.

name: Úlairë Nelya, Third of the Nine Riders
subtitle: Third of the Nine Riders
lore: 'There's been a strange customer asking for Mr. Baggins of Bag End, and he's only just gone.'
text: Fierce. Shadow: Exert Úlairë Nelya to replace the fellowship's current site with a site from your adventure deck.

name: Úlairë Nertëa, Ninth of the Nine Riders
subtitle: Ninth of the Nine Riders
lore: Sauron's servants interrogate with terror and torture.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) While Úlairë Nertëa is at a forest site, he is strength +2. While you can spot 6 companions, each Nazgûl is strength +2.

name: Úlairë Otsëa, Seventh of the Nine Riders
subtitle: Seventh of the Nine Riders
lore: The riding figure sat quite still with its head bowed, as if listening.
text: When you play Úlairë Otsëa, you may spot a companion who has X wounds to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. Take each [wraith] card revealed this way into hand.

name: Úlairë Toldëa, Eighth of the Nine Riders
subtitle: Eighth of the Nine Riders
lore: The terrifying pursuit of the Nazgûl on their Black Steeds drives their victims headlong into the wild.
text: Fierce. Each time Úlairë Toldëa wins a skirmish, you may play the fellowship's next site.

name: The Witch-king, Captain of the Nine Riders
subtitle: Captain of the Nine Riders
lore: ...a shape, black-mantled, huge and threatening.
text: Fierce. Toil 2. (For each [wraith] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)

name: Anduin Banks
text: River. The minion archery total is +2 for each companion in the fellowship over 4.

name: Anduin Confluence
text: River. When the fellowship moves to this site, discard each ally from play.

name: Barazinbar
text: Mountain. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert a Dwarf to play a [dwarven] possession from your draw deck.

name: Legolas' Bow
lore: Though not as sturdy as the bows of the Galadhrim, a Mirkwood bow is no less dangerous in skilled hands.
text: Bearer must be an Elf. Bearer is an archer. If bearer is Legolas, each time you exert him to play an [elven] condition or [elven] event, you may heal him (limit once per phase).

name: Buckland Homestead
text: Dwelling. Shadow: Play a Nazgûl to discard a condition from play.

name: Caras Galadhon
text: Forest. No more than 1 minion can be assigned to each skirmish.

name: Cavern Entrance
text: Underground. Skirmish special abilities cannot be used.

name: Chamber of Mazarbul
text: Underground. The Free Peoples player may transfer Free Peoples artifacts and possessions at no twilight cost.

name: Crags of Emyn Muil
text: Mountain. If this site is in region 2 when the fellowship moves from it during the regroup phase, wound each companion.

name: Dammed Gate-stream
text: Marsh. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may play a [gollum] Free Peoples card from your draw deck.

name: East Road
text: Forest. Each companion is twilight cost +2.

name: Ettenmoors
text: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your character (except an enduring character), to make it strength +2.

name: Expanding Marshland
text: Marsh. Shadow: If the total number of minions and twilight tokens is 3 or fewer, play a minion at twilight cost -3.

name: Fangorn Glade
text: Forest. When the fellowship moves to this site, add (1) for each Free Peoples weapon.

name: Might of the Elf-lords
lore: Dimly Frodo saw the river below him rise, and down along its course there came a plumed cavalry of waves.
text: Exert an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If that card's twilight cost is 3 or less, make a minion strength -3.

name: Flats of Rohan
text: Plains. Each unbound companion skirmishing more than 1 minion is strength +3.

name: Fortress of Orthanc
text: Battleground. When the fellowship moves to this site, add (2) for each companion over 5.

name: Green Dragon Inn
text: Dwelling. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert 2 Hobbits to play a Hobbit from your draw deck.

name: Harrowdale
text: Plains. Until the regroup phase, each minion skirmishing a [rohan] companion loses fierce and cannot gain fierce.

name: Heights of Isengard
text: Battleground. Each time a [gandalf] companion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player may discard a condition from play.

name: Helm's Gate
text: Battleground. Each character bearing a hand weapon is strength +2.

name: Mere of Dead Faces
text: Marsh. Regroup: Exert your Gollum or your Sméagol to play the fellowship's next site.

name: Moria Guardroom
text: Underground. When your fellowship moves from this site, you may spot a Dwarf to draw 2 cards.

name: Moria Stairway
text: Underground. Each character bearing a hand weapon is damage +1.

name: Neekerbreekers' Bog
text: Marsh. When the fellowship moves to here, heal each character who has resistance 5 or more and exert each other character.

name: Nocked
lore: Legolas can fit an arrow to his bowstring faster than most can clear a blade from its scabbard.
text: Exert an Elf who has resistance 4 or more to wound a minion.

name: North Undeep
text: River. The minion archery total is -3.

name: Old Forest Road
text: Forest. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may heal 2 Elves.

name: Osgiliath Reclaimed
text: Battleground. When the fellowship moves from this site, the Free Peoples player may spot 3 burdens to remove a burden.

name: Pelennor Fields
text: Plains. Each [men] minion gains ambush (1).

name: Pelennor Flat
text: Plains. At the start of the maneuver phase, the Free Peoples player must add a burden or discard 3 cards from hand.

name: Pinnacle of Zirakzigil
text: Mountain. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert 3 companions to play a Wizard from your dead pile.

name: The Prancing Pony
text: Dwelling. At the start of your fellowship phase, you may add a burden to play a ranger from your draw deck.

name: Rohan Uplands
text: Plains. During the archery phase, [uruk-hai] minions cannot take wounds.

name: Slag Mounds
text: Battleground. Each time a companion is killed, add a burden.

name: Stables
text: At the start of your fellowship phase, you may exert a [rohan] Man to play a [rohan] mount from your draw deck.

name: Uncertain Future
lore: 'What did you see?'
text: When you play this condition, spot an Elf to add 3 [elven] tokens here. Maneuver: Discard this condition or remove an [elven] token from here to reveal the top card of your draw deck. You may place that card beneath your draw deck.

name: Trollshaw Forest
text: Forest. Each time you play an artifact or possession on your companion, you may draw a card.

name: Valley of the Silverlode
text: Dwelling. River. When your fellowship moves to this site, you may heal each Hobbit companion.

name: Watch-tower of Cirith Ungol
text: Mountain. Maneuver: Exert your [orc] minion to discard a card at random from the Free Peoples player's hand.

name: West Gate of Moria
text: Underground. When the fellowship moves from this site, remove (2).

name: Westemnet Village
text: Dwelling. When the fellowship moves to this site, the Free Peoples player wounds a companion for each ally.

name: Window on the West
text: Underground. Each unwounded [gondor] Man is defender +1.

name: Woody-End
text: Forest. Shadow: Remove a burden to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile.

name: Woodland Sentinel
lore: 'We drove them off after some time; they were many and fierce, but they came from over the mountains, and were unused to the woods.'
text: While this companion is at a forest site, he is strength +2.

name: The Art of Gandalf
lore: The fireworks were by Gandalf: they were not only brought by him, but designed and made by him....
text: To play, spot a [gandalf] Wizard. Regroup: Stack a spell from hand here. Fellowship: Discard a [gandalf] card from hand to take a card stacked here into hand.

name: Ease the Burden
lore: 'Bilbo was meant to find the Ring. In which case, you also were meant to have it. And that is an encouraging thought.'
text: Exert a [gandalf] Wizard to remove a burden (or 2 burdens if the fellowship is at a dwelling site).

name: Axe of Khazad-dûm
lore: The Dwarves led by Balin to the great Dwarf-hall of old, though ill-prepared, were well-armed.
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. While bearer is at a mountain site, he is damage +1.

name: Erland, Dale Counselor
subtitle: Dale Counselor
lore: 'They are valiant men and keep open the High Pass and the Ford of Carrock.'
text: To play, spot a [gandalf] companion. Skirmish: Exert Erland to take a [gandalf] skirmish event from your discard pile into hand.

name: Final Account
lore: Gandalf lifted it carefully, but the leaves crackled and broke as he laid it on the slab.
text: To play, exert a [gandalf] Wizard. Discard 2 cards from hand to take a Free Peoples card and a Shadow card from your discard pile into hand.

name: G for Grand
lore: To them he was just one of the 'attractions' at the party. Hence the excitement of the hobbit-children.
text: While you can spot a [gandalf] Wizard, each companion who has resistance 6 or more is strength +1.

name: Gandalf, Leader of the Company
subtitle: Leader of the Company
lore: 'I will help you bear this burden, Frodo Baggins....'
text: While Gandalf is in region 1, each other companion is strength +2. While Gandalf is in region 2, each companion is strength +1. While Gandalf is in region 3, he is strength +2.

name: Gandalf's Staff, Ash-staff
subtitle: Ash-staff
text: Bearer must be a Wizard. If bearer is Gandalf, he gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) Each time bearer wins a skirmish, choose a Shadow player who must wound a minion.

name: Glamdring, Foe-hammer
subtitle: Foe-hammer
lore: There was a ringing clash and a stab of white fire.
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may remove a burden.

name: Inspiration
lore: Through his own strength, Gandalf spurred all the Free Peoples of Middle-earth to stand against the coming darkness.
text: Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to reveal your hand and make a minion strength -3 for each companion in your hand (or -4 for each if the fellowship is at a battleground site).

name: New Authority
lore: 'Prepare for battle!'
text: To play, spot a [gandalf] Wizard. Each time a Shadow card adds a burden, you may remove (3). Response: If a minion uses its special ability, discard this condition to cancel the effect of that special ability.

name: New-awakened
lore: 'Too long have you sat in shadows and trusted to twisted tales and crooked promptings.'
text: Spell. Toil 2. (For each [gandalf] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to discard 2 conditions from play.

name: Prolonged Struggle
lore: 'We fought far under the living earth, where time is not counted.'
text: Exert a [gandalf] Wizard and spot 2 companions who each have resistance 7 or more to wound a minion that Wizard is skirmishing twice.

name: Battle to the Last
lore: As had the children of Durin and the followers of Balin before him, Gimli would fight the interlopers in Khazad-dûm with all his strength.
text: Spot a Dwarf. For each wound on that Dwarf, make him strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Shadowfax, Unequaled Steed
subtitle: Unequaled Steed
lore: 'He has come for me: the horse of the White Rider. We are going to battle together.'
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each time Gandalf is about to take a wound, you may add a burden to prevent that.

name: Frenzied Attack
lore: 'He musstn't hurt Preciouss. Give it to Sméagol, yess, give it to us! Give it to uss!'
text: If a minion is skirmishing a Free Peoples character who has resistance 2 or less, spot Gollum to wound that character twice.

name: Gollum, Skulker
subtitle: Skulker
lore: 'O yes, Shelob will get him, not Sméagol: he promised; he won't hurt Master at all.'
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Exert Gollum twice to make another minion strength +2.

name: Horribly Strong
lore: Gollum hissed and spat, but he did not let go.
text: Discard Gollum from play to wound an unbound companion who has resistance 6 or less.

name: Incited
lore: 'He's much more dangerous than he looks.'
text: Each time a companion loses a skirmish, you may exert Gollum to take a [gollum] card into hand from your discard pile.

name: Led Astray
lore: So far Gollum's plot had succeeded.
text: Spot Gollum to add (3) and exchange one of your sites on the adventure path with another site from your adventure deck.

name: Master Commands It
lore: 'It's not sense to try and get into Mordor at all. But if master says I must go or I will go, then he must try some way.'
text: Make Sméagol strength +1 for each companion who has resistance 5 or more.

name: No End of Wickedness
lore: ...a fear was growing on him, a menace which he could not see....
text: Exert Gollum to make another minion strength +2 (or +3 if Gollum is at a mountain site).

name: Not Yet Vanquished
lore: A sudden weight smote him and he crashed forward, tearing the backs of his hands that still clasped his master's.
text: Each time a companion loses a fierce skirmish, you may exert Gollum to add a burden.

name: One Good Turn Deserves Another
lore: 'Nice hobbits! We will come with them. Find them safe paths in the dark, yes we will.'
text: Spot Sméagol to play the fellowship's next site. Then you may add a burden to take this card back into hand.

name: Dwarven Embassy
lore: Glóin and his countrymen stood as reassurance that the Dwarves would also stand against the will of the Dark Lord.
text: To play, spot a Dwarf. Each companion is damage +1. Discard this condition at the end of your turn.

name: Safe Passage
lore: 'Here! We can get down here. Sméagol went this way once: I went this way, hiding from Orcs.'
text: When you play this condition, name forest, mountain, plains, or river. Each time the fellowship moves to a site that has the named keyword, you may exert Gollum or Sméagol to remove (4).

name: Sméagol, Scout and Guide
subtitle: Scout and Guide
lore: They would have foundered in the Dead Marshes but for Gollum.
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, you may play the fellowship's next site. Skirmish: If Sméagol is at a marsh, exert him to cancel a skirmish involving him.

name: Strange and Terrible
lore: Gollum on the edge of the abyss was fighting like a mad thing with an unseen foe.
text: Spot a [gollum] minion at a mountain site to play a minion from your discard pile.

name: Aragorn, Guide and Protector
subtitle: Guide and Protector
lore: '...I know all the lands between the Shire and the Misty Mountains, for I have wandered over them for many years.'
text: Ranger. Each time a Free Peoples skirmish event is played, you may exert Aragorn to wound a minion he is skirmishing.

name: Aragorn, Strider
subtitle: Strider
lore: ...in spite of the heat of the room he wore a hood that overshadowed his face; but the gleam of his eyes could be seen as he watched the hobbits.
text: Ranger. Each time the fellowship moves, add (1).

name: Armor of the Citadel
lore: Upon the black surcoats were embroidered in white a tree blossoming like snow....
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Each minion skirmishing bearer loses all damage bonuses. While bearer is at a battleground site and unwounded, he or she is defender +1.

name: Battle Cry
lore: '...men were yelling and screaming, and one clear loud voice was calling 'Gondor! Gondor!'
text: Make a ranger strength +2 (or +3 if he or she is skirmishing a minion who has a damage bonus).

name: Boromir, Hero of Osgiliath
subtitle: Hero of Osgiliath
lore: 'Let the armies of Mordor know this: never again will the land of my people fall into enemy hands!'
text: Knight. Each time Boromir wins a skirmish, you may heal a [gondor] companion.

name: Bow of Minas Tirith
lore: From the ramparts of the Gondorian fortress, death rained down upon the servants of Sauron.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. At the start of the archery phase, if bearer is at a battleground site, you may exert him or her to make the fellowship archery total +1.
