name: Gondorian Blade
lore: While many knights of Gondor favor hand-and-a-half swords, lighter weapons are often preferred by the rangers who patrol Ithilien.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. While bearer is a ranger or at a river site, he or she is damage +1.

name: Fallen Lord
lore: He is dead then,' said Frodo. 'I feared it was so.' Gimli cast his hood over his face.
text: Exert the Ring-bearer and a Dwarf to make that Dwarf strength +X, where X equals that Dwarf's resistance.

name: The Highest Quality
lore: 'Captain Faramir, you have shown your quality, sir. The very highest.'
text: Exert any number of [gondor] companions who have total resistance 12 or more to make a minion skirmishing a [gondor] companion strength -3 for each companion exerted this way.

name: Houses of Healing
lore: ...the king was indeed come among them, and after war he brought healing....
text: When you play this condition, spot a [gondor] Man to add 3 [gondor] tokens here. Fellowship: Add (2) and either discard this condition or remove a [gondor] token from here to heal a [gondor] Man.

name: Madril, Ranger of Ithilien
subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien
lore: '...we must look to our own borders. Faramir, Orcs are on the move.'
text: Ranger. Fellowship: If Madril is at a forest site, exert him to play the fellowship's next site.

name: Much-needed Rest
lore: 'A guest-house shall be made ready: there you shall sleep, when you have eaten.'
text: Heal each [gondor] companion who has resistance 5 or more.

name: Pledge of Loyalty
lore: 'I ask leave once again to be your companion, Frodo.'
text: Make a [gondor] companion strength +2 (or +3 if he or she has resistance 4 or more).

name: Ranger of Westernesse
lore: The road may pass, but they shall not!
text: Ranger. When you play this companion, you may play the fellowship's next site.

name: Well-traveled
lore: With a great many years' experience in the wilds of Middle-earth, Aragorn's skills as guide and tracker were unmatched.
text: To play, exert a  ranger. If the fellowship is in region 1, play the fellowship's next 2 sites. Otherwise, play the fellowship's next site.

name: Archer of Harad
lore: Haradrim bowmen pick off stragglers who rout after losing a battle.
text: Archer. While you can spot a companion who has resistance 4 or less, the minion archery total is +1.

name: Armored Easterling
lore: The Men of the East were well-equipped.
text: Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a lurker strength +1. Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a lurker fierce until the regroup phase. Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a lurker damage +1.

name: Axeman of Harad
lore: Tribes of Harad gather when their enemies appear weak.
text: While you can spot a companion who has resistance 3 or less, this minion's twilight cost is -2.

name: Farin, Emissary of Erebor
subtitle: Emissary of Erebor
lore: 'If we make no answer, the Enemy may move Men of his rule to assail King Brand, and Dáin also.'
text: While Farin is at a battleground or underground site, he gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.)

name: Bloodthirsty
lore: The ferocity of the Dunlendings is not easily slaked.
text: Spot 2 [men] minions to wound an unbound companion.

name: Bold and Cunning
lore: 'Even now he plays a game with peril and wins a throw.'
text: Toil 2. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a [men] minion to discard a possession from play.

name: Column of Easterlings
lore: The military training of the Easterlings is evident in their marching formations.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a [men] minion strength +4.

name: Corps of Harad
lore: When an enemy offers resistance, the Haradrim bloodlust rises to the occasion.
text: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is fierce.

name: Detachment of Haradrim
lore: No mere soldiers, all the Men of Harad are skilled assassins and raiders.
text: Maneuver: Exert this minion to add (1) for each companion who has resistance 5 or less.

name: Easterling Host
lore: Men of the East mass soldiers into huge groups.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Skirmish: Exert Easterling Host and make it strength -2 until the regroup phase to make each other [men] minion strength +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Easterling Shield Wall
lore: Tight columns allow Easterlings to protect each other.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Response: If a [men] minion is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert this minion and remove (1) to prevent that.

name: Elder of Dunland
lore: Experienced warriors gather the disparate tribes for massive raids.
text: While this minion is at a plains site, it is damage +1.

name: Elevated Fire
lore: The war towers of the mûmakil provide a great advantage for archers.
text: Toil 2. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.) Spot a [men] minion to make the minion archery total +3.

name: Fearsome Dunlending
lore: Accustomed as they are to traveling afoot, Dunlending mobs can strike quickly, without warning.
text: Ambush (1). When you play this minion at a plains site, you may spot an unbound companion to make that companion resistance -1 until the end of the turn.

name: Gimli, Lively Combatant
subtitle: Lively Combatant
lore: '...I am content. Till now I have hewn naught but wood since I left Moria.'
text: Damage +1. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may draw a card.

name: Ferocious Haradrim
lore: The killing frenzy of the Southrons is in stark contrast to the cool efficiency of Easterling columns.
text: Archer. Each time a Free Peoples character is killed, each of your [men] minions is strength +3 until the regroup phase.

name: Fletcher of Harad
lore: Makers of bows and arrows have a strong trade for the raiders of Harad.
text: While this minion is at a plains site, it is an archer. While you can spot 6 companions, each [men] minion is an archer.

name: Footman of Dunland
lore: Their savage war bands move swiftly across flat terrain.
text: The fellowship's current site gains plains.

name: Force of Harad
lore: Alliances between Haradrim tribes are fragile things which sometimes break down in battle.
text: When you cannot spot another [men] minion, discard this minion.

name: Harad Standard-bearer
lore: The strange craftsmen of Haradwaith fashion their war banners from woven wood.
text: Skirmish: Remove (3) to make this minion damage +1.

name: Horde of Harad
lore: Raiders and brigands they may be, but in force the Southron fighters are terrifying.
text: While this minion is at a battleground site, it is fierce.

name: Invading Haradrim
lore: The cruel Men of Harad slaughter the weak and infirm during their raids on Gondor.
text: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a skirmish, add (1) for each Free Peoples character who has resistance 5 or less.

name: Láthspell
lore: '...ill news is an ill guest they say.'
text: To play, spot a [men] minion. Bearer must be a companion. While bearer is skirmishing a [men] minion, bearer loses all strength and damage bonuses from possessions.

name: Legion of Harad
lore: The bellicose families of Harad cannot often agree, but when they do, they form a formidable army.
text: Toil 2. (For each [men] character you exert when playing this, its twilight cost is -2.)

name: Long Battle Bow
lore: Southron accuracy with bows is legendary.
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. Bearer is an archer. When you play this possession, you may make the Free Peoples player exert his or her Man.

name: Gimli's Battle Axe, Vicious Weapon
subtitle: Vicious Weapon
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer gains muster. (At the start of the regroup phase, you may discard a card from hand to draw a card.) Skirmish: If bearer is Gimli and he is at a battleground site, exert him to wound a minion he is skirmishing.

name: Man of Bree
lore: One or two gave Frodo a blank look and departed muttering among themselves.
text: This minion is strength +1 for each card in the Free Peoples player's hand.

name: Oath Sworn
lore: 'We will fight for you!'
text: At the start of the maneuver phase, if you have 2 or more cards in hand, you may spot 2 [men] minions and discard your hand to add (8).

name: Overrun
lore: An Easterling column strikes with terrific force.
text: Make a [men] minion strength +2 (or +4 if that minion is at a battleground or plains site).

name: Patroller of Haradrim
lore: Disarming strikes are common among the tactics of the Men of Harad.
text: Each time this minion is assigned to a character who has resistance 5 or less, you may discard a possession borne by that character.

name: Pavise
lore: An Easterling shield covers almost the entire body.
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. The twilight cost of this possession is -1 for each Free Peoples possession you spot. Bearer cannot take wounds except during a skirmish.

name: Poleaxe
lore: Many of the Men of the East march into battle carrying heavy bladed polearms.
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. Skirmish: Remove (2) to make a [men] minion fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Precision Targeting
lore: Arrows fired in volleys will never be as effective as one loosed by a skilled archer.
text: Spot a [men] minion to make the minion archery total +1 and to make the Free Peoples player choose 3 companions. Other companions cannot take archery wounds.

name: Raging Dunlending
lore: Furious hatred over the land they've lost drives the mobs of Dunland.
text: When you play this minion, you may exert it to make it fierce until the regroup phase. While you can spot 6 companions, each [men] minion is fierce.

name: Rampaging Easterling
lore: The fury of the Eastern warriors grows in battle.
text: Lurker. (Skirmishes involving lurker minions must be resolved after any others.) Each time another [men] minion wins a skirmish, make this minion strength +3 until the regroup phase.

name: Squad of Haradrim
lore: Small, harassing bands of Haradrim skirmishers make moving troops difficult.
text: Regroup: Spot another [men] minion and 2 Free Peoples characters who each have resistance 5 or less to make the move limit -1 for this turn.

name: Aggression
lore: 'Certainty of death, small chance of success....'
text: While you have initiative, each Dwarf is damage +1. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to draw X cards. Discard this condition.

name: Legolas, Elven Stalwart
subtitle: Elven Stalwart
lore: ...Legolas of the Elves, for whom the ghosts of Men have no terror.
text: Archer. While you can spot 3 wounded minions, each minion skirmishing Legolas is strength -3.

name: Gorgoroth Servitor
lore: ...hurrying orcs were digging... just out of bowshot from the walls....
text: Besieger. Archery: Return this minion to your hand to make the fellowship archery total -2 and prevent the Free Peoples player from using archery special abilities.

name: Gorgoroth Stormer
lore: '...they found the enemy already on the out-wall, or assailing it....'
text: Besieger. Shadow: If you have initiative, exert this minion to add a burden and make the Free Peoples player draw a card.

name: Great Hill Troll
lore: ...and wielded heavy hammers in their knotted hands.
text: Besieger. Fierce. The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each [sauron] engine you spot. When you play this minion at sites 5[K] to 9[K], you may discard a Free Peoples condition.

name: Grond, Hammer of the Underworld
subtitle: Hammer of the Underworld
text: Engine. Shadow: Play a [sauron] minion to add a [sauron] token here. Regroup: Remove X [sauron] tokens here to discard a Free Peoples card (except a companion) with a twilight cost of X. Discard a [sauron] minion or this possession.

name: Morgai
text: While you can spot a [sauron] minion at site 5[K], the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand. Response: If a companion is played, discard a [sauron] card from hand to take control of a site. Discard this condition.

name: Olog-hai of Mordor
text: Besieger. Fierce. The twilight cost of this minion is -2 for each [sauron] minion stacked on a site. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a besieger stacked on a site you control. That besieger is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Siege Troop
lore: ...yet still driven as if by a madness....
text: Besieger. Regroup: Exert this minion twice to take control of a site.

name: Their Marching Companies
lore: ...and soon yet more companies of the enemy were swiftly setting up....
text: Engine. To play, spot a [sauron] minion. Regroup: Remove a threat to stack your [sauron] minion on a site you control. Shadow: Remove a threat to play a [sauron] minion stacked on a site you control.

name: Troll of Gorgoroth, Abomination of Sauron
subtitle: Abomination of Sauron
lore: ...they could endure the Sun, so long as the will of Sauron held sway over them.
text: Besieger. Fierce. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc. The twilight cost of Troll of Gorgoroth is -2 for each [sauron] engine you spot. Regroup: Exert Troll of Gorgoroth to stack your besieger on a site you control.

name: Closer and Closer He Bent
lore: Pippin sat with his knees drawn up and the ball between them. He bent low over it, looking like a greedy child stooping over a bowl of food.
text: Regroup: Exert an unbound Hobbit and add a burden to reveal your hand. Place each Free Peoples card revealed this way beneath your draw deck.

name: Life of the Eldar
lore: 'Your hands are cold....'
text: To play, spot 2 Elves. Discard an Elf to draw 3 cards.

name: Morgai Foothills
text: When the fellowship moves from site 4[K], remove (1) for each Ring-bound companion you spot. Regroup: Discard a card from hand for each Ring-bound companion you spot. Discard this condition.

name: So Fair, So Desperate
lore: She should not die.... At least she should not die alone, unaided.
text: If the Shadow has initiative, add a threat to make an unbound Hobbit strength +1 for each [shire] card you spot.

name: Song of the Shire
text: Fellowship: Exert a [shire] companion and either a [rohan] companion or a [gandalf] companion to add a [shire] token here. Skirmish: Remove a [shire] token here to prevent an unbound companion from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

name: Sting, Bane of the Eight Legs
subtitle: Bane of the Eight Legs
lore: No such anguish had Shelob ever known, or dreamed of knowing....
text: Bearer must be Frodo or Sam. Response: If a fierce skirmish involving bearer is about to end, add a threat to discard a minion involved in that skirmish.

name: Straining Towards Us
lore: '...blind almost to all else that is moving. So we must keep it. Therein lies all our hope.'
text: Exert Frodo to remove (1) for each Frodo signet you spot.

name: Unheeded
lore: ...and passing up beneath the hauberk had pierced the sinew behind his mighty knee.
text: If a minion exerts, exert an unbound Hobbit to wound that minion.

name: We Shall Meet Again Soon
lore: 'He said: \"Who are you?\" I still did not answer, but it hurt me horribly; and he pressed me, so I said: \"A hobbit.\"'
text: If the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, exert an unbound Hobbit to place a Shadow card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

name: The Dimholt
text: Underground. Sanctuary. Fellowship: Add 3 threats to play an enduring companion from your draw deck.

name: City of the Dead
text: Underground. Shadow: Remove 2 burdens to play an enduring minion from your draw deck or discard pile.

name: Crashed Gate
text: At the start of the regroup phase, the Free Peoples player must add 3 threats or choose an opponent who may take control of a site.

name: Reckless We Rode
lore: '...driving them like leaves....'
text: Exert an Elf companion and make the fellowship archery total -X (to a minimum of 0) to wound a minion X times. You cannot use archery special abilities.

name: Osgiliath Channel
text: River. Regroup: Spot your minion and 6 companions to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn.

name: Merry, Noble Warrior
subtitle: Noble Warrior
lore: King's man! King's man!' his heart cried within him.
text: To play, spot a [rohan] companion. Skirmish: Discard 4 cards from hand to make Merry strength +2 for each [rohan] companion you spot.

name: Pippin, Guard of Minas Tirith
subtitle: Guard of Minas Tirith
lore: 'You're in the service of the Steward of Gondor now. You'll do as you're told.'
text: To play, spot a [gondor] Man. Skirmish: Discard 4 cards from hand to wound a minion Pippin is skirmishing twice if that minion bears a fortification.

name: Shake Off the Shadow
lore: 'Speak and be comforted....'
text: Fellowship: Exert an Elf companion and either a [gandalf] companion or a [dwarven] companion to add an [elven] token here. Archery: Remove an [elven] token here to make the fellowship archery total +1 (limit +2).

name: A Fool
lore: '...but an honest fool he remains.'
text: At sites 1[K] to 5[K], heal Gandalf. At any other site, prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

name: Gandalf, Leader of Men
subtitle: Leader of Men
lore: '...the rule of no realm is mine, neither of Gondor nor any other, great or small.'
text: When Gandalf is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -2.

name: Let Us Not Tarry
lore: 'There is much to say and to do, and you are weary.'
text: Exert Gandalf to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -1 for each Gandalf signet you spot.

name: Mighty Steed
lore: 'He always turns up when things are darkest. Go on! Go on, White Rider! Gandalf! Gandalf!'
text: If Gandalf is not assigned to a skirmish, spot Shadowfax or exert Gandalf to have Gandalf replace an unbound companion in a skirmish.

name: Not the First Halfling
text: Fellowship: Exert Gandalf and either an [elven] companion or a [shire] companion to add a [gandalf] token here. Skirmish: Remove a [gandalf] token here to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -2.

name: On Your Doorstep
lore: 'Lord Denethor is a Steward only.'
text: Spot Gandalf and exert a companion to place a card of that companion's culture from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

name: Battle in Earnest
lore: '...they laughed when they looked on us, for they were a great army still.'
text: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to place X wounds on minions.

name: Saved From the Fire
lore: '...we will bear Faramir, Steward of Gondor, to a place where he can sleep in peace....'
text: Spot Gandalf and place a companion (except the Ring-bearer) in the dead pile to take up to 3 cards from that companion's culture into hand from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.

name: Shadowfax, Greatheart
subtitle: Greatheart
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, each minion skirmishing Gandalf must exert. Skirmish: Add a threat to make Gandalf strength +1.

name: Hidden Even From Her
lore: ...even when he had come to her again and had bowed low....
text: Gollum is fierce. Shadow: Spot 6 companions to play Gollum from your discard pile and exert a companion. Place this condition on top of your draw deck.

name: Larder
lore: 'When she binds with cords, she's after meat.'
text: To play, spot a [gollum] minion. Regroup: Discard an Orc from hand to add a [gollum] token here. Skirmish: Remove a [gollum] token here to make Shelob strength +3 (limit +6).

name: Promise Keeping
lore: 'And we'll save the Precious, as we promised.... Then we'll pay everyone back!'
text: Each time a companion takes a wound during a skirmish that involves a [gollum] minion, exert a companion.

name: Shelob, Eater of Light
subtitle: Eater of Light
lore: ...who only desired death for all others....
text: Fierce. When you play Shelob, you may play a [gollum] possession from your draw deck. Shelob is strength +3 for each minion stacked on a [gollum] possession.

name: Shelob, Last Child of Ungoliant
subtitle: Last Child of Ungoliant
lore: ...for all living things were her food, and her vomit darkness.
text: Enduring. Fierce. While in a fierce skirmish, Shelob is damage +1.

name: Sméagol, Slippery Sneak
subtitle: Slippery Sneak
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Skirmish: Add threats equal to the total vitality of the minions Sméagol is skirmishing to discard Sméagol. Regroup: Discard Sméagol to take a [gollum] minion from your discard pile into hand.

name: Spider Poison
lore: He lay now pale, and heard no voice, and did not move.
text: Skirmish: Remove a threat or a burden to transfer this possession to a companion skirmishing Shelob. Each time bearer is assigned to a skirmish, bearer must exert.

name: Still Far Ahead
lore: ...the very crown of this bitter road.
text: Spot Sméagol to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary). The Shadow number of the fellowship's next site is -1 until the end of the turn.

name: Blood Runs Chill
lore: ...the Dark Door gaped before them like the mouth of night.
text: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X and exert that Dwarf to make an opponent discard X Shadow cards.

name: Web
lore: 'Caught in a web. Soon he'll be eaten!'
text: Regroup: If there are fewer than 3 cards stacked here, spot your Orc or [gollum] minion to stack that minion here. Shadow: Play a [gollum] minion stacked here as if played from hand.

name: At His Command
lore: 'Even the shades of Men are obedient to his will....'
text: Exert Aragorn to make an unbound companion with the Aragorn signet strength +1 for each threat you spot.

name: Catapult
text: To play, spot 2 [gondor] knights. Maneuver: Discard 2 cards from hand to reveal the top card of an opponent's draw deck. Choose an opponent who must discard a Shadow card that has a twilight cost that is the same as the twilight cost of the revealed card.

name: Elessar's Edict
lore: 'Yes, the Dead ride behind. They have been summoned....'
text: If a [gondor] Wraith is about to be killed, discard him and either exhaust another [gondor] Wraith or spot another exhausted [gondor] Wraith to prevent that.

name: Faramir, Defender of Osgiliath
subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath
lore: '...I will go and do what I can in his stead – if you command it.'
text: Knight. When you play Faramir (except in your starting fellowship), you may reveal the top 10 cards of your draw deck. You may play a knight revealed. Shuffle your draw deck.

name: Fourth Level
lore: ...about each was set a wall....
text: Fortification. Skirmish: Exert 2 [gondor] Men or spot 3 knights to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man. Exhaust that minion.

name: Garrison of Gondor
lore: But about the Gate resistance still was stout....
text: Knight. Archer. To play, spot 3 [gondor] companions. While you can spot a fortification, Garrison of Gondor is defender +1.

name: Imrahil, Prince of Dol Amroth
subtitle: Prince of Dol Amroth
lore: ...he was of high blood, and his folk also, tall men and proud with sea-grey eyes.
text: Knight. To play, spot a knight. Each time Imrahil wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 minions.

name: King of the Dead, Oathbreaker
subtitle: Oathbreaker
lore: '...crying out that the King of the Dead was upon them.'
text: Enduring. To play, spot a [gondor] Wraith and add 2 threats. Response: If Aragorn is about to take a wound in a skirmish, exert King of the Dead to prevent that wound.

name: Knight of Dol Amroth
lore: Amroth for Gondor!' they cried.
text: Knight. Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion he is skirmishing.

name: Counts But One
lore: '...no matter how big.'
text: If Gimli is not assigned to a skirmish, add a threat to have him replace an unbound companion in a skirmish.

name: Knight's Mount
lore: Like thunder they broke upon the enemy....
text: Bearer must be a knight. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion who is not assigned to a skirmish.

name: Oathbreaker
lore: at the Stone of Erech they shall stand again / and hear there a horn in the hills ringing.
text: Enduring. To play, add a threat. Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to discard a possession borne by a minion skirmishing this companion.

name: A Path Appointed
lore: '...those who follow me do so of their free will....'
text: Fellowship: Exert a [gondor] Man and either a [dwarven] companion or a [rohan] companion to add a [gondor] token here. Regroup: Remove a [gondor] token here to discard a minion.

name: Shadow Host
lore: ...fear went on before them, until they came to Calembel upon Ciril, and the sun went down like blood behind Pinnath Gelin....
text: Enduring. To play, spot 2 exhausted [gondor] Wraiths and add 2 threats. While Shadow Host is exhausted, it is defender +1.

name: Sixth Level
lore: ...and in each wall was a gate.
text: Fortification. Regroup: Exert a [gondor] Man to play a [gondor] fortification from your discard pile (limit 1).

name: Sleepless Dead
lore: '...for the Dead needed no longer any weapon but fear. None would withstand them.'
text: Enduring. To play, add a threat. Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may exert him to discard a minion he is skirmishing.

name: Spectral Sword
lore: '...pale banners like shreds of cloud, and spears like winter-thickets on a misty night.'
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Wraith. Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to heal bearer.

name: Stronger and More Terrible
lore: 'And lo! in the darkness of Mordor my hope rose....'
text: To play, add a threat. Each time your [gondor] Wraith wins a skirmish, you may remove a threat.

name: Swept Away
lore: 'And suddenly the Shadow Host that had hung back at the last came up like a grey tide, sweeping all away before it.'
text: Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. While you have initiative, exhausted [gondor] Wraiths cannot take wounds.

name: Black Númenorean
lore: ...corrupted by Sauron, and who hated above all the followers of Elendil.
text: Corsair. Fierce. Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a [raider] token to discard a possession borne by a character skirmishing this minion.

name: Gimli, Counter of Foes
subtitle: Counter of Foes
lore: Twenty, twenty-one, twenty-two....
text: Damage +1. For each wound on Gimli, he is strength +1 and damage +1.

name: Black Sails of Umbar
text: When you play this possession, you may add a [raider] token here. Shadow: Remove X [raider] tokens here to play a corsair from your discard pile; its twilight cost is -X. Discard this possession.

name: Castamir of Umbar
lore: 'They have long ceased to fear the might of Gondor.'
text: Corsair. Enduring. Fierce. Shadow: Exert Castamir of Umbar and play a corsair to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

name: Corsair Ballista
lore: Ranged weapons bristled from the warships and aided the Corsairs' plunder of coastal cities.
text: Bearer must be a corsair. While you have initiative, bearer is an archer and fierce.

name: Corsair Buccaneer
lore: '...a great fleet drawing near to the mouths of Anduin....'
text: Corsair. When you play this minion, you may remove a threat to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

name: Corsair Freebooter
lore: ...the strength of the rebels in Umbar was a great peril to Gondor....
text: Corsair. When you play this minion, you may remove 2 culture tokens to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

name: Corsair Gunners
lore: 'The Corsairs are upon us!'
text: Corsair. Skirmish: If you have initiative, remove a [raider] token to make a corsair fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Corsair Lookout
lore: ...watchmen on the walls saw afar a new sight of fear, and their last hope left them.
text: Corsair. When you play this minion, if you have initiative, you may discard an ally to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

name: Corsair Marauder
lore: Umbar remained at war with Gondor for many lives of men....
text: Corsair. When you play this minion, if you can spot another corsair, you may discard a possession to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

name: Corsair Plunderer
lore: ...Umbar... fell into the hands of the Men of Harad.
text: Corsair. When you play this minion, you may discard 2 cards from hand to add 2 [raider] tokens to a card that already has a [raider] token on it.

name: Corsair War Galley
text: When you play this possession, you may add a [raider] token here. While you can spot 6 [raider] tokens and a [raider] Man, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand. Regroup: Add (1) for each [raider] token you can spot. Discard this possession.

name: Honed
lore: 'What are we waiting for?'
text: Spot a Dwarf who is damage +X to make him strength +X.

name: Haradrim Marksman
lore: Archers from Harad rode atop the great war-beasts on the Fields of Pelennor.
text: Southron. Archer. While you can spot another [raider] Man, Ring-bound companions cannot take archery wounds.

name: Haradwaith
text: While you can spot a [raider] minion at site 4[K], the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand. Response: If a companion is played, discard a [raider] card from hand to add (5). Discard this condition.

name: Heavy Axeman
lore: ...the Easterlings were strong and war-hardened and asked for no quarter.
text: Easterling. While you can spot 4 burdens, Heavy Axeman is strength +4 and fierce.

name: Line of Defense
lore: ...and stood like towers of defence....
text: While you can spot a mounted [raider] Man, [raider] Men cannot take wounds (except during skirmishes).

name: Mûmakil
lore: But wherever the mûmakil came there the horses would not go, but blenched and swerved away....
text: Bearer must be a Southron. Bearer is fierce. While you have initiative or can spot 4 threats, bearer is damage +1.

name: Ships of Great Draught
text: Shadow: Remove a threat or discard a [raider] card from hand to add a [raider] token here. Regroup: Remove 2 [raider] tokens here to place a [raider] card from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

name: Wind That Sped Ships
lore: ...black against the glittering stream... a fleet borne up on the wind....
text: Make a corsair strength +1 for each [raider] token you spot (limit +6). If you have initiative, you may place this event on top of your draw deck.

name: Between Nazgûl and Prey
lore: ...the Nazgûl Lord like a shadow of despair.
text: Exert an enduring [wraith] minion twice to assign that minion to an unbound companion.

name: Beyond All Darkness
lore: '...where thy flesh shall be devoured....'
text: Exert a Nazgûl to make him strength +2 and damage +1. If the character he is skirmishing is killed, the Free Peoples player must place his or her hand beneath his or her draw deck.

name: Black Dart
text: Archery: Spot your enduring or mounted Nazgûl to transfer this condition from your support area to an unbound companion. Discard a mount borne by that companion. Bearer cannot heal or bear mounts.

name: Unheard of
lore: '...an Elf will go underground and a Dwarf dare not.'
text: If a Dwarf who is damage +X wins a skirmish, wound a minion not assigned to a skirmish X times.

name: Black Flail
lore: With a cry of hatred that stung the very ears like venom he let fall....
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. Skirmish: If bearer is The Witch-king, exert him and spot a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing to discard that possession.

name: Flung Into the Fray
text: When you play a minion stacked here, you may exert a companion. Regroup: If no minion is stacked here, spot your [wraith] minion to stack it here. Shadow: Spot 2 [wraith] minions to play a [wraith] minion stacked here as if played from hand.

name: Gothmog, Morgul Commander
subtitle: Morgul Commander
lore: 'The age of Men is over.'
text: While you have initiative, each [wraith] minion is an archer.

name: Mastered By Madness
lore: ...then Windfola had thrown them in his terror, and now ran wild upon the plain.
text: Make a Nazgûl strength +2. If that Nazgûl wins this skirmish, you may discard a Free Peoples mount.

name: Morgul Ambusher
lore: 'Fear, the City is rank with it.'
text: While you can spot 3 threats, the minion archery total is +2.

name: Morgul Creeper
lore: 'Kill all in your path!'
text: While you can spot 3 burdens, the minion archery total is +2.

name: Morgul Lurker
lore: 'The time of the Orc has come.'
text: While you have initiative, the minion archery total is +2.

name: Morgul Squealer
text: Shadow: Discard this minion to play a [wraith] minion from your discard pile. Shadow: Spot 6 companions and discard this minion to play up to 2 [wraith] minions from your draw deck; their twilight costs are each -1.

name: Streaming to the Field
lore: They had been mustered....
text: For each [wraith] Orc you can spot, the Free Peoples player must have an additional card in hand to have initiative. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [wraith] Orc strength +2.

name: Úlairë Attëa, Thrall of The One
subtitle: Thrall of The One
lore: 'They are looking for something, surely?'
text: Enduring. Regroup: Exert Úlairë Attëa and spot your [wraith] minion to return that minion to your hand.

name: Wish For Our Kinfolk
lore: '...war already marches on their own lands.'
text: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf companion and either an [elven] companion or a [gondor] Man to add a [dwarven] token here. Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token here to make a companion damage +1.

name: Úlairë Nertëa, Thrall of The One
subtitle: Thrall of The One
lore: ...into their minds a blackness came, and they thought no more of war, but only of hiding and of crawling, and of death.
text: Enduring. Fierce. The site number of each [wraith] minion is -1.

name: Úlairë Otsëa, Thrall of The One
subtitle: Thrall of The One
lore: Another long screech rose and fell, and he threw himself back again from the wall, panting like a hunted animal.
text: Enduring. Fierce. Regroup: Discard Úlairë Otsëa to add (X), where X is the current site number.

name: Unhindered
lore: 'No living man may hinder me!'
text: Make a Nazgûl strength +2. If that Nazgûl wins this skirmish, the Shadow has initiative until the end of the turn, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.

name: Winged Mount
lore: A creature of an older world maybe it was....
text: To play, discard 2 cards from hand. Bearer must be a Nazgûl. Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, remove a threat to prevent that wound.

name: The Witch-king, Black Captain
subtitle: Black Captain
lore: 'Do not stop the attack until the City is taken.'
text: Enduring. Each Man skirmishing The Witch-king loses all strength bonuses from weapons.

name: Charged Headlong
lore: ...and the black serpent foundered.
text: If you have initiative, discard a [rohan] possession to play a [rohan] possession from your discard pile.

name: Doom Drove Them
lore: Sea-kings' city in the South-kingdom / foe- beleaguered, fire-encircled.
text: Fellowship: Exert a [rohan] companion and either a [gondor] Man or a [shire] companion to add a [rohan] token here. Skirmish: Remove a [rohan] token here to exert a minion skirmishing a companion.

name: Éomer, Keeper of Oaths
subtitle: Keeper of Oaths
lore: 'Need brooks no delay, yet late is better than never....'
text: Valiant. When you play Éomer (except in your starting fellowship), you may reveal the top 10 cards of your draw deck. You may play each [rohan] possession revealed. Shuffle your draw deck.

name: Éowyn's Shield
lore: '...spear shall be shaken, shield shall be splintered....'
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. The minion archery total is -1. Skirmish: If bearer is Éowyn, add a threat and discard Éowyn's Shield to discard a hand weapon borne by a minion she is skirmishing.

name: Fury of the Northmen
lore: 'Death! Ride, ride to ruin and the world's ending!'
text: Exert a minion skirmishing a mounted [rohan] Man.

name: A Grey Ship
lore: '...full of ghosts.'
text: Spot an Elf companion and make the fellowship archery total -X (to a minimum of 0) to heal X unbound companions. You cannot use archery special abilities.

name: No Living Man
lore: 'Begone, foul dwimmerlaik, lord of carrion!'
text: Exert Théoden to exert a minion for each Théoden signet you spot.

name: Rohirrim Army
lore: ...like a storm upon the plain and a thunder in the mountains.
text: To play, spot 3 [rohan] companions. You may play Rohirrim Army any time you could play a regroup event. When you play Rohirrim Army, you may discard a minion.

name: Théoden, Tall and Proud
subtitle: Tall and Proud
lore: 'Up Eorlingas! Fear no darkness!'
text: Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Théoden's twilight cost is -1. When Théoden is killed, you may play a [rohan] companion from your discard pile or draw deck.

name: Called Away
lore: 'Thus the will of Sauron has entered into Minas Tirith; and thus I have been delayed here.'
text: Regroup: Discard a [sauron] minion, spot a companion (except the Ring-bearer), and remove X burdens, where X is that companion's vitality, to return that companion to its owner's hand.

name: Gorgoroth Agitator
text: Besieger. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc. When you play this minion, if you can spot another besieger, you may add a threat for each companion over 4. Shadow: Remove a threat to play a [sauron] engine from your discard pile.

name: Gorgoroth Assassin
lore: ...filled with malice, hating even their own kind....
text: Besieger. Assignment: Spot a [sauron] engine or a site you control to assign this minion to an unbound companion.

name: Gorgoroth Berserker
text: Besieger. Enduring. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc. Maneuver: If you have initiative, exert this minion twice to take control of a site. Maneuver: Remove a threat and exert this minion twice to take control of a site.

name: Gorgoroth Breaker
lore: 'The City is all set about with flame, and the field is full of foes.'
text: Besieger. Archery: Exert this minion or stack it on a site you control to make the fellowship archery total -2.

name: Gorgoroth Looter
lore: ...the hosts of Mordor were enheartened, and filled with a new lust and fury they came yelling....
text: Besieger. When you play this minion, you may remove a burden to play a besieger stacked on a site you control.

name: Gorgoroth Patrol
lore: ...new strength came now streaming to the field out of Osgiliath.
text: Besieger. Regroup: If this minion is stacked on a site you control, discard this minion to make the move limit for this turn -1.

name: Dain Ironfoot, Lord of the Iron Hills
subtitle: Lord of the Iron Hills

name: Azog, Commander of the Wolves Army
subtitle: Commander of the Wolves Army

name: Bolg, Captain of the Orc Army
subtitle: Captain of the Orc Army

name: Ring of Thror, Last of the Seven Rings
subtitle: Last of the Seven Rings

name: The One Ring, Isildur's Bane
subtitle: Isildur's Bane
lore: '...the Ring slipped from his finger as he swam....'
text: Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, add 2 burdens instead.

name: Dwarven Heart
lore: '...a Dwarf goes on, be the burden twice his own weight....'
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. When you play this condition, heal bearer up to 2 times. At the start of each of your turns, exert bearer.

name: The Choice of Lúthien
lore: 'But she chose mortality, and to die from the world, so that she might follow him; and it is sung that they met again beyond the Sundering Seas....'
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to heal Arwen, or exert Arwen to heal Aragorn.

name: Coat of Mail
lore: Soldiers of the White Tower have long appreciated the craftsmanship of the Gondorian metalsmiths.
text: Bearer must be a Man. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

name: Dagger Strike
lore: Every warrior needs a sword, bow, or axe – but sometimes, a dagger is enough.
text: Skirmish: Make a [gondor] or [shire] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Elendil's Valor
lore: 'In panoply of ancient kings, / in chainéd rings he armoured him; / his shining shield was scored with runes / to ward all wounds and harm from him....'
text: Maneuver: Make a [gondor] companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Eregion's Trails
lore: Guided by Aragorn they struck a good path. It looked to Frodo like the remains of an ancient road, that had once been broad and well planned....
text: Maneuver: Exert a ranger to make each roaming minion strength -3 until the regroup phase.

name: Foes of Mordor
lore: Through the long years, the Men of the Tower of Guard have shielded the West from the minions of the Eye.
text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Exert a [gondor] character to wound a [sauron] minion.

name: Gondor's Vengeance
lore: A Ranger in the wild is a deadly foe for the forces of the Shadow.
text: Regroup: Exert a ranger companion to discard a minion.

name: Great Shield
lore: The Kingdom of Gondor has smiths much practiced in creating strong tools of war.
text: Bearer must be a Man. The minion archery total is -1.

name: No Stranger to the Shadows
lore: 'Ah, but you had not got me with you then,' laughed Strider. 'My cuts, short or long, don't go wrong.'
text: Bearer must be a ranger. Limit 1 per ranger. Each site's Shadow number is -1.

name: One Whom Men Would Follow
lore: 'The skill of the elves can reforge the Sword of Elendil – but only you have the power to wield it.'
text: Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to spot an ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +2 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.

name: Farin, Dwarven Emissary
subtitle: Dwarven Emissary
lore: Among the envoys sent to represent the Dwarves of Erebor at the Council of Elrond was Farin, a young but wise Dwarf, and a fierce foe in battle.
text: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Orc, Farin is strength +2.

name: Pathfinder
lore: 'Strider can take you by paths that are seldom trodden. Will you have him?'
text: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot a ranger to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

name: Pursuit Just Behind
lore: 'We must do something to delay the enemy first. We will make them fear the Chamber of Mazarbul!'
text: Regroup: Exert a ranger companion to wound every minion.

name: Ranger's Sword
lore: Aragorn is a trustworthy companion and a deadly foe. His years roaming the wild have honed his swordfighting skills.
text: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is damage +1.

name: A Ranger's Versatility
lore: 'If you bring a Ranger with you, it is well to pay attention to him, especially if the Ranger is Aragorn.'
text: Maneuver: Exert a ranger at a river or forest to exhaust a minion.

name: The Saga of Elendil
lore: From out of the depths of the Sea, from the foundered land of Númenor, came Elendil to Middle-earth to found the kingdoms of Arnor and Gondor.
text: Tale. Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +2.

name: Strength of Kings
lore: 'Believe not that in the land of Gondor the blood of Númenor is spent, nor all its pride and dignity forgotten.'
text: Response: If a skirmish event is played during a skirmish involving a [gondor] Man, cancel that event.

name: Swordarm of the White Tower
lore: By our valour the wild folk of the East are still restrained, and the terror of Morgul kept at bay; and thus alone are peace and freedom maintained in the 'lands behind us, bulwark of the West.'
text: Skirmish: Make a [gondor] companion strength +2 (or +4 if he or she is defender +1).

name: Swordsman of the Northern Kingdom
lore: 'This is no mere Ranger. He is Aragorn, son of Arathorn... and you owe him your allegiance.'
text: Skirmish: Make a ranger strength +2 (or +4 when skirmishing a roaming minion).

name: Valiant Man of the West
lore: '...I swore to protect you.'
text: Maneuver: Make Aragorn defender +1 and he takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase until the regroup phase.

name: What Are They?
lore: 'They were men... once.'
text: Maneuver: Spot a ranger to discard a roaming minion.

name: Gimli, Dwarf of Erebor
subtitle: Dwarf of Erebor
lore: Gimli now walked ahead by the wizard's side, so eager was he to come to Moria.
text: Damage +1. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, add (2) to place a card from hand beneath your draw deck.

name: Alive and Unspoiled
lore: 'Bring them to me.... Kill the others....'
text: To play, exert an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) and spot X burdens to make the Free Peoples player reveal X cards at random from hand. You may discard 1 revealed card.

name: Bred for Battle
lore: 'You are the Uruk-hai of Isengard!... you do not know pain, you do not know fear.'
text: Skirmish: Exert an Uruk-hai to make it strength +3.

name: Breeding Pit
lore: 'He is breeding an army in the Caverns of Isengard. An army that can move in sunlight and cover great distance at speed.'
text: Response: If you play an Uruk-hai, take all copies of that card in your discard pile and place them beneath your draw deck.

name: Caradhras Has Not Forgiven Us
lore: 'It was no ordinary storm. It is the ill will of Caradhras.'
text: Spell. Weather. Maneuver: Exert an [isengard] minion and spot 5 companions to discard an exhausted companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Cruel Caradhras
lore: 'Yonder stands Barazinbar, the Redhorn, cruel Caradhras....'
text: Spell. Weather. Maneuver: Exert an [isengard] minion to make the opponent choose to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.

name: Greed
lore: 'It is a strange fate that we should suffer so much fear and doubt over so small a thing....'
text: To play, spot an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions and remove (2) to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Hunt Them Down!
lore: 'Do not stop until they are found!'
text: Maneuver: Make an Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Lurtz, Servant of Isengard
subtitle: Servant of Isengard
lore: 'And now... perfected. Grown beyond the height of Men – straight-limbed and strong, fearing nothing.'
text: Archer. Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot another Uruk-hai to make Lurtz fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Lurtz's Battle Cry
lore: 'Find the Halflings!'
text: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength -1 and damage +1.

name: The Misadventure of Mr. Underhill
lore: 'You're drawing far too much attention to yourself... Mr. Underhill.'
text: To play, exert an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of each companion played to a site which is not a sanctuary is +2.

name: Gimli, Son of Glóin
subtitle: Son of Glóin
lore: There was a younger dwarf at Glóin's side: his son Gimli.
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Gimli to make him strength +2.

name: No Ordinary Storm
lore: 'So Gandalf... you try to lead them over Caradhras. And if that fails – where then will you go?'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time you play a weather condition, exert a [gandalf] companion or [gandalf] ally.

name: Orthanc Assassin
lore: Black-feathered arrows from Uruk-hai bows reign over the corpses of Saruman's enemies.
text: Archer. Damage +1.

name: Parry
lore: Even the sword of a powerful warrior can be parried by the strength of an Uruk-hai.
text: Maneuver: Spot an Uruk-hai to cancel the strength bonus from a possession until the regroup phase.

name: Saruman's Ambition
lore: 'I did not expect you to show wisdom, even in your own behalf; but I gave you the chance of aiding me willingly, and so saving yourself much trouble and pain.'
text: Plays to your support area. The twilight cost of your [isengard] events is -1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an Uruk-hai strength +2.

name: Saruman's Chill
lore: Saruman's hand can control the chill of winter.
text: Spell. Weather. To play, exert an [isengard] minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site. Each Hobbit who moves from this site must exert. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

name: Saruman's Frost
lore: The small and weak suffer first from the White Wizard's powerful sorcery.
text: Spell. Weather. To play, exert an [isengard] minion. Plays on a site. Limit 1 per site. Each Hobbit at this site is strength -2. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

name: Saruman's Power
lore: The Uruks of Saruman are bred to be the instruments of his will, destroying his enemies with foul cruelty.
text: Spell. Shadow: Exert an [isengard] minion to discard all conditions.

name: Saruman's Reach
lore: Saruman used both magic and minions to impose his will.
text: Search. Maneuver: Exert an Uruk-hai to make the opponent choose to either exert 2 companions or make the Ring-bearer put on The One Ring until the regroup phase.

name: Saruman's Snows
lore: Saruman's spells can hinder even the wary.
text: Spell. Weather. To play, exert an [isengard] minion. Plays on a site. No player may play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes at this site. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

name: Savagery to Match Their Numbers
lore: Uruk-hai match their enemies' strength with their own feral rage.
text: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2, or spot 5 companions to make an Uruk-hai strength +4 and fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Gimli's Battle Axe
lore: Beside them Gimli stood with his stout legs apart, wielding his dwarf-axe.
text: Bearer must be Gimli. He is damage +1. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may wound an Orc.

name: Spies of Saruman
lore: '...they are crebain out of Fangorn or Dunland. I do not know what they are about....'
text: To play, exert an [isengard] minion. Plays on a site. While the fellowship is at this site, skip the archery phase. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

name: Their Arrows Enrage
lore: The ferocious charge of the Uruk-hai catches enemy archers groping for their swords.
text: To play, spot Saruman or an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Each archer companion and archer ally is strength -1.

name: Traitor's Voice
lore: 'In all the long wars with the Dark Tower treason has ever been our greatest foe.'
text: Search. To play, spot an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. While the Ring-bearer is exhausted or you can spot 5 burdens, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).

name: Troop of Uruk-hai
lore: Attacking in swarming hordes, the Uruk-hai close with the enemy rapidly to make weapons useless.
text: Damage +1. A character skirmishing this minion does not gain strength bonuses from weapons.

name: Uruk Bloodlust
lore: 'Take them alive!'
text: Plays to your support area. Response: If your Uruk-hai wins a skirmish, remove (1) to heal him.

name: Uruk Brood
lore: 'He does not see the caverns hidden deep beneath this tower... nor does he know what is growing there.'
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Remove (2) to make this minion strength +1 for each other Uruk-hai you spot.

name: Uruk Fighter
lore: Not stealth or cunning, but strength and ferocity are the weapons of Saruman's army of abominations.
text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 5 companions to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Uruk Guard
lore: 'Wolves and orcs were housed in Isengard, for Saruman was mustering a great force....'
text: Damage +1. Assignment: Exert this minion and spot a companion to prevent the opponent from assigning that companion to this minion.

name: Uruk Lieutenant
lore: Uruk-hai leaders gain savagery from their following hordes to maintain the rule of the strong.
text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each other Uruk-hai you can spot.

name: Uruk Messenger
lore: Saruman uses his Uruks abroad to gain information on the movements – and weaknesses – of his many enemies.
text: Damage +1. While you can spot a weather condition, this minion is strength +3.

name: Gimli's Helm
lore: A helm fashioned under the Lonely Mountain protects the head of Gimli the Dwarf.
text: Bearer must be Gimli. He takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. Skirmish: Discard Gimli's Helm to prevent all wounds to him.

name: Uruk Rager
lore: A bloodthirsty bellow from a huge Uruk can win a skirmish before it begins.
text: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must discard the top 2 cards of his or her draw deck.

name: Uruk Savage
lore: 'The friendship of Saruman is not lightly thrown aside. One ill turn deserves another.... We have work to do.'
text: Damage +1. (When this minion wins a skirmish, add 1 extra wound to the defender.)

name: Uruk Shaman
lore: Uruk shamans know the arts of healing as well as those of battle.
text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Remove (2) to heal an Uruk-hai.

name: Uruk Slayer
lore: A foe who is willing to kill or die outright is a foe to be feared indeed.
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make this minion strength +1 (limit +3).

name: Uruk Soldier
lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai band together as an extremely effective fighting unit.
text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player discard the top card of his draw deck.

name: Uruk Spy
lore: A wary eye on the mission could undo the quest.
text: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, exert this minion. Discard a card from the top of your draw deck for each [isengard] minion you spot. Add a burden for each Shadow card discarded in this way.

name: Uruk Warrior
lore: Powerful and fearless, Uruk-hai warriors are not intimidated by the weapons or numbers of their enemies.
text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions to make this minion fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Uruk-hai Armory
lore: The ranks of Saruman's army include forgers of weapons and armour.
text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot an Uruk-hai, the fellowship archery total is -1.

name: Uruk-hai Raiding Party
lore: 'Imagine, Gandalf, an army – born from the earth of Isengard.'
text: Damage +1. (When this minion wins a skirmish, add 1 extra wound to the defender.)

name: Uruk-hai Rampage
lore: Victory breeds rage in Saruman's foul creations.
text: To play, spot an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Response: If your Uruk-hai wins a skirmish, remove (3) to make him fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Greatest Kingdom of My People
lore: 'With golden roof and silver floor / And runes of power upon the door.'
text: Tale. Exert a Dwarf to play this condition. Plays to your support area. Each time your opponent plays an Orc, that player discards the top card of his or her draw deck.

name: Uruk-hai Sword
lore: Their malevolent strength worsens the wounds from the gruesome weapons of the Uruks.
text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must discard the top card of his or her draw deck.

name: Wariness
lore: Even Hobbits have trouble evading the Uruk-hai.
text: Search. Response: If a stealth event is played, exert or discard your Uruk-hai to cancel that event.

name: Worry
lore: 'One by one, regardless of their strength to good or evil... they fell.'
text: To play, exert an Uruk-hai. Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai, the opponent must choose to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.

name: Ancient Chieftain
lore: ...a huge orc-chieftain, almost man-high, clad in black mail from head to foot, leaped into the chamber; behind him his followers clustered in the doorway.
text: For each other [moria] Orc you can spot, Ancient Chieftain is strength +1.

name: Bitter Hatred
lore: Bitter and long is the hatred of the Orcs for the Elves, and thus they prefer Elves as targets.
text: Archery: Spot a [moria] archer to wound an Elf.

name: Cave Troll of Moria, Scourge of the Black Pit
subtitle: Scourge of the Black Pit
lore: Frodo's quest nearly ended before his companions halted the Cave Troll's ferocious attack.
text: Damage +1. Fierce. To play, spot a [moria] Orc. At an underground site, Cave Troll of Moria's twilight cost is -3.

name: Cave Troll's Hammer
lore: Suddenly the door burst into fragments and the Cave Troll was among them, his huge hammer striking like thunder.
text: Bearer must be Cave Troll of Moria. Cave Troll of Moria is damage +1.

name: Denizens Enraged
lore: ...there came a great noise: a rolling Boom that seemed to come from depths far below, and to tremble in the stone at their feet.
text: Skirmish: Make a [moria] Orc strength +1 for each other [moria] Orc you spot (limit +4).

name: Drums in the Deep
lore: The drum-beats broke out wildly: doom-boom, doom-boom, and then stopped... Doom, doom went the drum-beats again....
text: Skirmish: Make a [moria] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Dwarf).

name: The End Comes
lore: 'They have taken the Bridge and the second hall; we have barred the gates – but cannot hold them for long....'
text: Assignment: Spot 5 [moria] minions to make the Free Peoples player assign the Ring-bearer to a skirmish.

name: Grimir, Dwarven Elder
subtitle: Dwarven Elder
lore: Old and grey after many years spent in exile before the Lonely Mountain was reclaimed, Grimir can still wield his axe with strength.
text: Fellowship: Exert Grimir to shuffle a [dwarven] event from your discard pile into your draw deck.

name: Fool of a Took!
lore: 'Fool of a Took! Throw yourself in next time and rid us of your stupidity!'
text: Shadow: Spot a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer) to reveal cards from the top of your draw deck until you reveal one that is not a [moria] minion. Take the revealed cards into hand.

name: Frenzy
lore: The Goblins of the Misty Mountains, like all of their race, use their teeming numbers to slaughter their foes.
text: Assignment: Assign an exhausted companion (except the Ring-bearer) to skirmish a [moria] Orc.

name: Goblin Archer
lore: An arrow whistled over Frodo's head.
text: Archer. While you can spot another [moria] Orc, the fellowship archery total is -6.

name: Goblin Armory
lore: For scavenging vermin, the weapons of fallen foes are prized possessions.
text: Plays to your support area. Each time you play a [moria] weapon, add (1). Response: If a [moria] Orc is about to take a wound, discard this condition to prevent that wound.

name: Goblin Backstabber
lore: An attack from behind provides a cowardly Goblin with a boldness much like courage.
text: This minion is damage +2 while in the same skirmish as another [moria] Orc.

name: Goblin Domain
lore: The once beautiful kingdom of Khazad-dûm has become Moria, the black pit.
text: Search. To play, spot a [moria] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time a companion is played to site 4 or higher, that companion comes into play exhausted.

name: Goblin Marksman
lore: Arrows fell among them. One struck Frodo and sprang back. Another pierced Gandalf's hat and stuck there like a black feather.
text: Archer. (Add 1 to the minion archery total.)

name: Goblin Patrol Troop
lore: As they ran they heard the beat and echo of many hurrying feet behind. A shrill yell went up: they had been seen. There was a ring and clash of steel.

name: Goblin Runner
lore: ...a great horn was blown in the hall, and answering horns and harsh cries were heard further off. There was a hurrying sound of many feet.
text: When you play this minion, you may add (2).

name: Goblin Scavengers
lore: 'The Orcs have often plundered Moria; there is nothing left in the upper halls.'
text: When you play this minion, you may play a weapon from your discard pile on your [moria] Orc.

name: Halls of My Home
lore: 'I will go and look on the halls of Durin, whatever may wait there....'
text: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf to reveal the top 3 cards of any draw deck. You may discard 1 Shadow card revealed. Return the rest in any order.

name: Goblin Scimitar
lore: Some of the swords were crooked: orc-scimitars with blackened blades.
text: Bearer must be a [moria] Orc. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.

name: Goblin Sneak
lore: Their limber forms allow the Goblins of Moria to slither past barred doors and collapsed passageways.
text: When you play this minion, you may place a [moria] Orc from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.

name: Goblin Spear
lore: Simple creatures with simple weapons can be as deadly as an armoured warrior with fine sword.
text: Bearer must be a [moria] minion. If bearer kills a companion in a skirmish, add 1 burden (or 2 burdens if that companion was a Hobbit).

name: Goblin Swarms
lore: Beyond the fire he saw swarming black figures....
text: Plays to your support area. Response: If your [moria] Orc wins a skirmish, discard cards and wounds on that Orc and stack that Orc on this condition. Shadow: Play an Orc stacked here as if played from hand.

name: Goblin Wallcrawler
lore: Skittering along the walls of Moria, Goblins attack without warning.
text: While at an underground site, this minion is strength +2. While you can spot another [moria] Orc, the fellowship archery total is -1.

name: Goblin Warrior
lore: The ancient enmity between Goblins and Dwarves burns brightly still.
text: When you play this minion, you may discard a [dwarven] ally or [dwarven] condition.

name: Guard Commander
lore: His broad flat face was swart, his eyes were like coals and his tongue was red....
text: Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a [moria] Orc strength +2.

name: Host of Thousands
lore: Killing one is no victory, since a dozen from the warrens below will take his place.
text: Shadow: Play a [moria] Orc from your discard pile.

name: The Long Dark
lore: 'So ended the attempt to retake Moria! It was valiant but foolish. The time is not come yet.'
text: Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves to site 4 or 5, add (2) for each Dwarf companion. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make your [moria] Orc strength +2.

name: Lost to the Goblins
lore: Dwarven graves stood open in plundered disarray.
text: Response: If the Ring-bearer exerts or takes a wound, discard a card from the top of your draw deck for each [moria] minion you spot. For each Shadow card discarded in this way, add a burden (limit 3 burdens).

name: Here Lies Balin, Son of Fundin
lore: 'I have looked on Moria and it is very great, but it has become dark and dreadful; and we have found no sign of my kindred.'
text: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to wound 2 Orcs or to wound 1 Orc twice.

name: Moria Axe
lore: Goblins without scimitars wrest axes from the remains of fallen Dwarves.
text: Bearer must be a [moria] Orc. Bearer is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert bearer to make him strength +2.

name: Moria Scout
lore: Like their kindred in the North, the Orcs of Moria have keen noses, often following their prey by scent.
text: When you play this minion, spot an Elf to add (2).

name: Pinned Down
lore: Arrows whined and whistled down the corridor as he sprang back.
text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [moria] archer, the fellowship archery total is -1.

name: Plundered Armories
lore: The Goblins of Moria have oft plundered the deep armouries of Durin's folk.
text: Plays to your support area. Response: If your [moria] weapon is discarded, play it from your discard pile (that weapon's twilight cost is -1).

name: Relentless
lore: 'Then dig a hole in the ground,' said Legolas, 'if that is more after the fashion of your kind. But you must dig swift and deep, if you wish to hide from Orcs.'
text: Search. Response: If a stealth event is played, spot 3 [moria] minions to cancel that event.

name: Relics of Moria
lore: By both the doors they could now see that many bones were lying, and among them were broken swords and axe-heads, and cloven shields and helms.
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (2) to play a [moria] possession from your discard pile.

name: They Are Coming
lore: 'The last thing written is in a trailing scrawl of elf-letters: they are coming.'
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Discard 3 cards from hand to play a [moria] Orc from your discard pile.

name: Threat of the Unknown
lore: The danger of what lay hidden in the dark was more terrifying than the known perils of Moria.
text: Shadow: Exert your [moria] Orc to draw 2 cards.

name: Through the Misty Mountains
lore: 'One must tread the path that need chooses.'
text: Search. To play, exert a [moria] minion. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves to site 4, 5, or 6 and contains a Dwarf or Elf, the Free Peoples player discards 2 cards at random from hand.

name: Troll's Keyward
lore: Though shorter than a Man, the Troll's Keyward is a deadly adversary.
text: Cave Troll of Moria's twilight cost is -2.

name: The One Ring, The Ruling Ring
subtitle: The Ruling Ring
lore: One Ring to rule them all....
text: Response: If bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, add a burden instead.

name: Let Them Come!
lore: 'There is one Dwarf yet in Moria who still draws breath!'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish against an Orc, discard that Orc. Discard this condition if a Dwarf loses a skirmish.

name: The Underdeeps of Moria
lore: 'I am afraid Balin is buried deep, and maybe something else is buried there too.'
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is a [moria] Orc, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it.

name: Unfamiliar Territory
lore: Knowing the dark terrain of Moria gives Orcs a strategic advantage when attacking their foes.
text: Skirmish: Make a [moria] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing an archer).

name: What Is This New Devilry?
lore: 'This foe is beyond any of you! Run!'
text: Search. To play, exert a [moria] Orc. Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 5 or higher, each companion's twilight cost is +2.

name: All Blades Perish
lore: '...all blades perish that pierce that dreadful King. More deadly to him was the name of Elbereth.'
text: Response: If a Nazgûl is about to take a wound, prevent that wound.

name: All Veils Removed
lore: 'Give up the Halfling...!'
text: Skirmish: Make a Nazgûl strength +2 (or +5 if the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring).

name: Beauty Is Fading
lore: '...the Three will fail, and many fair things will fade and be forgotten.'
text: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgûl to discard a Free Peoples possession or Free Peoples condition. If you can spot no such card, discard an ally or companion (except the Ring-bearer) instead.

name: Bent on Discovery
lore: The riding figure sat quite still.... From inside the hood came a noise as of someone sniffing....
text: Search. Plays to your support area. At the beginning of each of your Shadow phases, draw 1 card. At the end of each of your Shadow phases, exert a Nazgûl or discard this condition.

name: Black Breath
lore: Vile breath infects the living with Shadow.
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl. Burdens and wounds may not be removed from bearer.

name: Black Steed
lore: '...these horses are born and bred to the service of the Dark Lord in Mordor.'
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. While at a plains site, bearer is strength +2. Discard this possession when at an underground site.

name: Blade Tip
text: Plays to your support area. Response: If your Nazgûl wins a skirmish, transfer this condition from your support area to the losing character. Limit 1 per character. Wound bearer at the start of each fellowship phase. (If bearer is the Ring-bearer, add a burden instead.)

name: Lord of Moria
lore: Gimli rushed ahead into the vast, empty chamber to see a huge slab of white stone. Knowing instinctively the significance of this tomb, he fell to his knees, 'overcome with grief.
text: Plays to your support area. Each Dwarf is damage +1.

name: Dark Whispers
lore: 'The Ring... The Ring... The Ring....'
text: Skirmish: Spot 3 burdens to make a Nazgûl strength +1 and damage +1, or spot 6 burdens to make a Nazgûl strength +3 and damage +2.

name: Drawn to Its Power
lore: 'And also the Ring drew them.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion is killed in a skirmish involving a Nazgûl, add a burden.

name: Fear
lore: 'Never has such a thing happened in my time!... Guests unable to sleep in their beds, and good bolsters ruined and all! What are we coming to?'
text: Search. Maneuver: Exert your Nazgûl to discard an ally.

name: Frozen by Fear
lore: ...he was quaking as if he was bitter cold, but his terror was swallowed up in a sudden temptation to put on the Ring.
text: Skirmish: Make a Nazgûl strength +2 (or +3 if the Ring-bearer is assigned to a skirmish that has not resolved).

name: In the Ringwraith's Wake
lore: 'He is fading.... We must get him to my father.'
text: Response: If a Nazgûl wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either exert the Ring-bearer or add a burden.

name: The Master's Will
lore: ...something seemed to be compelling him to disregard all warnings, and he longed to yield.
text: Search. Shadow: Spot X Nazgûl to reveal the top X cards of your draw deck. Take into your hand all [wraith] cards revealed and discard the rest.

name: Morgul Blade
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Skirmish: Discard this possession to transfer Blade Tip from your support area or discard pile to a companion bearer is skirmishing.

name: Morgul Gates
lore: The gates of Minas Morgul issued Nine Riders into the free lands, a blasphemy to ancient kings.
text: Shadow: Play a Nazgûl. His twilight cost is -2.

name: Nazgûl Sword
lore: The weapons of the Nine are wielded by unseen hands willed by Sauron's hate.
text: Bearer must be a Nazgûl. While you can spot 3 burdens, bearer is damage +1.

name: The Nine Servants of Sauron
lore: 'That Black Rider was looking for something... or someone – Frodo?'
text: Search. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a Nazgûl, you may exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Mithril Shaft
lore: 'Mithril! All folk desired it.'
text: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf to discard cards from the top of your draw deck until you choose to stop (limit 5). Add (1) for each card discarded in this way. Take the last card discarded into hand.

name: Not Easily Destroyed
lore: 'They were Kings... great Kings of Men. Sauron gave to them Nine Rings of Power and with them the promise of eternal rule... unending life.'
text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver or Skirmish: Remove (3) to heal a Nazgûl.

name: The Pale Blade
lore: In his wretched grip, the Captain raised a Pale Sword.
text: Bearer must be The Witch-king. He is damage +1. Response: If The Witch-king wins a skirmish, exert him to discard a Free Peoples condition.

name: Paths Seldom Trodden
lore: 'You will have to leave the open road after tonight; for the horsemen will watch it night and day.'
text: Search. To play, spot a Nazgûl. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to replace the fellowship's site with your version of the same site.

name: Relentless Charge
lore: Even the fastest arrows are of no avail against the Black Steeds of the Nine Riders.
text: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgûl to wound every archer companion.

name: Return to Its Master
lore: 'The Riders made straight for you....'
text: Response: If the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring at the end of a skirmish phase, cancel all remaining assignments and assign a Nazgûl to skirmish the Ring-bearer; The One Ring's game text does not apply during this skirmish.

name: Sword of Minas Morgul
lore: The Morgul hilt seared the flesh that would touch it, but the pierce was painless.
text: Bearer must be Úlairë Lemenya. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Úlairë Lemenya to discard a possession borne by a character he is skirmishing.

name: Their Power Is in Terror
lore: 'In dark and loneliness they are strongest... and already some in Bree are in their clutch.'
text: Maneuver: Exert a Nazgûl to wound every ally.

name: Threshold of Shadow
lore: 'They did not need the guidance of their horses any longer: you had become visible to them....'
text: Skirmish: Make a Nazgûl strength +2 (or +4 if you spot 5 burdens).

name: The Twilight World
lore: Immediately, though everything else remained as before, dim and dark, the shapes became terribly clear. He was able to see beneath their black wrappings.
text: Response: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, exert a Nazgûl to add 2 burdens.

name: Úlairë Attëa, Keeper of Dol Guldur
subtitle: Keeper of Dol Guldur
lore: Those that knew the most power as kings were placed in particular ways for the Will of Sauron.
text: Fierce. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make Úlairë Attëa strength +1 (limit +5).

name: Nobody Tosses a Dwarf
lore: 'My folk have never had dealings with any of the servants of the Enemy.'
text: Response: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, make an opponent discard 3 cards from the top of his or her draw deck.

name: Úlairë Cantëa, Lieutenant of Dol Guldur
subtitle: Lieutenant of Dol Guldur
lore: The Ringwraith has no semblance to the Man, its being passed into twilight, life spirit into void.
text: Fierce. Skirmish: Exert Úlairë Cantëa to discard a weapon borne by a character he is skirmishing.

name: Úlairë Enquëa, Lieutenant of Morgul
subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lore: The Nine Riders were embodiments of Sauron's will, searching all of Middle-earth for his prize.
text: Fierce. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions (or 5 burdens) and exert Úlairë Enquëa to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Úlairë Lemenya, Lieutenant of Morgul
subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lore: 'Do you wish them to find you? They are terrible!'
text: Each companion or ally who bears a [wraith] condition is strength -2.

name: Úlairë Nelya, Lieutenant of Morgul
subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lore: Many of the Nine were princes of majesty and power.
text: Fierce. Shadow: Exert Úlairë Nelya and spot an opponent's site to replace it with your site of the same number.

name: Úlairë Nertëa, Messenger of Dol Guldur
subtitle: Messenger of Dol Guldur
lore: Some accepted Sauron's gift for glory and a notion of great deeds.
text: When you play Úlairë Nertëa, for each companion over 4, you may play 1 minion from your discard pile.

name: Úlairë Otsëa, Lieutenant of Morgul
subtitle: Lieutenant of Morgul
lore: ...under their mantles were long grey robes; upon their grey hairs were helms of silver; in their haggard hands were swords of steel.
text: Shadow: Exert Úlairë Otsëa to make a [wraith] minion fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Úlairë Toldëa, Messenger of Morgul
subtitle: Messenger of Morgul
lore: Open, in the name of Mordor!' said a voice thin and menacing.
text: Fierce. Assignment: Spot 4 burdens to assign a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to skirmish Úlairë Toldëa.

name: The Witch-king, Lord of Angmar
subtitle: Lord of Angmar
lore: ...his hair was long and gleaming and on his helm was a crown.
text: Fierce. For each other Nazgûl you can spot, The Witch-king is strength +2.

name: Wreathed in Shadow
lore: They are beings in twilight, without form to catch the points of weapons.
text: To play, spot a Nazgûl. Plays to your support area. Archery: Remove (1) to make the fellowship archery total -1.

name: All Thought Bent on It
lore: '...for the Ring yearns, above all else, to return to the hand of its Master: they are one....'
text: Search. Maneuver: Spot a [sauron] Orc and 5 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion for each companion over 4.

name: Stairs of Khazad-dûm
lore: 'Moria – Khazad-dûm! Greatest of the dwarf-halls – What I would not give to look upon its treasures!'
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. While a Dwarf skirmishes a [moria] minion, that Dwarf is strength +1.

name: Band of the Eye
lore: Far more Orcs has Sauron bred in the pits under Barad-dûr than Saruman could ever imagine.
text: Response: If this minion wins a skirmish, remove (2) to make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from hand.

name: Curse From Mordor
lore: The Dark Lord harbors an ancient hatred for descendants of Gil-galad and those that marched with his gleaming host.
text: Shadow: Spot a [sauron] Orc to discard an [elven] condition.

name: The Dark Lord's Summons
lore: Orcs obey the Dark Lord unquestioningly.
text: Search. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a [sauron] card, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it and one other card from hand.

name: Despair
lore: 'The Nameless Enemy has arisen again. Smoke rises once more from Orodruin that we call Mount Doom.'
text: Maneuver: If the total number of burdens and companions in the dead pile is at least 12, spot a [sauron] Orc to corrupt the Ring-bearer.

name: Desperate Defense of the Ring
lore: The Company must defend the Ring at all costs.
text: To play, exert a [sauron] Orc. Plays on a companion. Each time bearer is assigned to a skirmish, the Free Peoples player chooses to either discard 3 cards from hand or add a burden.

name: Desperate Measures
lore: 'Go back, Sam. You can't swim. I'm going to Mordor alone.'
text: Maneuver: Spot a [sauron] Orc and remove a burden to make the Free Peoples player discard top 5 cards from his draw deck.

name: Enduring Evil
lore: 'The Dark Tower was broken, but its foundations were not removed; for they were made with the power of the Ring, and while it remains they will endure.'
text: Skirmish: Spot X burdens to make a character skirmishing a [sauron] Orc strength -X.

name: Enheartened Foe
lore: Orcs feed on their own success. The greater their exploits in battle, the greater their confidence grows.
text: Response: If a [sauron] Orc wins a skirmish, make that Orc fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Forces of Mordor
lore: '...the Dark Lord is not without allies. The Easterlings and Haradrim now pay tribute to Mordor.'
text: Shadow: Spot X [sauron] minions to add (X).

name: Gleaming Spires Will Crumble
lore: Gondor has long been a target for the wrath of Sauron the Great.
text: Plays to your support area. Each [sauron] Orc skirmishing a [gondor] character is strength +2. Discard this condition if your [sauron] Orc loses a skirmish.

name: Still Draws Breath
lore: When thirteen had fallen the rest fled shrieking, leaving the defenders unharmed....
text: Response: If a Dwarf wins a skirmish, heal that Dwarf.

name: Hate
lore: Orcs are filled with hatred not only for their foes, but for all that lives.
text: Maneuver: Exert a [sauron] Orc to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: A Host Avails Little
lore: 'Had I a host of Elves in armour of the Elder Days, it would avail little....'
text: Search. Maneuver: Spot a [sauron] Orc and 6 companions to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Do this once for each companion over 5.

name: The Irresistible Shadow
lore: Once more the desire to slip on the Ring came over Frodo; but this time it was stronger than before.
text: To play, exert a [sauron] Orc. Plays to your support area. If you can spot 5 burdens and the Free Peoples player has no cards in his or her draw deck, the Ring-bearer is corrupted.

name: Journey Into Danger
lore: 'I do not foretell, for all foretelling is now vain: on the one hand lies darkness, on the other only hope.'
text: Search. To play, exert a [sauron] Orc. Plays to your support area. While you can spot 5 companions, each companion's twilight cost is +2.

name: Mordor Enraged
