lore: The armies of Elendil and Gil-galad inflamed Sauron's anger and hatred.
text: Plays on a [sauron] minion. Shadow: Exert bearer to add (1) for each archer companion.

name: Mordor's Strength
lore: 'It should have ended that day, but evil was allowed to endure.'
text: Skirmish: Exert a [sauron] Orc to wound a character he is skirmishing.

name: Morgul Hunter
lore: Sauron's hatred lives in the hearts of his minions.
text: For each companion you can spot, this minion is strength +1.

name: Morgul Skirmisher
lore: The Orcs of Mordor, heartened by the promise of blood and plunder, are dangerous foes in battle.
text: Maneuver: Remove (3) to exert a Hobbit (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Morgul Skulker
lore: Sly servants of the Ringwraiths of Morgul Vale, Morgul Orcs are alert to the desires of their masters.
text: When you play this minion, you may shuffle up to 2 [wraith] cards from your discard pile into your draw deck.

name: Morgul Warden
lore: With blind devotion, the Orcs of Mordor follow orders issued from the Dark Tower.
text: For each other [sauron] Orc you can spot, Morgul Warden is strength +1.

name: Their Halls of Stone
lore: These are not holes,' said Gimli. 'This is the great realm and city of the Dwarrowdelf. And of old it was not darksome, but full of light and splendour, as is 'still remembered in our songs.'
text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 if at an underground site).

name: The Number Must Be Few
lore: 'The number must be few, since your hope is in speed and secrecy.'
text: Search. Plays to your support area. While you can spot 7 companions, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).

name: Orc Ambusher
lore: 'Orcs will often pursue foes for many leagues....'
text: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [sauron] minion you play is -1. Response: If a Free Peoples regroup event is played, exert this minion to cancel that event.

name: Orc Assassin
text: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [sauron] minion you play is -1. Assignment: Spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the Free Peoples player assign a Hobbit to skirmish this minion.

name: Orc Banner
lore: Tribes of Orcs from throughout Mordor rally to the banner of the Dark Tower.
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a [sauron] Orc, each [sauron] Orc is strength +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Orc Bowmen
lore: Where volleys of Orcish arrows fly, the defenders of the West fall.
text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [sauron] Orc, add 1 to the minion archery total.

name: Orc Butchery
lore: For sport, Orcs hew cruelly at the bodies of those they slay.
text: Response: If a companion is killed by a [sauron] Orc, the Free Peoples player must discard 3 cards from the top of his draw deck for each card in the dead pile.

name: Orc Chieftain
lore: Orc chieftains are the most cruel of a heartless race. Both strength and malice are needed to lead such followers.
text: When you play a weapon on this minion, add (2) (limit once per turn).

name: Orc Hunters
lore: Bred for battle, Sauron's soldiers live for the thrill of the fight – and the spoils of victory.
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.

name: Orc Inquisitor
lore: Cruel questioners of Mordor tore the secret from poor Gollum, that Sauron's most prized possession once again was found.
text: When you play this minion, you may make the Free Peoples player discard a card at random from hand.

name: Orc Scimitar
lore: An Orc's weapon reflects his passion for war and cruelty.
text: Bearer must be a [sauron] Orc. Skirmish: Remove (1) to make bearer strength +1 (limit +3).

name: Thrarin, Dwarven Smith
subtitle: Dwarven Smith
lore: A blacksmith by trade, Thrarin puts down his hammer and takes up his axe to fight when the need arises.
text: Maneuver: Exert Thrarin to allow him to participate in archery fire and skirmishes until the regroup phase.

name: Orc Scouting Band
lore: The cunning ambushes of the Orc armies rely upon scouts first finding the enemy.
text: Tracker. The roaming penalty for each [sauron] minion you play is -1. Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character it is skirmishing.

name: Orc Soldier
lore: Bearing cruel weapons, Orcs go forth from Mordor to serve the Eye.
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character he is skirmishing.

name: Orc War Band
lore: Sauron has countless armies of Orcs at his disposal.
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a character it is skirmishing.

name: The Ring's Oppression
lore: The Ring that hung upon its chain about his neck grew heavy, heavier than a great stone, and his head was dragged downwards.
text: Response: If a [sauron] Orc kills a companion, add 1 burden (or 3 if the Ring-bearer wears The One Ring).

name: Sauron's Defenses
lore: Sauron's minions are everywhere. Few roads escape the gaze of the Lidless Eye.
text: To play, exert a [sauron] Orc. Plays to your support area. While there are 3 or more companions in the dead pile, the move limit for this turn is -1 (to a minimum of 1).

name: Seeking It Always
lore: '...the only measure that he knows is desire, desire for power; and so he judges all hearts.'
text: Search. Plays to your support area. Response: If a stealth event is played, exert a [sauron] tracker to cancel that event.

name: Seeking Its Master
lore: 'This at least is plain: the evil of the Ring is already at work even in the Company, and the Ring must leave them before it does more harm.'
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Exert a [sauron] Orc and remove (2) to draw a card.

name: Shadow's Reach
lore: 'Is it secret? Is it safe?'
text: Shadow: Exert a [sauron] Orc to discard a Free Peoples condition.

name: Strength Born of Fear
lore: Fear of death in Barad-dûr's dungeons spurs Mordor's servants to even greater savagery.
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Remove (3) to make a [sauron] Orc strength +1.

name: Thin and Stretched
lore: 'I am old, Gandalf. I don't look it....'
text: To play, exert a [sauron] Orc. Plays on the Ring-bearer. Add a burden at the end of each turn during which bearer was not assigned to a skirmish (and another companion was).

name: Wealth of Moria
lore: 'For here alone in all the world was found Moria- silver, or true-silver as some have called it: mithril is the Elvish name.'
text: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all Free People cards revealed into hand and discard the rest.

name: Tower Lieutenant
lore: Sauron shows favour to those in his dungeons with the ambition to squeeze the information he needs from those caught spying out his borders.
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player discards 2 cards at random from hand.

name: Under the Watching Eye
lore: What the Lidless Eye of Sauron does not see, his countless minions observe and report.
text: Search. To play, exert a [sauron] tracker. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion.

name: The Weight of a Legacy
lore: 'It is because of Men, the Ring survives.... I was there the day the strength of Men failed.'
text: To play, exert a [sauron] Orc. Plays on Aragorn.

name: You Bring Great Evil
lore: 'And what is this? We have not had dealings with the Dwarves since the Dark Days.'
text: To play, spot a [sauron] Orc. Plays on a companion (except an Elf). While at a sanctuary, bearer cannot heal.

name: Bilbo, Retired Adventurer
subtitle: Retired Adventurer
lore: '...I don't suppose I have the strength or luck left to deal with the Ring. It has grown, and I have not.'
text: Fellowship: Exert Bilbo to shuffle a [shire] card from your discard pile into your draw deck.

name: Bilbo's Pipe
lore: Bilbo has a fine pipe, carved for him by his Dwarven friends.
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to shuffle X tales from your discard pile into your draw deck.

name: Bounder
lore: 'Aye, reckon we're in for a quite night... mind how you go.'
text: Skirmish: Exert this ally to prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless that Hobbit's strength is tripled.

name: Extraordinary Resilience
lore: 'Don't despair!' said Strider. 'You must trust me now. Your Frodo is made of sterner stuff than I had guessed....'
text: Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to heal, remove a burden instead.

name: Farmer Maggot, Chaser of Rascals
subtitle: Chaser of Rascals
lore: 'Old Maggot is really a stout fellow – if you leave his mushrooms alone.'
text: Fellowship: Exert Farmer Maggot to heal Merry or Pippin.

name: Frodo, Old Bilbo's Heir
subtitle: Old Bilbo's Heir
lore: 'But be that as it may, Mr. Frodo is as nice a young hobbit as you could wish to meet.'
text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). At the start of each of your turns, you may heal a Hobbit ally.

name: Ancient Enmity
lore: Hard and bitter is the Elven hatred of Orcs, for they have lost many kinsmen to Orc savagery.
text: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +1. If a minion loses this skirmish to that Elf, that minion's owner discards 2 cards at random from hand.

name: Frodo, Son of Drogo
subtitle: Son of Drogo
lore: 'I think you'll find there's more to this Hobbit than meets the eye.'
text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Fellowship: Exert another companion who has the Frodo signet to heal Frodo.

name: The Gaffer, Sam's Father
subtitle: Sam's Father
lore: No one had a more attentive audience than old Ham Gamgee, commonly known as the Gaffer. He held forth at The Ivy Bush, a small inn on the Bywater road; and he 'spoke with some authority, for he had tended the garden at Bag End for forty years....
text: Fellowship: Exert The Gaffer to heal Frodo or Sam.

name: The Gaffer's Pipe
lore: 'This... is the one art that we certainly claim to be our own invention. When Hobbits first began to smoke is not known....'
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to remove (X).

name: Halfling Deftness
lore: ...though they are inclined to be fat and do not hurry unnecessarily, they are nonetheless nimble and deft in their movements.
text: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit to make him strength +3.

name: Hobbit Appetite
lore: 'What about Elevenses, Luncheon, Afternoon Tea and Supper – he knows about them, doesn't he?'
text: Fellowship: Add (X) to heal a Hobbit companion X times.

name: Hobbit Farmer
lore: '...where our hearts truly lie is in peace and quiet and good-tilled earth....'
text: While you can spot your site 1, this ally has the game text of that site. Fellowship: Exert this ally and spot opponent's site 1 to replace it with your site 1.

name: Hobbit Intuition
lore: 'What? That were just a little detour, that's all... a shortcut.'
text: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1 to 4, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, make a Hobbit strength +3.

name: Hobbit Party Guest
lore: 'More promising still (to the hobbits' mind): an enormous open-air kitchen was erected....'
text: At the start of each of your turns, heal this ally. Fellowship: Exert this ally to heal another Hobbit ally whose home is site 1.

name: Hobbit Stealth
lore: They possessed from the first the art of disappearing swiftly and silently, when large folk whom they do not wish to meet come blundering by....
text: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1 to 5, cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, make a Hobbit strength +2.

name: Hobbit Sword
lore: 'Strap these on....'
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit.

name: Axe Strike
lore: Though Gimli's words were praised by the Lady of Light, he proved his best skill was swinging his axe.
text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +3 if bearing a [dwarven] hand weapon).

name: Arwen, Daughter of Elrond
subtitle: Daughter of Elrond
lore: Long she had been in the land of her mother's kin, in Lórien beyond the mountains, and was but lately returned to Rivendell to her father's house.
text: Ranger. While skirmishing a Nazgûl, Arwen is strength +3.

name: Longbottom Leaf
lore: Longbottom Leaf is the pipeweed enjoyed by most Hobbits throughout the Shire.
text: Pipeweed. Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may discard up to 2 cards from hand.

name: Master Proudfoot, Distant Relative of Bilbo
subtitle: Distant Relative of Bilbo
lore: His name, of course, was Proudfoot, and well merited; his feet were large, exceptionally furry....
text: Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 3 twilight tokens, add (2) to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all [shire] cards revealed into hand and discard the rest.

name: Merry, Friend to Sam
subtitle: Friend to Sam
lore: 'We're coming too! You'll have to send us home tied up in a sack to stop us!'
text: Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, exert him twice to add his strength to another companion.

name: Merry, From O'er the Brandywine
subtitle: From O'er the Brandywine
lore: 'I don't know why he's so upset, it's only a few carrots... my point is, he's overreacting.'
text: While Merry bears a weapon, he is strength +2.

name: Noble Intentions
lore: 'You carry the fate of us all, little one.... If this is indeed the will of the Council, then Gondor will see it done.'
text: Skirmish: Exert a companion (except a Hobbit) to make a Hobbit strength +3.

name: Old Toby
lore: Bilbo's favorite pipeweed is Old Toby, the finest weed in the Southfarthing.
text: Pipeweed. Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may draw a card.

name: Pippin, Friend to Frodo
subtitle: Friend to Frodo
lore: Baggins? Sure I know a Baggins – Frodo's my second cousin once-removed, on his mother's side and my third cousin twice-removed on his father's side, if you 'follow me.'
text: Your opponent may not discard your [shire] tales from play.

name: Pippin, Hobbit of Some Intelligence
subtitle: Hobbit of Some Intelligence
lore: 'Anyway, you need people of intelligence on this sort of mission... quest... thing.'
text: When you play Pippin, remove a burden or wound from a companion.

name: Power According to His Stature
lore: 'The ring had given him power according to his stature.'
text: Skirmish: Add a burden to wound each minion skirmishing the Ring-bearer.

name: Rosie Cotton, Hobbiton Lass
subtitle: Hobbiton Lass
lore: 'Go on Sam, ask Rosie for a dance.'
text: Sam is strength +1. Fellowship: Exert Rosie Cotton to heal Sam.

name: Asfaloth
lore: 'Noro lim, Asfaloth, noro lim!'
text: Bearer must be an Elf. When played on Arwen, Asfaloth's twilight cost is -2. While at a plains site, bearer is strength +2. Discard Asfaloth when at an underground site.

name: Sam, Faithful Companion
subtitle: Faithful Companion
lore: 'Mr. Frodo's not going anywhere without me!'
text: Fellowship: Play Bill the Pony from your draw deck. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: Sam, Son of Hamfast
subtitle: Son of Hamfast
lore: 'Oh, I've never held a girl's hand before. I... I think I might just have myself another ale.'
text: Fellowship: Exert Sam to remove a burden. Response: If Frodo dies, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: Sorry About Everything
lore: 'I am sorry that I brought this upon you... sorry you must carry this burden.'
text: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit companion to remove a burden.

name: Sting
lore: 'This is Sting.... Take it, if you like.'
text: Bearer must be Frodo. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Frodo to reveal an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed (limit (4)).

name: Stone Trolls
lore: 'For a couple o'pins,' says Troll, and grins, / 'I'll eat thee too, and gnaw thy shins. / A bit o' fresh meat will go down sweet!'
text: Tale. To play, spot Bilbo. Plays on any character. Limit 1 per character. Each time bearer skirmishes a Troll or Uruk-hai, bearer is strength +3.

name: Stout and Sturdy
lore: 'You have a stout heart, little hobbit, but your courage alone will not save you.'
text: Maneuver or Skirmish: Heal a Hobbit.

name: A Talent for Not Being Seen
lore: With their small size, Hobbits use any hole to hide in, and their trail is difficult to detect.
text: Stealth. To play, exert a Hobbit. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves, spot 2 Hobbit companions to make the Shadow number -1 (or spot 4 to make it -2).

name: There and Back Again
lore: 'So there I was – at the mercy of three monstrous trolls....'
text: Tale. Bearer must be a Hobbit companion. Maneuver: Discard this condition to make each Hobbit companion strength +2 until the regroup phase.

name: Thrór's Map
lore: Bilbo still keeps a map of Erebor, the Lonely Mountain, as a memento of his journey with the Dwarves many years ago.
text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship or  Regroup: Exert 2 Hobbits and discard Thrór's Map to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

name: Bag End
text: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play The Gaffer from your draw deck.

name: Border Defenses
lore: 'None of the Orcs will ever return out of Lórien. And there will be many Elves hidden on the northern border before another night falls.'
text: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing an archer).

name: East Road
text: Each companion's twilight cost is +2.

name: Farmer Maggot's Fields
text: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play Merry or Pippin from your draw deck.

name: Green Dragon Inn
text: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play Sam from your draw deck.

name: Green Hill Country
text: The twilight cost of each Hobbit is -1.

name: The Prancing Pony
text: Fellowship: Add a burden to play Aragorn from your draw deck.

name: Shire Lookout Point
text: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to play Gandalf's Cart from your draw deck.

name: Westfarthing
text: Fellowship: Exert a Hobbit to play a companion or ally; that character's twilight cost is -1.

name: Bree Gate
text: While you can spot a ranger, the move limit is +1 for this turn.

name: Bree Streets
text: The roaming penalty for each Nazgûl you play to Bree Streets is -2.

name: Breeland Forest
text: Forest. Stealth events may not be played.

name: Bow of the Galadhrim
lore: To Legolas she gave a bow such as the Galadhrim used, longer and stouter than the bows of Mirkwood, and strung with a string of elf-hair.
text: Bearer must be Legolas. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may wound a minion.

name: Buckleberry Ferry
text: River. While only Hobbits are in the fellowship, there are no assignment and skirmish phases at Buckleberry Ferry.

name: Ettenmoors
text: Plains. Skirmish: Exert your companion or minion to make that character strength +2.

name: Midgewater Marshes
text: Marsh. Each time a Hobbit moves to Midgewater Marshes, that Hobbit must exert.

name: Midgewater Moors
text: Plains. Each time a minion is played, the Free Peoples player discards a card from hand.

name: Trollshaw Forest
text: Forest. Each time you play a possession or artifact on your companion, draw a card.

name: Weatherhills
text: Each Nazgûl's twilight cost is -1.

name: Weathertop
text: Each Nazgûl at Weathertop is fierce.

name: Council Courtyard
text: Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves from Council Courtyard, remove (2).

name: Ford of Bruinen
text: River. Sanctuary. The twilight cost of the first Nazgûl played to Ford of Bruinen each turn is -5.

name: Frodo's Bedroom
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a Hobbit to draw a card.

name: Celeborn, Lord of Lórien
subtitle: Lord of Lórien
lore: They were clad wholly in white... and the hair of the Lord Celeborn was of silver long and bright; but no sign of age was upon them, unless it were in the 'depths of their eyes; for these were as keen as lances in the starlight, and yet profound....
text: Fellowship: Exert Celeborn to heal an [elven] ally.

name: Rivendell Terrace
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a Man to draw a card.

name: Rivendell Valley
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play an Elf to draw a card.

name: Rivendell Waterfall
text: Forest. Sanctuary. While you can spot a ranger at Rivendell Waterfall, the move limit is +1 for this turn.

name: Balin's Tomb
text: Underground. Maneuver: Discard your tale from play or from hand to heal your companion.

name: Dwarrowdelf Chamber
text: Underground. When the fellowship moves to Dwarrowdelf Chamber, Gimli or 2 other companions must exert.

name: Mithril Mine
text: Underground. Shadow: Remove (1) to play a Shadow weapon from your discard pile.

name: Moria Lake
text: Marsh. When the fellowship moves to Moria Lake, Frodo or 2 other companions must exert.

name: Moria Stairway
text: Underground. Each companion and minion bearing a hand weapon is damage +1.

name: Pass of Caradhras
text: Mountain. Shadow: Spot an [isengard] minion to play a weather card from your draw deck (limit 1 per turn).

name: The Bridge of Khazad-dûm
text: Underground. Shadow: Play The Balrog from your draw deck or hand; The Balrog's twilight cost is -6.

name: The Council of Elrond
lore: You will hear today all that you need in order to understand the purposes of the Enemy.... What shall we do with the Ring, the least of rings, the trifle that 'Sauron fancies? That is the doom that we must deem.'
text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to play a tale from your draw deck.

name: Dimrill Dale
text: Sanctuary. The twilight cost of the first [moria] Orc played each Shadow phase is -2.

name: Galadriel's Glade
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert an Elf to look at an opponent's hand.

name: Lothlórien Woods
text: Forest. Sanctuary. Each ally whose home is site 6 is strength +3.

name: Anduin Confluence
text: River. When the fellowship moves to Anduin Confluence, discard every ally.

name: Anduin Wilderland
text: Forest. River. While the fellowship is at Anduin Wilderland, skip the archery phase.

name: Silverlode Banks
text: River. When the fellowship moves to Silverlode Banks without a ranger, every companion must exert.

name: Anduin Banks
text: River. For each companion in the fellowship over 4, add 2 to the minion archery total.

name: Brown Lands
text: River. For each minion archer at Brown Lands, the minion archery total is +1 (limit +4).

name: Pillars of the Kings
text: River. Fellowship: Discard a [gondor] card from hand to heal a [gondor] companion.

name: Shores of Nen Hithoel
text: River. Shadow: Spot 5 Orc minions to prevent the fellowship from moving again this turn.

name: Curse Their Foul Feet!
lore: 'A strong company of Orcs has passed. They crossed the Nimrodel – curse their foul feet in its clean water!'
text: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. That player discards a card from hand for each Orc revealed.

name: Emyn Muil
text: Maneuver: Exert your minion to make that minion fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Slopes of Amon Hen
text: The twilight cost of each [isengard] minion is -1.

name: Summit of Amon Hen
text: When the fellowship moves to Summit of Amon Hen, each Shadow player may draw a card for each burden.

name: Tol Brandir
text: River. Shadow: Play up to 3 trackers from your discard pile; end your Shadow phase.

name: Gandalf, The Grey Wizard
subtitle: The Grey Wizard
lore: ...his long white hair, his sweeping silver beard, and his broad shoulders, made him look like some wise king of ancient legend.
text: Fellowship: Exert Gandalf to play a companion who has the Gandalf signet. The twilight cost of that companion is -2.

name: Aragorn, King in Exile
subtitle: King in Exile
lore: 'He turned from that path a long time ago. He has chosen exile....'
text: Ranger. At the start of each of your turns, you may heal another companion who has the Aragorn signet.

name: Defiance
lore: 'If you want him, come and claim him!'
text: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Nazgûl).

name: Double Shot
lore: The affray was sharp, but the orcs were dismayed by the fierceness of the defence. Legolas shot two through the throat.
text: Archery: Spot an Elf archer companion to make the fellowship archery total +1.

name: Elf-song
lore: ...the beauty of the melodies and of the interwoven words in elven-tongues, even though he understood them little, held him in a spell, as soon as he began to 'attend to them.
text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf to remove a burden.

name: Battle Fury
lore: The Dwarves quickly dispatch Orcs and Uruk-hai with their mighty battle axes.
text: Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf to make that Dwarf strength +3 and damage +1.

name: Elrond, Lord of Rivendell
subtitle: Lord of Rivendell
lore: He was the Lord of Rivendell and mighty among both Elves and Men.
text: To play, spot Gandalf or an Elf. At the start of each of your turns, heal every ally whose home is site 3. Fellowship: Exert Elrond to draw a card.

name: Elven Bow
lore: 'We live now upon an island amid many perils, and our hands are more often upon the bowstring than upon the harp.'
text: Bearer must be an Elf. Bearer is an archer.

name: Elven Cloak
lore: '...never before have we clad strangers in the garb of our own people.'
text: To play, spot an Elf. Bearer must be a companion. The minion archery total is -1.

name: Far-seeing Eyes
lore: Keen Elven eyes see farther and more keenly than those of Men or Dwarves.
text: Plays to your support area. Each time you play an Elf, choose an opponent to discard a card from hand.

name: Foul Creation
lore: Saruman's Uruk-hai mirrored the singular focus of their master, viewing with contempt and disgust all they encountered.
text: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to reveal an opponent's hand. You may discard an [isengard] minion revealed to draw 2 cards.

name: Galadriel, Lady of Light
subtitle: Lady of Light
lore: Very tall they were, and the Lady no less tall than the Lord; and they were grave and beautiful... and the hair of the Lady was of deep gold....
text: At the start of each of your turns, heal every ally whose home is site 6. Fellowship: Exert Galadriel to play an Elf for free.

name: Gift of Boats
lore: 'They will not sink, lade them as you will; but they are wayward if mishandled.'
text: To play, exert an Elf ally. Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves from a river during the fellowship phase, the move limit for this turn is +1.

name: Gwemegil
lore: Forged by the Elven-smiths of Rivendell, Arwen's blade bears enchantments to ward off the forces of the Great Eye.
text: Bearer must be Arwen. She is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Arwen or discard 2 cards from hand to make her strength +1.

name: Haldir, Elf of the Golden Wood
subtitle: Elf of the Golden Wood
lore: 'But there are some of us who still go abroad for the gathering of news and the watching of our enemies.... I am one. Haldir is my name.'
text: To play, spot an Elf. While Haldir is at site 6, 7, or 8, he is strength +2.

name: The Last Alliance of Elves and Men
lore: But Sauron of Mordor assailed them, and they made the Last Alliance of Elves and Men, and the hosts of Gil-galad and Elendil were mustered....
text: Tale. Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Limit 1 per bearer. Bearer is strength +1 for each Elf you can spot (limit +3).

name: Cleaving Blow
lore: The shoddy workmanship of Orc-smiths cannot withstand the fury of Durin's folk.
text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Legolas, Greenleaf
subtitle: Greenleaf
lore: 'And I too will go with him,' said Legolas. 'It would be faithless now to say farewell.'
text: Archer. Archery: Exert Legolas to wound a minion; Legolas does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Legolas, Prince of Mirkwood
subtitle: Prince of Mirkwood
lore: There was also a strange Elf clad in green and brown, Legolas, a messenger from his father, Thranduil, the King of the Elves of Northern Mirkwood.
text: Archer. While skirmishing a Nazgûl, Legolas is strength +3.

name: Lightfootedness
lore: '...let a ploughman plough, but choose an otter for swimming, and for running light over grass and leaf, or over snow – an Elf.'
text: Archery: Spot an Elf companion to make the minion archery total -1.

name: Lórien Elf
lore: '...we dwell now in the heart of the forest, and do not willingly have dealings with any other folk.'
text: To play, spot an Elf.

name: Mallorn-trees
lore: Upon the further side there rose to a great height a green wall encircling a green hill thronged with mallorn-trees taller than any they had yet seen in all the 'land.
text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Reveal an [elven] card from hand and place it beneath your draw deck.

name: The Mirror of Galadriel
lore: 'What you will see I cannot tell....'
text: Plays to your support area. Each Elf ally whose home is site 6 is strength +1. Maneuver: If an opponent has at least 7 cards in hand, exert Galadriel to look at 2 of those cards at random. Discard one and replace the other.

name: Orophin, Lórien Bowman
subtitle: Lórien Bowman
lore: The swift bow of Orophin, Haldir's kinsman, has slain many Orcs.
text: Archer. Archery: Exert Orophin to wound an Uruk-hai.

name: Rúmil, Elven Protector
subtitle: Elven Protector
lore: Brother to Haldir, Rúmil guards the northern marches of the Golden Wood.
text: Archer. Archery: Exert Rúmil to wound an Orc.

name: The Seen and the Unseen
lore: 'You have entered the realm of the Lady of the Wood – you cannot go back.'
text: Fellowship: Exert 2 Elves to discard a condition.

name: Shoulder to Shoulder
lore: 'May it be a sign that though the world is now dark better days are at hand, and that friendship shall be renewed between out peoples.'
text: Plays to your support area. Maneuver: Add (1) and exert a Dwarf to heal an Elf, or add (1) and exert an Elf to heal a Dwarf.

name: Delving
lore: '...they delved too greedily and too deep, and disturbed that from which they fled, Durin's Bane.'
text: Fellowship: Exert a Dwarf companion to draw 3 cards.

name: Silinde, Elf of Mirkwood
subtitle: Elf of Mirkwood
lore: Among the representatives of the Elves of Northern Mirkwood was Silinde, friend of the House of Thranduil.
text: While you can spot your site 3, Silinde has the game text of that site.

name: Songs of the Blessed Realm
lore: Elves seem to like music and poetry and tales as much as Hobbits like food.
text: Plays to your support area. Each time you play an [elven] tale, you may remove a burden.

name: The Splendor of Their Banners
lore: 'It recalled to me the glory of the Elder Days and the hosts of Beleriand, so many great princes and captains were assembled.'
text: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to make the fellowship archery total +1.

name: Stand Against Darkness
lore: What power still remains lies with us, here in Imladris, or with Círdan at the Havens, or in Lórien. But have they the strength, have we here the strength to 'withstand the Enemy...?'
text: Maneuver: Exert an Elf to discard a [sauron] minion, a [sauron] condition, or a [sauron] possession.

name: Support of the Last Homely House
lore: Merely to be there was a cure for weariness, fear, and sadness.
text: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally whose home is site 3. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.

name: Swan-ship of the Galadhrim
lore: ...and suddenly they perceived that it was a ship, wrought and carved with elven-skill in the likeness of a bird.
text: Maneuver: Exert an Elf ally whose home is site 6. Until the regroup phase, that ally is strength +3 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.

name: The Tale of Gil-galad
lore: Gil-galad was an Elven-king / Of him the harpers sadly sing: / the last whose realm was fair and free / between the Mountains and the Sea.
text: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make bearer strength +2.

name: Uruviel, Maid of Lórien
subtitle: Maid of Lórien
lore: An Elf-maid of the Galadhrim, Uruviel has dwelt for years beneath the mallorn-trees of Lothlórien.
text: While you can spot your site 6, Uruviel has the game text of that site.

name: The White Arrows of Lórien
lore: Straight and true, the arrows of the Golden Wood are known to leave a deadly mark.
text: Tale. Bearer must be an Elf companion. Archery: If bearer is an archer, exert bearer to make an opponent discard 2 cards at random from hand.

name: Albert Dreary, Entertainer from Bree
subtitle: Entertainer from Bree
lore: Typical of Bree-folk, Albert is a plain but stout- hearted fellow. He does not seek trouble, but he is willing to protect his home.
text: To play, spot Gandalf. Maneuver: Exert Albert Dreary to discard an [isengard] or [moria] condition.

name: Dwarf Guard
lore: Dwarves from Dáin's people are stout companions, trustworthy and loyal.
text: To play, spot a Dwarf.

name: Barliman Butterbur, Prancing Pony Proprietor
subtitle: Prancing Pony Proprietor
lore: 'You don't know much even about them, if you think old Barliman is stupid,' said Gandalf. 'He is wise enough on his own ground.'
text: Fellowship: Exert Barliman Butterbur to take a [gandalf] event into hand from your discard pile.

name: Durin's Secret
lore: They are wrought of ithildin that mirrors only starlight and moonlight, and sleeps until it is touched by one who speaks words now long forgotten in 'Middle-earth.'
text: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf, a Dwarf, and an Elf to make the move limit for this turn +1.

name: Gandalf, Friend of the Shirefolk
subtitle: Friend of the Shirefolk
lore: 'Among the Wise I am the only one that goes in for hobbit-lore: an obscure branch of knowledge, but full of surprises.'
text: Gandalf is strength +1 for each of these races you can spot in the fellowship: Hobbit, Dwarf, Elf, and Man.

name: Gandalf's Cart
lore: ...a cart came in through Bywater... An old man was driving it all alone.
text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Stack a Free Peoples artifact (or possession) from hand on this card, or play a card stacked here as if played from hand.

name: Gandalf's Pipe
lore: 'I know what is the matter with me,' he muttered, as he sat down by the door. 'I need smoke!'
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to remove X burdens.

name: Glamdring
lore: ...in his other hand Glamdring gleamed, cold and white.
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. He is damage +1. Fellowship or Regroup: Exert Gandalf to reveal an opponent's hand. Remove (1) for each Orc revealed.

name: Intimidate
lore: 'Go back to the Shadow!'
text: Spell. Response: If a companion is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf to prevent that wound.

name: Let Folly Be Our Cloak
lore: Well, let folly be our cloak, a veil before the eyes of the Enemy!... Into his heart the thought will not enter that any will refuse it, that having the Ring 'we may seek to destroy it.'
text: Fellowship: Exert X companions to remove (X).

name: Mysterious Wizard
lore: '...there are older and fouler things than Orcs in the deep places of the world.'
text: Spell. Skirmish: Make Gandalf strength +2 (or +4 if there are 4 or fewer burdens on the Ring-bearer).

name: The Nine Walkers
lore: 'Nine companions to match the Nine Ringwraiths... So be it.'
text: To play, spot Gandalf. Plays to your support area. Each time you play a companion whose race you cannot spot, that companion's twilight cost is -2.

name: Dwarven Armor
lore: The strongest armour still being made in Middle-earth is forged by Dwarves. It is so heavy that only they can bear it.
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

name: Ottar, Man of Laketown
subtitle: Man of Laketown
lore: The Men of Laketown come from the North, where they trade with the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain.
text: To play, spot Gandalf. Fellowship: Exert Ottar to discard up to 3 cards from hand and draw an equal number of cards.

name: Questions That Need Answering
lore: 'There are some things that I must see to....'
text: Spell. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 3 twilight tokens, spot Gandalf to look at the top 4 cards of your draw deck. Take 2 of those cards into hand and discard the rest.

name: Risk a Little Light
lore: 'Let me risk a little more light.'
text: Spell. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, spot Gandalf to look at the top 2 cards of your draw deck. Take one into hand and discard the other.

name: Servant of the Secret Fire
lore: 'I am a servant of the Secret Fire, wielder of the flame of Anor. You cannot pass.'
text: Spell. Skirmish: Spot Gandalf to make a minion strength -3.

name: Sleep, Caradhras
lore: 'Losto Caradhras, sedho, hodo, nuitho i ruith.'
text: Spell. Fellowship: Exert Gandalf to discard every condition.

name: Strength of Spirit
lore: 'There are many powers in the world, for good or for evil. Some are greater than I am. Against some I have not yet been measured. But my time is coming.'
text: Spell. Response: If a companion is about to exert, spot Gandalf to place no token for that exertion.

name: Treachery Deeper Than You Know
lore: 'By foul craft, Saruman has crossed Orcs with Goblin Men – he is breeding an army in the Caverns of Isengard.'
text: Spell. Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to reveal an opponent's hand.

name: A Wizard Is Never Late
lore: 'A wizard is never late, Frodo Baggins, nor is he early. He arrives precisely when he means to.'
text: Fellowship: Play a [gandalf] character from your draw deck.

name: An Able Guide
lore: '...though I cannot disappear, I have hunted many wild and wary things and I can usually avoid being seen, if I wish.'
text: Regroup: Spot a ranger to remove (4).

name: Aragorn, Ranger of the North
subtitle: Ranger of the North
lore: 'Lonely men are we, Rangers of the wild, hunters – but hunters ever of the servants of the Enemy....'
text: Ranger. Maneuver: Exert Aragorn to make him defender +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Dwarven Axe
lore: 'Buckler and corslet, axe and sword / And shining spears were laid in hoard.'
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time a player's minion loses a skirmish to bearer, that player discards the top card from his or her draw deck.

name: Aragorn's Bow
lore: Rangers learn the bow as well as the blade.
text: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is an archer. Archery: Exert Aragorn to wound a minion; Aragorn does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Aragorn's Pipe
lore: He had a tall tankard in front of him, and was smoking a long-stemmed pipe curiously carved.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed possession and spot X pipes to heal X companions.

name: Armor
lore: Then Elendil the Tall and his mighty sons, Isildur and Anárion, became great lords; and the North-realm they made in Arnor, and the South-realm in Gondor....
text: Bearer must be a Man. Bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase.

name: Arwen's Fate
lore: For the love of a mortal Man, Arwen, daughter of Elrond, must forsake her Elven heritage, and give up forever her journey to the Undying Lands.
text: Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make Arwen strength +3, or exert Arwen to make Aragorn strength +3.

name: Athelas
lore: The hands of the king are the hands of a healer, and so shall the true king be known.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Fellowship: Discard this possession to heal a companion or to remove a Shadow condition from a companion.

name: Blade of Gondor
lore: With the valour of Boromir's mighty longsword, the Enemies of the West are kept at bay.
text: Bearer must be Boromir. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Boromir to wound an Orc or Uruk-hai he is skirmishing.

name: Boromir, Lord of Gondor
subtitle: Lord of Gondor
lore: '...Boromir will also be in the Company. He is a valiant man.'
text: Ranger. Boromir is not overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.

name: Boromir, Son of Denethor
subtitle: Son of Denethor
lore: 'Long has my father, the Steward of Gondor, held the forces of Mordor at bay – by the blood of our people are the lands of others kept safe.'
text: Skirmish: Exert Boromir to make a Hobbit strength +3.

name: Boromir's Cloak
lore: He was cloaked and booted as if for a journey on horseback; and indeed though his garments were rich, and his cloak was lined with fur, they were stained with 'long travel.
text: Bearer must be Boromir. Maneuver: Exert Boromir to discard a weather condition.

name: Change of Plans
lore: 'Then let me help you. There are other ways, Frodo – other paths that we might take.'
text: Regroup: Exert a ranger to make an opponent shuffle his hand into his draw deck and draw 8 cards.

name: The One Ring, The Ring of Doom
subtitle: The Ring of Doom
lore: ...the earth shook, the plain heaved and cracked, and Orodruin reeled.
text: While wearing The One Ring, the Ring-bearer gains hunter 3, and each time he or she is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead. Skirmish: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.

name: Whatever End
lore: 'I will go with you even on the Paths of the Dead....'
text: Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may make a hunter [gondor] companion or hunter [elven] companion damage +1 until the regroup phase. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [dwarven] companion strength +2.

name: Black Land Commander
lore: '...do they just live on foul air and poison?'
text: While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +5. Skirmish: Remove 2 threats to make a character skirmishing this minion strength -2.

name: Black Land Observer
lore: Orcs must always watch for attacks from their enemies... and from their own.
text: When you play this minion, you may spot an [orc] condition to add a threat. While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +3.

name: Black Land Overlord
lore: Move on! To the Gate!
text: Maneuver: Remove a threat and spot another [orc] minion to exert an unbound companion.

name: Black Land Runner
lore: When commanded to, Orcs could travel great distances with great speed.
text: To play, spot an [orc] Orc. While you can spot more sites on the adventure path than minions, this minion is strength +5.

name: Black Land Shrieker
lore: No sound from an Orc was more frightening.
text: To play, spot an [orc] condition. Black Land Shrieker is twilight cost -1 for each threat you spot.

name: Black Land Spy
lore: Frodo's quest could be undone with one glance.
text: When you play this minion, you may spot an [orc] possession to add a threat. While you can spot a companion of strength 13 or more, this minion is strength +7.

name: Coordinated Effort
lore: Breaking a Gondorian fortification is not easily done.
text: To play, spot 2 [orc] minions. Each time the Free Peoples player plays a possession, add (2).

name: Desolation Orc
lore: Neither Man nor beast can withstand the fury of the Orcs.
text: To play, spot 3 Free Peoples cultures or discard 2 [orc] conditions from play.

name: Destructive Orc
lore: At Minas Tirith, some Orcs chose to attack the city before its inhabitants.
text: When you play Destructive Orc, you may discard a fortification for each [orc] possession and each [orc] artifact you can spot.

name: Gorbag, Filthy Rebel
subtitle: Filthy Rebel
lore: I'm gonna bleed you... like a stuck pig!
text: Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.) When you play Gorbag, you may discard a card from the top of the Free Peoples player's deck for each hunter character you can spot.

name: Arwen, She-Elf
subtitle: She-Elf
lore: I do not fear them.
text: While you can spot Aragorn, Arwen is strength +1 and resistance +2. Skirmish: Remove an [elven] token to make a minion skirmishing Arwen strength -2.

name: Isengard Marauder
lore: Wargs and riders sent by Saruman disrupted the villagers' retreat to Helm's Deep.
text: To play, discard 3 cards from your hand. While you can spot 2 other [orc] minions, this minion is fierce.

name: Moria Menace
lore: Orcs attacked in sunlight only when absolutely necessary.
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player shuffle his or her draw deck and reveal the top card of that draw deck. Make this minion strength +X, where X is the twilight cost of the revealed card.

name: Mountain-troll
lore: Thrice the great ram boomed. And suddenly on the last stroke the Gate of Gondor broke.
text: When you play this minion, you may discard 5 [orc] minions from play to make it twilight cost -10 and fierce. Shadow: Remove (3) to play an [orc] Orc from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.

name: Orkish Camp
text: While you can spot an [orc] Orc, the Free Peoples player cannot replace the fellowship's current site. Shadow: Exert an [orc] minion and remove (2) to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is an [orc] Orc, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it.

name: Orkish Hunting Spear
lore: Orcs hunt for Men, ponies, and their own kind.
text: Bearer must be an [orc] Orc. Bearer gains hunter X (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +X.), where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you can spot.

name: Pummeling Blow
lore: Where battering rams failed, Trolls did not.
text: To play, exert an [orc] minion. Plays on the fellowship's current site. This site cannot be replaced. While the fellowship is at this site, each Troll is strength +1.

name: Scouting Orc
lore: ...it was of a small breed... with wide and snuffling nostrils: evidently a tracker of some kind.
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.

name: Tower Troll
text: For each companion over 5, this minion is damage +1. Assignment: Exert this minion twice to assign it to a companion (except the Ring-bearer). If you cannot spot 6 companions, the Free Peoples player may exert a companion to prevent this.

name: Unmistakable Omen
text: While you can spot a threat, the site number of each [orc] Orc is -1. Regroup: Remove 3 threats and discard 3 [orc] Orcs from play to make the Free Peoples player spot a companion and place that companion in the dead pile. Discard this condition.

name: Unreasonable Choice
lore: An attacking swarm of Orcs leaves few desirable options.
text: Spot 2 [orc] minions to discard a Free Peoples condition. The Free Peoples player may add (2) for each Free Peoples condition you can spot to prevent that.

name: Dínendal, Mirkwood Archer
subtitle: Mirkwood Archer
lore: Elven archers were seldom seen before it was too late.
text: Aid – (3). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (3) to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you transfer this to a companion, except an [elven] companion, exert bearer. Bearer is an archer.

name: Veteran War Chief
lore: '...I'll stick you, if you don't shut it down, see?'
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.

name: Brilliant Light
lore: The Orcs reeled and screamed and cast aside both sword and spear.
text: Make a [rohan] companion strength +2 (or strength +3 and damage +1 if he or she is a hunter companion).

name: Burial Mounds
lore: Their hearts were heavy, remembering the many men that had fallen in battle in this place.
text: Make a [rohan] companion defender +1 and minions skirmishing that companion cannot take wounds during a skirmish involving that companion until the regroup phase.

name: Éomer, Horsemaster
subtitle: Horsemaster
text: Valiant. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1. Skirmish: Discard a [rohan] card from hand to make Éomer strength +2.

name: Éomer's Spear, Trusty Weapon
subtitle: Trusty Weapon
lore: Aim for their heads!
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. If bearer is Éomer and he is unwounded, he is damage +1 and resistance +1. Skirmish: If bearer is Éomer, discard this possession to wound a minion he is skirmishing.

name: Éowyn, Willing Fighter
subtitle: Willing Fighter
lore: I can fight!
text: Valiant. Response: If a hunter companion or valiant Man is about to take a wound, exert Éowyn to prevent that wound.

name: Gamling, The Old
subtitle: The Old
lore: 'Dawn is not far off... But dawn will not help us, I fear.'
text: Valiant. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) To play, spot a [rohan] Man. While you can spot 3 hunters, Gamling is strength +3.

name: Grim Trophy
lore: 'At least they will not love the Orcs.'
text: Make a [rohan] Man strength +1 for each hunter you can spot (or if you can spot more valiant Men than hunters, make a [rohan] Man strength +1 for each valiant Man you can spot).

name: Haleth, Son of Háma
subtitle: Son of Háma
text: While you can spot 2 mounts, Haleth is strength +2. While you can spot 3 mounts, Haleth is damage +1. While you can spot 4 Free Peoples mounts, those mounts can not be discarded by a Shadow player.

name: Horse of Great Stature
lore: Aragorn saw a shadow on the distant green, a dark swift-moving blur.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert. Skirmish: Exert bearer to make a [rohan] Man strength +1.

name: Elven Bow
lore: No finer bows could defend Helm's Deep than those of the Golden Wood.
text: Bearer must be an Elf. Bearer is an archer.

name: Horseman of the North
lore: 'And they became our allies, and have ever proved true to us....'
text: While you can spot a valiant Man, this companion's twilight cost is -1. This companion is strength +2 while no opponent controls a site.

name: Our Inspiration
lore: Decorative armor adorned the hallways and armories of Helm's Deep.
text: Spot a [rohan] Man to play a possession from your discard pile for each hunter character you can spot.

name: Last Days of My House
lore: No parent should have to bury their child.
text: Spot 2 [rohan] Men (or 1 hunter [rohan] Man) to play a [rohan] companion or a [rohan] follower from your draw deck.

name: Rider's Mount
lore: Their horses were of great stature, strong and clean- limbed; their grey coats glistened, their long tails flowed in the wind....
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.

name: Rohan Stable Master
lore: Rohirrim warriors were seldom seen without their mount.
text: Aid – (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a [rohan] Man. Bearer is considered to be mounted.

name: Rohan Worker
lore: In preparation for the Battle of Helm's Deep, everyone helped fortify the doors and walls.
text: Aid – (1). Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a [rohan] companion, exert bearer twice. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may liberate a site.

name: Rohirrim Axe
lore: Rohirrim young and old were given weapons of all kinds to defend Helm's Deep.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. While bearer is skirmishing a hunter minion, bearer is damage +1.

name: Rohirrim Doorwarden
lore: '...any weapon that you bear, be it only a staff, you must leave it on the threshold.'
text: Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a [rohan] Man. Bearer is strength +1 for each possession he or she bears.

name: Rohirrim Soldier
lore: 'Let us ride on!'
text: Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, this companion's twilight cost is -1. This companion is strength +1 for each hunter minion you can spot.

name: Rohirrim Warrior
lore: '...a warrior should have more skills and knowledge than only the craft of weapons and slaying....'
text: Valiant. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot a hunter minion (or exert 2 valiant Men) to make this companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Elven Warrior
lore: Elven warriors used their strength and wisdom equally in battle.
text: While this companion is bearing a possession, he is strength +2. Maneuver: Exert this companion to place an [elven] card from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck.

name: Spear of the Mark
lore: Rohirrim spears are much deadlier when the bearer is on horseback.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. If bearer is mounted, bearer is defender +1.

name: Sturdy Shield
lore: Sometimes the best offense is a good defense.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. While no opponent controls a site, bearer is strength +1. Regroup: Discard this to liberate a site (or two sites if bearer is mounted).

name: Swift Stroke
lore: ...she drove her sword between crown and mantle, as the great shoulders bowed before her.
text: Spot your [rohan] Man bearing a possession to discard all possessions from one character.

name: Community Living
lore: ...ease and peace had left this people still curiously tough.
text: Spot a Hobbit to play a [shire] follower from your draw deck.

name: Frodo, Weary From the Journey
subtitle: Weary From the Journey
lore: 'Let's... get out of this cursed place as quick as we can – if we can!'
text: Ring-bearer. Ring-bound. While skirmishing a minion of strength 8 or less, Frodo is strength +2.

name: Hobbit Sword
lore: These are for you. Keep them close.
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit.

name: Hobbiton Brewer, Maker of Fine Ales
subtitle: Maker of Fine Ales
text: Aid – Add 2 burdens. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add 2 burdens to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a Hobbit. Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, transfer Hobbiton Brewer to your support area to prevent that wound.

name: Hobbiton Farmer, Lover of Pipeweed
subtitle: Lover of Pipeweed
lore: ...for ages folk in the Shire smoked various herbs....
text: Aid – Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Bearer is strength +1 for each fierce minion you can spot.

name: Little Golden Flower
lore: '...she is very beautiful, and is going to be beautifuller still.'
text: Each Hobbit bearing a hand weapon is vitality +1. Each Hobbit bearing a follower is resistance +1. Each unwounded Hobbit is strength +1.

name: Merry, The Tall One
subtitle: The Tall One
lore: Three-foot-eight? You did something!
text: While Merry bears a follower, he is strength +2. Skirmish: If Merry is skirmishing a hunter minion, add a threat to make Merry strength +2.

name: Focus
lore: '...not even my eyes can see him, my good Legolas....'
text: Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a hunter [dwarven] Dwarf or hunter [gondor] Man. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [elven] Elf strength +2.

name: No Visitors
lore: No thank you!
text: Transfer a follower from a Hobbit to your support area to cancel a skirmish involving that Hobbit.

name: Pippin, The Short One
subtitle: The Short One
lore: I've always been taller than you.
text: Each [shire] follower is twilight cost -1. Skirmish: If Pippin is skirmishing a hunter minion, exert the Ring-bearer to make Pippin strength +2.

name: Relaxation
lore: As for the Hobbits of the Shire... they were a merry folk.
text: Response: If a Shadow card is about to add any number of burdens, discard a [shire] follower and this condition from play to prevent that and discard that Shadow card.

name: Sam, Innocent Traveler
subtitle: Innocent Traveler
text: Ring-bound. While Sam bears the One Ring, he is resistance -4. Maneuver: If Sam is bearing a follower, exert him to heal another Hobbit. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer.

name: Second Breakfast
lore: Don't think he knows about second breakfast, Pip.
text: Add a threat and exert your Ring-bearer to wound each non-hunter minion skirmishing your [shire] Ring-bearer.

name: Advancing Horde
lore: To war!
text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each site you control.

name: Charging Uruk
lore: They kept no order... yet their speed was very great.
text: Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and gains hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)

name: Chasing Uruk
lore: 'But why not kill them quick, kill them now?'
text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot 4 hunters (or Uglúk) to control a site.

name: Covetous Uruk
lore: The Uruk-hai pillage the remains of the fallen merely to satisfy their bloodlust.
text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each possession you can spot.

name: Defensive Rush
lore: Though the arrows rained down, the Uruk formation did not break.
text: While you can spot an [uruk-hai] minion, the Free Peoples player cannot replace a site. At the start of each skirmish, you may remove (3) to heal an [uruk-hai] minion (or heal an [uruk-hai] minion twice if you control a site).

name: Gift of the Evenstar, Blessed Light
subtitle: Blessed Light
text: Each time an Elf wins a skirmish, you may exert that Elf or Aragorn to place an [elven] token here. At the start of each maneuver phase, you may remove an [elven] token here to draw a card.

name: Following Uruk
lore: The hobbits were left with the Isengarders: a grim dark band... of large, swart, slant-eyed Orcs with great bows and short broad-bladed swords.
text: Fierce. Hunter 1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert a companion not assigned to a skirmish.

name: Hunting Uruk
lore: They're taking the Hobbits to Isengard!
text: While this minion is at a battleground site, it gains hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.).

name: Lurtz, Now Perfected
subtitle: Now Perfected
lore: You will taste man-flesh!
text: Damage +1. Each time Lurtz wins a skirmish, the Free People's player must exert X companions, where X is the current region number.

name: Lurtz's Sword, Mighty Longsword
subtitle: Mighty Longsword
lore: Defeating an Uruk with a broad-bladed sword is not easily done.
text: Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai. Bearer gains hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.). If bearer is Lurtz, he is fierce.

name: Mauhúr, Relentless Hunter
subtitle: Relentless Hunter
text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Assignment: Exert Mauhúr to assign him to a non-hunter character (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Merciless Berserker
lore: These are Uruk-hai. Their armor is thick and their shields broad.
text: Damage +1. Shadow: Exert this minion to exert X companions and add X threats, where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you spot over 2.

name: Poised for Assault
lore: Over the wall... the last assault came sweeping like a dark wave upon a hill of sand.
text: Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] minion, place an [uruk-hai] token here. Skirmish: Remove 2 [uruk-hai] tokens from here to take control of a site.

name: Pursuing Uruk
lore: 'I wish to kill, and then go back north.'
text: Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it gains hunter 4.

name: Searching Uruk
lore: '...we must stick together....'
text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Searching Uruk is strength +1 for each other [uruk-hai] hunter you can spot.

name: Seeking Uruk
lore: 'Rest while you can! We'll find a use for your legs before long.'
text: Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non- hunter character, this character is strength +1.) During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +1 for each hunter you can spot.

name: Haldir, Sentry of the Golden Wood
subtitle: Sentry of the Golden Wood
lore: '...since you come with an Elf of our kindred, we are willing to befriend you, as Elrond asked....'
text: To play, spot an Elf. While the fellowship is at a battleground site, Haldir is strength +2. While the fellowship is at a forest site, Haldir is an archer.

name: Sentry Uruk
text: To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion. While you can spot a fierce minion, this minion is fierce. While you can spot a hunter, this minion gains hunter 1. While you can spot a character that is damage +1, this minion is damage +1.

name: Tracking Uruk
lore: 'We are servants of Saruman the Wise, the White Hand: the Hand that gives us man's-flesh to eat.'
text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)

name: Uglúk, Ugly Fellow
subtitle: Ugly Fellow
lore: '...let's have no more nonsense!'
text: Fierce. Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.) At the start of each skirmish involving Uglúk, each non-hunter skirmishing Uglúk must exert.

name: Uglúk's Sword, Weapon of Command
subtitle: Weapon of Command
lore: 'I don't trust you little swine.'
text: Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai. While you control 2 or more sites, bearer can not take wounds (except during skirmish phases). If bearer is Uglúk, he is damage +1.

name: Uruk Cavern Striker
lore: Get them into the caves.
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Spot a Free Peoples player's site on the adventure path and exert this minion twice to exchange the spotted site with a site you control. You now control the spotted site.

name: Uruk Infantry
lore: March to Helm's Deep! Leave none alive!
text: Damage +1. While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +2. Regroup: Exert 4 [uruk-hai] minions (or discard 3 [uruk-hai] minions) to take control of a site.

name: Uruk Village Assassin
lore: Rohan, my Lord, is ready to fall.
text: Damage +1. At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot another [uruk-hai] minion and remove 3 [uruk-hai] tokens to take control of a site or discard a follower.

name: Uruk Village Rager
lore: They come to destroy its people.
text: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, take control of a site. While you control a site, this minion cannot take wounds (except during the skirmish phase).

name: Uruk Village Stormer
lore: Saruman's hordes will pillage and burn....
text: Damage +1. While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +4. Each time a companion or ally is killed during a skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] minion, you may take control of a site.

name: Violent Hurl
lore: Uruk-hai weaponry was built to be used offensively and defensively, depending on the situation.
text: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +2 (and damage +1 if that minion is a hunter).

name: Legolas, Fleet-footed Hunter
subtitle: Fleet-footed Hunter
lore: 'We have already overtaken some of those that we are hunting....'
text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Regroup: Exert 2 hunter companions to draw a card.

name: With All Possible Speed
lore: 'They seemed to have left winter clinging to the hills behind.'
text: Each unwounded hunter [uruk-hai] minion is strength +1. Response: If your hunter minion is about to take a wound during a skirmish, discard that minion to exert a non-hunter companion.

name: Later Than You Think
lore: The Nine have left Minas Morgul.
text: Remove 2 threats to play a Nazgûl. That Nazgûl is twilight cost -2 and gains hunter 2 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) until the start of the regroup phase.

name: A Shadow Fell Over Them
lore: ...a blind fear and a deadly cold fell on them. Cowering they looked up.
text: Each time a Nazgûl wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 Nazgûl (or a Nazgûl twice) to add a threat. Assignment: Spot a Nazgûl and remove (4) to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile.

name: They Feel The Precious
lore: 'Three times is a threat. They feel us here....'
text: Response: If a Nazgûl is about to take a wound, remove a threat to prevent that wound.

name: Úlairë Attëa, Desirous of Power
subtitle: Desirous of Power
lore: The Nazgûl were strongest, and most terrifying, at night.
text: Fierce. Úlairë Attëa is strength +1 for every 3 twilight tokens you can spot.

name: Úlairë Lemenya, Eternally Threatening
subtitle: Eternally Threatening
lore: Soon there could be no doubt: three or four tall black figures were standing on the slope, looking down on them.
text: Fierce. When you play Úlairë Lemenya, you may remove (1) to add a threat for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.

name: Úlairë Nelya, Fell Rider
subtitle: Fell Rider
text: Fierce. While you can spot 6 companions, [wraith] minions cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases). Skirmish: If this minion is mounted, exert him twice to wound a companion bearing a [wraith] condition.

name: Anduin River
text: River. The fellowship archery total is -3.

name: Breeding pit of Isengard
text: Underground. The twilight cost of the first hunter minion played each Shadow phase is -2.

name: City Gates
text: When the Fellowship moves to this site, add a threat (or 2 if you can spot a hunter minion) for each companion over 4.

name: Legolas, Of the Woodland Realm
subtitle: Of the Woodland Realm
lore: You would die before your stroke fell!
text: Archer. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Archery: Exert Legolas to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each hunter minion you can spot (limit +3).

name: East Wall of Rohan
text: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may exert two hunter companions to play a hunter companion from your draw deck.

name: Gate of Mordor
text: Battleground. Each time the fellowship moves to this site, add (1) for each culture you can spot.

name: Isengard Ruined
text: Battleground. Each time a follower is transferred to a character, the first Shadow player may exert a companion twice.

name: Mount Doom
text: Battleground. Mountain. Underground. Until the end of the game, sites in this region cannot be replaced.

name: Westfold Village
text: Plains. Each hunter character is strength +1.

name: The One Ring, The Ruling Ring
subtitle: The Ruling Ring
lore: One Ring to rule them all....
text: Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he or she wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While the Ring-bearer is wearing The One Ring, each time he or she is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead.

name: Lórien's Blessing
lore: 'We have drunk the cup of parting...and the shadows fall between us.'
text: Spot an [elven] follower to make the minion archery total -3.

name: Forth the Three Hunters!, Dwarven Version
subtitle: Dwarven Version
text: Archery: Exert Legolas and exert Aragorn to wound a minion. Skirmish: Exert Aragorn and spot Gimli to make a minion strength -1 (or -3 if Aragorn and Gimli are hunters). Regroup: Exert Gimli and spot Legolas to draw a card (or 2 cards if Gimli and Legolas are hunters).

name: Forth the Three Hunters!, Elven Version
subtitle: Elven Version
text: Archery: Exert Legolas and exert Aragorn to wound a minion. Skirmish: Exert Aragorn and spot Gimli to make a minion strength -1 (or -3 if Aragorn and Gimli are hunters). Regroup: Exert Gimli and spot Legolas to draw a card (or 2 cards if Gimli and Legolas are hunters).

name: Forth the Three Hunters!, Gondor Version
subtitle: Gondor Version
text: Archery: Exert Legolas and exert Aragorn to wound a minion. Skirmish: Exert Aragorn and spot Gimli to make a minion strength -1 (or -3 if Aragorn and Gimli are hunters). Regroup: Exert Gimli and spot Legolas to draw a card (or 2 cards if Gimli and Legolas are hunters).

name: Mighty Shot
lore: 'But who can say what it hit?'
text: Spot an Elf to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each minion with a twilight cost of 2 or less that you can spot.

name: The Mirror of Galadriel, Dangerous Guide
subtitle: Dangerous Guide
text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Each time you are about to draw a card, you may exert an Elf to look at the top three cards of your draw deck instead. Take a Free Peoples card into your hand and place the other cards on the bottom of your draw deck.

name: Point Blank Range
lore: How many there were the company could not count.
text: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if you can spot 3 archers).

name: Spied From Afar
text: To play, spot 3 Elves. While you can spot an [elven] follower, the twilight cost of each Shadow possession is +1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [elven] companion strength +1 for each archer companion you can spot.

name: Sword of the Fallen
lore: Elven weapons remain in use for centuries.
text: Bearer must be an Elf. Each minion skirmishing bearer is strength -1 for each wound on that minion. Skirmish: Exert bearer to exert a minion skirmishing bearer.

name: Uruviel, Woodland Maid
subtitle: Woodland Maid
text: Aid – (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may exert an Elf to make the fellowship's current site a forest until the end of the turn.

name: Be Gone!
lore: You did not kill me, you will not kill him!
text: Spell. Exert your [gandalf] companion X times to make a minion strength -2 until the regroup phase, for each time that [gandalf] companion exerted.

name: Ent Avenger
lore: As they drew near the flash and flicker of their eyes could be seen.
text: While you can spot 3 Ents, this companion is strength +2.

name: Gandalf, Powerful Guide
subtitle: Powerful Guide
lore: Let the Ring-bearer decide.
text: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Each time you play a spell, you may add a burden to wound a minion. At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, you may draw a card and then discard a card from your hand.

name: Chamber of Records
text: When you play this, you may spot a Dwarf to place 2 [dwarven] tokens here. Fellowship: Discard this from play or remove a [dwarven] token from here to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a [dwarven] card, take it into your hand, otherwise, place it in your discard pile.

name: Leaflock, Finglas
subtitle: Finglas
lore: When roused to action, little could stop the destructive power of the Ents.
text: Leaflock's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent you can spot. While you can spot 4 other Ents, Leaflock is strength +4.

name: Mellon!
text: To play, spot 2 [gandalf] companions. At the start of the maneuver phase, discard this condition to make each player count the number of cards in his or her hand, discard each of them and draw the same number of cards from the top of his or her draw deck.

name: Momentous Gathering
lore: '...I have managed to make a fair number promise to come.'
text: Choose one: spot an Ent to take a [gandalf] companion into hand from your draw deck; or spot 2 Ents to take a [gandalf] companion and a [gandalf] condition into hand from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.

name: One Last Surprise
lore: The dragon passed like an express train... and burst over Bywater with a deafening explosion.
text: Spell. Spot Gandalf and an unbound companion skirmishing a minion to use Gandalf's resistance to resolve that skirmish instead of that companion's strength.

name: Quickbeam, Hastiest of All Ents
subtitle: Hastiest of All Ents
lore: 'A punch from an Ent-fist crumples up iron....'
text: Quickbeam is twilight cost -1 for each Ent you can spot. Maneuver: Discard this companion to place another [gandalf] companion from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck and reinforce a [gandalf] token.

name: Shadow of the Wood
lore: Treebeard's call to the Ent Moot could not be refused.
text: This companion is twilight cost -1 for each [gandalf] companion you can spot. Fellowship: Place this companion in the dead pile to remove (5).

name: Shepherd of the Trees
lore: Ents rarely interacted with Men, but Saruman's devilry demanded action.
text: While you can spot 4 Ents, this companion is strength +3. Maneuver: Exert this companion to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is a [gandalf] character, you may play it.

name: Skinbark, Elder Ent
subtitle: Elder Ent
lore: '...a man that hacks once at an Ent never gets the chance of a second blow.'
text: Skinbark is twilight cost -1 for each [gandalf] condition you can spot. Each time Skinbark wins a skirmish, you may place a [gandalf] card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.

name: Treebeard, Enraged Shepherd
subtitle: Enraged Shepherd
lore: My business is with Isengard tonight.
text: To play, spot 3 [gandalf] companions. Each time Treebeard wins a skirmish, the first Shadow player must exert X minions, where X is the difference between Treebeard's strength and the losing character's strength.

name: Called to Mordor
lore: It won't be long now. He will soon be ready.
text: Bearer must be Sméagol. While you can spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits, each time an opponent uses a skirmish special ability in a skirmish involving Gollum or Sméagol, you may wound a minion.

name: The Fortunes of Balin's Folk
lore: 'It is grim reading....'
text: Exert a Dwarf to shuffle a [dwarven] condition with one or more [dwarven] tokens on it into your draw deck. Wound a minion for each [dwarven] token that was on that condition.

name: Connected By Fate
lore: Thief, thief! Baggins! We hates it for ever!
text: To play, spot Sméagol. While you can spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits, each Shadow event is twilight cost +1. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make each Ring-bound companion strength +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Controlled By The Ring
lore: Gollum's appetite for the One Ring could not be quenched.
text: Bearer must be Gollum. Skirmish: If Gollum is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to have him replace a minion skirmishing a companion.

name: Desperate Move
lore: 'He leaped into the waters, but the Ring slipped from his finger as he swam....'
text: Discard a [gollum] minion from play to discard a companion. The Free Peoples player may make the move limit -1 this turn to prevent that.

name: Gollum, Hopeless
subtitle: Hopeless
lore: Give it to us raw and wriggling!
text: At the start of each skirmish involving Gollum, he is strength +X until the end of that skirmish, where X is the Ring-bearer's strength.

name: Herbs and Stewed Rabbit
lore: 'Eat them, Eat them!'
text: While you can spot Frodo, Sméagol is resistance +1. While you can spot Sam, Sméagol is strength +1. While you can spot Bilbo, Sméagol is damage +1.

name: Hurry Hobbitses
lore: Very lucky we find you.
text: Make Sméagol strength +1 for each Ring- bound Hobbit you can spot.

name: Nice Fish
lore: 'Bring fish with you. Come!'
text: Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, place a [gollum] token here. Regroup: Heal a Ring-bound companion for each token here. Discard this condition.

name: Not This Time!
lore: Got away, did it, Precious!
text: Skirmish: Exert Gollum and remove a threat to wound a companion Gollum is skirmishing.

name: Release Them
lore: If you let them go, your life will be forfeit.
text: Spot Sméagol to prevent a Ring-bound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled. While this card is in your discard pile, Sméagol is resistance +1.

name: Sméagol, Wretched and Hungry
subtitle: Wretched and Hungry
lore: '...this creature is in some way bound up with my errand.'
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Each Ring-bound companion is resistance +1. Skirmish: Exert 2 Ring-bound Hobbits to make Sméagol strength +1 and prevent him from being overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.

name: Gimli, Eager Hunter
subtitle: Eager Hunter
lore: 'Well, after them!' said Gimli. 'Dwarves too can go swiftly....'
text: Damage +1. Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.)

name: Something Slimy
lore: What he was chewing, they did not ask or like to think.
text: Spot Sméagol to play a condition from your draw deck. If that condition was a [gollum] condition, you may make an opponent place a random card from his or her hand beneath his or her draw deck.

name: Sudden Strike
lore: ...she drove her huge bulk down on him again.
text: Spot Gollum or Sméagol to play a minion from your draw deck. If that minion is a [gollum] minion, you may also play a Shadow possession or Shadow condition from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.

name: Swear by the Precious
lore: 'I will serve the master of the Precious.'
text: Spot Frodo and Sméagol to discard a minion. That minion's owner may make each minion strength -2 until the end of the turn to prevent that.

name: Unseen Foe
lore: ...all the while he hissed, but spoke no words.
text: Discard a [gollum] minion from play to wound each companion with strength 8 or more.

name: Aragorn, Swift Hunter
subtitle: Swift Hunter
lore: Ride out with me. Ride out and meet them.
text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make a hunter companion strength +1.

name: Aragorn, Thorongil
subtitle: Thorongil
lore: 'I will follow the Orcs....'
text: Ranger. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) Maneuver: Add a threat to exert a non- hunter minion with strength less than Aragorn.

name: Aragorn's Bow, Ranger's Longbow
subtitle: Ranger's Longbow
lore: The bow can reach what the sword cannot.
text: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is an archer. Archery: Add a threat to wound a minion with the lowest strength.

name: Damrod, Dúnadan of Gondor
subtitle: Dúnadan of Gondor
lore: 'Curse the Southrons!'
text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (1) to heal a ranger.

name: Decorated Barricade
lore: In times of war, the beauty of the walls matters little.
text: Fortification. This condition is twilight cost -1 for each [gondor] ranger you spot. Skirmish: Exert 2 [gondor] Men to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

name: Dúnedain of the South
lore: 'We come to ambush the Men of Harad.'
text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may make a [gondor] ranger strength +2 until the regroup phase.

name: Glóin, Son of Gróin
subtitle: Son of Gróin
text: Each time Glóin wins a skirmish, you may draw 3 cards, then place 3 cards from your hand beneath your draw deck in any order. Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token to make Glóin strength +2.

name: Gondorian Prowler
lore: Rangers use all five senses to hunt their prey.
text: Ranger. Hunter 1. When this companion is in your starting fellowship, he is twilight cost -1. Skirmish: Remove a [gondor] token or exert a [gondor] Man to make the site number of a minion +2.

name: Ithilien Blade
lore: Most Rangers of Ithilien carried spears, bows, and swords while marching.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. While you can spot a roaming minion, bearer is strength +1. Maneuver: Exert bearer twice to discard a roaming minion.

name: Mablung, Ranger of Ithilien
subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien
lore: 'We come to teach them another lesson.'
text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Skirmish: Exert Mablung to wound a roaming minion he is skirmishing.

name: Madril, Defender of Osgiliath
subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath
lore: 'For that is the ruin of Osgiliath....'
text: Ranger. Hunter 1. While you can spot 2 [gondor] rangers, Madril is twilight cost -2. At the start of the maneuver phase, each minion is site number +1 for each threat you can spot until the start of the regroup phase.

name: No Quicker Path
lore: '...we no longer need any trail to tell us which way....'
text: Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, you may make a hunter [dwarven] companion or hunter [elven] companion strength +1 until the regroup phase. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [gondor] Man strength +2.

name: No Travellers In This Land
lore: '...only the servants of the Dark Tower, or of the White.'
text: Exert a [gondor] Man to wound a minion (or wound that minion twice if it is a hunter).

name: Portico
