lore: The doors of Minas Tirith were meant to keep out more than Orcs.
text: Fortification. The twilight cost of this condition is -1 for each [gondor] ranger you spot. Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot 2 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

name: Ranger's Cloak
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. While bearer is a ranger or at a forest site, each minion skirmishing bearer is site number +2. Skirmish: Add a threat or exert bearer to make a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man site number +2.

name: Silent Traveler
lore: 'We have not found what we sought....'
text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) At the start of each skirmish involving this companion and a roaming minion, you may reinforce a [gondor] token.

name: Heavy Axe
lore: Dwarven smiths created weaponry of all sizes and styles.
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. This is twilight cost -1 for each [dwarven] card that has a culture token on it. Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token to make bearer strength +1.

name: Tremendous Wall
text: Fortification. Characters skirmishing bearer cannot take wounds from losing a skirmish involving bearer. Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot 3 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

name: Unyielding Ranger
lore: Their faces were hooded and masked with green, except for their eyes....
text: Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) This companion is strength +1 for each roaming minion you can spot.

name: Bill Ferny, Agent of Saruman
subtitle: Agent of Saruman
lore: '...he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'
text: If Bill Ferny is unwounded, the Free Peoples player cannot assign him to skirmish a companion. Shadow: Exert Bill Ferny twice and spot a site you control to add (2).

name: Bold Easterling
lore: 'They hold the northward road; and many have passed on into Anórien.'
text: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Chieftain of Dunland
text: Fierce. Skirmish: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to make a [men] Man strength +2. Skirmish: Spot 2 sites you control and remove (2) to make a [men] Man strength +3. Skirmish: Spot 3 sites you control and remove (2) to make a [men] Man strength +4.

name: Courageous Easterling
lore: Easterlings came to Mordor to aid Sauron in his final assault.
text: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Destroyed Homestead
lore: Destruction sometimes brings new opportunities.
text: When you play this, spot 2 [men] Men to randomly reveal a site from the Free Peoples player's adventure deck. Note its card title. Each site on the adventure path with the same card title as the selected site loses its game text.

name: Easterling Scout
lore: In battle, Easterlings surprise their foes with a great number of different techniques.
text: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Engrossed Hillman
lore: Years of anger have a tendency to bring focus to one's rage.
text: At the start of the maneuver phase, if you can spot another [men] Man and 8 characters (or if you can spot 3 Free Peoples cultures), you may take control of a site.

name: Enraged Herdsman
lore: Dunlendings don't mind being outnumbered in battle.
text: While you can spot more companions than minions, each [men] hunter is strength +2 and is an archer.

name: Sturdy Stock
lore: Dwarves have a knack for surviving misfortune.
text: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or if you can spot a hunter minion, strength +1 and damage +1 for each hunter minion you can spot).

name: Great Axe
lore: To his surprise, Frodo's cloak served as an effective camouflage among the rocks.
text: Bearer must be a [men] Man. While bearer is skirmishing a hunter companion, bearer is strength +2.

name: Grieving the Fallen
lore: Mordor will pay for this!
text: To play, spot a [men] Man. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Bearer cannot take wounds during the archery phase. At the start of the regroup phase, discard this condition.

name: Grousing Hillman
lore: Acquiring more territories only increases the rage of the Dunlendings.
text: While you control a site, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.

name: Hunting Herdsman
lore: Hunters are valuable members of Dunlending tribes.
text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) This minion is strength +3 for each follower you can spot.

name: Last Gasp
lore: Southron archers know that they must press through their exhaustion to win the battle.
text: Wound 3 [men] archers to exhaust a companion.

name: Lying Counsel
lore: 'Let your counsellor Gríma keep all things....'
text: Exert your [men] Man and spot an unbound companion bearing 3 or more cards to return each Free Peoples card that companion bears to its owner's hand. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to discard those cards instead.

name: Mûmak Commander, Giant Among the Swertings
subtitle: Giant Among the Swertings
lore: ...high upon his neck still desperately clung a tiny figure – the body of a mighty warrior....
text: Maneuver: Exert Mûmak Commander twice to exert a companion twice (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Primitive Savage
lore: The only thing scarier than a Wild Man is a Wild Man with an axe.
text: While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +5. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if he bears a hand weapon, you may take control of a site.

name: Pursuing Horde
lore: Once the Dunlendings track their enemy they will not lose their trail.
text: To play, spot a [men] Man. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per companion. Each time the fellowship moves, add (1).

name: Rapid Reload
lore: The Men of Harad kept a large supply of arrows at hand.
text: While you can spot a [men] Man, the Free Peoples player cannot replace a site in the current region. Archery: Spot a [men] Man and remove (3) to exert an unbound companion.

name: Well-crafted Armor
lore: Dwarven armor is among the strongest crafted in Middle-earth.
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time bearer takes a wound, you may reinforce a [dwarven] token. Skirmish: Discard a [dwarven] card from hand to make bearer damage +1.

name: Rapt Hillman
lore: Dunlendings take delight in destruction.
text: At the start of the regroup phase, the Free People's player may liberate a site. You may spot 3 Men to prevent this. Maneuver: Spot another [men] Man and exert this minion to take control of a site.

name: Ravaging Wild Man
lore: No villager is safe when the Wild Men attack.
text: While you can spot a hunter, this minion gains hunter 1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 [men] Men to discard a follower.

name: Savage Southron
lore: The Southrons are skilled at fighting in many different kinds of terrain.
text: Maneuver: If the Free People's player has at least 1 site in his or her adventure deck, exert 2 [men] Men to randomly choose a site from that deck. Replace the fellowship's current site with that site.

name: Swarthy Hillman
lore: The Wild Men will defend their territories at all costs.
text: While you control a site, this minion is an archer.

name: Wandering Hillman
lore: The Hillmen are always searching for lands to conquer.
text: To play, spot a [men] Man. While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +3. Maneuver: Remove 2 burdens or 2 threats to control a site.

name: Battlefield Recruit
lore: Grond! Grond! Grond!
text: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a minion strength +2.

name: Battlefield Veteran
lore: Though he had seen it many times before, Grond's destructive power never ceased to amaze.
text: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a minion strength +1.

name: Beasts of Burden
lore: ...some great beast...would go mad and spread stamping ruin....
text: To play, spot 2 [orc] minions. At the start of your Shadow phase, you may discard an [orc] condition from play to play an [orc] minion. It is twilight cost -2 (or -4 if you can spot 6 or more companions).

name: Black Gate Sentry
lore: Very few tried to sneak into Mordor. Even fewer succeeded.
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.

name: Black Land Chieftain
lore: Orcs frequently used the weapons of their fallen enemies as their own.
text: To play, spot an [orc] minion. When you play Black Land Chieftain, you may add a threat for each Free Peoples possession and each Free Peoples artifact you can spot.

name: Phial of Galadriel, Bane of Darkness
subtitle: Bane of Darkness
text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. Discard this if you can spot more than 4 companions. Maneuver: Add 2 burdens to hinder all Shadow support cards with a title you spot. Response: If The One Ring is transferred, play this on the new Ring-bearer.  You may use this ability from your discard pile.

name: Your Staff is Broken
lore: 'Behold, I am not Gandalf the Grey, whom you betrayed. I am Gandalf the White, who has returned from death. You have no colour now, and I cast you from the order and from the Council.'
text: At the start of each Assignment phase, you may exert Gandalf bearing an artifact to discard a hindered Shadow card.

name: Sauron, Lord of All Middle-earth
subtitle: Lord of All Middle-earth
text: Sauron is twilight cost -1 for each artifact and companion you can spot (limit -6). While you can spot 6 companions, Sauron is fierce. While you can spot 7 companions, Sauron is relentless (he participates in 1 extra round of skirmishes after fierce.). Each time a companion loses a skirmish to Sauron, kill that companion.

name: Sauron's Reach
lore: Victory was slipping from his grasp even as he stretched out his hand to seize it. But his arm was long. He was still in command, wielding great powers.
text: Exert 3 [sauron] minions (or spot Sauron) to hinder all Free Peoples support cards.  For each card hindered, hinder a Shadow support card.

name: The Mouth of Sauron, Emissary of Mordor
subtitle: Emissary of Mordor
lore: Those nearby saw the anguish in his face, and now he seemed...crushed, defeated at last.
text: Lurker. Each time a companion loses a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must add a threat or a burden. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a wounded companion strength -1.

name: They Are Not All Accounted For
lore: 'Fëanor himself, maybe, wrought them, in days so long ago...But there is nothing that Sauron cannot turn to evil uses.'
text: To play, spot 2 [sauron] or [ringwraith] cards. Each time a Free Peoples card reveals or discards a card from any draw deck, you may exert an unbound companion or ally to draw a card (limit once per site).

name: Was He Dear to Thee?
lore: 'And now he shall endure the slow torment of years, as long and slow as our arts in the Great Tower can contrive, and never be released, unless maybe when he is changed and broken...'
text: Exert a unique [sauron] or [ringwraith] minion and hinder the Ring-bearer to make each minion strength +2 until the regroup phase.

name: Driven By Her Own Cruel Will
lore: 'You've hurt my master, you brute, and you'll pay!'
text: Make a skirmishing Hobbit bearing a hand weapon (except the Ring-bearer) strength +X, where X is the total vitality of all characters in that skirmish.  At the end of that skirmish, hinder a minion involved in that skirmish if you cannot spot more than 4 companions.

name: Flotsam
lore: 'We have heaps of it,' he said; 'and you can all pack as much as you wish, when we go.'
text: Pipeweed. Bearer must bear a pipe. When you play this possession, you may shuffle up to 2 pipes or pipeweed from your discard pile into your draw deck.

name: For Frodo
lore: 'His Eye is now straining towards us, blind almost to all else that is moving....Therein lies all our hope.'
text: Exert a unique [gondor] or [shire] companion (except Frodo) to make that companion strength +1 for each burden on Frodo (limit +3 unless you cannot spot more than 4 companions).  Remove this from the game.

name: For the Shire
text: Spot a Hobbit companion (except the Ring-bearer). In region 1, hinder all other Hobbits. In region 2, make that Hobbit defender +2 until the regroup phase. In region 3, make that Hobbit enduring until the regroup phase.

name: For My Old Gaffer
lore: The orc wheeled round, but before it could make a move Sam slashed its whip-hand from its arm.
text: Spot a Hobbit skirmishing more than 1 minion.  Resolve skirmishes between that Hobbit and those minions individually.  Until the regroup phase, add a burden each time that Hobbit loses a skirmish and a threat each time that Hobbit wins.

name: Fickle Loyalties
lore: So he thought in an inner chamber of his cunning, which he still hoped to hide from her...
text: To play, spot 2 [shire] companions. Each time Gollum loses a skirmish, make another minion strength -1 until the regroup phase. Each time Shelob loses a skirmish, kill Gollum.

name: Frodo, Bereft of Hope
subtitle: Bereft of Hope
lore: 'Look here, Sam dear lad,' said Frodo: 'I am tired, weary, I haven't a hope left. But I have to go on trying to get to the Mountain, as long as I can move. The Ring is enough. This extra weight is killing me. It must go.'
text: Ring-bearer (resistance 7).  Ring-bound. Frodo is strength +1 for each burden.

name: Get Up, Mister Frodo
lore: 'I'll get there, if I leave everything but my bones behind,' said Sam. 'And I'll carry Mr. Frodo up myself, if it breaks my back and heart.'
text: Spot Frodo to restore a [shire] card.  If you cannot spot more than 4 companions, you may add (3) to reconcile your hand and heal up to 2 [shire] companions.

name: Hornblower Barrel
text: Pipeweed. When you play this, you may discard a Free Peoples card from your draw deck. When you discard this with a pipe, you may spot another Hornblower Barrel to take 2 other Free Peoples cards (except events or Hornblower Barrels) from your discard pile into hand.

name: Merry's Pipe
lore: 'But Ents only drink, and drink is not enough for content. Treebeard's draughts may be nourishing, but one feels the need of something solid.'
text: Bearer must be an unbound Hobbit. Each time a pipeweed is discarded, you may exert bearer to play that pipeweed from your discard pile.  Hinder it and this pipe.

name: Pippin's Pipe
lore: 'I have carried it a long way, though I don't know why. I never really expected to find any pipe-weed on the journey, when my own ran out.'
text: Bearer must be an unbound Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard a pipeweed to remove X threats, where X is the number of pipes you can spot. Hinder this pipe or hinder bearer.

name: Sam, Undaunted
subtitle: Undaunted
lore: 'I can't carry it for you, but I can carry you...!'
text: Ring-bound. Frodo is resistance +2. Maneuver: If you cannot spot more than 4 companions, add a burden to choose condition or possession, then choose odd or even.  Hinder all Shadow support cards with a type and twilight cost matching your choice. Limit once per turn.

name: Smeagol, Once Like Us
subtitle: Once Like Us
lore: ...thought that they beheld an old weary hobbit...
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Assignment: If you cannot spot a companion with a culture other than [shire], exert Smeagol and hinder him to spot a minion.  Add (2) (and add 2 threats if that minion is twilight cost 5 or more) to hinder that minion.

name: Sting, Sharp Elven-blade
subtitle: Sharp Elven-blade
text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit.  Skirmish: If you cannot spot more than 4 companions, add a threat to make bearer strength +1 for each threat you can spot (limit +6).  Response: If The One Ring is transferred, play this on the new Ring-bearer.  You may use this ability from your discard pile.

name: The Sooner We're Rid of It
text: To play, spot 2 Hobbit companions. Skirmish: Exert a companion and hinder each card borne by them to make that companion strength +1 for each card hindered (+3 if that card is a weapon).  Hinder this condition if you can spot more than 4 companions.

name: Treasured Pipe
lore: 'I keep a treasure or two near my skin, as precious as Rings to me. Here's one: my old wooden pipe.'
text: To play, spot a pipe or an unbound Hobbit. Bearer must be a companion. Fellowship: Discard 2 pipeweeds and spot X pipes to make X companions strength +1 until the regroup phase.  Hinder this pipe.

name: Pass of the Spider
text: Each time a special ability on a Free Peoples condition is used, you may discard a minion stacked here to hinder that condition and heal Shelob. Skirmish: If Shelob is skirmishing, stack another minion from play here to make a character skirmishing her strength -2 (limit once per phase).

name: Worth Fighting For
text: To play, spot a Hobbit companion. Make the Shadow player exhaust 1 of your characters.  For each exertion made, hinder a Shadow support card.  If you cannot spot more than 4 companions, you may make the Shadow player shuffle one of their hindered cards (and all cards stacked on it) into their owner's draw deck.

name: Gates of Isengard
text: Fellowship: Exert an unbound Hobbit to play a pipe and pipeweed from your draw deck (limit once per phase).

name: Desolation of Ash
text: At the start of each phase, the Shadow player may remove (1) to take a Shadow event for that phase into hand from discard.

name: Gorgoroth Highway
text: At the start of the maneuver phase, hinder all weapons. All characters gain enduring.

name: Gorgoroth Wastes
text: When moving here, for each Free Peoples card borne by companions, the Free Peoples player must discard it or add (1).

name: Muster of Gorgoroth
text: Battleground. Each minion is strength +1 for each threat you can spot.

name: Cracks of Doom
text: Mountain.  Underground. Game text on Free Peoples items and The One Ring does not apply. Each minion is strength +1.

name: Doom Causeway
text: Mountain. Underground. Battleground. Each time a card is hindered, discard it.  Each time a character is exerted, wound it.

name: Orodruin
text: Mountain. Battleground. Each time a threat is added, the Free Peoples player must assign all threat wounds.

name: Pinnacle of Doom
text: Mountain. At the start of each phase, the Shadow player may remove (1) to hinder a card (except companions or The One Ring).

name: Shelob, Terror of Cirith Ungol
subtitle: Terror of Cirith Ungol
text: Fierce.  Enduring. Each time a skirmish involving Shelob ends, you may hinder each character she was skirmishing. Skirmish: If Gollum is skirmishing, exert Gollum and Shelob to hinder a character he is skirmishing.

name: Threshold of Doom
text: Mountain. Shadow: Remove a burden or a threat to play a minion from your discard pile. If it costs (5) or more, add (1).

name: Sticky Strands of Spider-silk
lore: Never yet had any fly escaped from Shelob's webs, and the greater now was her rage and hunger.
text: At the end of each skirmish involving bearer, make bearer strength -1 until the end of the turn.\Skirmish: Hinder your [gollum] card to transfer this to a companion skirmishing a [Gollum] minion. Limit 1 per bearer unless they are skirmishing Shelob.

name: Two-faced
lore: Too little did he or his master know of the craft of Shelob. She had many exits from her lair.
text: Shadow or Maneuver or Skirmish: Restore a [gollum] card. Then you may spot a [gollum] minion and remove a threat to replace it with another minion from your discard pile with the same title (keep all tokens and borne cards).

name: Two Minds of It
lore: 'All the same, I'd rather have him under my eye,' said Sam. 'All the more so, if he's false.'
text: Fellowship or Maneuver or Skirmish: Restore Smeagol. Then you may spot Smeagol (if he is not the Ring-bearer) and add a threat to replace him with another Smeagol from your discard pile (keep all tokens and borne cards).

name: Ungoliant's Get
text: Each time Shelob loses a skirmish, you may play a [gollum] item from your discard pile. Response: If Shelob wins a skirmish and there are 4 minions stacked on [gollum] items, hinder this to make her relentless until the regroup phase (she participates in 1 extra round of skirmishes after fierce).

name: Andúril, Legend Remade
subtitle: Legend Remade
lore: 'Here is the Sword that was Broken and is forged again! Will you aid me or thwart me? Choose swiftly!'
text: Bearer must be Aragorn. He is damage +1. Response: If an unbound companion is about to take a wound (except Aragorn), add 2 threats to hinder that companion. Add (2) unless that companion was [gondor] or a Man.

name: Aragorn, King of Gondor and Arnor
subtitle: King of Gondor and Arnor
lore: Out from the beleaguered hills knights of Gondor, Riders of Rohan, Dúnedain of the North, close-serried companies, drove against their wavering foes...
text: Aragorn is strength +1 for each culture among other Men you can spot.\Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert Aragorn and hinder another unbound Man to remove a threat or a burden.

name: Jetsam
text: Pipeweed. Bearer must bear a pipe. When you play this, you may discard a Shadow card on bearer. When this is discarded by a pipe, add 1 to the number of pipes you can spot this phase and make your character lose unhasty until the end of the turn.

name: Domain of the Dead King
text: When you play this, spot a [gondor] Wraith to remove a threat. Each time a [gondor] Wraith takes a threat wound, wound a minion. Response: If an exhausted [gondor] Wraith is about to take a wound, add a threat and hinder this artifact to hinder that Wraith.

name: Ethereal Banner
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Wraith. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may exert a Wraith and a minion it is assigned to skirmish. Response: If bearer overwhelms a minion, discard this possession and remove 2 threats to wound 2 minions.

name: Ethereal March
lore: 'Folk say that Dead Men out of the Dark Years guard the way and will suffer no living man...'
text: While you can spot 2 [gondor] Wraiths, the threat limit is +2. While you can spot more threats than companions, each Wraith is strength +1. Each time this condition is hindered or discarded, remove a threat.

name: Great Gate of Minas Tirith
text: Fortification.  To play, exert a [gondor] companion (or spot 3 knights). Each time the special ability of a Shadow support card is used, you may hinder a fortification to hinder that card.  Then you may exert X knights to hinder X other copies of that card with the same title.

name: I Call on You
lore: 'The hour is come at last.....When all this land is clean of the servants of Sauron, I will hold the oath fulfilled, and ye shall have peace and depart for ever. For I am Elessar, Isildur's heir of Gondor.'
text: Exert Aragorn (or spot Anduril) and add X threats to play a Wraith from your dead pile, where X is the region number.

name: Inner Gate
lore: 'But men are better than gates, and no gate will endure against our Enemy if men desert it.'
text: Fortification. Maneuver: If this is in your support area, exert and hinder 2 unbound knights to transfer this to a minion.  Hinder that minion.

name: Keep Him Blind to All Else That Moves
lore: 'But we must at all costs keep his Eye from his true peril. We cannot achieve victory by arms, but by arms we can give the Ring-bearer his only chance, frail though it be.'
text: When you play this, heal each Free Peoples Man.  Shadow: The Shadow player may discard this to reconcile their hand.

name: King of the Dead, Dead Keeper
subtitle: Dead Keeper
lore: 'Yet it is said in Harrowdale,' said Éowyn in a low voice. 'that in the moonless nights but little while ago a great host in strange array passed by.'
text: Enduring.  To play, add 2 threats. Each time King of the Dead is killed, heal every Wraith. Assignment: Exert King of the Dead and restore a Wraith to heal that Wraith.

name: Northern Signal-fire, Flame of Amon Din
subtitle: Flame of Amon Din
lore: 'On, Shadowfax! We must hasten. Time is short. See! The beacons of Gondor are alight, calling for aid. War is kindled.'
text: Beacon. To play, hinder 2 beacons. Response: If an unbound Man costing X is about to take a wound, spot X beacons to prevent that wound. Hinder a beacon.

name: Northern Signal-fire, Flame of Eilenach
subtitle: Flame of Eilenach
lore: 'For I saw the beacons last night and the errand-riders; and Gandalf said that it was a sign...'
text: Beacon. To play, hinder 2 beacons. Skirmish: Hinder this beacon to make your unbound Man strength +1 for each of the following you can spot: ranger, knight, mounted Man, valiant Man, ring-bound Man, exhausted Man.

name: Mantle of the White Wizard
lore: 'Indeed I am Saruman, one might almost say, Saruman as he should have been.'
text: Each time you play a spell, you may hinder a [Gandalf] artifact to restore a Free Peoples card. Each time the fellowship moves to or from a sanctuary, you may exert Gandalf to heal another companion.

name: Northern Signal-fire, Flame of Nardol
subtitle: Flame of Nardol
lore: 'What is that?' cried Pippin suddenly, clutching at Gandalf's cloak. 'Look! Fire, red fire! Are there dragons in this land? Look, there is another!'
text: Beacon. To play, hinder 2 beacons. Archery: Hinder X beacons and discard X [Gondor] or [Rohan] conditions or possessions to make the fellowship archery total +X.

name: Pippin, Trollslayer
subtitle: Trollslayer
lore: 'But now I must do my best...then almost I should draw level with old Merry. Well, I'll smite some of this beastly brood before the end.'
text: Knight. Enduring. To play, spot a [gondor] companion. Skirmish: Exert Pippin twice to make a minion he is skirmishing lose all keywords until the regroup phase.

name: Tormented Revenant
lore: There they stood silent, hardly to be seen, save for a red gleam in their eyes that caught the glare of the ships that were burning.
text: Enduring. To play, spot or add 2 threats. This companion is strength +X, where X is the twilight cost of each minion skirmishing this companion.

name: Tormented Spectre
lore: 'At his command they fell back. \"Even the shades of Men are obedient to his will,\" I thought. \"They may serve his needs yet!'
text: Enduring. To play, add a threat. This companion is strength +1 for each hindered card you can spot.

name: Tormented Warrior
lore: 'For this war will last through years uncounted, and you shall be summoned once again ere the end.'
text: Enduring. To play, add a threat. This companion is strength +1 for each companion in the dead pile. This companion is strength +1 for each Wraith in the dead pile.

name: War-beacon
text: Beacon. To play, spot an unbound Man. Fellowship: Add (1) per beacon you can spot to play a beacon from the discard pile. Fellowship: Exert a Man and hinder a beacon to reveal the top 5 cards of your draw deck. You may take any [gondor] or [rohan] cards revealed into hand. Replace the rest in any order.

name: The Way is Shut
lore: 'Is it then your errand to seek death? For that is all that you will find on that road. They do not suffer the living to pass.'
text: Maneuver: Spot 3 [gondor] Wraiths to discard a Shadow condition.  You may exert a Wraith to hinder another Shadow condition. Skirmish: Make your Wraith strength +1 for each threat you can spot (limit +3).

name: Nor is He Early
lore: ...he arrives precisely when he's meant to.
text: To play, spot 2 [isengard] minions. Response: If a Free Peoples character is played, add (3).  If you can spot 5 or more companions (or if that character is [Gandalf]), you may discard an [isengard] card from hand to hinder that character.  Hinder this condition.

name: One Ill Turn Deserves Another
lore: 'If they're such fools, I will...teach them a lesson.'
text: To play, spot 2 [isengard] minions (or Saruman). Each time your minion is hindered or discarded by a Free Peoples card, hinder a companion. Each time your condition is hindered or discarded by a Free Peoples card, hinder a Free Peoples condition.

name: Savage Fury
text: Each time your [isengard] minion wins a skirmish, you may discard another Savage Fury to hinder each Free Peoples card on a companion it was skirmishing. Maneuver: Discard a minion to make your [isengard] minion fierce or relentless until the regroup phase (it participates in 1 extra round of skirmishes after fierce).

name: Saruman's Hospitality
text: Pipeweed. Bearer must be an unbound companion bearing a pipe.  Each time the fellowship moves, spot 3 pipes of different cultures to make the number of Free Peoples cultures that can be counted -1 until the regroup phase.

name: A Wizard Knows Better
lore: 'Despite the injuries that have been done to me, in which the men of Rohan, alas! have had some part, still I would save you, and deliver you from the ruin that draws nigh inevitably...'
text: Restore 2 [Isengard] cards.  Then you may exert X [isengard] minions (or spot Saruman and spot X [isengard] minions) to hinder an unbound companion costing up to X.

name: Bladetusk Charger
text: Maneuver: Stack 1 or more Southron Men here to make this a fierce mounted Southron minion until the end of the turn that is strength +4 and ambush (1) for each Southron stacked here. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, add a threat (or 2 threats if there are 4 Southrons stacked here).

name: Bladetusk Matriarch
text: Each time a Southron is played, you may stack a [raider] Man from play or hand here. Maneuver: Remove (6) to make this artifact a fierce mounted Southron minion until the end of the turn that is strength +3 and ambush (1) for each Southron stacked on her. She adds 1 to the Shadow archery total for each Southron stacked on her (limit 6).

name: Bladetusk Rearguard
lore: The great monsters were unfought,...like towers of defence, and the Haradrim rallied about them.
text: Regroup: Stack a Southron Man here. Maneuver: Remove (5) to make this artifact a fierce mounted Southron minion until the end of the turn that is strength +3 and ambush (1) for each Southron stacked on it.

name: Burn and Pillage
lore: For black against the glittering stream they beheld a fleet borne up on the wind: dromunds, and ships of great draught with many oars, and with black sails bellying in the breeze.
text: Hinder up to 4 [raider] cards to reinforce the same number of [raider] tokens. Draw a card for each 2 hindered Shadow cards you can spot.

name: Corsair Quartermaster
text: Corsair. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, the Free Peoples player may hinder any number of Free Peoples items on a character in that skirmish. This minion is damage +1 for each Free Peoples item you can spot on each character in its skirmish.

name: Corsair Helmsman
lore: They cried. 'Back to the walls! Come back to the City before all are overwhelmed!' But the wind that sped the ships blew all their clamour away.
text: Corsair. Response: If your [raider] card is about to be hindered or discarded by another card effect, exert or hinder this minion to prevent that.

name: Desert Wind Initiate
lore: 'From the North to the field of Dagorlad there is skirmish and rumour of war. In the South the Haradrim are moving, and fear has fallen on all our coastlands, so that little help will come to us thence.'
text: Southron. Tracker. Ambush (3). Other Southrons are twilight cost -1. When you play this minion, remove (3) or hinder this minion.

name: Desert Wind Scout
lore: All the Southrons had been accounted for...Of the enemy no movement could be seen; not even an orc-spy was abroad.
text: Southron. Tracker. Ambush (2). When you play this minion, remove (3) or hinder this minion. Each time this minion is hindered, you may hinder or restore another [raider] minion.

name: Desert Wind Stalker
text: Southron. Tracker. When you play this minion, remove (3) or hinder this minion. Southrons gain ambush (1).

name: Shadowfax, Swiftest of All
subtitle: Swiftest of All
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. While you can spot a [gandalf] artifact, minions skirmishing bearer gain no strength or keyword bonuses from Shadow cards they bear. While bearer is unwounded or exhausted, bearer is strength +3.

name: Desert Wind Whisper
lore: But they saw nothing, and heard no sound but the sigh of withered leaves and grass.
text: Southron. Tracker. When you play this minion, remove (4) or hinder this minion. Each minion with ambush (X) is strength +X.

name: Duty No Less Than Yours
lore: He wondered what the man's name was and where he came from; and if he was really evil of heart, or what lies or threats had led him on the long march...
text: Each time a [raider] minion dies, you may exert a [raider] minion to exert an unbound companion. If you can spot another Duty No Less Than Yours, you may discard it to also hinder that companion.

name: Hailing from the Far South
text: Each time you play a unique Southron, you may exert it to take a non-unique [raider] item or minion into hand from discard. Response: If your mounted Southron wins a skirmish, hinder this condition to make that Southron relentless until the regroup phase (they participate in 1 extra round of skirmishes after fierce).

name: Honor of the Desert Warrior
lore: To the land of the Haradrim came only a tale from far off: a rumour of the wrath and terror of Gondor.
text: Exert a Southron and hinder all other minions to assign that Southron to an unbound companion. The Free Peoples player may make that Southron strength +3, ambush (4), and fierce until the regroup phase to prevent this.

name: Horn of Far Harad
lore: But wherever the mûmakil came there the horses would not go, but blenched and swerved away; and the great monsters were unfought.
text: Bearer must be a mounted Southron. When you play this, hinder all Free Peoples mounts. Skirmish: Remove a threat to make a Southron strength +2.

name: Raiding Schooner
text: When you play this, spot a Corsair to add a [raider] token here. Shadow: Remove 2 [raider] tokens from your cards to hinder a Free Peoples possession. Maneuver: Spot a Corsair, hinder another Raiding Schooner, and remove 3 [raider] tokens from your cards to hinder a Free Peoples artifact.

name: Sandcraft Trap
lore: 'We were outnumbered, for Mordor has allied itself with the Easterlings and the cruel Haradrim; but it was not by numbers that we were defeated. A power was there that we have not felt before.'
text: Restore all trackers and minions with ambush. If you restored any, make each Southron ambush (1) and strength +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Savage Harpoon
text: Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must hinder bearer or a Free Peoples item on bearer. Maneuver: Exert 2 corsairs and remove 2 [raider] tokens from a possession to transfer this from your support area to an unbound companion. Limit 1 per bearer.

name: Shifting Battle-lines
lore: Soon their case became worse; for new strength came.
text: At the start of each skirmish involving a minion with ambush, you may remove (2) to hinder a Free Peoples condition. Each time your Southron Man dies, you may remove (1) to stack a Southron from your discard pile on a [raider] item that already has a Southron stacked on it.

name: Strength of Men
lore: Hard fighting and long labour they had still; for the Southrons were bold men and grim, and fierce in despair; and the Easterlings were strong and war-hardened and asked for no quarter.
text: Spot 2 [raider] cards to restore 2 [raider] cards (or reconcile your hand if you can spot 5 burdens or 6 [raider] cards).

name: Show Them the Meaning of Haste
lore: Wherever he came men's hearts would lift again, and the winged shadows pass from memory.
text: Maneuver or Skirmish: Exert Gandalf thrice (or spot Shadowfax and exert Gandalf once) to reveal another Free Peoples event from your hand. Play that event 3 times, then remove it from the game.

name: The Mouth of Sauron, Herald of the Dark Lord
subtitle: Herald of the Dark Lord
lore: 'Thou shalt see what comes to him who sets his foolish webs before the feet of Sauron the Great.'
text: Lurker. Your Shadow events are twilight cost -2. Response: If a minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that wound and hinder a Free Peoples weapon.

name: Ulaire Attea, Khamul of the East
subtitle: Khamul of the East
lore: The second to the Chief, Khamul the Shadow of the East, abode in Dol Guldur as Sauron's lieutenant.
text: Easterling. Fierce. While you can spot 3 burdens, each Easterling is strength +3. While you can spot 5 burdens, each Easterling is damage +1.

name: War Howdah
text: Bearer gains archer. Maneuver: If this is in your support area, exert a mounted Southron to transfer this to that Southron. Limit 1 per bearer. Choose a Man stacked on that Southron. Until the end of the turn, that Southron gains the game text of that stacked Man.

name: Cirith Ungol Watcher, Spirit of Vigilance
subtitle: Spirit of Vigilance
text: To play, spot a [ringwraith] card. Each time a companion exerts, draw a card (limit once per site). Response: If a companion is exerted by a Free Peoples card, discard another Cirith Ungol Watcher to add (6) and hinder that companion.

name: Cover of Darkness, Omen of Fear
subtitle: Omen of Fear
lore: So now at last the City was besieged, enclosed in a ring of foes.
text: Twilight. To play, hinder 2 twilight conditions. Assignment: Spot 3 [ringwraith] minions, remove a burden, and hinder this condition to spot a [ringwraith] minion and an unbound companion.  Hinder all other characters.

name: Cover of Darkness, Omen of Gloom
subtitle: Omen of Gloom
lore: 'But the Lord of the City, Beregond, has fallen before his city is taken. He is fey and dangerous.'
text: Twilight. To play, hinder 2 twilight conditions. Shadow: Hinder this condition and remove (1) to take a twilight card into hand from your draw deck. Regroup: Hinder a twilight card to add (1).

name: Gollum, Half a Wraith Himself
subtitle: Half a Wraith Himself
lore: Gollum withdrew himself, and a green glint flickered under his heavy lids. Almost spider-like he looked now, crouched back on his bent limbs...
text: Each time you play a Nazgul, you may exert Gollum to add a threat. Assignment: Remove X threats to assign Gollum to a companion costing X or less (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Ill Wind
lore: 'Alas! For she was pitted against a foe beyond the strength of her mind or body.'
text: The second time you play a Nazgul each Shadow phase, you may hinder a wounded companion.  The Free Peoples player may make you exert another companion to prevent this (or wound if you can spot The Witch-king).

name: Morgul Legions
text: The second time you play a [ringwraith] Orc each Shadow phase, you may hinder a Free Peoples possession. Shadow: Spot a Nazgul to play any number of possessions on your [ringwraith] Orcs from your discard pile.  Discard this condition.

name: No Man May Hinder Me
lore: 'Yet now under the Lord of Barad-dur the most fell of all his captains is already master of your outer walls,' said Gandalf. 'King of Angmar long ago, Sorcerer, Ringwraith, Lord of the Nazgul, a spear of terror in the hand of Sauron, shadow of despair.'
text: Maneuver or Skirmish: Restore a Nazgul. Then you may exert The Witch-king twice to hinder all Free Peoples possessions.

name: Wizard's Stash
lore: 'Hobbits first put it into pipes. Not even the Wizards first thought of that before we did.'
text: Pipeweed. Bearer must be a Wizard. Each companion who is bearing a pipe is strength +1. Regroup: Exert bearer and discard this. This phase you may use special abilities on pipes as if it were the Fellowship phase.

name: The Mouth of Sauron, Bearer of Dread News
subtitle: Bearer of Dread News
lore: 'Take swift counsel with what little wit is left to you. For Sauron does not love spies...'
text: Lurker. Other minions cannot take more than 1 wound per phase. Response: If a Free Peoples event is played, exert this minion to cancel that event.

name: This is My Hour
lore: A great black shape against the fires beyond he loomed up, grown to a vast menace of despair. In rode the Lord of the Nazgûl, under the archway that no enemy ever yet had passed, and all fled before his face.
text: If your Nazgul wins a skirmish, exert it to reconcile your hand.  You may discard a Nazgul from hand to wound a companion it was skirmishing.

name: Úlairë Attëa, Bestowed with Dominion
subtitle: Bestowed with Dominion
text: Fierce. Each time you play a minion from hand, you may exert Ulaire Attea to play another minion with the same twilight cost from your discard pile. Skirmish: Hinder another minion to make Ulaire Attea strength +1.

name: Úlairë Cantëa, Exalted with Decay
subtitle: Exalted with Decay
lore: 'Do you not know Death when you see it? Die now and curse in vain!'
text: Fierce. Skirmish: Exert this minion to hinder all possessions and conditions borne by a character it is skirmishing.  If you can spot another Nazgul, hinder all other copies of those cards you can spot.

name: Úlairë Enquëa, Magnified through Suffering
subtitle: Magnified through Suffering
text: Fierce. Relentless. (This minion participates in 1 extra round of skirmishes after fierce.) At the start of each skirmish involving Ulaire Enquea and a wounded character, you may exert him to heal that character and exert a companion.

name: Ulaire Lemenya, Anointed with Terror
subtitle: Anointed with Terror
lore: 'The storm is coming. The Nazgul have crossed the River! Ride, ride! Wait not for the dawn! Let not the swift wait for the slow! Ride!'
text: Fierce. Each character skirmishing this minion is strength -1 for each other Nazgul you can spot (or -1 for each other companion you can spot if you can spot 6 companions).

name: Ulaire Nelya, Glorified to Conquer
subtitle: Glorified to Conquer
lore: 'Those Nazgul give me the creeps....But He likes 'em; they're His favourites nowadays.'
text: Fierce. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a Nazgul strength +1 for each of your sites on the adventure path (limit +2, or limit +5 if you can spot another Nazgul).

name: Úlairë Nertëa, Sanctified for Cruelty
subtitle: Sanctified for Cruelty
lore: 'And they skin the body off you as soon as look at you, and leave you all cold in the dark on the other side.'
text: Fierce. Each time you play a minion, you may exert it to play a possession on it from your discard pile (or an artifact if you exert this minion as well).

name: Ulaire Otsea, Consecrated by Pestilence
subtitle: Consecrated by Pestilence
lore: 'As their Dark Lord now grew and put forth his strength, so their voices, which uttered only his will and his malice, were filled with evil and horror.'
text: Fierce. Each time a Nazgul wins a skirmish, you may exert this minion and remove (1) to play a Shadow condition from your discard pile. Add a threat if it is [ringwraith].

name: Ulaire Toldea, Blessed with Brutality
subtitle: Blessed with Brutality
text: Fierce. Each time this minion is assigned to a stronger companion, you may exhaust this minion to hinder that companion. Each time this minion is assigned to a weaker companion, you may exert this minion to exert that companion or add a threat.

name: Words of Power
lore: 'For this is what your folk would call magic. I believe; though I do not understand clearly what they mean; and they seem also to use the same word of the deceits of the Enemy.'
text: Spell. Exhaust your Wizard to reconcile your hand. You may spot a [gandalf] artifact to shuffle this into your draw deck.

name: The Witch-king, Empowered by His Master
subtitle: Empowered by His Master
lore: From a mouth unseen there came a deadly laughter.
text: Enduring. Damage +1. When you play this minion, spot another Nazgul to hinder all Free Peoples cards of one type (except companion). The Free Peoples player may restore any number of their cards, and must exert one of their characters for each card restored.

name: Winged Nazgul
lore: To the air he had returned, summoning his steed ere the darkness failed, and now he was come again, bringing ruin, turning hope to despair, and victory to death.
text: Enduring. Fierce. Assignment: Return another Winged Nazgul to hand to assign this minion to an unbound companion.

name: Death Take Us All
text: The Shadow player may hinder any of their own support cards. Spot an unhindered Shadow support card.  Make a [rohan] companion strength +1 for each of the following: that card's twilight cost, cards stacked on that card, culture tokens on that card, copies of that card in play.

name: Gondor Calls For Aid!
lore: And so King Théoden departed from his own realm, and mile by mile the long road wound away...
text: Beacon. To play, hinder 4 beacons. This cannot be discarded or hindered.\Your [Gondor] Men are considered [Rohan] Men.  Your [Rohan] Men are considered [Gondor] Men. Maneuver: Hinder X beacons to play X items from your discard pile on your Men.

name: I Am No Man
lore: 'You look upon a woman. Éowyn I am, Éomund's daughter. You stand between me and my lord and kin. Begone, if you be not deathless! For living or dark undead, I will smite you, if you touch him.'
text: Exert a skirmishing valiant companion twice (or spot Eowyn in a skirmish) to make a minion strength -1 for each hindered or wounded card you can spot.

name: Merry, Master Holbytla
subtitle: Master Holbytla
text: Valiant. Enduring. While you can spot 3 [rohan] companions (or Eowyn), Merry is considered a [Rohan] Man. Each time another [rohan] Man exerts, you may exert Merry to heal that Man. Skirmish: If he is not assigned to a skirmish, hinder Merry to immediately resolve a skirmish involving a [rohan] Man.

name: Northern Signal-fire, Flame of Calenhad
subtitle: Flame of Calenhad
lore: 'It is over-late to send for aid when you are already besieged,' answered Beregond. 'But I do not know the counsel of the Lord and his captains.'
text: Beacon. To play, hinder 2 beacons. Maneuver: Hinder this beacon and exert an unbound Man. Until the regroup phase, each of your other Men gain each of the unloaded keywords on that Man.

name: Northern Signal-fire, Flame of Halifirien
subtitle: Flame of Halifirien
lore: 'And there, I think, he will hear tidings of war, and the Riders of Rohan will go down to Minas Tirith.'
text: Beacon. To play, hinder 2 beacons. Each time you play a mount on your Man, you may add (1) to heal that Man. Response: If a mount borne by your Man exerts a minion, hinder a beacon to exert that minion again.

name: Snowmane, Faithful Servant
subtitle: Faithful Servant
lore: Lightfoot's foal, swift Snowmane.
text: Bearer must be Theoden. [Rohan] companions are strength +1 (or +2 if mounted) for each wound on Theoden. At the start of the assignment phase, the Shadow player may exhaust a minion of strength 15 or more to hinder Snowmane.

name: Take it Down!
lore: He let blow the horns to rally all men to his banner that could come thither; for he thought to make a great shield-wall at the last, and stand, and fight there on foot till all fell...
text: Exert Theoden or Eomer to wound a mounted minion twice.  You may then exert X [rohan] companions to discard X stacked Shadow cards.

name: You Cannot Enter Here
lore: All fled before his face. All save one. There waiting, silent and still in the space before the Gate, sat Gandalf upon Shadowfax.
text: Exert your Wizard to hinder a Shadow card.  Exhaust that Wizard if you chose a minion.

name: Teach Me Your Herb-lore
lore: 'Live now in blessedness; and when you sit in peace with your pipe, think of me! For never now shall I sit with you in Meduseld, as I promised, or listen to your herb-lore.'
text: Play up to 2 pipes from your draw deck.  If you cannot spot Theoden, add a burden for each pipe played.

name: Vanguard's Lance
lore: South strode Éomer and men fled before his face, and they were caught between the hammer and the anvil.
text: Bearer must be a [Rohan] companion. While bearer is mounted, bearer is strength +1 and each time bearer wins a skirmish, you must exert them to wound a minion.

name: Cirith Ungol Watcher, Hideous Warden
subtitle: Hideous Warden
text: To play, spot a [sauron] card. Each time a companion exerts, draw a card (limit once per site). Response: If a companion is exerted by a Free Peoples card, discard another Cirith Ungol Watcher to add 2 threats and hinder that companion.

name: Cover of Darkness, Omen of Despair
subtitle: Omen of Despair
lore: 'Go now, and die in what way seems best to you.'
text: Twilight. To play, hinder 2 twilight conditions. Skirmish: Exert a Troll twice and hinder this condition to discard a Free Peoples card borne by a companion that Troll is skirmishing.

name: Cover of Darkness, Omen of Dread
subtitle: Omen of Dread
lore: 'He is burning, already burning,' he said sadly. 'The house of his spirit crumbles.'
text: Twilight. To play, hinder 2 twilight conditions. Response: If a burden is added, hinder an Orc and this condition to add a threat. Response: If a threat is added, hinder an Orc and this condition to add a burden.

name: Cover of Darkness, Omen of Horror
subtitle: Omen of Horror
lore: The shadows closed on men again, and their hearts went cold, and the valour of Gondor withered into ash.
text: Twilight. To play, hinder 2 twilight conditions. Skirmish: Exert an Orc or Troll and hinder a twilight condition to make that minion strength +2.

name: Endless Night
text: Twilight. To play, hinder 4 twilight conditions. This cannot be discarded or hindered. Orcs gain fierce. Trolls gain enduring. Nazgul gain damage +1. Your Men and Uruk-hai gain archer. Shadow: Hinder X of your other Shadow support cards to play Sauron from your hand or discard pile; he is twilight cost -X.

name: Ominous Sky
lore: 'No...not at sunrise. The Darkness has begun. There will be no dawn.'
text: Twilight. Each time you play an Orc or Troll, you may hinder this to add (1). Shadow or Regroup: Remove (2) to choose a Shadow condition from your discard pile. Shuffle it into your draw deck (or you may play it if it is twilight).

name: Red Eye Assassin
lore: Their purpose was only to test the strength of the defence and to keep the men of Gondor busy in many places.
text: This minion is strength +1 for each hindered card you can spot. Skirmish: Exert this minion to hinder a weapon or condition borne by a companion it is skirmishing.

name: Release the Prisoners!
lore: It tumbled down, small round shot that did not burn. But when men ran to learn what it might be, they cried aloud or wept.
text: Maneuver: Exert a [sauron] minion and remove a companion in the dead pile from the game to exert every character sharing a culture with that companion.  Hinder this condition.

name: The One Ring, The Ruling Ring
subtitle: The Ruling Ring
lore: One Ring to rule them all....
text: Response: If bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, add a burden instead.

name: Loyalty Unshaken
text: When you play this condition, you may stack 2 cards from hand here and draw a card for each [dwarven] card you stack. Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2. Also, make that Dwarf damage +2 for each [dwarven] card stacked on this condition. Discard this condition.

name: Greatest Stronghold
lore: '...City of Kings of yore.'
text: Exert a [gondor] Man and spot 3 fortifications to make the fellowship archery total +2.

name: Guarded
text: To play, spot 3 [gondor] Men. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion (or all roaming minions).

name: Hasty Repairs
lore: 'The work will be finished ere evening...'
text: To play, spot 3 [gondor] Men. Regroup: While you have only 4 cards in hand, you may discard 2 cards from hand to play a [gondor] fortification from your discard pile.

name: Hearts Raised
lore: ...lifted for a while by the return of Faramir....
text: At the start of your regroup phase, you may spot a [gondor] Man and discard a card from hand to remove a threat.

name: Hidden Knowledge
text: Spot a [gondor] companion to reveal the top 5 cards of an opponent's draw deck. For each Shadow card revealed, add a threat. For each Free Peoples card revealed, place a [gondor] token on one of your conditions with a [gondor] token on it. Shuffle that draw deck.

name: I Will Go
lore: 'I do command it.'
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. If you have initiative, bearer is defender +1.

name: Ingold
lore: 'Do you know aught of them? Will they answer the summons, think you?'
text: Knight. Fellowship: Discard a fortification to heal Ingold twice.

name: Iorlas
text: Response: If a possession or engine is played by your opponent, remove a [gondor] token from your condition to make that opponent remove (1). If he or she cannot, discard that possession or engine.

name: Knight's Spear
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Skirmish: If you cannot spot 2 threats, add a threat to make bearer strength +1.

name: Long Prepared
lore: 'For myself, I have long known....'
text: To play, add 2 threats. Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man to wound a roaming minion that Man is skirmishing. Discard this condition at the start of the regroup phase.

name: Out of Darkness
lore: 'Had I known what was before me, I think that not for any friendship would I have taken the Paths of the Dead.'
text: Make a Dwarf strength +2. You may also exert that Dwarf to draw 2 cards.

name: Madril, Faramir's Aide
subtitle: Faramir's Aide
lore: 'I have sent the company of Ithilien to strengthen it....'
text: Ranger. Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to wound a roaming minion Madril is skirmishing.

name: Man the Walls
lore: '...their force was too weak to make any stroke of war on their own part....'
text: The site number of each minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man is +1.

name: Noble Leaders
text: When you play this condition, place a [gondor] token here for each of the following characters you can spot: Aragorn, Boromir, Denethor or Faramir. Skirmish: Remove a token from here or discard this condition to make a [gondor] companion strength +1 and damage +1.

name: Pippin's Armor
lore: 'Here do I swear fealty and service to Gondor....'
text: Bearer must be Pippin. While you can spot 3 [gondor] Men, Pippin may take no more than 1 wound in a skirmish.

name: Pippin's Sword
lore: The old man laid the sword along his lap, and Pippin put his hand to the hilt....
text: Bearer must be Pippin. Skirmish: Exert Pippin twice make him strength +1 for each [gondor] companion you spot.

name: Ranger of Minas Tirith
lore: And upon its out-thrust knee was the Guarded City, with its seven walls of stone....
text: Ranger. While skirmishing a roaming minion, this companion is strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Ranger of Osgiliath
lore: 'Osgiliath ... once the greatest city in all of Gondor....'
text: Ranger. Regroup: Discard 2 cards from hand to exhaust a minion.

name: Reckless Counter
lore: 'Do not throw your life away so rashly!'
text: Spot 2 knights or exert 2 [gondor] Men to liberate a site or discard any number of cards from hand.

name: Second Level
lore: ...but the next faced half south....
text: Fortification. Maneuver: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot a ranger to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion.

name: Seventh Level
lore: Up it rose, even to the level of the topmost circle, and there was crowned by a battlement....
text: Fortification. Skirmish: Exert 3 [gondor] Men to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

name: Preparations
text: Regroup: Exert a Dwarf companion to stack a card from your discard pile here. Skirmish: Wound a minion skirmishing a Dwarf once for each [dwarven] card stacked here. Discard this condition.

name: Stand to Arms
lore: 'Return to the outer walls!'
text: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to wound a roaming minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man twice.

name: Stout Resistance
lore: ...the hardiest of the garrison stood at bay.
text: Add a threat to make a [gondor] Man strength +3.

name: Strong and Old
text: To play, spot 2 [gondor] Men. The twilight cost of each of your [gondor] fortifications is -1. Response: If an opponent is about to control a site, discard 2 [gondor] fortifications to prevent this.

name: Support of the City
lore: '...Gondor shall not perish yet.'
text: Fellowship: Play a [gondor] Man to place a [gondor] token here. Fellowship: Play a [gondor] companion. That companion's twilight cost is -1 for each token here. Discard this condition.

name: Targon
lore: 'This is a fortress and a tower of guard and is now in posture of war.'
text: Ranger. Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to wound a Man Targon is skirmishing.

name: Third Level
lore: ...and the third half north....
text: Fortification. Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot 2 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

name: Unexpected Visitor
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Unexpected Visitor." Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and remove (4).

name: Vorondil
lore: ...greater and stronger than Isengard, and far more beautiful.
text: While no opponent controls a site, Vorondil is strength +2. Regroup: Exert 3 [gondor] Men or 2 knights to liberate a site.

name: While We Yet Live
lore: '...not if the Nameless One himself should come, not even he could enter....'
text: Make a roaming minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man strength -3.

name: Bold Men and Grim
text: To play, spot 2 [raider] Men and add a threat. Each time a companion is about to be killed, you may remove a threat to discard a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Discard this condition at the start of the regroup phase.

name: Reckless Pride
text: Bearer must be a [dwarven] companion. Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Reckless Pride." Regroup: Discard this condition to draw 4 cards.

name: Dark Tidings
lore: '...yet not all unguessed.'
text: Regroup: Spot 2 [raider] Men and remove (3) to add a threat (limit 1).

name: Desert Fighter
lore: ...the great monsters were unfought....
text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (1) to add a threat.

name: Desert Nomad
lore: 'In the South the Haradrim are moving....'
text: Southron. While you can spot 2 threats, this minion is damage +1.

name: Desert Runner
lore: New forces of the enemy were hastening up the road from the River....
text: Southron. Ambush (1). When the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a character and you have initiative, you may wound that character.

name: Desert Scout
lore: ...and the Haradrim rallied about them.
text: Southron. Ambush (1). When the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a character and you have initiative, you may wound that character.

name: Desert Sneak
lore: ...from the southward fields came the footmen of Harad....
text: Southron. Ambush (1). When the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a character and you have initiative, you may wound that character.

name: Desert Soldier
text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (3) to wound a companion or ally he is skirmishing.

name: Desert Spearman
text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (3) to wound a companion or ally he is skirmishing.

name: Desert Villain
lore: ...with red banners....
text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (1) to add a threat.

name: Easterling Aggressor
lore: ...others held westward to hold off the forces of Gondor....
text: Easterling. Skirmish: If you have initiative or you spot 3 Easterlings, discard 2 cards from hand to heal another Easterling.

name: Slaked Thirsts
lore: 'Food and drink would pay off some of my score against you.'
text: Choose one: Spot a Dwarf to draw a card; or, if this card is stacked on a [dwarven] condition, spot a Dwarf companion and discard this event to exert a minion twice.

name: Easterling Assailant
lore: 'The new host that we had tidings of has come first....'
text: Easterling. Skirmish: Remove a burden and exert this minion to heal another Easterling (or 2 Easterlings if you have initiative).

name: Easterling Attacker
lore: 'Soon there will be battle on the fields.'
text: Easterling. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make him damage +1.

name: Easterling Blademaster
lore: ...great forces were flowing in from the East.
text: Easterling. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make him damage +1.

name: Easterling Footman
lore: '...and so have many also in the East.'
text: Easterling. Maneuver: If you cannot spot 2 burdens, spot another Easterling and discard a card from hand to add a burden.

name: Easterling Ransacker
lore: ...forces ten times, and more than ten times....
text: Easterling. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make him damage +1.

name: Easterling Regiment
lore: ...there marched up an army of Easterlings....
text: Easterling. Fierce. Each time Easterling Regiment wins a skirmish, you may add (1) for each burden.

name: Easterling Sergeant
lore: ...Easterlings with axes....
text: Easterling. Maneuver: If you cannot spot a burden, spot another Easterling and exert this minion to add a burden.

name: Easterling Veteran
lore: ...enclosed in a ring of foes.
text: Easterling. Skirmish: Remove 2 burdens to heal another Easterling.

name: Fierce in Despair
lore: ...displaying his standard, black serpent upon scarlet....
text: Spot 2 [raider] Men to discard a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Great Beasts
lore: ...like moving houses in the red and fitful light....
text: To play, spot a [raider] Man. Regroup: Remove (9) and spot 3 [raider] Men to make the move limit -1.

name: Ancient Blade
text: Bearer must be an [elven] companion. Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Ancient Blade." Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and reconcile your hand.

name: Harsh Tongues
text: To play, spot a [raider] Man. Regroup: Remove (3) and spot a [raider] Man to place a [raider] token here. While there are 3 [raider] tokens here, the Shadow has initiative regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.

name: Hosts Still Unfought
text: To play, spot 2 [raider] Men. Discard any number of cards from hand. The Free Peoples player then discards any number of cards from hand. For each card you discarded more than the Free Peoples player, add (1).

name: Mûmak Commander
lore: Great was the clash of their meeting.
text: Southron. To play, spot a [raider] Man. While you can spot 6 threats, each time this minion wins a skirmish, the companion he was skirmishing is killed.

name: Mûmakil of the Harad
lore: ...dragging through the lanes amid the fires....
text: Spot a [raider] minion to add (2) for each threat.

name: New Strength Came Now
lore: ...Southrons in scarlet....
text: Make a [raider] Man strength +3 (or +6 if you have initiative).

name: Raider Bow
lore: Neither Hirluin the fair would return to Pinnath Gelin, nor Grimbold to Grimslade....
text: Bearer must be a [raider] Man. Bearer is an archer and ambush (5).

name: Raider Halberd
lore: ...the drawing of the scimitars of the Southrons was like a glitter of stars.
text: Bearer must be a [raider] Man. Skirmish: Exert bearer to add (2).

name: Red Wrath
lore: ...he came against the white horse and the green with great press of men....
text: Exert a [raider] Man to wound a companion he is skirmishing twice.

name: Rout
lore: Already men were breaking away, flying wild and witless here and there....
text: To play, spot a [raider] Man. Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must exert 2 companions, if you have initiative.

name: Small Hope
lore: ...had any now that Faramir could hold the fords for longs.
text: Maneuver: If you cannot spot 2 burdens, exert an Easterling to add a burden. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an Easterling strength +2.

name: Arwen, Fair Elf Maiden
subtitle: Fair Elf Maiden
lore: 'But she also sends word to you... Fair well, Elfstone!'
text: While skirmishing a fierce minion, Arwen is strength +3.

name: Southron Bandit
lore: ...wild Southron men....
text: Southron. Maneuver: Exert this minion to add (5). The Free Peoples player may add a threat to prevent this.

name: Southron Brigand
lore: ...gathered about the standard of their chieftain.
text: Southron. Shadow: Remove (3) and spot 3 [raider] Men to make one of those Men damage +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Southron Captain
lore: ...a mounted champion of Harad....
text: Southron. While you can spot 4 threats, this minion is damage +2.

name: Southron Chieftain
lore: ...regiments from the South....
text: Southron. To play, spot a [raider] Man. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a character, the Shadow has initiative until the end of the turn.

name: Southron Conqueror
lore: ...company upon company of the enemy pressed to the walls.
text: Southron. Archer. While you can spot 6 twilight tokens, other [raider] Men are damage +1. While you can spot 9 twilight tokens, other [raider] Men are damage +1.

name: Southron Intruder
text: Southron. Archer. While you can spot 3 twilight tokens, all [raider] Men are strength +1. While you can spot 6 twilight tokens, all [raider] Men are strength +1. While you can spot 9 twilight tokens, all [raider] Men are strength +1.

name: Southron Leader
lore: ...Haradrim, cruel and tall.
text: Southron. Archery: Spot 4 Free Peoples cultures and either exert this minion or remove a threat to wound a companion (except the Ring-bearer).

name: Southron Marksmen
lore: Southward beyond the road lay the main force of the Haradrim....
text: Southron. Archer. Fierce. To play, spot a [raider] Man. Archery: Exert this minion and remove a threat to make the minion archery total +1.

name: Southron Thief
lore: ...the red southland swords that would have hewed him as he lay.
text: Southron. Archery: Spot another [raider] Man, spot 6 companions, and remove a threat to exert a companion.

name: Surging Up
text: Regroup: Exert an Easterling and discard this condition to make the move limit -1 for this turn. The Free Peoples player may add 2 burdens to prevent this. Skirmish: Discard this condition to heal an Easterling.

name: Asfaloth, Elven Steed
subtitle: Elven Steed
text: Bearer must be an Elf. Skirmish: If bearer is Arwen, exert her to make each minion skirmishing her strength -2.

name: Suzerain of Harad
lore: ...there came flying a deadly dart....
text: Southron. Archer. While you have initiative, the Ring-bearer cannot take wounds during the archery phase and this minion is ambush (8).

name: Thrice Outnumbered
lore: Southward beyond the road lay the main force of the Haradrim....
text: Spot a threat and X [raider] Men to make the Free Peoples player exert X companions (limit 3).

name: Troop of Haradrim
text: Southron. While you can spot 2 threats, this minion is an archer. While you can spot 3 threats, this minion is fierce. While you can spot 4 threats, this minion is damage +1.

name: War Towers
lore: ...behind them rose the huge backs of the mûmakil....
text: Spot a [raider] minion to add a threat. Add an additional threat for each companion over 4.

name: Called
lore: ...sensing some other power within his valley.
text: Assignment: Remove 5 threats to assign a Nazgûl to a companion (except the Ring-bearer). The Free Peoples player may discard that companion.

name: Corrupt
lore: Figures stood there at its head, carven with cunning in forms human and bestial, but all corrupt and loathsome.
text: Make a Nazgûl strength +1 for each Free Peoples culture you spot.

name: Disposable Servants
text: Spot a Nazgûl to discard any number of cards from your hand. The Free Peoples player then discards any number of cards from his or her hand. For each card you discarded more than the Free Peoples player, add a threat.

name: Feel His Blade
text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl. During the turn this card is transferred, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.

name: Foul Clutches
lore: 'Ah! there one of the foul things is stooping on him.'
text: Discard 3 cards from hand to make a Nazgûl strength +3.

name: Ghastly Host
lore: And out of the gate an army came.
text: Shadow: Spot a Nazgûl and remove a threat to play a Nazgûl. Its twilight cost is -2.

name: Bow of the Galadhrim, Gift of Galadriel
subtitle: Gift of Galadriel
text: Bearer must be Legolas. Each time you play an [elven] skirmish event during a skirmish involving Legolas, you may heal him.

name: Gorbag, Lieutenant of Cirith Ungol
subtitle: Lieutenant of Cirith Ungol
lore: 'If there's any game, me and my lads must be in it.'
text: While you can spot a Nazgûl, Gorbag is strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Held Ground
text: To play, spot 2 Nazgûl and add up to 3 threats. Each time a companion is about to be killed, you may remove a threat to discard up to 2 possessions. Discard this condition and remove 3 threats during the regroup phase.

name: Loathsome
lore: Frodo felt his senses reeling and his mind darkening.
text: If a skirmish that involved a Nazgûl is about to end, discard a possession borne by a companion in that skirmish.

name: Mind and Body
lore: Weariness and more than weariness oppressed him....
text: If a Nazgûl kills a character, wound each character bearing a [wraith] condition.

name: More Unbearable
text: To play, spot a Nazgûl. Regroup: Discard a Nazgûl to place a [wraith] token on this card. While there are 3 [wraith] tokens on this card, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.

name: Morgul Answers
lore: There was a flare of livid lightnings....
text: To play, spot a Nazgûl. Skirmish: Remove (3) and spot 3 Nazgûl to discard a possession or condition borne by a companion a Nazgûl is skirmishing.

name: Morgul Axe
lore: ...marching swiftly and silently, passing outwards in an endless stream.
text: Bearer must a [wraith] Orc. While you can spot 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer, bearer is damage +1.

name: Morgul Brawler
text: While the Ring-bearer is exhausted, this minion is strength +3, fierce and damage +1.

name: Morgul Brute
text: When you play this minion, you may spot a Nazgûl to add a burden. The Free Peoples player may wound the Ring-bearer to prevent this. Skirmish: Remove a burden to make this minion strength +3.

name: Morgul Cur
lore: 'They swarmed across like beetles.'
text: While you can spot a Nazgûl, this minion is strength +2.

name: Careful Study
lore: 'If thou art in haste, remember the Paths of the Dead.'
text: Spot an Elf and discard 3 cards from hand to reconcile your hand.

name: Morgul Destroyer
text: When you play this minion, you may spot a Nazgûl to add 2 threats. The Free Peoples player may wound the Ring-bearer to prevent this. Skirmish: Remove a threat to make this minion strength +3.

name: Morgul Detachment
lore: 'His own folk quail at him, and they would slay themselves at his bidding.'
text: While you can spot a Nazgûl, this minion is fierce and damage +1.

name: Morgul Hound
lore: All that host was clad in sable, dark as the night.
text: While you can spot 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer, this minion is strength +4 and fierce.

name: Morgul Lackey
lore: 'He uses others as his weapons.'
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a Nazgûl or [wraith] Orc strength +1.

name: Morgul Mongrel
lore: The old wound throbbed with pain and a great chill spread towards Frodo's heart.
text: While you can spot 3 wounds on the Ring-bearer, this minion is fierce and damage +1.

name: Morgul on the March
text: To play, spot a Nazgûl. Each time the Free Peoples player draws a card (except during the regroup phase), add a threat. Regroup: Discard a Nazgûl and this condition to add a threat.

name: Morgul Predator
lore: '...driving his slaves in madness on before.'
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a Nazgûl or [wraith] Orc strength +1.

name: Morgul Regiment
lore: ...a host had issued from Minas Morgul....
text: For each Nazgûl you can spot, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion to assign this minion to a skirmish. Skirmish: Exert this minion to make a Nazgûl or [wraith] Orc strength +1.

name: Morgul Ruffian
lore: ...while the less stout-hearted quailed and wept.
text: While you can spot a Nazgûl, this minion may only take wounds during skirmish phases.

name: Morgul Soldier
lore: ...ever and anon, high above the city, a faint cry would come....
text: Nazgûl are strength +1.

name: The One Ring, Such a Weight to Carry
subtitle: Such a Weight to Carry
lore: ...One Ring to find them....
text: Maneuver: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound, add a burden instead.

name: Defiance
text: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a Nazgûl).

name: Morgul Spawn
lore: '...the fear of him has passed before him over the River.'
text: While you can spot a Nazgûl, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion to assign this minion to a skirmish.

name: Morgul Spearman
lore: 'And we have learned... that the Black Captain leads them once again....'
text: While you can spot a Nazgûl, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion to assign this minion to a skirmish.

name: Morgul Whelp
text: While you can spot a wound on the Ring-bearer, this minion is strength +6.

name: Nazgûl Scimitar
lore: ...small black figures in rank upon rank....
text: Bearer must be a [wraith] minion. While you can spot 5 threats, bearer is damage +1.

name: Out of Sight and Shot
text: To play, spot a Nazgûl. Each time a companion is played, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion. Shadow: Spot a Nazgûl and discard this condition to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile.

name: Put Forth His Strength
lore: ...so their voices, which uttered only his will and malice, were filled with evil and horror.
text: To play, spot a Nazgûl. Shadow: If you have initiative and there are 3 characters in the dead pile, spot 3 burdens, 3 threats and a Nazgûl to corrupt the Ring-bearer.

name: Stronghold of Minas Morgul
text: Response: If your [wraith] minion wins a skirmish, place a [wraith] token here (limit 1 per site). Regroup: Spot 3 [wraith] tokens here to exhaust the Ring-bearer. Discard this condition.

name: Their Power Is in Terror
text: Exert a Nazgûl to wound each ally.

name: There Came a Cry
lore: Mingled with harsh high voices as of birds of prey....
text: Spot a Nazgûl to add a threat (or 3 threats if you have initiative).

name: Too Late
lore: At that moment the rock quivered and trembled beneath them.
text: Skirmish: Transfer this condition from your support area to a character skirmishing a Nazgûl. Each time bearer exerts, add (1).

name: Elrond, Elven Lord
subtitle: Elven Lord
lore: 'Onen i-estel Edain.'
text: To play, spot Aragorn or an Elf. At the start of each turn, you may exert Elrond to heal a character bearing an artifact.

name: Úlairë Attëa, Wraith on Wings
subtitle: Wraith on Wings
lore: ...faint, but heart-quelling, cruel and cold.
text: Fierce. Shadow: If you have initiative, exert Úlairë Attëa and spot another [wraith] minion to add a burden.

name: Úlairë Cantëa, Faster Than Winds
subtitle: Faster Than Winds
lore: ...and of the winged terror, the Nazgûl.
text: Fierce. When you play Úlairë Cantëa, add a threat for each companion over 4. Maneuver: Remove 2 threats and spot another [wraith] minion to discard a possession.

name: Úlairë Enquëa, Faster Than Winds
subtitle: Faster Than Winds
text: Fierce. While you can spot 6 companions, Úlairë Enquëa is damage +1. Each time a companion is killed, you may exert Úlairë Enquëa to exert the Ring-bearer.

name: Úlairë Lemenya, Assailing Minion
subtitle: Assailing Minion
text: Úlairë Lemenya is strength +1 for each other [wraith] minion you can spot. While you can spot 3 [wraith] minions Úlairë Lemenya is fierce. While you can spot 4 [wraith] minions Úlairë Lemenya is damage +1.

name: Úlairë Lemenya, Wraith on Wings
subtitle: Wraith on Wings
lore: And even at that moment the sun for a second faltered and was obscured, as though a dark wing had passed across it.
text: Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Úlairë Lemenya to discard a possession.

name: Úlairë Nelya, Assailing Minion
subtitle: Assailing Minion
lore: He shuddered, and hope seemed to wither.
text: Fierce. Skirmish: Discard a [wraith] minion to make Úlairë Nelya strength +2.

name: Úlairë Nelya, Black-Mantled Wraith
subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith
lore: 'It is the sign of our fall, and the shadow of doom, a Fell Rider of the air.'
text: Fierce. Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Úlairë Nelya to exert each Ring-bound companion.

name: Úlairë Nertëa, Black-Mantled Wraith
subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith
lore: 'I fear that Minas Tirith shall fall. Night comes. The very warmth of my blood seems stolen away.'
text: Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Úlairë Nertëa to add a burden.

name: Úlairë Otsëa, Black-Mantled Wraith
subtitle: Black-Mantled Wraith
lore: ...horrible as carrion-fowl yet greater than eagles, cruel as death.
text: Regroup: If you have initiative, discard Úlairë Otsëa to make the Free Peoples player exert a Ring-bound companion twice or return an unbound companion to his or her hand.

name: Úlairë Toldëa, Wraith on Wings
subtitle: Wraith on Wings
lore: Almost beyond hearing he thought he caught, high and far up in the heavens, a cry....
text: Fierce. While you have initiative and can spot a Nazgûl, Úlairë Toldëa's twilight cost is -6.

name: Hope Comes
lore: 'Either our hope cometh, or all hopes end.'
text: To play, spot 2 Elves. Response: If an [elven] skirmish event is played, discard this condition to draw 3 cards.

name: War Long Planned
lore: 'Through many ages Sauron has hated the West....'
text: Make a [wraith] Orc strength +2 (or +4 if you spot 2 wounds on the Ring-bearer).

name: The Witch-king, Morgul King
subtitle: Morgul King
text: Fierce. When you play The Witch-king, you may remove a threat to take a [wraith] card into hand from your discard pile. The Ring-bearer cannot take threat wounds.

name: Déor
lore: As the king approached many men sprang up out of the rocks....
text: Villager. Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard a card from hand to make a [rohan] Man strength +1.

name: Death They Cried
lore: But the Rohirrim sang no more. Death they cried with one voice....
text: Spot a mounted [rohan] Man to exert a minion. That minion's owner may exert a companion and if he or she does so, you may exert a minion; repeat this until a player does not exert a character.

name: Elfhelm, Marshal of Rohan
subtitle: Marshal of Rohan
lore: 'There seemed to be some understanding between Dernhelm and Elfhelm, the Marshal who commanded the éored in which they were riding.'
text: Valiant. Skirmish: Exert Elfhelm to make him strength +1 for each uncontrolled plains site you can spot.

name: Elite Rider
text: When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. While skirmishing a wounded minion, this companion is strength +2.

name: Enraged Horseman
lore: Doom drove them on. Darkness took them, / horse and horseman; hoofbeats afar / sank into silence: so the songs tell us.
