text: While you can spot another [rohan] Man and this companion is skirmishing a wounded minion, this companion is strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Éomer, Skilled Tactician
subtitle: Skilled Tactician
lore: '...call the heralds, Éomer.... Let the Riders be marshalled!'
text: Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1. Fellowship: Play a [rohan] companion to take a [rohan] possession or [rohan] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.

name: Éowyn, Dernhelm
subtitle: Dernhelm
lore: 'Do you not? Then call me Dernhelm.'
text: Valiant. While skirmishing a mounted minion, Éowyn is strength +2. While skirmishing a fierce minion, Éowyn is strength +2.

name: Éowyn, Restless Maiden
subtitle: Restless Maiden
lore: He turned and saw her as a glimmer... for she was clad in white; but her eyes were on fire.
text: Skirmish: Discard a possession borne by Éowyn to make her strength +2.

name: Into the West
lore: 'The days are now short.'
text: Regroup: Exert an Elf to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is an [elven] card, remove 3 threats. Place the revealed card beneath your draw deck.

name: Éowyn's Sword, Dernhelm's Blade
subtitle: Dernhelm's Blade
lore: A swift stroke she dealt, skilled and deadly.
text: Bearer must be Éowyn. You may play this possession any time you could play a skirmish event. When you play this possession, you may wound a minion Éowyn is skirmishing.

name: Fey He Seemed
lore: ...the battle-fury of his fathers ran like new fire in his veins....
text: Make a [rohan] Man strength +2 (or +3 and damage +1 if skirmishing a wounded minion).

name: Firefoot, Éomer's Steed
subtitle: Éomer's Steed
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert. Regroup: If bearer is Éomer, exert him to discard a condition. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.

name: Grimbold, Marshal of Rohan
subtitle: Marshal of Rohan
lore: 'And Grimbold shall lead his towards the left.'
text: Valiant. Skirmish: Replace the fellowship's site with your plains site of the same number to discard a card from hand.

name: Guarded Fastness
lore: '...for I will not leave my strongholds all unguarded.'
text: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to heal all [rohan] allies.

name: Guthláf, Herald
subtitle: Herald
lore: And straightaway all the horns in the host were lifted up in music....
text: Skirmish: Discard a [rohan] condition to make Guthláf strength +1.

name: Herugrim, Sword of the Mark
subtitle: Sword of the Mark
lore: Out swept his sword, and he spurred to the standard, hewed staff and bearer....
text: Bearer must be Théoden. He is damage +1. Response: If Théoden is about to take a wound and you cannot spot 3 threats, add 2 threats to prevent that wound.

name: His Golden Shield
lore: ...even as Oromë the Great in the battle of the Valar when the world was young.
text: Spot 3 [rohan] Men to make an opponent remove (1) or place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck. Do this once for each card in that player's hand when you play this event.

name: Knights of His House
lore: Éomer rode there, and the white horsetail on his helm floating in his speed....
text: Choose an opponent. For each mounted companion you spot, that opponent must remove (1) or place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck.

name: Léowyn
lore: '...when they saw the king they cried with glad voices: 'Théoden King! Théoden King!'
text: Villager. Fellowship: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to heal a [rohan] Man.

name: Leaving Forever
lore: 'Then I thought in my heart that we drew near to the sea....'
text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a condition or draw 2 cards.

name: Long Spear
lore: ...more skilled was their knighthood with long spears....
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. You may add a threat to play this possession any time you could play a skirmish event.

name: Merry's Armor
lore: 'Rise now, Meriadoc, esquire of Rohan of the household of Meduseld!'
text: Bearer must be Merry. While you can spot 3 [rohan] Men, Merry cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.

name: Merry's Sword
lore: Merry's sword had stabbed him from behind, shearing through the black mantle....
text: Bearer must be Merry. Maneuver: Exert Merry twice to exert a minion once for each [rohan] companion you spot.

name: Morning Came
lore: ...morning and a wind from the sea; and darkness was removed, and the hosts of Mordor wailed....
text: Make a [rohan] Man strength +4. Any Shadow player may place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck to make that Man strength +2 instead.

name: Mustering for Battle
lore: 'For we are already at war, as you may have seen, and you do not find us all unprepared.'
text: To play, spot 3 [rohan] Men. Maneuver: Exert a [rohan] companion twice or discard this condition to play a [rohan] possession from your discard pile.

name: Riding Armor
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. Response: If you have initiative and bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, discard 3 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

name: Rohirrim Guard
lore: ...and strengthened his host by some three score of Riders that came late to the weapontake.
text: Skirmish: Discard a card from hand to exert a minion skirmishing this companion.

name: Rohirrim Herdsman
lore: ...he found the remaining strength of his people already assembled....
text: Villager. To play, spot 2 [rohan] Men. Regroup: Discard 3 cards from hand to remove a threat.

name: Rohirrim Javelin
lore: ...the Rohirrim went hither and thither at their will.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. Archery: Discard this possession to make the fellowship archery total +1.

name: Seeking New Foes
text: Skirmishes are resolved in an order decided by the first Shadow player. Each time a [rohan] Man wins a skirmish, place a [rohan] token here. Each [rohan] Man is strength +1 for each token here. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.

name: Legolas, Fearless Marksman
subtitle: Fearless Marksman
lore: 'I also will come... for I do not fear the Dead.'
text: Archer. Archery: If you have initiative, discard 4 cards from hand to wound a minion.

name: Snowmane
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert. Regroup: If bearer is Théoden, exert him to liberate a site. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.

name: Stern People
text: To play, spot 2 [rohan] Men. Regroup: Discard cards from hand equal to the number of cards in an opponent's hand to make the move limit +1 for this turn. Each Shadow player may take up to 4 cards into hand from his or her discard pile. Discard this condition.

name: Strong Arms
lore: 'But he knows that we are a people who fight rather upon horseback and in the open....'
text: To play, spot a [rohan] Man. Plays on a site. This site is a plains. Each [rohan] Man is strength +1 at this site.

name: Swift Steed
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. While at a plains site, bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.

name: Théoden, Leader of Spears
subtitle: Leader of Spears
lore: Forth rode Théoden. Five nights and days / east and onward rode the Eorlingas....
text: Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Théoden's twilight cost is -1. Each time the fellowship moves, you may exert a [rohan] companion to exert a minion.

name: Théoden, Rekindled King
subtitle: Rekindled King
text: While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Théoden's twilight cost is -1. Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, play a [rohan] possession on Théoden and add (2) to heal another [rohan] companion.

name: They Sang as They Slew
lore: ...for the joy of battle was on them, and the sound of their singing that was fair and terrible came even to the City.
text: Exert X mounted companions to wound X minions.

name: Veteran Horseman
lore: ...through Folde and Fenmarch and the Firienwood, six thousand spears to Sunlending....
text: Skirmish: Exert this companion to make him strength +1 for each mounted companion you spot.

name: White Hot Fury
lore: Fewer were they but they clove through the Southrons like a fire-bolt in a forest.
text: Make a mounted [rohan] Man strength +1 for each mounted companion. If that Man is skirmishing a [raider] minion, also make him or her strength +2 and damage +2.

name: Wind in His Face
lore: Far, far away, in the South the clouds could be dimly seen as remote grey shapes, rolling up, drifting: morning lay beyond them.
text: Make a [rohan] Man strength +2. If that Man is mounted, choose an opponent who must place a random card from hand beneath his or her draw deck.

name: Legolas, Nimble Warrior
subtitle: Nimble Warrior
lore: 'Alas for the wailing of the gulls! Did not the Lady tell me to beware of them?'
text: Archer. Archery: If you cannot spot a threat, add a threat to make the fellowship archery total +1.

name: Windfola
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert. Skirmish: If bearer is Éowyn, exert her twice to wound a fierce minion she is skirmishing.

name: With Strength to Fight
lore: '...it is a long road....'
text: To play, spot a [rohan] companion. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Regroup: Discard this condition to heal up to 2 [rohan] companions.

name: Above the Battlement
lore: ...they began to throw missiles marvellously high....
text: Play a besieger stacked on a site you control or remove a burden to play a [sauron] Orc from your discard pile.

name: Anguish
lore: '...the Rammas is breached far and wide....'
text: Remove 3 threats to make a character skirmishing a [sauron] Orc strength -3.

name: Army of Udûn
text: Shadow: Discard a [sauron] Orc to add a threat. Skirmish: Remove a threat to make Army of Udûn strength +1. Regroup: Discard Army of Udûn and X other [sauron] Orcs to add X threats.

name: Besieging Pike
lore: ...all day more force and gear of war had poured across.
text: Bearer must be a [sauron] Orc. If you have initiative, bearer is strength +3.

name: Breached
lore: 'Yet now under the Lord of Barad-dûr the most fell of all his captains is already master of your outer walls....'
text: Remove 4 threats and spot 2 [sauron] Orcs to make the Free Peoples player spot a companion and place that companion in the dead pile.

name: Din of Arms
text: Choose an opponent to discard the top card of his or her draw deck. If the twilight cost of that card is less than the number of besiegers you spot, take control of a site and all besiegers are strength +3 until the regroup phase.

name: Encirclement
text: For each 2 sites you control, the twilight cost of each of your [sauron] cards is -1. Regroup: Spot a [sauron] minion to draw a card (or draw 2 cards instead if that minion is a besieger). Discard this condition.

name: Fires Raged Unchecked
lore: And so slowly they passed out of a dim day of fears into the darkness of a desperate night.
text: The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1 for each threat. While you can spot 3 threats, each [sauron] Orc that is not roaming is strength +1.

name: Mirkwood Bowman
lore: 'Thus we passed over Gilrain, driving the allies of Mordor in rout before us....'
text: Exert 2 [elven] companions to discard the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Make the fellowship archery total +1 for each [elven] card discarded.

name: Gorgoroth Attacker
lore: ...the weakest point in all that high and impenetrable wall.
text: Besieger. When you play this minion from a site you control, add a burden for each site you control.

name: Gorgoroth Axeman
lore: Down from the hills... poured Orcs innumerable.
text: Besieger. Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a [sauron] minion strength +1 for each site you control (or +2 if you have initiative).

name: Gorgoroth Engineer
lore: From behind the battle the River had been swiftly bridged....
text: Besieger. When you play this minion from a site you control, add 2 threats.

name: Gorgoroth Garrison
lore: ...their purpose was only to test the strength of the defence....
text: Besieger. Regroup: Discard 2 cards from hand to stack a [sauron] Orc on a site you control (or discard 1 card from hand if that Orc is a besieger).

name: Gorgoroth Officer
lore: The drums rolled louder. Fires leaped up.
text: Besieger. Skirmish: Discard 2 cards from hand to play a [sauron] Orc stacked on a site you control. That Orc is fierce and strength +6 until the regroup phase.

name: Gorgoroth Pillager
lore: Great engines crawled across the field....
text: Besieger. While this minion is stacked on a site you control, besiegers are fierce.

name: Gorgoroth Ransacker
lore: ...company upon company of the enemy pressed to the walls.
text: Besieger. Skirmish: If this minion is stacked on a site you control, discard him to make a [sauron] Orc strength +5 (or +10 if you have initiative).

name: Gorgoroth Sapper
lore: It was against the Gate that he would throw his heaviest weight.
text: Besieger. Shadow: Discard 2 cards from hand to play a [sauron] Orc stacked on a site you control (discard 1 card from hand instead if that Orc is a besieger).

name: Gorgoroth Soldier
lore: Ever since the middle night the great assault had gone on.
text: Besieger. Response: If a besieger is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent it.

name: Gorgoroth Troop
lore: 'They are strong: battalions of Orcs of the Eye....'
text: Besieger. Skirmish: Stack your besieger on a site you control to make Gorgoroth Troop strength +2.

name: Shadow Between
lore: 'But did I not also fortell that you shall neither have wife, nor bind any woman to you....'
text: To play, spot an Elf. At the start of your regroup phase, you may discard this condition or a card from hand to heal an Elf.

name: Great Peril of Fire
lore: ...all who could be spared were busy quelling the flames that sprang up in many places.
text: To play, spot a besieger or a site you control. Maneuver: Discard an engine to discard a condition from the Free Peoples support area.

name: Great Siege-towers
text: Engine. Shadow: Play a besieger to place a [sauron] token here. Skirmish: Remove a [sauron] token from a condition to make a [sauron] Orc strength +1 (limit +2).

name: Host of Udûn
lore: The great doors of the Black Gate swung back wide. Out of it streamed a great host as swiftly as swirling waters when a sluice is lifted.
text: When you play Host of Udûn, you may remove X threats to make its twilight cost -X.

name: Legions of Morgul
text: To play, spot 2 [sauron] Orcs and add up to 3 threats. Each time a companion is about to be killed, you may remove a threat to make all minions fierce until the regroup phase. Discard this condition and remove 3 threats at the start of the regroup phase.

name: Mordor Assassin
lore: Drums rolled and fires leaped up.
text: Response: If a companion is overwhelmed during a skirmish involving a [sauron] Orc and threat wounds are about to be placed, remove a threat to assign this minion to the Ring-bearer (even if the Ring-bearer is already assigned).

name: Mordor Defender
lore: ...towards Mordor where the first bitter assault would come....
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion and spot another [sauron] minion to add a threat.

name: Mordor Fighter
lore: The men of the West were trapped....
text: While you can spot a threat and another [sauron] Orc, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free People player's hand.

name: Mordor Guard
lore: ...from the host of Mordor there went up a jeering yell.
text: Skirmish: Exert 3 [sauron] Orcs to add 3 threats. When this minion is discarded, remove 3 threats.

name: Mordor Regular
lore: ...but the sun now climbing towards the South was veiled in the reeks of Mordor....
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion and spot another [sauron] minion to add a threat.

name: Mordor Savage
lore: ...he watched the enemy come charging to the assault.
text: Skirmish: Exert this minion and spot another [sauron] minion to add a threat.

name: Still Needed
lore: 'You must not go to the Havens Legolas. There will always be some folk... who need you.'
text: Make an Elf strength +2. You may place this event on top of your draw deck.

name: Mordor Soldier
lore: ...or the end maybe of all the world of light.
text: Skirmish: Remove a threat to make this minion strength +4.

name: Mordor Trooper
lore: ...and then all hope was quenched.
text: Skirmish: Remove 2 threats to make a [sauron] Orc strength +6.

name: Mordor Veteran
lore: ...the first assault crashed into them.
text: Skirmish: Remove 3 threats to make a [sauron] minion strength +8.

name: Mordor Warrior
lore: Sauron had taken the proffered bait in jaws of steel.
text: Skirmish: Discard a card from your hand to make a companion skirmishing this minion strength -1 for each other [sauron] Orc you spot (limit -3).

name: Orc Archer Troop
lore: The wind blew, and the trumpets sang, and arrows whined....
text: Archer. If you have initiative, the minion archery total is +1 and Orc Archer Troop is fierce.

name: Orc Assault Band
lore: The plain was dark with their marching companies....
text: Skirmish: Spot 6 companions and exert this minion to make another [sauron] Orc strength +6.

name: Orc Brood
lore: ...the vomit of the maggot-folk of Mordor.
text: Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to make this minion strength +3.

name: Orc Butcher
text: For each [sauron] condition you can spot, this minion is strength +1.

name: Orc Chaser
lore: But still the Enemy made no sign.
text: Tracker. The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1. While you have initiative, this minion is strength +6.

name: Orc Destroyer
lore: ...all the hills and rocks about the Morannon were filled with hidden foes....
text: Shadow: Remove (3) and spot 3 [sauron] Orcs to draw a card.

name: Battle Tested
lore: 'We're going to follow you, lad – even on the dark Road....'
text: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (+4 if you spot a card stacked on a [dwarven] condition).

name: Uncertain Paths
lore: 'But defenders and foes alike gave up the battle....'
text: Make an Elf strength +2 and you may shuffle your draw deck.

name: Orc Fanatic
lore: ...far away he saw fires spring up....
text: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make another [sauron] Orc strength +3.

name: Orc Marauder
lore: ...their bodies were cast aside... and others took their place.
text: While you can spot 3 other [sauron] Orcs, this minion is strength +5.

name: Orc Officer
lore: ...and the shadowy defile beyond was bored and tunnelled by teeming broods of evil things.
text: Each time a companion is overwhelmed in a skirmish that involves a [sauron] Orc, add 3 burdens.

name: Orc Pursuer(2)
lore: ...and they knew that they were watched.
text: Tracker. The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1. While you have initiative, this minion is strength +5.

name: Orc Rager
lore: The drums rolled and rattled.
text: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make another [sauron] Orc strength +4.

name: Orc Savage
lore: North amid the noisome pits lay the first of the great heaps and hills of slag....
text: While you can spot 6 companions and another [sauron] Orc, this minion is strength +9 and fierce.

name: Orc Seeker
lore: ...even before they came to the gate Sauron sprang his trap.
text: Tracker. The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1. If you have initiative when you play this minion, you may spot another [sauron] Orc to draw 2 cards.

name: Orc Stalker
lore: ...his soldiers blew their horns in a signal long arranged....
text: Tracker. The site number of each [sauron] Orc is -1. While you have initiative, this minion is strength +8.

name: Rally the Host
lore: And now the fighting waxed furious on the fields of the Pelennor....
text: To play, spot 2 [sauron] Orcs. Regroup: Exert a [sauron] Orc and remove a threat to shuffle a [sauron] Orc from play into your draw deck.

name: Rope and Winch
text: To play, spot 2 [sauron] Orcs. Discard any number of cards from hand. The Free Peoples player then discards any number of cards from hand. For each card you discarded more than the Free Peoples player, make a [sauron] Orc strength +2.

name: All Save One
lore: 'You cannot enter here....'
text: Make Gandalf strength +2 (or +4 and damage +1 if you have initiative).

name: Sauron's Hatred
text: To play, spot a [sauron] Orc. Shadow: Remove a threat to play a [sauron] Orc without paying any roaming penalty. Regroup: Spot a [sauron] Orc and remove (4) to add a threat.

name: Siege Commander
lore: 'They have taken the wall!'
text: Besieger. Skirmish: Discard 2 cards from hand to make a besieger fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Siegecraft
lore: 'They are blasting breaches in it.'
text: If your [sauron] Orc wins a skirmish, make all your [sauron] Orcs fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Some Secret Art of Flame
text: To play, spot a [sauron] Orc. Regroup: Play a [sauron] condition to place a [sauron] token on this card. While there are 3 tokens on this card, the Shadow has initiative, regardless of the Free Peoples player's hand.

name: Stronghold of Cirith Ungol
lore: In the Land of Mordor where the Shadows lie.
text: Response: If your [sauron] minion wins a skirmish, place a [sauron] token here (limit 1 per site). Regroup: Add (2) for each token here. Discard this condition.

name: Tower Walkway
lore: ...the hidden Captain put forth his strength.
text: Engine. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc. Each besieger is strength +1 for each site you control. Regroup: Discard 3 [sauron] Orcs to take control of a site. Discard this condition.

name: Troop Tower
lore: Slowly the great siege-towers built in Osgiliath rolled forward through the dark.
text: Engine. To play, spot a [sauron] Orc. All [sauron] Orcs are strength +1 for each besieger stacked on a site. Regroup: Discard a besieger to take control of a site. Discard this condition.

name: Frodo, Hope of Free Peoples
subtitle: Hope of Free Peoples
lore: 'Aiya Eärendil Elenion Ancalima!'
text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Ring-bound. Each time the fellowship moves, you may add (3) to remove a threat.

name: Frodo, Wicked Masster!
subtitle: Wicked Masster!
lore: 'Wicked masster cheats us; cheats Sméagol, gollum.'
text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Ring-bound. Skirmish: At sites 6[K] to 8[K], add 4 burdens to wound a minion skirmishing Frodo.

name: Hobbit Sword
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit.

name: The Board Is Set
lore: 'We come to it at last... the greatest battle of our time.'
text: Spell. If an event is played, exert Gandalf to make that opponent remove (2) or cancel that event.

name: Merry, Rohirrim Squire
subtitle: Rohirrim Squire
lore: 'I will be ready... even if you bid me ride with you on the Paths of the Dead.'
text: Skirmish: If you cannot spot 3 threats, add a threat to make Merry strength +2.

name: Merry, Swordthain
subtitle: Swordthain
lore: 'And I would not have it said of me in song only that I was always left behind!'
text: Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, return him to your hand to play up to 2 [rohan] possessions from your discard pile.

name: Noble Intentions
text: Exert a companion (except a Hobbit) to make a Hobbit strength +3.

name: Pippin, Sworn to Service
subtitle: Sworn to Service
lore: 'I do not know what put it into your head, or your heart, to do that. But it was well done.'
text: While you cannot spot 4 threats, Pippin is strength +1 for each threat you can spot.

name: Pippin, Wearer of Black and Silver
subtitle: Wearer of Black and Silver
lore: 'And as for orders, I think you have a madman to deal with, not a lord.'
text: Skirmish: If Pippin is not assigned to a skirmish, return him to your hand to wound a roaming minion twice.

name: Pressing On
text: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Regroup: Discard this condition and exert a Hobbit companion to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

name: Sam, Needer of Vittles
subtitle: Needer of Vittles
lore: '...but where there's life there's hope, as my Gaffer used to say....'
text: Ring-bound. Fellowship: Play a Hobbit companion to remove a burden. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: Sam, Resolute Halfling
subtitle: Resolute Halfling
lore: The news that his master was still alive roused him....
text: Ring-bound. Fellowship: If you have initiative, discard a card from hand to heal Sam. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: Slow-kindled Courage
text: Bearer must be Merry or Pippin. Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to bearer of Slow-kindled Courage." Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and remove 2 burdens.

name: Dunharrow Plateau
text: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to play a [dwarven] condition from your draw deck (limit once per turn).

name: Citadel to Gate
lore: Wherever he came men's hearts would lift again, and the winged shadows pass from memory.
text: Exert Gandalf twice to remove all threats and to heal all companions of one culture (except [gandalf]).

name: Edoras Hall
text: The twilight cost of each [rohan] possession is -1.

name: Isengard Ruined
text: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to add (2). Each player may draw a card.

name: Rohirrim Road
text: Fellowship: Exert an Elf to make the twilight cost of each condition and possession +2 until the end of the turn.

name: Sleeping Quarters
text: When the fellowship moves from this site, the Free Peoples player may spot 3 Hobbits to remove (2).

name: Steps of Edoras
text: Each [gondor] companion is defender +1 until the end of the turn.

name: King's Tent
text: Shadow: If the Shadow has initiative, spot your minion to make the move limit for this turn -1.

name: Rohirrim Camp
text: Plains. If the Shadow has initiative, minions are not roaming.

name: West Road
text: Plains. If the Shadow has initiative, the Shadow number of this site is +3.

name: Beacon of Minas Tirith
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: If you cannot spot 3 threats, add a threat to heal a companion.

name: Hall of the Kings
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: If you cannot spot 3 threats, add a threat to draw a card.

name: Echoes of Valinor
lore: 'Here in the Court of the Kings, Isildur grew a white tree, from a seed brought over the waters....'
text: Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may exert him to draw 2 cards.

name: Tower of Ecthelion
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: If you cannot spot 3 threats, add 3 threats to make the move limit for this turn +1.

name: Anduin Banks
text: River. Skirmish: Spot your minion and remove a burden to make that minion strength +2.

name: Osgiliath Fallen
text: Skirmish: Spot your minion and remove 2 burdens to make that minion damage +1.

name: Pelennor Plain
text: Plains. Archery: Spot your minion and remove 3 burdens to make the minion archery total +3.

name: City Gates
text: When the fellowship moves to this site, add 3 threats. When the fellowship moves from this site, remove 3 threats.

name: Pelennor Flat
text: Plains. At the start of the maneuver phase, the Free Peoples player must discard his or her hand or add 2 burdens.

name: Minas Tirith Fifth Circle
text: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal Gandalf three times.

name: Minas Tirith First Circle
text: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, wound each companion.

name: Minas Tirith Fourth Circle
text: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal each [rohan] companion.

name: Minas Tirith Second Circle
text: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal each [dwarven] companion.

name: Fool's Hope
lore: 'There never was much hope....'
text: Spot Gandalf and discard 2 cards from hand to make an opponent discard all but 2 Shadow conditions.

name: Minas Tirith Seventh Circle
text: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal each [elven] companion.

name: Minas Tirith Sixth Circle
text: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal each [gondor] companion.

name: Minas Tirith Third Circle
text: Sanctuary. If the fellowship moves from this site during the regroup phase, heal each Hobbit companion.

name: Osgiliath Crossing
text: River. Shadow: Exert 2 minions and spot 6 companions to draw 2 cards.

name: Pelennor Grassland
text: Plains. Shadow: Exert a minion and spot 6 companions to add (1).

name: Ruined Capitol
text: River. Shadow: Spot your minion and 6 companions to make the move limit for this turn -1.

name: Cross Roads
text: Shadow: Spot 2 [raider] Men and remove a threat to add (2).

name: Morgul Vale
text: Skirmish: Spot your [sauron] minion and remove 2 threats to make your [sauron] minion strength +3.

name: Morgulduin
text: Shadow: Remove 2 threats to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile. His twilight cost is -2.

name: Northern Ithilien
text: Shadow: Remove 2 threats and play Gollum from your discard pile to add 2 burdens.

name: Gandalf, Defender of the West
subtitle: Defender of the West
lore: 'I come with counsel and tidings in this dark hour.'
text: While you cannot spot 3 companions of the same culture, Gandalf is strength -2.

name: Dagorlad
text: Plains. When the fellowship moves to this site, add 3 threats.

name: Haunted Pass
text: Shadow: Remove a threat and spot your minion to draw a card.

name: Narchost
text: Shadow: Spot 8 burdens to make the Ring-bearer wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.

name: Slag Mounds
text: Each time a companion is killed, add a burden.

name: Aragorn, Driven by Need
subtitle: Driven by Need
lore: '...for you will find both toil and great fear, and maybe worse.'
text: While you cannot spot 4 threats, Aragorn is strength +1 for each threat. Regroup: Exert Aragorn twice to remove 3 threats.

name: Éomer, Valiant Warchief
subtitle: Valiant Warchief
text: Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1. Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 3 cards from hand to make Éomer strength +1 for each valiant companion you spot.

name: Gandalf, Manager of Wizards
subtitle: Manager of Wizards
text: Skirmish: Place 3 cards from hand on top of your draw deck to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -3. Any Shadow player may place 3 cards from his or her hand on top of his or her draw deck to prevent this.

name: Gandalf's Staff, Focus of Power
subtitle: Focus of Power
lore: 'But for Gandalf Stormcrow you would have seen a host of foes coming out of Anórien....'
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. While you can spot 4 twilight tokens, Gandalf is strength +1.

name: Glamdring, Elven Blade
subtitle: Elven Blade
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. He is damage +1. Skirmish: If you have more cards in hand than each opponent, discard 2 cards from hand to make an opponent exert a minion.

name: Calculated Risk
lore: 'Beyond the eyes of Dwarves are such fortellings....'
text: Spot a Dwarf and add a threat to draw 3 cards.

name: Have Patience
text: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound companion twice.

name: Intimidate
text: Spell. If a companion is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf to prevent that wound.

name: King's Advisor
lore: 'Will they answer the summons, think you?'
text: Exert Gandalf twice to make an opponent exert a minion for each [rohan] companion you spot.

name: Light the Beacons
lore: 'Théoden will honour your old alliance and come with a mighty army.'
text: Exert Gandalf three times (or twice if you have initiative) to make all unbound companions of one culture (except [gandalf]) strength +3 until the regroup phase.

name: Moment of Respite
lore: '...Gandalf says you must go ere nightfall, and the Lord of the Mark is eager for his own house.'
text: At the start of your regroup phase, you may discard 2 cards from hand to heal Gandalf.

name: Númenor's Pride
text: To play, spot Gandalf and add 3 threats. Gandalf is defender +1 and cannot take wounds. Discard this condition at the start of the regroup phase.

name: Peace of Mind
lore: 'All Wizards should have a Hobbit or two in their care... to teach them the meaning of humility!'
text: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound Hobbit 3 times.

name: Sharpen Your Swords
lore: 'Courage will now be your best defence against the storm that is at hand....'
text: Spot Gandalf to make a [gondor] companion strength +1 for each [gondor] companion you spot (limit +4).

name: Stay This Madness
lore: So it was that Gandalf took command of the last defence of the City of Gondor.
text: To play, spot Gandalf. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Regroup: Discard this condition to wound 2 minions.

name: Steadfast Champion
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to Gandalf." Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and heal a companion 3 times.

name: Dark Ways
text: To play, spot a Dwarf. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Regroup: Discard this condition to heal a Dwarf twice and take a [dwarven] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile.

name: Terrible and Evil
lore: 'Minas Morgul is their lair.'
text: Spell. Exert Gandalf X times to wound a minion X times. If that minion is a Nazgûl, wound it again.

name: Undaunted
lore: '...here the hammerstroke will fall hardest....'
text: Exert Gandalf to make him strength +1 for each twilight token you spot (limit +8).

name: Wizard Staff
text: Bearer must be a Wizard. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to make a minion strength -3.

name: Captured by the Ring
lore: 'Give us that....'
text: Play Gollum from your draw deck or discard pile to add a threat.

name: Clever Hobbits
lore: 'Clever hobbits to climb so high, very clever hobbits!'
text: Discard any number of [gollum] conditions. For each condition discarded, make Sméagol strength +3 and damage +1.

name: Days Growing Dark
lore: 'Come on, we must go, no time to lose!'
text: Fellowship: Discard 3 cards from hand to play Sméagol from your discard pile.

name: The Dead City
lore: 'Not that way!'
text: Stealth. Bearer must be Sméagol. If Sméagol is about to be killed in a skirmish, he is discarded instead.

name: Fat One Wants It
text: Each time Gollum or Sméagol is played, add a threat. Regroup: Discard this condition to return Gollum to his owner's hand.

name: Gollum, Plotting Deceiver
subtitle: Plotting Deceiver
lore: 'Let Her deal with them... she must eat. All She gets is filthy Orcses.'
text: If you have initiative during the Shadow phase, you may play this minion from your discard pile.

name: Gollum, Vile Creature
subtitle: Vile Creature
lore: When they come to the bridge they will see us. Come away! Climb, climb!
text: Skirmish: Exert Gollum twice or remove a threat to make him strength +2.

name: Gimli, Faithful Companion
subtitle: Faithful Companion
lore: 'I will go with you even on the Paths of the Dead, and to whatever end they may lead....'
text: Damage +1. While you have initiative, Gimli is strength +2.

name: Heavy Burden
lore: 'Sméagol knows... Sméagol carried burden many years.'
text: Regroup: Discard Gollum and remove a threat to add a burden.

name: Hobbitses Are Dead
text: Spot Gollum or Sméagol to make a Nazgûl, [sauron] minion, or [gollum] minion strength +2. If you have initiative, you may play this event from your discard pile; place it under your draw deck instead of discarding it.

name: It's Mine
lore: 'See! See! He wants it for himself.'
text: Shadow: Remove (1) and exert Gollum to discard the top card of your draw deck. If that card is a [gollum] or [wraith] card, take it into hand.

name: Let Her Deal With Them
text: To play, spot Gollum or Sméagol. Bearer must be a minion. Limit 1 per bearer. Bearer is damage +1. If you have initiative during the Shadow phase, you may play this condition from your discard pile.

name: Nasty
lore: 'He's a fat, horrid Hobbit, who hates Sméagol, who makes up nasty lies.'
text: Make Sméagol strength +1 for each [gollum] card you spot.

name: Never
lore: 'Sméagol wouldn't hurt a fly!'
text: To play, spot Sméagol. Regroup: Discard Sméagol to remove 2 threats.

name: No Safe Places
lore: '...they are watching... eyes will see us.'
text: Exert Sméagol to reveal an opponent's hand. That opponent must discard a card from hand for each culture revealed.

name: Plotting
lore: 'We shall see... Oh yes, we shall see!'
text: To play, spot Gollum and add up to 9 threats. Gollum is strength +2. Discard this condition and remove 9 threats at the start of the regroup phase.

name: Scouting
text: To play, spot Sméagol. Each time the fellowship moves, add a threat or discard this condition. Maneuver: Discard Sméagol to discard a minion. An opponent may exert a minion twice to prevent this.

name: Secret Paths
lore: 'Not that way! No, not that way!'
text: To play, spot Sméagol and add 2 threats. The move limit for this turn is +1. Discard this condition at the end of the turn.

name: Gimli, Feared Axeman
subtitle: Feared Axeman
lore: 'There are countless things still to see in Middle-earth, and great works to do.'
text: Damage +1. Response: If a [dwarven] condition is about to be discarded by an opponent, exert a Dwarf or discard a [dwarven] card from hand to prevent that.

name: Serving the Precious
lore: 'Sméagol look after Master. Sméagol serve Master well!'
text: Discard Sméagol to play a companion from your discard pile.

name: Sméagol, Always Helps
subtitle: Always Helps
lore: 'Yes, yes! Sméagol helps, always helps.'
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Assignment: Assign a minion to Sméagol and add 2 threats to exhaust that minion.

name: Sméagol, Hurried Guide
subtitle: Hurried Guide
lore: 'Wake up! Wake up! Wake up, sleepies! We must go, yes, we must go at once!'
text: Ring-bound. To play, add a burden. Skirmish: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from your hand. Sméagol cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.

name: Sneaking!
lore: 'What were you doing?'
text: Stealth. Heal Sméagol (or cancel Sméagol's skirmish if he has more vitality than the minion or minions he is skirmishing).

name: So Polite
lore: 'Sméagol shows them secret ways that nobody else could find and they say, 'Sneak!''
text: Play Gollum from your discard pile to add (1) for each threat you spot.

name: Sweeter Meats
lore: 'It may well be, oh yes, it may very well be, that when She throws away the bones and the empty clothes... we shall find It!'
text: If a minion is about to take a wound, spot Gollum to prevent that wound.

name: Very Nice Friends
lore: 'He hurts us... hurts poor Sméagol!'
text: Play Sméagol from your discard pile to play the fellowship's next site (replacing an opponent's site if necessary). If you do not move again this turn, discard your hand.

name: We Hates Them
text: Bearer must be Sméagol. Each minion gains this ability: "Assignment: Assign this minion to Sméagol." Regroup: Discard this condition to discard a minion and play a companion from your discard pile.

name: Where Shall We Go
lore: 'If you scare him off, we are lost.'
text: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to wound a minion Sméagol is skirmishing twice.

name: Andúril, Flame of the West
subtitle: Flame of the West
text: Bearer must be Aragorn. Discard other weapons he bears. He is damage +1 and cannot bear other weapons. Fellowship or Regroup: If the fellowship is at any site 2 or any site 5, play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

name: Gimli's Armor
lore: 'I hope that the forgotten people will not have forgotten how to fight....'
text: Bearer must be Gimli. Response: If you have initiative and Gimli is about to take a wound, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

name: Andúril, King's Blade
subtitle: King's Blade
lore: The Sword of Elendil was forged anew by Elvish smiths... for Aragorn son of Arathorn was going to war upon the marches of Mordor.
text: Bearer must be Aragorn. If you cannot spot a threat, Aragorn is defender +1.

name: Aragorn, Captain of Gondor
subtitle: Captain of Gondor
lore: '...but one who can wield the power this sword commands....'
text: Knight. At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (2) to heal another [gondor] companion.

name: Cirion
lore: So now at last the City was besieged....
text: While you have only 4 or 5 cards in hand, Cirion is strength +2.

name: City of Men
lore: 'I will gladly give my life to defend her beauty, her memory... her wisdom.'
text: Make a [gondor] Man strength +2. If that Man is skirmishing a [sauron] minion, discard that minion at the end of the skirmish.

name: Dagger Strike
text: Make a [gondor] or [shire] companion bearing a hand weapon strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Denethor, Steward of the City
subtitle: Steward of the City
lore: A pale smile, like a gleam of cold sun on a winter's evening, passed over the old man's face....
text: Fellowship: Play a [gondor] knight. That knight's twilight cost is -2. Each time a Shadow card adds a threat, add a burden. Each time a Shadow card adds a burden, add a threat.

name: Denethor, Wizened Steward
subtitle: Wizened Steward
lore: '...in desperate hours gentleness may be repaid with death.'
text: Denethor is strength +1 for each other [gondor] Man you can spot (limit +4).

name: Derufin
lore: From the uplands of Morthond....
text: Regroup: While you have exactly 5 cards in hand, you may exert Derufin to discard an engine, machine, or possession.

name: Dervorin
lore: The men of Ringló Vale behind the son of their lord....
text: At the start of the regroup phase, if you have only 4 cards in hand, you may spot another [gondor] Man to discard a minion.

name: Duty of Two
lore: '...for himself, and for the one that will not return.'
text: Add 3 threats to heal all [gondor] companions.

name: Gimli's Battle Axe, Trusted Weapon
subtitle: Trusted Weapon
text: Bearer must be a Dwarf. While you can spot a threat, bearer is damage +1. While you can spot 2 threats, bearer is strength +1. While you can spot 3 threats, the fellowship archery total is +1.

name: Faramir, Stout Captain
subtitle: Stout Captain
lore: 'But if I should return, think better of me!'
text: Ranger. To play, spot a [gondor] Man. Each time Faramir wins a skirmish involving a fierce minion, you may exert Faramir to discard that minion.

name: Faramir, Wizard's Pupil
subtitle: Wizard's Pupil
text: Ranger. Fellowship: Play a [rohan] Man to heal Faramir. Skirmish: Exert Faramir to make an unbound Hobbit strength +2. Skirmish: Exert Gandalf to prevent all wounds to Faramir.

name: First Level
lore: ...the walls passed from looming white to grey....
text: Fortification. Maneuver: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot a knight to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion.

name: Footman's Armor
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Response: If bearer is about to be overwhelmed, discard a [gondor] fortification or a card from hand to make bearer strength +2.

name: Gondor Bow
lore: ...tall Duinhir with his sons, Duilin and Derufin, and five hundred bowmen.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. If bearer is a knight, he or she is strength +1. Skirmish: Exert bearer to wound a minion he or she is skirmishing if that minion bears a fortification.

name: Gondor Still Stands
text: To play, spot 3 [gondor] companions. While no opponent controls a site, wound a minion at the start of each regroup phase. Regroup: Discard this condition to place a [gondor] fortification from your discard pile on top of your draw deck.

name: Gondorian Captain
lore: 'The Captains of the Outlands are expected up the South Road ere sundown.'
text: Knight. Fellowship: Discard a fortification to remove a threat.

name: Gondorian Merchant
lore: ...they talked now of Gondor and its ways and customs....
text: Maneuver: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from hand to make the site number of a minion +2 until the regroup phase.

name: Gondorian Sword
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Skirmish: Discard 3 cards from hand to make bearer damage +1.

name: Great Gate
lore: ...and its iron doors rolled back before them.
text: Make a [gondor] companion strength +2 and, if you can spot 2 [gondor] fortifications, exert a minion that companion is skirmishing.

name: The Great Goblin, Chieftain of the Misty Mountains
subtitle: Chieftain of the Misty Mountains

name: The One Ring, Answer To All Riddles
subtitle: Answer To All Riddles
lore: '...thought to have perished from the world.'
text: While wearing The One Ring, the Ring-bearer is strength +2, and each time he is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead. Skirmish: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.

name: Dunlending Brigand
lore: 'This was a rich vale and had many homesteads. Alas for my folk!'

name: Shadowfax
lore: 'He is the chief of the Mearas, lords of horses....'
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. Discard any hand weapon he bears. Gandalf may not bear a hand weapon. At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, each minion skirmishing him must exert.

name: Stump and Bramble
lore: 'Many of those trees were my friends... many had voices of their own that are lost for ever now.'
text: Maneuver: Spot an [isengard] minion and an Ent ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is damage +2 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.

name: Task Was Not Done
lore: 'Naked I was sent back – for a brief time, until my task is done. And naked I lay upon the mountain-top.'
text: Spell. Regroup: Exert Gandalf to discard up to 2 wounded minions.

name: Treebeard, Earthborn
subtitle: Earthborn
lore: 'Do not be hasty, that is my motto.'
text: Unhasty. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to be discarded, stack him here instead. Fellowship: Exert Treebeard and add (1) to play an unbound Hobbit stacked here.

name: Treebeard, Oldest Living Thing
subtitle: Oldest Living Thing
lore: 'No, I am not tired. I do not easily get tired. And I do not sit down. I am not very, hm, bendable.'
text: Unhasty. Fellowship: Exert Treebeard and discard an unbound companion from hand to heal an unbound companion.

name: Under the Living Earth
lore: 'Thither I came at last, to the uttermost foundations of stone. He was with me still.'
text: Skirmish: Make Gandalf strength +1 for each twilight token you spot (limit +5).

name: Well Met Indeed
lore: 'And what may you be doing in these parts? An Elf, a Man, and a Dwarf, all clad in elvish fashion.'
text: Fellowship: Spot an Elf, a [gondor] Man, and a Dwarf to play Gandalf from your dead pile.

name: Windows in a Stone Wall
text: To play, exert an Ent. Plays on that Ent. Response: If an [isengard] minion is killed, discard this condition to reveal the top 10 cards of an opponent's draw deck. Discard 1 Shadow card and 1 Free Peoples card revealed. Your opponent reshuffles that deck.

name: Wizardry Indeed
lore: The hosts of Isengard roared, swaying this way and that, turning from fear to fear.
text: Maneuver: If you can spot more minions than companions, exert Gandalf to make an opponent discard a minion.

name: Aragorn, Heir of Elendil
subtitle: Heir of Elendil
lore: 'Sauron fears you, Aragorn, he fears what you may become.'
text: Defender +1.

name: Dunlending Looter
lore: ...the Dunlendings raided often over the Isen.
text: When this minion wins a skirmish, you may stack him on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. His twilight cost is -2.

name: Arrows Thick in the Air
lore: He came to rest in the fern a few feet away, face downward, green arrow-feathers sticking from his neck below a golden collar.
text: Archery or Skirmish: Exert 2 Ring-bound Men to wound each roaming minion.

name: Boromir, My Brother
lore: 'Where is thy horn? Whither goest thou? O Boromir! But he was gone.'
text: Bearer must be Faramir. Skirmish: Discard a [gondor] card from hand to make a Ring-bound Man strength +1.

name: Boromir's Gauntlets
lore: '...now Boromir has taken his road, and we must make haste to choose our own.'
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Skirmish: Exert bearer to cancel a skirmish involving bearer. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.

name: Curse Them
lore: 'It is close on ten leagues hence to the east-shore of Anduin... and we seldom come so far afield.'
text: Skirmish: Exert a Ring-bound Man to cancel a skirmish involving a roaming minion.

name: Damrod, Ranger of Ithilien
subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien
lore: 'I doubt not that the days of Gondor are numbered, and the walls of Minas Tirith are doomed, so great is His strength and malice.'
text: Ring-bound. Ranger. To play, spot a Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: Exert Damrod to exhaust a Man he is skirmishing.

name: Defend It and Hope
lore: 'Is it not said that no foe has ever taken the Hornburg, if men defended it?'
text: Maneuver: Exert a [gondor] Man to wound a minion once (or twice if that minion is an Uruk-hai).

name: Faramir, Captain of Gondor
subtitle: Captain of Gondor
lore: 'He leads us now in all perilous ventures.'
text: Ring-bound. Ranger. The twilight cost of each other [gondor] Man in your starting fellowship is -1. While skirmishing a roaming minion, Faramir is strength +2.

name: Faramir, Son of Denethor
subtitle: Son of Denethor
lore: He could see Faramir's face, which was now unmasked; it was stern and commanding, and a keen wit lay behind his searching glance.
text: Ring-bound. Ranger. An opponent may not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving Faramir.

name: Faramir's Bow
lore: 'Were I as hasty as you, I might have slain you long ago.'
text: Bearer must be Faramir. He is an archer. Skirmish: If Faramir is skirmishing a Man or a roaming minion, exert Faramir to wound that minion.

name: Faramir's Cloak
lore: Captain Faramir and his rangers were clad in green and brown of varied hues, better to walk unseen in the glades of Ithilien.
text: Bearer must be Faramir. Each roaming minion skirmishing a Ring-bound Man is strength -1.

name: Dunlending Madman
lore: 'They hate us, and they are glad; for our doom seems certain to them.'
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may make him strength +2 and fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Forbidden Pool
lore: '...tonight you have come where it is death to come.'
text: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 6[T], each Ring-bound Man takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. Fellowship: Add (2) and discard this condition to heal a Ring-bound Man.

name: Forests of Ithilien
lore: ...a fair country of climbing woods and swift-falling streams.
text: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 5[T], the site number of each Man in a skirmish is +2. Regroup: Discard this condition and exert a Ring-bound Man to liberate a site.

name: Gondorian Ranger
lore: Green gauntlets covered their hands, and their faces were hooded and masked with green, except for their eyes, which were very keen and bright.
text: Ring-bound. Ranger. The site number of each minion assigned to skirmish a Ring-bound Man is +2.

name: Hard Choice
lore: 'Shall we rest by night, or shall we go on while our will and strength hold?'
text: Fellowship: Spot Aragorn to heal a companion who has the Aragorn signet twice.

name: Help in Doubt and Need
lore: 'The Heir of Elendil would be a strength indeed to the Sons of Eorl in this evil tide.'
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert an unbound [gondor] Man to make a [rohan] companion strength +2, or exert a [rohan] companion to make an unbound [gondor] Man strength +2.

name: Henneth Annûn
lore: 'This is the Window of the Sunset....'
text: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 6[T], each roaming minion skirmishing a Ring-bound companion is strength -2. Skirmish: Spot a [gondor] Man and discard this condition to wound a roaming minion.

name: Ithilien Trap
lore: He was glad he could not see the dead face.
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a [gondor] Man wins a skirmish, you may place a [gondor] token here. Maneuver: Exert a minion for each [gondor] token here (limit 3). Discard this condition.

name: Mablung, Soldier of Gondor
subtitle: Soldier of Gondor
lore: '...we have a new errand on this journey....'
text: Ring-bound. Ranger. To play, spot a Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: Exert Mablung to exhaust a roaming minion he is skirmishing.

name: New Errand
lore: '...we come to ambush the Men of Harad.'
text: Skirmish: Spot a Ring-bound Man to make a minion's site number +2. If that minion loses this skirmish, you may wound a minion.

name: Pathfinder
lore: 'If you take my counsel, you will not turn eastward yet. Go straight on, for thus you will have the cover of the woodland for many miles.'
text: Fellowship or Regroup: Spot a ranger to play the fellowship's next site (replacing opponent's site if necessary).

name: Dunlending Pillager
lore: 'Not in half a thousand years have they forgotten their grievance that the lords of Gondor gave the Mark to Eorl the Young and made alliance with him.'
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may discard a Free Peoples possession (or 2 possessions if you spot 6 companions).

name: Ranger of Ithilien
lore: ...they were goodly men, pale-skinned, dark of hair, with grey eyes and faces sad and proud.
text: Ring-bound. Ranger. When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. While skirmishing a roaming minion, this companion is strength +2.

name: Ranger's Bow
lore: Two had great bows, almost of their own height, and great quivers of long green-feathered arrows.
text: Bearer must be Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: If bearer is skirmishing a Man or a roaming minion, exert bearer to wound that minion.

name: Ranger's Sword, Blade of Aragorn
subtitle: Blade of Aragorn
lore: 'I am not weaponless.'
text: Bearer must be Aragorn. While skirmishing an Uruk-hai, Aragorn is strength +2.

name: Ruins of Osgiliath
lore: The Citadel of the Stars had fallen into ruin.
text: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 7[T], each Ring-bound Man is defender +1. Skirmish: Spot a Ring-bound Man and discard this condition to wound an opponent's Man.

name: Sword of Gondor
lore: Four tall Men stood there.... All had swords at their sides....
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. While skirmishing a Man or a roaming minion, bearer is damage +1.

name: War and Valor
lore: 'So even was my brother, Boromir: a man of prowess, and for that he was accounted the best man in Gondor.'
text: Skirmish: Make a [gondor] Man strength +2 (or +3 and damage +1 if skirmishing a roaming minion).

name: Advance Uruk Patrol
lore: 'This is no rabble of mindless Orcs.'
text: Damage +1. While at a battleground, this minion is fierce. While you control a battleground, this minion is strength +4.

name: Attack on Helm's Deep
lore: 'Ten thousand strong at least....'
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Play an Uruk-hai to place an [isengard] token on this card. Regroup: Remove 3 [isengard] tokens from this card and discard an Uruk-hai to take control of a site.

name: Band of Uruk Bowmen
lore: Taking the high ground provides a better field of fire.
text: Archer. Damage +1. While you control a site, the minion archery total is +1.

name: Banished
lore: 'Oh, but this is not from me – it comes from the King. He signed it this morning.'
text: To play, exert Saruman or an [isengard] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. Each time another ally or companion loses a skirmish, bearer must exert.

name: Dunlending Ransacker
lore: 'Yet there are many that cry in the Dunland tongue.'
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot another [dunland] Man to take control of a site.

name: Beyond All Hope
lore: 'How shall any tower withstand such numbers and such reckless hate?'
text: Maneuver: Exert 2 Uruk-hai to add a burden for each card in the dead pile.

name: Beyond Dark Mountains
lore: Where now was the Ring-bearer? How thin indeed was the thread upon which doom still hung!
text: Response: If a companion or ally is killed, exert an [isengard] minion to add a burden (or 2 burdens if Aragorn, Gandalf, or Théoden is killed).

name: Broad-bladed Sword
lore: They were armed with short broad-bladed swords, not with the curved scimitars usual with Orcs....
text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Bearer may not take wounds (except during skirmish phases).

name: Brought Back Alive
lore: 'What are they wanted for?... Why alive? Do they give good sport?'
text: Search. Assignment: Exert an [isengard] tracker to assign it to an unbound companion. That companion may exert to prevent this (unless that companion is a Hobbit).

name: Burning of Westfold
lore: 'We have found many of our folk lying slain as they fled....'
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: If you control a site, play an Uruk-hai to discard a Free Peoples condition.

name: Cloud of Arrows
lore: Behind them orc-archers crowded, sending a hail of darts against the bowmen on the walls.
text: Archery: Exert an [isengard] archer to make the minion archery total +1 and the fellowship archery total -1.

name: Come Down
lore: 'We are the fighting Uruk-hai.... Bring out your skulking king!'
text: Plays to your support area. Archery: Spot 2 [isengard] archers to make allies take wounds from archery fire instead of companions.

name: Covering Fire
lore: Archers cowered on the walls, unable to reply.
text: To play, spot 2 [isengard] archers. Plays to your support area. The Free Peoples player may not play archery events or use archery special abilities. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.

name: Down to the Last Child
lore: The Uruks brought death to the villages of Rohan.
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai, place an [isengard] token on this card. Shadow: Remove 2 [isengard] tokens from this card to take control of a site.

name: Driven Back
lore: With each fallen defender, the morale of the attacking army rose.
text: Archery: Spot 2 [isengard] archers to make the minion archery total +1 for each card in the dead pile.

name: Dunlending Ravager
lore: 'They will not give way now for dusk or dawn, until Théoden is taken, or they themselves are slain.'
text: While skirmishing a [rohan] Man, this minion is strength +2. Assignment: Spot an ally to make that ally participate in skirmishes and assign this minion to skirmish that ally.

name: Elite Crossbowmen
lore: The best archers were held in reserve, awaiting the final assault.
text: Archer. Damage +1. Archery: Exert Elite Crossbowmen to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion; this minion does not add to the minion archery total.

name: Ferocity
lore: Uruk savagery remained despite their battle training.
text: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2 (or +3 if at a battleground).

name: Get Back
lore: 'We do not answer to Mordor scum!'
text: Assignment: Prevent an [isengard] tracker from being assigned to a skirmish by any player.

name: Gríma, Son of Galmód
subtitle: Son of Galmód
lore: 'Did I not counsel you, lord, to forbid his staff?'
text: Each unbound companion (or ally) bearing a Shadow condition is strength -1.

name: Gríma, Wormtongue
subtitle: Wormtongue
lore: 'I care for you and yours as best I may. But do not weary yourself, or tax too heavily your strength.'
text: Maneuver: Exert Gríma and spot an unbound companion bearing 3 or more cards to return each Free Peoples card that companion bears to its owner's hand.

name: Haunting Her Steps
lore: 'What was the promised price? When all the men were dead, you were to pick your share of the treasure and take the woman you desire?'
text: Response: If a special ability of an ally or unbound companion is used, exert Gríma to cancel that action.

name: Kill Them Now
lore: 'They're a cursed nuisance, and we're in a hurry.'
text: Skirmish: Make an [isengard] tracker strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a character bearing a search card).

name: Leechcraft
lore: 'Your leechcraft ere long would have had me walking on all fours like a beast.'
text: Spell. To play, exert Saruman or an [isengard] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. Special abilities in bearer's game text may not be used.

name: Lieutenant of Orthanc
lore: 'Do you wish to see the greatness of our army? We are the fighting Uruk-hai.'
text: Damage +1. Maneuver: Exert Lieutenant of Orthanc to make another Uruk-hai fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Many Riddles
lore: 'It will be hard news for Frodo....'
text: Search. To play, exert an [isengard] tracker. Plays on a companion (except the Ring- bearer). Assignment: Exert an [isengard] tracker and remove (2) to assign that tracker to bearer. Bearer may exert to prevent this.

name: Dunlending Robber
lore: 'We will fight....'
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may make him strength +2 and fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Mauhúr, Patrol Leader
subtitle: Patrol Leader
lore: 'Mauhúr and his lads are in the forest, and they should turn up any time now.'
text: Tracker. Fierce. Skirmish: Remove (2) to prevent an [isengard] tracker from taking wounds.

name: Men Will Fall
lore: 'The Ring of Barahir. So, Gandalf Greyhame thinks he has found Isildur's heir, the Lost King of Gondor... Fool! That line was broken years ago.'
text: Skirmish: Spot Saruman or an [isengard] Man to make an unbound companion strength -2.

name: New Power Rising
lore: 'For those who aid the Great Eye there will be rich reward.'
text: Regroup: Spot Saruman or an [isengard] Man, reveal your hand, and discard all Free Peoples cards revealed to take an [isengard] card into hand from your discard pile.

name: No Dawn for Men
lore: 'This night, the land will be stained with the blood of Rohan....'
text: Maneuver: Exert an Uruk-hai to exert X unbound companions, where X is the number of sites you control.

name: Orthanc Champion
lore: A warrior trained in single combat, he tore a swath through the defenders.
text: Damage +1. Assignment: Exert Orthanc Champion to assign it to an unbound companion. That companion may exert to prevent this.

name: Orthanc Warrior
lore: The Uruk-hai bred by Saruman are stronger and more fell than Orcs of Mordor.
text: Damage +1.

name: The Palantír of Orthanc, Seventh Seeing-stone
subtitle: Seventh Seeing-stone
lore: 'The name meant that which looks far away.'
text: To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Spot an [isengard] minion and remove (2) to reveal the top card of any draw deck. You may place that card beneath that draw deck.

name: Pillage of Rohan
lore: Rumor of plunder swelled the ranks of the Isengarders.
text: Plays on a site you control. While an Uruk-hai is stacked on this site, the Free Peoples player may not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities.

name: Race Across the Mark
lore: 'But in the meantime, the Uruk-hai of Isengard can do the dirty work as usual.'
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to cancel a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai.

name: Ranged Commander
lore: Hand-picked Uruks led Saruman's crossbowmen.
text: Archer. The twilight cost of each [isengard] archer is -1. Archery: Exert Ranged Commander to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion; this minion does not add to the minion archery total.

name: Dunlending Savage
lore: The Dunlendings' fury could only end in the death of the king of Rohan.

name: Ranks Without Number
lore: 'All Isengard must be emptied....'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns an ally to a skirmish, you may play an [isengard] minion from your discard pile. That minion's twilight cost is -2.

name: Rest While You Can
text: Search. To play, spot an [isengard] tracker. Plays on a companion. Limit 1 per companion. If bearer is killed, reveal the top 10 cards of opponent's draw deck and discard 1 Shadow card and 1 Free Peoples card. Your opponent reshuffles that deck.

name: Rohan Is Mine
lore: 'You have no power here, Gandalf the Grey.'
text: To play, spot Saruman or an [isengard] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns bearer to a skirmish, exert each ally.

name: Saruman, Black Traitor
subtitle: Black Traitor
text: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. When you play Saruman, you may discard a condition. Shadow: Exert Saruman to play Saruman's Staff from your discard pile.

name: Saruman's Staff, Wizard's Device
subtitle: Wizard's Device
lore: His hand clutched his heavy black staff like a claw.
text: Plays on Saruman. He is fierce and damage +1. Maneuver: Make the first sentence of Saruman's game text not apply until the regroup phase.

name: Still They Came
lore: Before the wall's foot the dead and broken were piled like shingle in a storm; ever higher rose the hideous mounds....
text: Skirmish: Exert an Uruk-hai who is not assigned to a skirmish to make another Uruk-hai strength +3.

name: Uglúk, Servant of Saruman
subtitle: Servant of Saruman
text: Tracker. Fierce. The roaming penalty for each [isengard] tracker you play is -2. While you can spot 2 [isengard] trackers, Uglúk is strength +3. While you can spot 3 [isengard] trackers, Uglúk is damage +1.

name: Uglúk's Sword
lore: 'I am Uglúk. I command.'
text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Shadow: If bearer is Uglúk, exert it and discard a minion from hand to play a minion. Its twilight cost is -3.

name: Unferth, Gríma's Bodyguard
subtitle: Gríma's Bodyguard
lore: Gríma promised him riches when Rohan fell to Saruman.
text: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns a companion or ally to an [isengard] Man, that companion or ally must exert.

name: Uruk Assault Band
text: Damage +1. To play, spot an Uruk-hai. While at a battleground, this minion is fierce. While you control a battleground, this minion is strength +6. While you control 2 battlegrounds, this minion may not take wounds.

name: Dunlending Warrior
lore: These were a remnant of the peoples that had dwelt in the vales of the White Mountains in ages past.
text: Assignment: Spot an ally to make that ally participate in skirmishes and assign this minion to skirmish that ally.

name: Uruk Besieger
lore: Fresh troops awaited to attack any weakness.
text: Damage +1. Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. Its twilight cost is -1.

name: Uruk Chaser
lore: 'Now we'll have to leg it double quick.'
text: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +2.

name: Uruk Crossbow Troop
lore: Bolts from the Uruk crossbows shattered the shields of the defenders.
text: Archer. When you play this minion, you may place an [isengard] token on a machine.

name: Uruk Crossbowman
lore: Both the weapon and its wielder were foul creations of Saruman.
text: Archer. Archery: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion; this minion does not add to the minion archery total.

name: Uruk Defender
lore: Saruman's Uruk army trained in formation tactics.
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert this minion at a battleground to make another Uruk-hai strength +2.

name: Uruk Fanatic
lore: Despite intensive training, the smell of blood still enraged the Uruk warriors.
text: Damage +1. If there are at least 3 cards in the dead pile, this minion is fierce.

name: Uruk Follower
lore: But at the moment Uglúk was not engaged in sport. He needed speed and had to humour unwilling followers.
text: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion to add a burden.

name: Uruk Foot Soldier
lore: 'Evening's coming on, and we ought to get a move on.'
text: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and damage +1.

name: Uruk Hunter
lore: 'We came out of Isengard, and led you here, and we shall lead you back the way we choose.'
text: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion twice to exhaust a companion.

name: Uruk Plains Runner
lore: 'Run! Or you'll never see your beloved holes again!'
text: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and damage +1.

name: Hides
lore: Only heavy animal skins armored the Dunlendings.
text: Plays to your support area. When you play this possession, you may draw a card. Response: If a [dunland] Man is about to take a wound, remove (2) or discard this possession to prevent that wound.

name: Uruk Pursuer
lore: 'None of that! Hold your tongues.'
text: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion.

name: Uruk Rear Guard
lore: Promised a fair share of plunder, they defended against possible reinforcements.
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert this minion at a battleground to make another Uruk-hai strength +1.

name: Uruk Regular
lore: 'We are the Uruk-hai; we do not stop the fight for night or day, for fair weather or for storm.'
text: Damage +1. Shadow: Exert this minion to play an Uruk-hai; its twilight cost is -1 for each other Uruk-hai you can spot.

name: Uruk Runner
lore: 'Run, curse you! Run while night lasts!'
text: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +2.

name: Uruk Searcher
lore: 'Why don't we search them and find out?'
text: Tracker. Fierce. While skirmishing a character bearing a search card, this minion is strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Uruk Seeker
lore: 'No crying out, no trying to escape.'
text: Tracker. Fierce. While skirmishing a character bearing a search card, this minion is strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Uruk Spear
lore: The Uruk-hai braced their long pikes to challenge the oncoming Riders.
text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Maneuver: Exert bearer to discard a Free Peoples mount.

name: Uruk Stalker
lore: A moment they hesitated, and then on they came.
text: Damage +1. While an ally is in the dead pile, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.

name: Uruk Stormer
lore: They wavered, broke, and fled back; and then charged again, broke and charged again; and each time, like the incoming sea, they halted at a higher point.
text: Damage +1. Each time a companion or ally is killed during a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai, you may take control of a site.

name: Uruk Trooper
lore: Thousands of Uruk-hai came to take the Hornburg.
text: Damage +1. Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. Its twilight cost is -1.

name: The One Ring, The Ruling Ring
subtitle: The Ruling Ring
lore: One Ring to rule them all....
text: Response: If bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he wears The One Ring until the regroup phase. While wearing The One Ring, each time the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound during a skirmish, add a burden instead.

name: Hill Chief
lore: '...Saruman has armed the wild hillmen and herdfolk of Dunland beyond the rivers, and these also he loosed upon us.'
text: Shadow: Spot a site you control and exert Hill Chief to draw 3 cards.

name: Uruk Vanguard
lore: 'These are Uruk-hai – their armour is thick, their shields broad.'
text: Damage +1. To play, spot an Uruk-hai. While at a battleground, this minion is fierce and damage +1.

name: Uruk Veteran
lore: 'We come to kill, by sun or moon.'
text: Damage +1. Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. Its twilight cost is -1.

name: Uruk-hai Band
lore: There were four... of greater stature, swart, slant-eyed, with thick legs and broad hands.
text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +2 for each site you control.

name: Uruk-hai Horde
lore: The rumour of war grew behind them.
text: Damage +1. The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each site you control.

name: Uruk-hai Marauder
lore: 'We shall have some fun later.'
text: Damage +1. The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each site you control.

name: Uruk-hai Mob
lore: 'Let the fighting Uruk-hai do the work, as usual.'
text: Damage +1. The twilight cost of this minion is -1 for each site you control.

name: Uruk-hai Patrol
lore: 'We are the servants of Saruman the Wise....'
text: Damage +1. While you control a site, this minion is damage +1.

name: Uruk-hai Raiding Party
lore: Bands of Uruks crossed the plains of Rohan.
text: Damage +1.

name: Vengeance
lore: Saruman instilled a spirit for revenge in his fighting brood.
text: Skirmish: Make an [isengard] tracker strength +2 for each card borne by the character it is skirmishing.

name: Volley Fire
lore: Defenders on the walls made perfect targets for the Isengard crossbowmen.
text: Archery: Discard 2 [isengard] archers to exhaust an unbound companion.

name: Hillman Band
lore: As in years past, the Dunlendings marched in force to the west.
text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot another [dunland] Man to take control of a site.

name: We Are the Fighting Uruk-hai
lore: 'But for us you'd all have run away.'
text: Skirmish: Make an Uruk-hai strength +2 (and damage +1 if you control a site).

name: Weapons of Isengard
lore: Crossbowmen arrived with munitions from Isengard.
text: Machine. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Play an [isengard] archer to place an [isengard] token on this card. Archery: Remove 2 [isengard] tokens from this card to make the minion archery total +2. Discard this condition.

name: Weary
lore: 'We shall not turn back here.'
text: Search. Plays on a companion or ally. Limit 1 per character. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns bearer to skirmish an [isengard] tracker, bearer must exert.

name: What Did You Discover?
lore: 'The scouts have come back at last.'
text: Search. Plays to your support area. Each time the fellowship moves during the regroup phase, you may discard 2 cards from hand to take an [isengard] tracker from your discard pile into hand.

name: Where Has Gríma Stowed It?
lore: 'Loth was he to render up the keys. Many other things are there which men have missed.'
text: Maneuver: Spot Gríma to discard a possession borne by an ally or unbound companion.

name: Wounded
lore: 'He's alive!'
text: To play, exert an [isengard] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. When you play this condition, exert bearer. Wounds may not be removed from bearer.

name: Arrow From the South
lore: Haradrim is the Gondorian name for Southrons.
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a [raider] Man, you may place a [raider] token here. Archery: Heal a [raider] archer for each [raider] token here. Discard this condition.

name: Desert Lancers
lore: 'Mordor has allied itself with... the cruel Haradrim....'
text: Southron. To play, spot a [raider] Man. Regroup: Exert Desert Lancers twice to take control of a site.

name: Desert Legion
text: Southron. Ambush (1). While you can spot 4 burdens, this minion is strength +5. While you can spot 5 burdens, this minion is fierce. While you can spot 6 burdens, this minion is damage +1.

name: Desert Lord
lore: Southron legends tell of powerful warrior leaders and the kingdoms they have conquered.
text: Southron. Archer. Archery: Exert Desert Lord to exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer); Desert Lord does not add to the minion archery total.

name: Hillman Horde
lore: 'They are fierce folk when roused.'
text: While you control 2 sites, skip the archery phase. While you control 3 sites, each of your [dunland] Men is fierce. While you control 4 sites, each of your [dunland] Men is damage +1.

name: Desert Soldier
lore: 'Not nice; very cruel wicked Men they look.'
text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (3) to wound a companion or ally he is skirmishing.

name: Desert Spearman
lore: Long spears are used by Southrons to attack while riding desert beasts.
text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (3) to wound a companion or ally he is skirmishing.

name: Desert Warrior
lore: The Haradrim wear cloaks and head wraps to survive the deserts of their homeland.
text: Southron. At the start of each skirmish involving this minion, you may remove (3) to wound a companion or ally he is skirmishing.

name: Discovered
lore: The voices and the clink of weapons and harness were very close.
text: Maneuver: Exert a [raider] Man to discard a Free Peoples condition (or 2 Free Peoples conditions if you spot 3 burdens).

name: Easterling Axeman
lore: Poleaxes wielded by tall Easterling warriors cut through armor and bone.
text: Easterling. While you can spot 2 burdens, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.

name: Easterling Captain
text: Easterling. Fierce. Skirmish: Spot 2 burdens and remove (2) to make an Easterling strength +2. Skirmish: Spot 4 burdens and remove (2) to make an Easterling strength +3. Skirmish: Spot 6 burdens and remove (2) to make an Easterling strength +4.

name: Easterling Guard
lore: Armored Easterlings protect their commanders from enemy assaults.
text: Easterling. Each time this minion is assigned to an unbound companion, you may exert him to add a burden.

name: Easterling Infantry
lore: Sometimes called the Men of Rhûn, the Easterlings hated Gondor for her riches.
text: Easterling. While you can spot 3 burdens, this minion is fierce and damage +1.

name: Easterling Lieutenant
lore: 'Easterlings... have passed through the Black Gate....'
text: Easterling. Each time this minion is assigned to an unbound companion, you may exert him to add a burden.

name: Easterling Skirmisher
lore: Enemy formations are threatened by the spears of Easterling light troops.
text: Easterling. When you play this minion, you may spot another Easterling to add (1) for each burden (limit (4)).

name: Hillman Mob
lore: 'That old hatred Saruman has inflamed.'
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [dunland] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Easterling Trooper
lore: Trained Easterling fighters formed ranks of axes and spears to charge the knights of Gondor.
text: Easterling. While you can spot 3 burdens, this minion is fierce and damage +1.

name: Eastern Emyn Muil
lore: The Emyn Muil was a strange, twisted knot of hills.
text: Plays to your support area. Each Ring-bound companion moving from site 2[T] must exert twice. Maneuver: Discard this condition and exert a [raider] Man to exert a Ring-bound companion.

name: Elite Archer
lore: Veteran bowmen are highly valued in the kingdoms of the South.
text: Southron. Archer. Archery: Exert this minion to exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer); this minion does not add to the minion archery total.

name: Fearless
lore: Despite their foreign ways, the Men from the South and East were formidable fighters.
text: Skirmish: Make a Southron strength +1 for each burden you spot (limit +5), or make a [raider] Man strength +2.

name: Flanking Attack
lore: 'Our scouts report more Haradrim making their way up here....'
text: Maneuver or Skirmish: Exert a Southron to add (3).

name: Gathering to the Summons
lore: These were Men of other race, out of the wide Eastlands....
text: Skirmish: Spot a [raider] Man skirmishing a Ring-bound companion to add a burden.

name: Howl of Harad
