lore: Blood-curdling cries rout the Southrons' enemies from the battlefield.
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a Southron, you may remove (4) to make the Free Peoples player wound a Ring-bound companion.

name: Ithilien Wilderness
text: Plays to your support area. At the end of each phase during which the fellowship has moved to 7[T], 8[T], or 9[T] and the twilight pool has fewer than 7 twilight tokens, you may add (8). Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [raider] Man strength +2.

name: Men of Harad
lore: The savage Haradrim, men from the kingdoms south of Gondor and Mordor, were called Southrons.
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Spot a site you control, spot 3 Southrons and remove (2) to draw a card.

name: Men of Rhûn
lore: Sudden war came upon Gondor out of Rhûn, land of the East.
text: Skirmish: Make a [raider] Man strength +3 (or +4 if you spot 4 burdens).

name: Hillman Rabble
lore: The relentless fury of the Dunlendings consumed one village after another.
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may stack it on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. Its twilight cost is -2.

name: New Fear
lore: They heard singing and coarse shouting. At first it seemed a long way off, but it drew nearer....
text: Regroup: Exert a [raider] Man to add a burden for each companion over 4. The Free Peoples player may discard 2 companions (except the Ring-bearer) to prevent this.

name: On the March
lore: Easterlings traveled up the ancient roads of Gondor to swell the hosts of the Dark Tower.
text: Skirmish: Make a [raider] Man strength +3 (or +5 if you spot 6 companions).

name: Raiders From the East
lore: The Easterlings raid their enemies to gather supplies and equipment.
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) and exert a [raider] Man to place a [raider] token here. Maneuver: Remove a [raider] token here to add (1).

name: Rapid Fire
lore: Wars between the southern kingdoms taught speed and precision to the archers of the Haradrim.
text: Archery: Exert a [raider] archer to make the minion archery total +1 for each burden (limit +5).

name: Regiment of Haradrim
lore: 'One of their regiments is due by our reckoning to pass by, some time ere noon....'
text: Southron. To play, spot a [raider] Man. Regroup: Exert Regiment of Haradrim twice to take control of a site.

name: Southron Archer
lore: 'They have passed on to the Black Gate; but more may follow.'
text: Southron. Archer. While you can spot another Southron, the minion archery total is +1 for each site you control.

name: Southron Assassin
lore: 'Some of the Southrons have broken from the trap and are flying from the road.'
text: Southron. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a Southron, you may remove (1) to make the Free Peoples player wound a Ring-bound companion.

name: Southron Bow
lore: Volleys from Southron bows are deadly in large numbers.
text: Bearer must be a [raider] Man. Bearer is an archer. While you can spot another [raider] Man, the minion archery total is +1.

name: Southron Bowman
lore: The Southron armies deploy archers to harass enemy troop formations.
text: Southron. Archer. Archery: Exert this minion to exert a companion (except the Ring-bearer); this minion does not add to the minion archery total.

name: Southron Commander
lore: 'Almost as bad as Orcs, and much bigger.'
text: Southron. Ambush (1). Assignment: Spot 6 companions to assign this minion to the Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may discard an unbound companion to prevent this.

name: Hillman Tribe
lore: 'They will not quail at the sun... the wild men of the hills.'
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot another [dunland] minion to take control of a site.

name: Southron Explorer
lore: Scouts find oases for Southron armies as they cross the deserts of Harad.
text: Southron. Regroup: Exert this minion and remove (5) to take control of a site.

name: Southron Fighter
lore: '...they have come out of the South beyond the Great River's end....'
text: Southron. Ambush (1). Maneuver: Exert this minion and spot 5 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.

name: Southron Scout
lore: 'They have black eyes, and long black hair, and gold rings in their ears....'
text: Southron. Ambush (2).

name: Southron Sentry
lore: Pickets guarded the borders of the Southron encampment.
text: Southron. Maneuver: Exert this minion to add (2) for each site you control.

name: Southron Soldier
lore: The kingdoms of Harad fight countless wars and train thousands of warriors.
text: Southron. Ambush (2).

name: Southron Spear
lore: Long pikes defend the Southrons against the armored knights of Gondor.
text: Bearer must be a Southron. Skirmish: Remove (4) and exert bearer to wound a companion or ally bearer is skirmishing.

name: Southron Troop
text: Southron. Archer. Ambush (1). To play, spot a Southron. Assignment: Spot 7 companions to assign this minion to the Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may make you discard a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to prevent this.

name: Southron Veterans
lore: He caught a glimpse of swarthy men... running down the slope some way off....
text: Southron. Ambush (1). Maneuver: Exert this minion and spot 6 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert 2 companions.

name: Southron Wanderer
lore: Some desert warriors have no allegiance and work for any faction that will pay them.
text: Southron. Ambush (1). Assignment: Exert this minion and spot 5 companions to assign this minion to the Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may add (4) to prevent this.

name: Vision From Afar
lore: Then he knew that the hope that had for one wild moment stirred in his heart was vain.
text: Assignment: Assign an Easterling to the Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to prevent this.

name: Iron Axe
lore: Saruman armed the Dunlendings with weapons forged by his Orcs in Isengard.
text: Bearer must be a [dunland] Man.

name: Whirling Strike
lore: The Southrons fight with tactics the men of Gondor have never before seen.
text: Skirmish: Wound a companion or ally skirmishing a [raider] Man.

name: Wrath of Harad
lore: Massed Southron troops prepared to attack Gondor.
text: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [raider] Man, each Free Peoples event that spots or exerts a ranger gains this cost: "wound a companion." Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [raider] Man strength +2.

name: Aldor, Soldier of Edoras
subtitle: Soldier of Edoras
lore: Fighting to defend his people, Aldor found courage to replace his youth.
text: Archery: Exert Aldor and spot a villager to make the fellowship archery total +1.

name: Brego
lore: Brego was named for the second King of Rohan.
text: To play, spot a [rohan] Man. Bearer must be a Man, Elf, or Wizard. When you play Brego, you may heal bearer. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.

name: Ceorl, Weary Horseman
subtitle: Weary Horseman
lore: 'We were driven back yesterday over the Isen with great loss; many perished at the crossing.'
text: Response: If your opponent is about to take control of a site, exert Ceorl and a villager to prevent this.

name: Elite Rider
lore: After him they rode: a long line of mail-clad men, swift, shining, fell and fair to look upon.
text: When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. While skirmishing a wounded minion, this companion is strength +2.

name: Éomer, Sister-son of Théoden
subtitle: Sister-son of Théoden
lore: 'Now indeed there is hope of victory!'
text: While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1. At the start of each turn, you may heal a [rohan] ally.

name: Éomer, Third Marshal of Riddermark
subtitle: Third Marshal of Riddermark
lore: Then one rode forward, a tall man, taller than the rest; from his helm as a crest a white horsetail flowed.
text: While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1. Éomer is strength +2 for each wound on each minion he is skirmishing.

name: Éomer's Spear
lore: He advanced until the point of his spear was within a foot of Aragorn's breast.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. If bearer is Éomer and he is mounted, Éomer is damage +2.

name: Éothain, Scout of the Mark
subtitle: Scout of the Mark
lore: 'Time is pressing.... We must hasten south, lord.'
text: Each time the fellowship moves to a plains site, each minion must exert.

name: Living Off Rock
lore: 'The Horsemen took your land; they drove your people into the hills to scratch living off rock.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a [dunland] Man wins a skirmish involving a [rohan] Man, you may make that minion strength +2 and fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Éowyn, Lady of Rohan
subtitle: Lady of Rohan
lore: Thus Aragorn... beheld Éowyn... and thought her fair, fair and cold, like a morning of pale spring that is not yet come to womanhood.
text: Valiant. Response: If an unbound companion is about to take a wound, exert Éowyn and add (1) to prevent that wound.

name: Éowyn, Sister-daughter of Théoden
subtitle: Sister-daughter of Théoden
lore: Slender and tall she was... but strong she seemed and stern as steel, a daughter of kings.
text: Valiant. Response: If Éowyn is exhausted and about to take a wound in a skirmish, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that wound.

name: Éowyn's Sword
lore: ...the sword was set upright before her, and her hands were laid upon the hilt.
text: Bearer must be Éowyn. While you can spot a villager, Éowyn is damage +1.

name: Fight for the Villagers
lore: 'Bar the gates, set a watch on the surrounds, and get the women and children to the caves.'
text: Skirmish: Make a [rohan] Man strength +2 (or +3 if you spot a villager).

name: Firefoot
lore: Riders of his éored claimed that Éomer's horse had no equal, save Shadowfax.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. If bearer is Éomer, he is defender +1. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.

name: Forth Eorlingas!
lore: 'Behind them from the Deep came the stern cries of men issuing from the caves, driving forth the enemy.'
text: Maneuver: Exert Théoden to make a companion who has the Théoden signet defender +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Fortress Never Fallen
lore: '...it was the spirit of your people that held it strong.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a [rohan] Man wins a skirmish, you may place a [rohan] token on this card. Regroup: Discard a Shadow condition for each [rohan] token here. Discard this condition.

name: Guma, Plains Farmer
subtitle: Plains Farmer
lore: Foodstores swelled as refugees like Guma brought provisions to the Hornburg.
text: Villager. Discard Guma if an opponent controls his home site. Fellowship: Exert Guma to heal a [rohan] Man.

name: Heavy Chain
lore: What Man of an earlier age wore this chain? Was his end worth a song?
text: Bearer must be a Man. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

name: Helm! Helm!
lore: And with that shout the king came. His horse was white as snow, golden was his shield, and his spear was long.
text: Regroup: Spot 2 mounted [rohan] Men to liberate a site or draw 3 cards.

name: No Defense
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: Remove (3) to place a [dunland] token here. Skirmish: Spot a [dunland] Man and remove a [dunland] token from this card. A character skirmishing that [dunland] Man does not gain strength bonuses from possessions.

name: Herugrim
lore: 'Here, lord, is Herugrim, your ancient blade....'
text: Bearer must be Théoden. He is damage +1.

name: Hlafwine, Village Farmhand
subtitle: Village Farmhand
lore: Too old to fight, Hlafwine prepared meals for the defenders.
text: Villager. Discard Hlafwine if an opponent controls his home site. Skirmish: Exert Hlafwine to make a [rohan] Man strength +2.

name: An Honorable Charge
lore: 'A time may come when there will be a need for valour without renown....'
text: Skirmish: Make an unbound companion strength +1 for each [rohan] Man you spot (limit +3).

name: Horse of Rohan
lore: Very swift were the horses of Rohan.
text: To play, spot a [rohan] Man. Bearer must be a Man, Elf, or Wizard. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.

name: King's Mail
lore: Now men came bearing raiment of war from the king's hoard....
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. Bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. If bearer is Théoden, he may not take wounds except during a skirmish involving him.

name: Léod, Westfold Herdsman
subtitle: Westfold Herdsman
lore: Humble Léod was a rancher before he became a soldier at Helm's Deep.
text: Villager. Discard Léod if an opponent controls his home site. Skirmish: Exert Léod to make a mounted companion strength +2.

name: Rider of Rohan
lore: 'They are proud and wilful, but they are true-hearted, generous in thought and deed....'
text: Skirmish: If this companion is mounted, exert him to exert a minion skirmishing an unbound companion.

name: Rider's Mount
lore: Their horses were of great stature, strong and clean-limbed; their grey coats glistened, their long tails flowed in the wind....
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.

name: Rider's Spear
lore: Shafts of the sun flared above the eastern hills and glimmered on their spears.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. If bearer is mounted, bearer is damage +1.

name: Simbelmynë
lore: 'How fair are the bright eyes in the grass! Evermind they are called... for they blossom in all seasons of the year, and grow where dead men rest.'
text: Fellowship: Spot 2 [rohan] Men (or 1 valiant [rohan] Man) to play a [rohan] character or [rohan] possession from your draw deck.

name: No Refuge
lore: As their homes were ravaged by the wild men, refugees fled to the safety of Helm's Deep.
text: Plays to your support area. While a [dunland] Man is stacked on a site, the Shadow number of each site is +5.

name: Supplies of the Mark
lore: 'This is all we could save, my Lady.'
text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Add (2) and place a villager from hand beneath your draw deck to heal a [rohan] ally.

name: Sword of Rohan
lore: 'This is a good sword, Haleth, son of Háma... there is always hope.'
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. While bearer is skirmishing an Uruk-hai, bearer is damage +1.

name: Théoden, Son of Thengel
subtitle: Son of Thengel
lore: 'I myself will go to war, to fall in the front of the battle, if it must be.'
text: Regroup: Spot a [rohan] ally and exert Théoden to liberate a site.

name: Valleys of the Mark
lore: 'Where is the hand on the harpstring, and the red fire glowing? / Where is the spring and the harvest and the tall corn growing?'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time your opponent plays a roaming minion, you may spot a villager to exert that minion.

name: Weapon Store
lore: 'And to you my other guests I will offer such things as may be found in my armoury.'
text: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Exert a [rohan] Man to play a hand weapon from your discard pile.

name: Weland, Smith of the Riddermark
subtitle: Smith of the Riddermark
lore: A tender of horses, Weland found much work at Helm's Deep.
text: Villager. Discard Weland if an opponent controls his home site. Fellowship: Exert Weland to heal a mounted companion.

name: Well Stored
lore: Behind us in the caves of the Deep are... old and young, children and women. But great store of food, and many beasts and their fodder, have also been gathered 'there.'
text: Plays to your support area. At the start of each fellowship phase, you may heal a villager.

name: Work for the Sword
lore: 'The Orcs are destroyed. We slaughtered them during the night.'
text: Skirmish: Make a [rohan] Man strength +2 (and damage +2 if mounted).

name: Brace of Coneys
lore: 'He let them stew for close on an hour, testing them now and again with his fork, and tasting the broth.'
text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard this possession to remove a burden.

name: Cliffs of Emyn Muil
lore: 'We've escaped from the Emyn Muil!'
text: Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves from site 1[T], remove up to 2 burdens. Skirmish: Discard this condition to wound a minion a Hobbit companion is skirmishing.

name: Anger
lore: Rage filled the hearts of the Dunlending attackers.
text: Skirmish: Spot 3 [dunland] minions or a site you control to make a [dunland] Man fierce until the regroup phase.

name: No Retreat
lore: Hordes from Dunland laid waste to villages as their numbers grew.
text: Plays on a site you control. Regroup: Spot 2 [dunland] Men and discard this condition to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn (if the move limit allows).

name: Escape
lore: Suddenly Merry and Pippin realized that without moving they were now outside the circle....
text: Stealth. Bearer must be an unbound Hobbit. Limit 1 per character. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to cancel a skirmish involving him. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.

name: Frodo, Courteous Halfling
subtitle: Courteous Halfling
lore: 'But as for us, we are Hobbits of the Shire, far to the North and West, beyond many rivers.'
text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). While you can spot 3 unbound companions, Shadow cards may not discard cards from your hand or from the top of your draw deck.

name: Frodo, Tired Traveller
subtitle: Tired Traveller
lore: 'We have come by long ways – out of Rivendell, or Imladris as some call it.'
text: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Ring-bound. Fellowship: Play a Ring-bound companion to remove a burden.

name: Frodo's Cloak
lore: Neither weather nor searching eyes found Frodo.
text: Bearer must be Frodo. Skirmish: At sites 1[T] to 4[T], add a burden and discard this possession to cancel a skirmish involving Frodo. At any other site, discard this possession to remove a burden and heal Frodo.

name: Get On and Get Away
lore: 'The Dead can't be really there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'
text: Fellowship: Add 2 burdens to play the fellowship's next 2 sites (replacing opponent's sites if necessary).

name: Good Work
lore: 'You seem to have been doing well, Master Took.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, you may place a [shire] token here. Fellowship: Remove a burden for each [shire] token here (limit 3). Discard this condition.

name: Hobbit Sword
lore: Although the Ranger had never before seen a Hobbit, he recognized the swords they carried.
text: Bearer must be a Hobbit.

name: Impatient and Angry
lore: He planted himself... as if he was addressing a young hobbit who had offered him what he called 'sauce' when questioned about visits to the orchard.
text: Skirmish: Exert Sam to make him strength +3. If Sam wins this skirmish, you may remove a burden.

name: Knocked on the Head
lore: 'I wonder if poor Merry is much hurt.'
text: Regroup: Play an unbound Hobbit from your discard pile.

name: Light Shining Faintly
lore: 'He's like that, and sometimes it shines through, somehow.'
text: Fellowship: Add a burden to heal a Ring-bound companion twice.

name: Over the Isen
lore: Like their ancestors years before, the Dunlendings came down from Isengard.
text: Plays to your support area. Assignment: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to assign a [dunland] Man to an unbound companion.

name: Merry, Learned Guide
subtitle: Learned Guide
lore: 'I don't suppose you have much notion where we are; but I spent my time at Rivendell rather better.'
text: Skirmish: Exert the Ring-bearer to discard Merry. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.

name: Merry, Unquenchable Hobbit
subtitle: Unquenchable Hobbit
lore: 'All Wizards should have a hobbit or two in their care – to teach them the meaning of the word, and to correct them.'
text: Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, discard him to remove a [sauron] Orc from a skirmish involving an unbound companion.

name: Mind Your Own Affairs
lore: 'Yet those who claim to oppose the Enemy would do well not to hinder it.'
text: Skirmish: Spot Frodo and add a burden to wound a minion skirmishing a companion who has the Frodo signet.

name: Pippin, Just a Nuisance
subtitle: Just a Nuisance
lore: 'What good have I been?... a passenger, a piece of luggage.'
text: Skirmish: If Pippin is not assigned to a skirmish, discard him to remove an Uruk-hai from a skirmish involving an unbound companion.

name: Pippin, Woolly-footed Rascal
subtitle: Woolly-footed Rascal
lore: 'We had foul fare with the Orcs, and little enough for days before that. It seems a long while since we could eat to heart's content.'
text: Skirmish: Add a burden to discard Pippin. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.

name: Sam, Frodo's Gardener
subtitle: Frodo's Gardener
lore: 'I am only a hobbit, and gardening's my job at home, sir, if you understand me....'
text: Ring-bound. Fellowship: Play Sam's Pack from your draw deck. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: Sam, Samwise the Brave
subtitle: Samwise the Brave
lore: 'Frodo wouldn't have got far without Sam....'
text: Ring-bound. Response: If a Shadow card is about to add any number of burdens, spot Frodo and exert Sam to prevent this. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).

name: Sam's Pack
lore: He still hopefully carried some of his gear in his pack....
text: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. At the start of each turn, you may add (2) to heal a Ring-bound companion.

name: Seven We Had
lore: '...one we lost at Moria, the others we left at Parth Galen above Rauros....'
text: Fellowship: Add a burden to discard a condition borne by a Hobbit.

name: Severed His Bonds
lore: 'The cord was cut!'
text: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1[T] to 4[T], cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, prevent a Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.

name: Ravage the Defeated
lore: What the Dunlendings cannot steal, they destroy.
text: Response: If your [dunland] Man wins a skirmish, discard all Free Peoples cards borne by the companion or ally he was skirmishing.

name: Store-room
lore: 'Saruman kept enough wisdom not to trust his Orcs. He had Men to guard his gates.... Anyway, they were favoured and got good provisions.'
text: Regroup: Heal an unbound Hobbit once (or twice if you spot Gandalf).

name: Swiftly and Softly
lore: In the deep of night under hard clear stars they set off.
text: Stealth. Skirmish: At sites 1[T] to 5[T], cancel a skirmish involving a Hobbit. At any other site, prevent a Hobbit from taking more than 1 wound.

name: Warmed Up a Bit
lore: '...we shall be able to stand again, and walk.'
text: Stealth. Skirmish: Discard an unbound Hobbit.

name: East Wall of Rohan
text: When the fellowship moves from East Wall of Rohan, add (2).

name: Eastemnet Downs
text: Each time you play a companion here, you must discard 2 cards from hand.

name: Eastemnet Gullies
text: Fellowship: Exert 2 unbound companions to play Legolas from your draw deck.

name: Horse-country
text: Plains. While you can spot a [rohan] mount at Horse-country, the move limit is +1 for this turn.

name: Plains of Rohan
text: Plains. Fellowship: Exert 2 unbound companions to play Gimli from your draw deck.

name: The Riddermark
text: Plains. Fellowship: Exert 2 unbound companions to play Aragorn from your draw deck.

name: Western Emyn Muil
text: When the Fellowship moves from Western Emyn Muil, each Ring-bound companion must exert.

name: Saruman, Rabble-rouser
subtitle: Rabble-rouser
text: Saruman may not be assigned to a skirmish. Each time the fellowship moves, the Free Peoples player must exert a companion for each [dunland] Man you can spot. Skirmish: Exert Saruman to make a [dunland] Man strength +2.

name: Derndingle
text: Forest. While you can spot an unbound Hobbit at Derndingle, the move limit is +1 for this turn.

name: Eastfold
text: Plains. Shadow: Spot 3 [isengard] trackers to prevent the fellowship from moving again this turn.

name: Fangorn Forest
text: Forest. Fellowship: Play Treebeard from your draw deck.

name: Plains of Rohan Camp
text: Plains. At the start of each fellowship phase, heal up to 3 wounds from companions.

name: Rohirrim Village
text: Each [dunland] Man may not take wounds during the archery phase.

name: Uruk Camp
text: Battleground. Plains. Each time an Uruk-hai is played, that minion must exert.

name: Wold of Rohan
text: Plains. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns a companion or ally to a skirmish, add (1).

name: Barrows of Edoras
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Place your hand beneath your draw deck and draw 4 cards.

name: Golden Hall
text: Sanctuary. When the fellowship moves to Golden Hall, all Free Peoples weapons must be discarded.

name: Stables
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Exert a [rohan] Man to play a [rohan] mount from your draw deck (limit once per turn).

name: Secret Folk
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a [dunland] Man, you may place a [dunland] token on this card. Maneuver: Discard a Free Peoples possession for each [dunland] token here (limit 3). Discard this condition.

name: Streets of Edoras
text: Sanctuary. Each [rohan] ally may not participate in archery fire or skirmishes at Streets of Edoras.

name: Throne Room
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play Théoden from your draw deck.

name: Westemnet Plains
text: Plains. Sanctuary. Each [dunland] Man may not take wounds during the archery phase.

name: Ered Nimrais
text: Mountain. The twilight cost of each companion and ally played at Ered Nimrais is +3.

name: Westemnet Hills
text: Plains. When the fellowship moves to Westemnet Hills, heal each mounted companion and mounted ally.

name: White Mountains
text: Mountain. When the fellowship moves to White Mountains, Théoden or 2 other companions must exert.

name: White Rocks
text: Battleground. The Shadow number of this site is +1 for each mounted companion.

name: Deep of Helm
text: Battleground. Plains. The twilight cost of the first Uruk-hai played at Deep of Helm each turn is -3.

name: Deeping Wall
text: Battleground. Shadow: Play Saruman from your draw deck.

name: Helm's Gate
text: Battleground. Each companion and minion bearing a hand weapon is strength +2.

name: Wake of Destruction
lore: The anger of the wild men increased with every home they pillaged.
text: Maneuver: Spot 2 sites you control to make each of your [dunland] Men fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Hornburg Courtyard
text: Battleground. While you can spot Aragorn, the Shadow number of Hornburg Courtyard is -2.

name: Hornburg Parapet
text: Battleground. The fellowship archery total is +1. The minion archery total is -1.

name: Caves of Aglarond
text: Underground. Sanctuary. Maneuver: Remove (2) and spot your Uruk-hai to make it fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Great Hall
text: Battleground. Sanctuary. Each [rohan] ally may participate in archery fire and skirmishes at Great Hall.

name: Hornburg Armory
text: Sanctuary. Fellowship: Play a possession to draw a card.

name: Cavern Entrance
text: Underground. Skirmish events may not be played and skirmish special abilities may not be used.

name: Hornburg Causeway
text: Battleground. The minion archery total is +2 for each unbound companion over 3.

name: King's Room
text: When the fellowship moves to King's Room without a [rohan] companion, each unbound companion must exert.

name: Ring of Isengard
text: Shadow: Play a [dunland] minion to draw a card.

name: Wizard's Vale
text: At the start of the first Shadow phase, if the twilight pool has fewer than 9 twilight tokens, add (4) (limit once per turn).

name: War Club
lore: The wooden weapons of the wild men slew scores of unarmed villagers.
text: Bearer must be a [dunland] Man. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard 2 Free Peoples possessions.

name: Fortress of Orthanc
text: Battleground. The Shadow number of Fortress of Orthanc is +2 for each companion over 4.

name: Orthanc Balcony
text: Battleground. Shadow: Play Saruman from your discard pile; his twilight cost is -2.

name: Orthanc Library
text: When the fellowship moves to Orthanc Library, each Shadow player may draw a card for each companion over 4.

name: Palantír Chamber
text: Shadow: Remove 2 burdens to play a minion from your discard pile.

name: Aragorn, Wingfoot
subtitle: Wingfoot
lore: 'Forty leagues and five you have measured ere the fourth day is ended! Hardy is the race of Elendil!'
text: Ranger. Each time the fellowship moves, you may wound a minion for each unbound Hobbit you spot.

name: Théoden, Lord of the Mark
subtitle: Lord of the Mark
lore: 'Every man and strong lad able to bear arms, all who have horses, let them be ready in the saddle at the gate ere the second hour from noon!'
text: Fellowship: Play a [rohan] possession on a [rohan] companion to heal that companion (limit once per turn).

name: War Cry of Dunland
lore: 'Death to the Forgoil!'
text: Response: If a [dunland] Man wins a skirmish, make him fierce and strength +4 until the regroup phase.

name: Wild Man of Dunland
lore: 'By our blood... we swear to fight for you....'
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [dunland] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Wild Man Raid
lore: Not even the smallest of trinkets was safe from the destruction of the Dunlendings.
text: Maneuver: Spot 3 [dunland] Men to discard a Free Peoples possession or condition.

name: Band of Wild Men
lore: 'The Wild Men of Dunland have no love for Théoden of Rohan since he took their land.'
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may make it fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Wulf, Dunlending Chieftain
subtitle: Dunlending Chieftain
lore: 'Do you not hear their voices?'
text: Fierce. Response: If another [dunland] Man wins a skirmish, exert Wulf to take control of a site.

name: Axe of Erebor
lore: '...wherever thou goest my thought goes with thee. But have a care to lay thine axe to the right tree!'
text: Bearer must be Gimli. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Discard a [dwarven] condition or a card stacked on a [dwarven] condition to make Gimli strength +1.

name: Best Company
lore: An axe swung and swept back. Two Orcs fell headless. The rest fled.
text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 if at a battleground).

name: Come Here Lad
lore: 'You are the canniest, luckiest, most reckless fool I've ever met! Bless you.'
text: Fellowship: Stack the top 2 cards from your draw deck on a [dwarven] condition that has a card already stacked on it.

name: Courtesy of My Hall
lore: 'Now my guests, come!... Come and take such refreshment as haste allows.'
text: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, stack a card from your discard pile here. Fellowship: Discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to heal a Dwarf.

name: Dwarven Foresight
lore: 'I would guess that the burned bones of the hobbits are now mingled with the Orcs'.'
text: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to take a Free Peoples card stacked on a [dwarven] condition into hand.

name: Ever My Heart Rises
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, reveal the top 6 cards of your draw deck and stack them here. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf and discard the top card of your draw deck to take a Free Peoples card stacked here into hand.

name: From the Armory
lore: 'It's a bit tight around the chest.'
text: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf and stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to prevent all wounds to that Dwarf.

name: Gimli, Lockbearer
subtitle: Lockbearer
lore: 'You speak evil of that which is fair beyond the reach of your thought, and only little wit can excuse you.'
text: Damage +1. Gimli is strength +1 for each unbound Hobbit companion you can spot.

name: Gimli, Unbidden Guest
subtitle: Unbidden Guest
lore: But a small dark figure that none had observed sprang out of the shadows and gave a hoarse shout: Baruk Khazâd!
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Gimli to make an unbound companion strength +1 (or +2 if that companion is Legolas).

name: Burn Every Village
lore: 'Take your rabble through the Westemnet; take back the lands they stole from you.'
text: Skirmish: Make a [dunland] Man strength +2 (or +4 if you control a site).

name: Here Is Good Rock
lore: 'Give me a year and a hundred of my kin and I would make this a place that armies would break upon like water.'
text: Tale. Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to make a Dwarf damage +1.

name: Khazâd Ai-mênu
lore: 'The Orcs are behind the wall. Ai-oi! Come, Legolas! There are enough for both of us.'
text: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or strength +3 and damage +1 if you spot Legolas).

name: My Axe Is Notched
text: Plays to your support area. Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, place a [dwarven] token on this card. While you can spot X [dwarven] tokens on this card and the same number of [elven] tokens on Final Count, Gimli is strength +X (limit +3).

name: Quick As May Be
lore: 'I think, nonetheless, that we no longer need any trail to tell us which way to go.'
text: Maneuver: Spot a Dwarf companion and an Elf companion to wound a minion.

name: Rest by Blind Night
lore: 'And yet even I, Dwarf of many journeys... cannot run all the way to Isengard without any pause....'
text: Regroup: Shuffle any number of [dwarven] conditions (and all cards stacked on them) into your draw deck.

name: Restless Axe
lore: 'Give me a row of orc-necks and room to swing and all weariness will fall from me!'
text: Regroup: Exert a Dwarf to shuffle a [dwarven] condition (and all cards stacked on it) into your draw deck. Exert a minion for each card shuffled into your draw deck.

name: Search Far and Wide
lore: 'We have been set many riddles since we came to Tol Brandir, but this is the hardest to unravel.'
text: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf and discard the top card of your draw deck to draw 2 cards.

name: Stout and Strong
lore: 'Never did I see an axe so wielded.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may place a [dwarven] token on this card. Skirmish: Make an unbound companion strength +1 for each [dwarven] token here (limit +3). Discard this condition.

name: Alliance Reforged
lore: 'If we do not trust the strength of Men, then we trust to the victory of Sauron.'
text: Tale. Fellowship: Draw a card for each Elf companion you spot.

name: Arrow and Blade
lore: The Elven bow and the sword of Man fought together as one weapon.
text: Skirmish: Exert X Elf companions to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -X.

name: Constantly Threatening
lore: The men of Dunland have hated the Rohirrim for many years.
text: Plays to your support area. Shadow: If the fellowship has moved more than once this turn, remove (2) to play a [dunland] Man from your discard pile.

name: Blades Drawn
lore: The sword skills of the Elven archers were unexpected.
text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Plays to your support area. For each wound on each minion, that minion is strength -2. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.

name: Company of Archers
lore: The Naith Company, a veteran band from the South of Lórien, concentrated fire on the Uruk machines.
text: Archery: Spot 2 Elf companions to discard a condition.

name: Elven Bow
lore: No finer bows could defend Helm's Deep than those of the Golden Wood.
text: Bearer must be an Elf. Bearer is an archer.

name: Elven Brooch
lore: 'Not idly do the leaves of Lórien fall.'
text: To play, spot an Elf. Bearer must be a companion. Response: If another possession borne by bearer is about to be discarded by a Shadow card, discard this possession instead.

name: Elven Sword
lore: Fine blades forged by Elven smiths are centuries-old heirlooms.
text: Bearer must be an Elf. Skirmish: Exert bearer or discard 2 cards from hand to make a minion skirmishing bearer strength -1.

name: Erethón, Naith Lieutenant
subtitle: Naith Lieutenant
lore: At close range, Erethón's accuracy is uncanny.
text: To play, spot an Elf. While Erethón bears a ranged weapon, he is strength +1 and damage +1, and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Feathered
lore: Elven swords found the same targets as their arrows.
text: Skirmish: Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -2 for each wound on that minion.

name: Fereveldir, Son of Thandronen
subtitle: Son of Thandronen
lore: Thandronen's sons patrol the borders of Lórien together.
text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Fereveldir and remove an [elven] token from your condition to wound a minion Fereveldir is skirmishing.

name: Ferevellon, Son of Thandronen
subtitle: Son of Thandronen
lore: The Uruks at Helm's Deep fell to his blade as easily as Goblins from the mountains.
text: To play, spot an Elf. Skirmish: Exert Ferevellon to make a minion skirmishing him strength -2.

name: Final Count
text: Plays to your support area. Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may place an [elven] token on this card. While you can spot X [elven] tokens on this card and the same number of [dwarven] tokens on My Axe Is Notched, Legolas is strength +X (limit +3).

name: Dark Fury
lore: Dunland and Dunlendings are the names that the Rohirrim gave to them, because they were swarthy and dark-haired....
text: Skirmish: Make a [dunland] Man strength +2 (or +4 if at a sanctuary).

name: Flashing Steel
lore: 'Good!... But my count is now two dozen. It has been knife-work up here.'
text: Skirmish: Exert an Elf to make a minion skirmishing that Elf strength -3.

name: Haldir, Emissary of the Galadhrim
subtitle: Emissary of the Galadhrim
lore: 'In days of old, my people stood beside the King of Gondor – we come to honor that allegiance.'
text: While no opponent controls a site, Haldir is strength +2. Regroup: Exert Haldir at a battleground and exert another Elf to liberate a site.

name: Killing Field
lore: The courage of the defenders blunted the Uruk assaults.
text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Plays to your support area. Each wounded minion is prevented from being fierce. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.

name: Legolas, Dauntless Hunter
subtitle: Dauntless Hunter
lore: 'They are far, far away.... I know in my heart that they have not rested this night.'
text: Archer. The twilight cost of each Shadow event and Shadow condition is +1 for each unbound Hobbit you can spot.

name: Legolas, Elven Comrade
subtitle: Elven Comrade
lore: 'Come, you shall sit behind me, friend Gimli.'
text: Archer. Skirmish: Exert Legolas to make a minion skirmishing an unbound companion strength -1 (or -2 if that companion is Gimli).

name: Lembas
lore: Sam thought that it tasted far better, somehow, than it had for a good while....
text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Bearer must be a companion. Regroup: Discard this possession to reconcile your hand.

name: Lórien Guardian
lore: Haldir's Elven bowmen were experienced defenders of the borders of the Golden Wood.
text: Regroup: Exert this companion to make a Shadow player wound a minion.

name: Lórien Is Most Welcome
lore: 'We are proud to fight alongside Men once more....'
text: To play, spot 3 Elves. Plays to your support area. Each wounded minion loses all damage bonuses. Discard this condition during the regroup phase.

name: Lórien Swordsman
lore: Long, curved Elven steel cut down Uruks already weakened by Elven arrows.
text: Each minion skirmishing this companion is strength -2 for each wound on that minion.

name: Night Without End
lore: 'Would that this night would end, and I could have better light for shooting.'
text: Response: If an Elf wins a skirmish, exert that Elf to liberate a site or wound a minion.

name: Death to the Strawheads
lore: The dark Dunlendings called their fair-haired enemies from Rohan \"Strawheads.\"
text: Skirmish: Make a [dunland] Man strength +1 for each companion you spot.

name: Ordulus, Young Warrior
subtitle: Young Warrior
lore: Ordulus always has an arrow nocked and a full quiver too.
text: To play, spot an Elf. The twilight cost of each ranged weapon played on Ordulus is -1.

name: Pengedhel, Naith Warrior
subtitle: Naith Warrior
lore: Pengedhel can wield an arrow like a short spear.
text: To play, spot an Elf. While Pengedhel bears a ranged weapon, he is strength +2 and he does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Strength of Arms
lore: Elvish weapons were more than a match for the Uruks.
text: Plays to your support area. Each time an Elf wins a skirmish, you may place an [elven] token on this card. Skirmish: Make a minion skirmishing an Elf strength -1 for each [elven] token here (limit -3). Discard this condition.

name: Supporting Fire
lore: Sword-work is made easier with archery support.
text: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +3 if you spot 3 Elf companions).

name: Sword-wall
lore: A fixed line of Elven blades can hold off great numbers of the Enemy's hordes.
text: Skirmish or Regroup: Spot 3 Elf companions to liberate a site or exert a minion.

name: Thandronen, Veteran Protector
subtitle: Veteran Protector
lore: The twin sons of Thandronen marched with their father to defend Helm's Deep.
text: To play, spot an Elf. Regroup: Exert Thandronen to discard a minion stacked on a condition or stacked on a site.

name: Thónnas, Naith Captain
subtitle: Naith Captain
lore: Elves of Lórien hone their knife-work fighting Goblin raiders.
text: To play, spot an Elf. While Thónnas bears a ranged weapon, each minion skirmishing him is strength -2 and Thónnas does not add to the fellowship archery total.

name: Valor
lore: An Elf avoids taking up arms, but once committed to the fray, his will is resolute.
text: Skirmish: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +3 if skirmishing a wounded minion).

name: Behold the White Rider
lore: 'Gandalf is come again.'
text: Plays to your support area. Each time Gandalf wins a skirmish, you may place a [gandalf] token here. Skirmish: Wound a minion skirmishing Gandalf for each [gandalf] token here. Discard this condition.

name: Gandalf, Greyhame
subtitle: Greyhame
lore: 'Dangerous!... And so am I, very dangerous; more dangerous than anything you will ever meet....'
text: Fellowship: If the twilight pool has fewer than 2 twilight tokens, add (2) to play a character from your discard pile.

name: Dunlending Arsonist
lore: 'They bring fire... and they are burning as they come, rick, cot, and tree.'
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [dunland] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.

name: Gandalf, The White Wizard
subtitle: The White Wizard
lore: 'Behold, I am not Gandalf the Grey, whom you betrayed. I am Gandalf the White, who has returned from death.'
text: While you can spot 3 twilight tokens, Gandalf is strength +3.

name: Gandalf's Staff, Walking Stick
subtitle: Walking Stick
lore: 'The staff in the hand of a Wizard may be more than a prop for age....'
text: Bearer must be Gandalf. While you can spot 2 twilight tokens, Gandalf is damage +2.

name: Grown Suddenly Tall
lore: His hood and grey rags were flung away. His white garments shone.
text: Spell. Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to discard all conditions.

name: Have Patience
lore: 'Go where you must go, and hope!'
text: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound companion twice.

name: Hearken to Me
lore: 'Not all is dark. Take courage, Lord of the Mark; for better help you will not find.'
text: Spell. To play, spot Gandalf. Bearer must be Théoden. Discard all Shadow conditions on Théoden. Shadow conditions may not be played on Théoden.

name: Into Dark Tunnels
lore: 'Even Sauron knows them not. They are older than he. Now I have walked there, but I will bring no report to darken the light of day.'
text: Spell. Response: If you play a [gandalf] event, exert Gandalf twice to place that event in your hand instead of your discard pile.

name: Keep Your Forked Tongue
lore: 'A witless worm you have become.'
text: Skirmish: Spot Gandalf and 3 twilight tokens to prevent all wounds to a companion who has the Gandalf signet.

name: Long I Fell
lore: 'His fire was about me. I was burned.'
text: Spell. Skirmish: Spot Gandalf to prevent all wounds to him. Any Shadow player may make you wound a minion to prevent this.

name: Mithrandir, Mithrandir!
lore: The wild men fell on their faces before him.
text: Spell. Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound each minion who has strength of 6 or less.

name: Roll of Thunder
lore: 'I have not passed through fire and death to bandy crooked words with a serving-man till the lightning falls.'
text: Fellowship or Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to discard a Shadow possession or Shadow artifact.

name: Barrow-wight Stalker
lore: The icy touch froze his bones, and he remembered no more.
text: Enduring. Each [wraith] Wraith cannot take wounds (except during skirmishes). Shadow: Remove a burden to play a [wraith] Wraith. That minion's twilight cost is -2.

name: Candle Corpses
lore: ...here and there they twisted like ghostly sheets unfurled by hidden hands.
text: Enduring. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a companion, you may spot another [wraith] Wraith and remove (2) to wound that companion.

name: Covetous Wisp
lore: 'Only shapes to see, perhaps, not to touch.'
text: Enduring. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns Covetous Wisp to a companion, you may spot another [wraith] Wraith and remove (2) to add a burden.

name: Dead Faces
lore: 'There are dead things, dead faces in the water!'
text: Enduring. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns this minion to a companion, you may spot another [wraith] Wraith and remove (2) to discard a condition.

name: Spirit of Dread
lore: ...across their three necks lay one long naked sword.
text: Enduring. While you can spot another [wraith] Wraith, wounds cannot be healed and burdens can not be removed (except by Wraiths). Skirmish: Exert Spirit of Dread to make another [wraith] Wraith strength +1.

name: Undead of Angmar
lore: In the dark there was a snarling noise.
text: Enduring. While you can spot another [wraith] Wraith, each wounded companion is resistance -2. Shadow: Exert Undead of Angmar twice to play a [wraith] Wraith from your draw deck, then reshuffle.

name: Gimli, Sprinter
subtitle: Sprinter
text: Damage +1. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may add a threat to wound a minion (or wound a hunter minion twice).

name: Elven Supplies
lore: By river you have the chance of outrunning the enemy....
text: Fellowship: Remove a culture token from a Free Peoples card to add an [elven] token here. Skirmish: Remove 2 [elven] tokens from here to make a minion skirmishing an [elven] companion strength -1.

name: Gamling's Horn
lore: Sound the charge! Take them head-on!
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man or Merry. Skirmish: Discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4. If bearer is Gamling, you may also spot another companion to make him or her strength +4 until the regroup phase.

name: Precise Attack
lore: Éomer's spear, now thrown, brought down the Haradrim leader.
text: Discard a [rohan] possession from play to choose one: wound an unwounded minion; exert a minion; or discard a Shadow card the Ring-bearer is bearing.

name: Rohirrim Diadem
lore: With Gríma's treacherous whispers removed and Saruman's grasp released, none doubted the might and lordship of Théoden, the King of Rohan.
text: To play, spot Théoden. Skirmish: Spot a [rohan] Man bearing a possession and discard a [rohan] possession from hand to make that Man strength +2.

name: Rohirrim Recruit
lore: Even the older men of Rohan had talents in the arts of war.
text: Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] token, this companion is strength +2.

name: Surrendered Weapons
lore: I cannot allow you before Théoden-King so armed.
text: Each time the fellowship moves, you may spot a [rohan] companion to discard a possession a character is bearing from play. Skirmish: Add (1) to transfer a [rohan] possession borne by a companion to another eligible bearer.

name: Théoden, Ednew
subtitle: Ednew
lore: Now for wrath! Now for ruin! And a red dawn!
text: While you can spot Gandalf, Théoden is resistance +2. While you can spot Éomer, Théoden is damage +1. While you can spot 3 mounted [rohan] companions, Théoden is strength +2.

name: A Dragon's Tale
lore: If you're referring to the incident with the dragon, I was barely involved. All I did was give your uncle a little nudge out of the door.
text: Tale. To play, spot a Hobbit. Maneuver: Discard a tale from play to choose a Shadow player who must exert one of his or her minions.

name: Fredegar Bolger, Fatty
subtitle: Fatty
lore: 'You'll wish you were back here with me before this time tomorrow.'
text: While the fellowship is in region 1 and you can spot 2 other [shire] companions, Fredegar Bolger is strength +3.

name: Golden Perch Ale
lore: 'The best beer in the Eastfarthing, or used to be: it is a long time since I tasted it.'
text: Each time a [shire] companion wins a skirmish, you may add a [shire] token here. Fellowship: Remove a [shire] token here to remove a burden.

name: Make a Run For It
lore: As soon as he saw the dark shapes creep from the garden he knew that he must run for it, or perish. And run he did, out of the back door, through the garden, 'and over the fields.
text: Remove 2 [shire] tokens to cancel a skirmish involving an unbound Hobbit.

name: Galadriel's Silver Ewer
lore: Will you look into the mirror?
text: To play, spot Galadriel or Celeborn. While Galadriel is the Ring-bearer, she is strength +2 and resistance +2. Each time you play an [elven] skirmish event, you may reinforce an [elven] token.

name: Prized Lagan
lore: We are sitting on the field of victory, enjoying a few well-earned comforts.
text: At the start of each turn, you may add (2) to heal a [shire] companion. Maneuver: Add a threat to spot a minion. That minion loses fierce and cannot gain fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Robin Smallburrow, Shirriff Cock-Robin
subtitle: Shirriff Cock-Robin
text: Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you attach this follower to a [shire] companion, you may discard X cards from hand to draw X cards.

name: Scouring of the Shire
text: Tale. When there are 4 [shire] tokens here, discard this condition from play. Response: If a [shire] condition or [shire] possession is about to be discarded from play by a Shadow card, add a [shire] token here to prevent that.

name: Sting, Elven Long Knife
subtitle: Elven Long Knife
lore: My old sword, Sting! Here! Take it, take it!
text: Bearer must be Bilbo or Frodo. Regroup: Exert bearer to remove a threat.

name: Cleaved
text: Regroup: Exert an [uruk-hai] hunter twice to transfer this condition from your support area to an unbound companion. Archery: Spot an [uruk-hai] minion to transfer this condition from your support area to a Free Peoples archer.

name: Final Triumph
lore: Now left alone, it stopped before its foe. With a snarl it pulled back the bow, ready to deliver the last blow.
text: Spot your Uruk-hai skirmishing a companion to use vitality to resolve that skirmish instead of strength.

name: Fury of the Evil Army
lore: What can men do against such reckless hate?
text: Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] minion. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may choose one: discard a follower from play; heal an [uruk-hai] minion; or control a site.

name: Ghastly Wound
lore: That force of ten-thousand Uruk-hai was designed for the downfall of Man – and all those that allied with them.
text: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +2 and damage +1.

name: Lurtz, Halfling Hunter
subtitle: Halfling Hunter
text: Archer. Damage +1. Maneuver: Spot 6 companions to make Lurtz fierce until the regroup phase. Assignment: Exert Lurtz twice to assign it to an unbound companion. The Free Peoples player may exert that companion or add a burden to prevent this.

name: Lurtz's Bow, Black-fletch Bow
subtitle: Black-fletch Bow
lore: The bow of the Uruk captain dealt a powerful blow.
text: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. When you play this possession on Lurtz, you may draw a card. Archery: If bearer is Lurtz, discard 2 [uruk-hai] cards from hand to exert an unbound companion.

name: Gil-galad, High King of the Noldor
subtitle: High King of the Noldor
lore: '...the power of Gil-galad has increased in his absence.'
text: To play, spot 2 [elven] companions. Maneuver: Add a threat to take an [elven] skirmish event into hand from your discard pile. Regroup: Remove an [elven] token to play an [elven] condition from your discard pile.

name: New Forges Built
lore: 'I looked on it and saw that, whereas it had once been green and fair, it was now filled with pits and forges.'
text: Exert an [uruk-hai] minion to reinforce an [uruk-hai] token.

name: Pikes Upon Pikes
lore: Many a crude weapon was forged for his forces.
text: Each [uruk-hai] minion bearing a hand weapon cannot take wounds during the archery phase. Skirmish: Discard this condition from play to make an [uruk-hai] minion bearing a possession strength +2.

name: Shagrat, Tower Captain
subtitle: Tower Captain
lore: I don't take orders from stinking Morgul rats!
text: Damage +1. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) While you can spot 7 possessions, Shagrat is fierce and cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).

name: Tracking the Prize
lore: Though bred for battle, the Uruks could track prey like the best of hunters.
text: While you can spot 3 [uruk-hai] hunters, at the start of each skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] hunter, each companion skirmishing that minion must exert.

name: White Hand Attacker(2)
lore: The Uruk-hai army stopped and growled in anticipation of the upcoming battle.
text: Damage +1. While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.

name: White Hand Exorciser
lore: March to Helm's Deep! Leave none alive!
text: Damage +1. When you play this minion, you may heal an [uruk-hai] minion.

name: White Hand Marchers
lore: The enormous Uruk-hai armies marched with great speed.
text: Damage +1. This minion is strength +1 for each other [uruk-hai] minion you can spot.

name: White Hand Marshal
lore: The Men and Elves looked out into the darkness, and through the rain they saw, lit by the thousands of torches, the huge advancing Uruk-hai army.
text: Damage +1. Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may control a site.

name: White Hand Mystic
lore: The Uruk-hai... resilient... imposing....
text: Damage +1. Response: If an [uruk-hai] minion is about to take a wound, exert this minion to prevent that wound.

name: White Hand Sieger
lore: The flood of Uruk-hai storming the Deeping Wall seemed to be unstoppable.
text: Damage +1. To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion and you must control a site.

name: Glorfindel, Eldarin Lord
subtitle: Eldarin Lord
lore: 'Yet oft in lies truth is hidden....'
text: Ranger. To play, spot 2 [elven] companions. Minions skirmishing Glorfindel cannot gain strength bonuses from possessions. Each time Glorfindel wins a skirmish, you may remove a threat.

name: White Hand Traveler
lore: The Uruk-hai troop snuck along through the forest following the three boats carrying the Fellowship.
text: Damage +1. Skirmish: Spot 2 other [uruk-hai] minions and remove (2) to make this minion strength +1 and damage +1.

name: White Hand Uruk
text: Damage +1. To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion.

name: All Life Flees
lore: A sudden unreasoning fear of discovery laid hold of Frodo, and he thought of his Ring.
text: To play, spot a Nazgûl. Remove (X) to choose one: discard a follower from play that has a twilight cost of X; or play from deck a [wraith] minion that has a twilight cost of X.

name: Pull of the Ring
lore: I'm naked in the dark. There's nothing, no veil between me and the Wheel of Fire. I can see him with my waking eyes!
text: Remove a burden to choose one: assign a [wraith] minion to a companion who has resistance 0; or have a [wraith] minion lose fierce and gain hunter 2 until the regroup phase.

name: Doorway to Doom
text: Mountain. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player wounds two of his or her characters.

name: Foot of Mount Doom
text: Mountain. Each card that is about to be placed into the discard pile is removed from the game instead.

name: Mithlond
text: River. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player heals each of his or her characters.

name: Morannon Plains
text: Battleground. Plains. When the fellowship moves to this site, each player may reinforce a culture token.

name: Sirannon Ruins
text: River.

name: Steward's Tomb
text: Wounds cannot be prevented or healed. Burdens cannot be removed.

name: Haldir, Warrior Messenger
subtitle: Warrior Messenger
lore: I bring word from Elrond of Rivendell.
text: Skirmish: Exert Haldir or discard an [elven] card from hand to make a minion skirmishing Haldir strength -2.

name: Streets of Bree
text: Dwelling. While the fellowship is at this site, followers cannot be transferred to a character.

name: Lembas Bread
lore: Sam thought that it tasted far better, somehow, than it had for a good while....
text: To play, spot 2 [elven] companions. Bearer must be a companion. Regroup: Discard this possession from play to reconcile your hand.

name: Miruvóre
lore: The long years have passed like swift draughts of sweet mead in lofty halls beyond the West....
text: Add 2 threats to heal an [elven] companion.

name: Woodhall Elf, Exile
subtitle: Exile
lore: 'Go not to the Elves for counsel, for they will say both no and yes.'
text: Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) When you transfer this to an [elven] companion, you may draw 3 cards.

name: Beorning Axe
lore: No Orc or wolf dared enter the land of the Beornings.
text: Bearer must be a [gandalf] Man. While Grimbeorn is bearing this possession, each time he wins a skirmish, you may take a [gandalf] card from your discard pile into hand.

name: Drawn to Full Height
lore: I am not trying to rob you. I'm trying to help you.
text: Spell. Spot a [gandalf] Wizard to make a minion lose all strength bonuses from possessions.

name: Run Until Found
lore: Let us hunt some Orc!
text: When you play this condition, place a [dwarven] token here. Skirmish: Discard this condition from play or remove a [dwarven] token from here to make a [dwarven] companion gain hunter 1.

name: Ents Marching
lore: The old that is strong does not wither; Deep roots are not reached by the frost.
text: If the fellowship is in region 1 or region 2, exert 2 Ents to make an Ent defender +1 until the regroup phase. If the fellowship is in region 3, spot a [gandalf] companion to draw a card.

name: Last Stand
lore: To give his people time to escape, Brand stood against the Mordor army until he was slain. His friend, the dwarf Dáin Ironfoot, stood over him until he too was 'slain.
text: Fellowship: Exert a [gandalf] Man to add 2 [gandalf] tokens here. Skirmish: Remove 3 [gandalf] tokens from here to make a companion strength +3.

name: Librarian, Keeper of Ancient Texts
subtitle: Keeper of Ancient Texts
lore: A guide through books and scrolls from floor to ceiling.
text: While you can spot 2 [gandalf] tokens, each of your [gandalf] Men is strength +2. Regroup: Discard a follower from play to choose one: draw a card; or take a [gandalf] skirmish event from your discard pile into hand.

name: One-Upsmanship
lore: Gandalf regarded the smoke ring for a moment, sucked his cheeks in, and blew out a majestic, full-rigged ship that sailed right through the ring.
text: Spell. Spot 2 pipeweed cards to remove a burden for each [gandalf] Wizard you can spot.

name: Our Time
lore: All we have to decide is what to do with the time that is given to us.
text: Spell. To play, exert Gandalf. When you play this condition, remove (3). At the start of the maneuver phase, add (4) and remove this condition from the game.

name: Perspective
lore: Hobbits really are amazing creatures! You can learn all that there is to know about their ways in a month, and yet after a hundred years, they can still 'surprise you.
text: Maneuver: Add 2 threats and spot a Wizard to spot a minion in play. That minion cannot use special abilities until the regroup phase.

name: Radagast's Herb Bag
lore: The tools of a master of herb and beast-lore were often confined to the simplest of places.
text: Bearer must be a [gandalf] Wizard. Each time you play a [gandalf] spell, you may exert bearer to wound a minion.

name: Ship of Smoke
lore: Old Toby. The finest weed in the Southfarthing.
text: Pipeweed. Each time you play a pipeweed card, you may spot Gandalf to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all Free Peoples cards revealed into hand and discard the remaining cards.

name: Countless Cords
lore: 'But don't go on, master! Don't go down to that den! Now's our only chance. Now let's get out of this foul hole!'
text: Spot Shelob to make a minion strength +1 for each threat you can spot.

name: Deceit
lore: Presently they were under the shadow, and there in the midst of it they saw the opening of a cave. 'This is the way in,' said Gollum softly.
text: Response: If a Free Peoples player's card is about to discard your other [gollum] condition, remove (1) to prevent that.

name: Thorin's Harp
text: Tale. Maneuver: Exert a [dwarven] companion to make the fellowship's current site gain mountain until the regroup phase.

name: Enemy in Your Midst
lore: Earning pity and trust was the first step of Gollum's plan to reclaim his precious.
text: Heal a Ring-bound companion to reinforce a [gollum] token.

name: It Draws Him
lore: He will never be rid of his need for it. He hates and loves the Ring, as he hates and loves himself.
text: Spot a [gollum] card to play a minion. Its twilight cost -1 (or -3 if it is roaming).

name: Not Easily Avoided
lore: 'But I still feel that they are looking at me, or thinking about me: making some other plan, perhaps.'
text: Shadow: Remove (3) to take a [gollum] card into hand from your draw deck, then randomly discard a card from your hand. Skirmish: Discard a [gollum] card from hand to make a [gollum] minion strength +2.

name: Set Up
lore: He took it!! I've seen him. He is always stuffing his face when Master is not looking.
text: Spot Gollum or Sméagol to return a follower to its owner's hand.

name: Shelob, Menace
subtitle: Menace
text: Fierce. Each time Shelob wins a skirmish, you may add threats up to the number of burdens you can spot. Each time Shelob wins a skirmish, you may play Gollum from your discard pile; he is strength +3 and fierce until the end of turn.

name: Sting of Shelob
lore: Poison frothed and bubbled....
text: To play, spot Shelob. The Free Peoples player must choose two companions in play (except the Ring- bearer). He or she then chooses to place one of those companions in the dead pile and return the other to his or her hand.

name: Time for Food
lore: Oh yes we could! Spoil nice fish. Give it to usss rrraw... and wrrriggling! You keep nasty chips.
text: If a skirmish event is played, spot Sméagol to cancel that event.

name: Trusted Promise
lore: We swears to serve the master of the preciousss. We will swear on... on the precious.
text: Reinforce a [gollum] token. Each Shadow player may draw a card.

name: Aragorn, Heir to the Throne of Gondor
subtitle: Heir to the Throne of Gondor
text: Hunter 2. While you can spot 3 Free Peoples cultures, Aragorn is defender +1. While you can spot 2 Shadow cultures, Aragorn is defender +1.

name: Armor of the White City
lore: Surely this is the greatest jest in all the history of Gondor: that we should ride with seven thousand, scarce as many as the vanguard of its army in the days 'of its power, to assail the mountains and the impenetrable gate of the Black Land!'
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Bearer is a knight.

name: Arwen's Bow
lore: Arwen had skill with a bow matched only by her beauty.
text: Bearer must be an [elven] companion. Archery: If bearer is Arwen, discard 2 [elven] cards from hand to wound a minion.

name: Boromir, Proud and Noble Man
subtitle: Proud and Noble Man
lore: Yes, there is weakness. There is frailty. But there is courage also, and honor to be found in Men.
text: Ranger. When you play Boromir (except in your starting fellowship), you may play a possession with a twilight cost of 1 or less on him from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck.

name: Crown of Gondor
lore: Et Eärello Endorenna utúlien. Sinome maruvan ar Hildinyar tenn' Ambar-metta!
text: To play, spot Aragorn, Elendil, or Isildur. Skirmish: Spot a [gondor] Man with 3 or more vitality and discard a [gondor] card from hand to make that Man strength +2.

name: Denethor, On the Edge of Madness
subtitle: On the Edge of Madness
lore: No tomb for Denethor and Faramir. No long, slow sleep of death embalmed.
text: Each time the fellowship moves from a site, add a burden. Skirmish: Exert another [gondor] Man to make him or her strength +1 and damage +1.

name: Denethor's Sword
lore: But if doom denies this to me, then I will have naught: neither life diminished, nor love halved, nor honour abated.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. While bearer is Denethor, his game text does not apply.

name: Defenses Long Held
lore: Let the armies of Mordor know this: Never again will the land of my people fall into enemy hands!
text: Make a ranger strength +2 and you may reinforce a [gondor] token.

name: Dúnadan's Bow
lore: Well trained and deadly accurate, a ranger's bow was more an extension of himself than a weapon of wood.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] ranger. Archery: Discard 2 [gondor] cards from hand to make the fellowship archery total +1.

name: Disarmed
lore: In a flurry of swordplay, Aragorn sliced his arm off.
text: Bearer cannot bear any Shadow cards. When this condition is transferred to bearer, discard all Shadow cards it bears. Maneuver: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot a ranger to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion.

name: Elendil's Army
lore: ...and on the slopes of Mount Doom they fought for the freedom of Middle-earth.
text: Aid – Exert a [gondor] companion. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may exert a [gondor] companion to transfer this to a companion.)

name: Faramir, Captain of Ithilien
subtitle: Captain of Ithilien
lore: There are no travelers in this land. Only servants of the Dark Tower.
text: Ranger. Hunter 2. If Faramir is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. Maneuver: Exert Faramir to heal another companion with resistance 5 or more.

name: Faramir's Company
lore: Cloaked rangers armed with deadly arrows and swords.
text: Aid – Add a threat. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a threat to transfer this to a companion.) When you attach this card to a companion, spot a [gondor] possession to heal that companion.

name: Arwen's Dagger
lore: Woe be to any against whom she wielded it.
text: Bearer must be an [elven] companion. Bearer may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Maneuver: If bearer is Arwen, exert her to draw 2 cards.

name: The Faithful Stone
lore: Each turn was guarded by Púkel-men stones with their huge, clumsy arms folded across their round bellies.
text: Tale. Each time a non-[wraith] minion is played, you may spot a Man to add a [gondor] token here. Maneuver: Remove 3 [gondor] tokens from here to spot a minion. That minion cannot be assigned to a skirmish until the regroup phase. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.

name: For Gondor!
lore: This city was once the jewel of our kingdom. A place of light and beauty and music. And so it shall be once more!
text: Exert a knight to make him or her strength +3.

name: Gondorian Servant, Denethor's Handman
subtitle: Denethor's Handman
lore: If the personal servants of Denethor were aware of his madness, they were wise to conceal it.
text: Aid – (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.) Each time you attach this to a companion, except a [gondor] Man, add (4).

name: Horn of Boromir, The Great Horn
subtitle: The Great Horn
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Maneuver: Exert bearer and discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4 until the regroup phase (if bearer is Boromir, he is also defender +1 and cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled).

name: Isildur, Sword-bearer
subtitle: Sword-bearer
lore: It was in this moment, when all hope had faded, that Isildur, son of the king, took up his father's sword.
text: Knight. Each time Isildur loses a skirmish, exert a companion. Each time Isildur wins a skirmish, heal a companion.

name: Ranger of the North
lore: This is no mere ranger. He is Aragorn, son of Arathorn. You owe him your allegiance.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. Maneuver: If the fellowship is in region 1 or region 2, you may exert bearer to make him or her defender +1 until the regroup phase. Regroup: Discard this to heal a companion.

name: Ranger of the South
lore: All had swords at their sides, and were clad in green and brown of varied hues, as if the better to walk unseen in the glades of Ithilien.
text: Ranger. While you can spot a [gondor] token, this companion is strength +2.

name: Shield of the White Tree
lore: Tipped with silver, and adorned with the White Tree.
text: Bearer must be a [gondor] Man. The minion archery total is -1. Regroup: Discard this possession from play to make each opponent shuffle his or her hand into his or her draw deck and draw 8 cards.

name: Soldier's Cache
text: Fortification. At the start of your maneuver phase, you may spot 3 rangers or exert a [gondor] Man to transfer this condition to a minion. Wound that minion. Regroup: Exert a ranger to reinforce a [gondor] token.

name: Watcher at Sarn Ford, Ranger of the North
subtitle: Ranger of the North
lore: 'Little do they know of our long labour for the safekeeping of their borders, and yet I grudge it not.'
text: Ranger. Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man with a resistance 6 or more to make that Man strength +3.

name: Back to the Light
text: To play, exert an [elven] companion or spot Arwen. Examine the top 5 cards of your draw deck and place any number of them aside. Shuffle the remaining cards into your draw deck and place those cards set aside on top of your draw deck in any order.

name: Corsair Boarding Axe
lore: Small and light, the boarding axe is ideal for close- quarters fighting aboard ships or in confined spaces.
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. Skirmish: Remove (3) to reinforce a [men] token and make bearer fierce until the regroup phase.

name: Corsair Bow
lore: Not nearly as ornate or as accurate as the Gondorian bows, the short-bows of the Corsairs killed just as well.
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. Bearer is an archer. Each time a companion is killed during the archery phase, you may control a site.

name: Corsair Grappling Hook
lore: A tool equally useful in times of peace and in times of war.
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. When you play this possession you may reinforce a [men] token twice. Each time a companion is killed during a skirmish phase, you may control a site.

name: Corsair Halberd
lore: Long handled and heavy, a single powerful swing of this weapon could cleave through even some of the thickest armor.
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. Bearer is damage +1. Shadow: Remove a companion in the dead pile from the game to control a site.

name: Corsair Scimitar
lore: A largely stylistic weapon, scimitars are favored for their light weight yet powerful strikes.
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. Bearer is strength +1 for each [men] token you can spot (limit +5).

name: Declined Business
lore: During the War of the Ring, the streets of Bree were filled mainly with Southern ruffians and thieves, and Bree-folk were afraid to leave their homes.
text: If the Free Peoples player plays a companion, discard a [men] card from hand to return that companion to its owner's hand.

name: Fleet of Corsair Ships
lore: They'll be in the city in two days. You're outnumbered, Aragorn.
text: When you play this possession, you may add a [men] token here. Regroup: Remove 4 [men] tokens from here to place a [men] card from your discard pile on the top of your draw deck.

name: Gríma, Witless Worm
subtitle: Witless Worm
lore: 'You are held wise, my friend Wormtongue, and are doubtless a great support to your master.'
text: Regroup: Exert Gríma to add (2). Regroup: Remove a [men] token to add (2). Regroup: Remove (4) to exert an unbound companion.

name: Harry Goatleaf
lore: What do you want?
text: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.

name: Henchman's Dagger
lore: Carved from bone or forged from iron, no warrior would enter the fields of battle without a trusty, simple blade.
text: Bearer must be a [men] minion. Bearer may bear this hand weapon in addition to 1 other hand weapon.

name: Celebring, Elven-smith
subtitle: Elven-smith
lore: ...renewed shall be the blade that was broken.
text: Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot 2 [elven] companions. When you play Celebring, you may play an [elven] artifact from your deck.

name: Ill News is an Ill Guest
lore: Late is the hour in which this conjurer chooses to appear.
text: Exert a [men] minion to discard a follower from play (if you can spot Gríma, also draw a card).

name: Mûmakil Commander, Bold and Grim
subtitle: Bold and Grim
lore: With a sound of his horn, a line of Mûmakil appeared and the Pelennor field was filled with chaos.
text: While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2. Each mounted Man is strength +1. Regroup: Shuffle any number of your [men] mounts in play into your draw deck.

name: Ruffian
lore: It works for him!
text: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.

name: Rough Man of the South
lore: Making money and making mischief was often inspiration enough for these louts. The taking of Bree and the Shire was easy work.
text: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.

name: Squint-eyed Southerner
lore: A man of Dunland, this outlaw was a prized agent of Saruman and a spy for the Witch-king.
text: While the fellowship is in region 1, this minion is strength +4. While the fellowship is in region 2, this minion is strength +2.

name: Ted Sandyman, Chief's Men's Ally
subtitle: Chief's Men's Ally
lore: 'You can't touch me. I'm a friend o' Boss's. But he'll touch you all right, if I have any more of your mouth.'
text: Maneuver: Liberate a site you control to make each [men] minion strength +2 until the regroup phase. Regroup: Exert Ted Sandyman to stack a [men] Man in play on a possession.

name: Treachery
lore: This order does not come from me. It comes from the king. He signed it this morning.
text: Spot Gríma to exert an unbound companion. That companion cannot use his or her game text until the regroup phase.

name: Whisper in the Dark
lore: My lord, Gandalf the Grey is coming. He's a herald of woe.
text: Bearer must be a follower. At the start of the maneuver phase, if you can spot a [men] Man, the Free Peoples player must exert an unbound companion.

name: Destroyers and Usurpers
lore: They come with fire, they come with axes.
text: While you can spot an [orc] minion and fewer minions than companions, each companion loses all defender bonuses and cannot gain defender bonuses. Maneuver: Spot 2 [orc] minions to make the fellowship's current site gain battleground until the regroup phase.

name: Frenzy of Arrows
lore: The black fletched arrows of Sauron's armies found many targets.
text: Spot an [orc] archer minion to add 2 to the minion archery total. If you do, you may add an additional 2 to the minion archery total for each follower you can spot.

name: Elven Armaments
lore: Tangado haid!
text: To play, bearer must not be bearing any possessions. Bearer must be an [elven] companion. Bearer cannot bear any other possessions. While a unique companion bears this possession, the Free Peoples player may not use archery special abilities and the minion archery total is -1.

name: Gothmog, Morgul Leader
subtitle: Morgul Leader
lore: Fear. The city is rank with it.
text: Each of the fellowship and minion archery totals is +3. Regroup: Remove (2) to play an [orc] minion from your discard pile. That minion comes into play exhausted.

name: Gothmog's Warg, Leader's Mount
subtitle: Leader's Mount
text: Bearer must be an [orc] Orc with strength 9 or less (or bearer must be Gothmog). Bearer is fierce. While bearer is Gothmog, he is damage +1 in fierce skirmishes.

name: Grond, Forged With Black Steel
subtitle: Forged With Black Steel
lore: Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond! Grond!
text: To play, spot an [orc] minion. Each time the fellowship moves in the regroup phase, you may discard this possession to search the Free Peoples player's draw deck and choose 2 Free Peoples cards found there. Remove those cards from the game.

name: Gruesome Meal
lore: They dined on the flesh of all that lived and breathed in Middle-earth.
text: Make a companion skirmishing an [orc] minion strength -2 (or -3 if he or she is an archer).

name: Orkish Ax
lore: Crude blood rusted steel axes were dragged by Orcs from battle to battle.
text: Bearer must be an [orc] Orc. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may add a threat.

name: Orkish Aggressor
lore: Enraged by Sauron, the frenzied Orcs streamed to the battlefields.
text: While at a battleground, this minion is strength +2.

name: Orkish Archer Troop
lore: ...the enemy is moving. Sauron's forces are massing in the east....
text: To play, spot an [orc] card. The minion archery total is +1 for each hunter companion you can spot.

name: Orkish Breeder
lore: Deep in the Isengard pits, Orcs tended the mud from which the Uruk-hai were pulled from.
text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) Shadow: Exert this minion to play an [uruk-hai] hunter at twilight cost -2.

name: Orkish Defender
lore: 'Many Elves and many mighty Men, and many of their friends, had perished in the war.'
text: While the fellowship is at a battleground or underground site, this minion cannot take wounds in the archery phase.

name: Orkish Headsman
lore: As the free people of Middle-earth fell, Mordor's strength grew.
text: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) This minion is strength +3 for each companion in the dead pile (limit +6).

name: Elven Defender
lore: While they may prefer to avoid conflict, the elves can be ferocious warriors in defense of their ideals.
text: While you can spot an [elven] token, this companion is strength +2.

name: Orkish Skirmisher
lore: Pain. Pain was part of each Orc's life.
text: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert him twice to wound a companion.

name: Orkish Sneak
lore: The Orcs attacked the Alliance, rushing across the field that separated the armies.
text: Assignment: Spot another [orc] Orc to assign this minion to skirmish a non-[shire] Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may add a burden or exert the Ring-bearer twice to discard this minion.

name: War Preparations
lore: The old world will burn in the fires of industry. The forests will fall. A new order will rise. We will drive the machine of war with the sword and the spear 'and the iron fists of the Orc. We have only to remove those who oppose us.
text: Remove a threat to reinforce an [orc] token.

name: Wary Orc
lore: War is brewing. The mountains are fair teeming with goblins.
text: This minion is strength +1 for each hunter companion you can spot.

name: Cast from the Hall
lore: Your leechcraft would have had me crawling on all fours like a beast!
text: Each time you play a [rohan] possession from hand, add a [rohan] token here. Skirmish: Remove 3 [rohan] tokens from here to make a [rohan] companion strength +1 and damage +1.

name: Éomer's Bow
lore: The short bows of Rohan brought down many a foe on the fields of battle.
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. If bearer is mounted, he or she is strength +1. Archery: If bearer is Éomer, exert him to choose a Shadow player who must exert one of his or her minions.

name: Erkenbrand's Horn
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. Fellowship: Exert bearer to play a follower from your draw deck. Reshuffle your draw deck. Skirmish: Discard a follower from play to make bearer strength +4 (if bearer is Erkenbrand, he is strength +5 instead).

name: Erkenbrand's Shield
text: Bearer must be a [rohan] Man. The minion archery total is -1. Skirmish: If bearer is Erkenbrand, you may add (2) to cancel a fierce skirmish involving him. Response: If a [rohan] Man is about to take a wound, spot Gandalf and exert bearer to prevent that wound.

name: Fall Back to Helm's Deep
lore: This is not a defeat. We will return.
text: If the fellowship is at a plains site, exert a [rohan] companion to return a minion to its owner's hand.

name: Gamling, Dutiful Marshal
subtitle: Dutiful Marshal
lore: Summon every able-bodied man to Dunharrow.
text: Valiant. Skirmish: Transfer a [rohan] possession that Gamling can bear to him.
